TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_MIOUNNE_000_1: , have you visited the Bannock on your wanderings?
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_MIOUNNE_000_2: It is a training ground found just outside the city where the soldiers of the Order of the Twin Adder are drilled in swordplay and other martial matters.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_MIOUNNE_000_3: I mention this because an acquaintance of mine─a gentleman by the name of Galfrid─is an instructor there, and I think you may be of use to him. Go and introduce yourself, and find out if there is anything you can do to help.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_MIOUNNE_000_4: Mind you do not stray far from the path─the Twelveswood is no place for merry strolls through the underbrush.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_GALFRID_000_10: Greetings, . Miounne sent word to expect you.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_GALFRID_000_11: My name is Galfrid, and I am responsible for training our Twin Adder recruits.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_GALFRID_000_12: I thank you for volunteering your assistance. The Twelveswood is much changed since the calamitous arrival of the Seventh Umbral Era five years ago.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_GALFRID_000_13: The power of the elementals wanes, and the harmony of the forest gives way to chaos. A great abundance of life has been lost as the strong run rampant, stifling the weak and new-sprung.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_GALFRID_000_14: Though it may not appear so to the eyes of an outsider, the Twelveswood is ailing─its once rich variety a fading memory.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_GALFRID_000_15: For the citizens of Gridania, the restoration of the forest is a sacred duty. And it is my hope that adventurers such as you will offer to aid them in their struggle.
TEXT_SUBFST005_00028_GALFRID_000_16: Listen to their requests, and do all that you can. May the elementals bless your endeavors, .
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_1: Let us begin at the beginning, shall we? Now that you are a formal member of the Adventurers' Guild, we must be sure you have a firm grasp of the fundamentals of adventuring. To that end, I have three tasks I wish you to perform.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_2: Your first task is to visit the aetheryte. This massive crystal stands in the middle of the aetheryte plaza, not far from the Carline Canopy.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_3: As a device that enables instantaneous transportation, the aetheryte plays a key role in the life of the ever-wandering adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_4: Once you have located the crystal, all you need do is touch its surface. A member of the Wood Wailers will be present to offer further instruction.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_5: For your second task, you are to visit the Lancers' Guild.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_6: There is no better place to learn the arts of the polearm. Speak with Jillian, and she will explain the benefits of joining the guild.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_7: For your third and final task, I would have you visit the markets at the heart of Old Gridania's commercial district. There you shall find weapons and armor, and all the various items that an adventurer might need on  travels.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_8: There is, however, more to the markets than buying and selling goods. Speak with Parsemontret, and listen well to his counsel.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_9: The master merchant can be...uncooperative at times, so be sure to offer him one of my famous eel pies. Like so many men, he is much more charitable when his stomach is full. Here, I made a batch not long ago.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_10: You have your tasks, . May Nophica guide your path.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_11: Ah, and one more thing: should you happen to come across any citizens in need, don't be afraid to proffer a helping hand. I am certain they will be pleased to meet an adventurer in whom they can confide their woes.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_12: Granted, the work they offer is unlikely to be of realm-shattering importance─but prove your worth and build a reputation, and in time folk will be more inclined to entrust you with matters of moment.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_13: I also suggest that you lend an ear to the Smith here in the Canopy. The Smiths are trusted representatives of the Adventurers' Guild, and are an invaluable source of advice for neophyte heroes seeking to attain greatness.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_20: Welcome to the Lancers' Guild. I see you brought your own spear.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_21: If you seek to refine your skills with the polearm, then you have come to the right place.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_22: Here at the Lancers' Guild, spear wielders gather to train with one another, and further hone their abilities under the tutelage of our fine instructors.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_23: More than just an instrument of war, the spear is also a tool for hunting, and with game ever plentiful in the Twelveswood, the weapon has been the mainstay of the locals here since before the founding of Gridania.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_24: With the passing of time, our nation became a gathering place for spearmasters from across the realm─many eager to test their mettle against the famed might of our Wood Wailers.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_25: And it was here in Gridania that their myriad fighting styles came into contact, eventually giving rise to the art taught here today.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_26: That spear technique could be formalized at all owed much to the founding of the Lancers' Guild by Wood Wailer captain Mistalle nigh on a century past.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_27: The tradition of accepting students from without as well as within Gridania's borders persists to this day, ensuring that the art of the polearm may not only survive, but also continue to evolve.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_28: Well, there you have it. I hope this brief history of the guild has helped settle any doubts in your mind.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_29: The Lancers' Guild is always eager to welcome new initiates.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_JILLIAN_000_30: If you've a will to enlist, speak with me again and we can begin the enrollment procedures.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_NICIA_000_40: Greetings, adventurer. I see you are faithfully following Mother Miounne's instructions.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_NICIA_000_41: Allow me to offer you a bit of instruction myself. I am Nicia of the Wood Wailers, and I know a thing or two about the aetheryte─yes, that big crystal right there.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_NICIA_000_42: Aetherytes are devices that tap into aetherial energies, and are primarily used as a means to travel swiftly from one place to another.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_NICIA_000_43: Return and Teleport─the most common transportation spells─make direct use of the aetherytes and their connection to the flow of aether.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_NICIA_000_44: And as these devices are found in almost every corner of Eorzea, any adventurer worthy of the name will wish to seek out and attune  to each one.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_NICIA_000_45: Truly, few things in this world are so useful to an intrepid explorer.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_NICIA_000_46: But you need not locate them all at once. Before rushing out into the wilds, I suggest you start with the aetherytes found here in Gridania.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_NICIA_000_47: Should you wish to learn more about the aetheryte or transportation magic, I am here to answer your questions.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_SYSTEM_000_48:
You attune with the aetheryte.
You are now able to use the Return spell!
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_50: By what right does a fledgling adventurer presume to address Parsemontret, master of the markets?
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_51: You think you can stroll in here, bold as you please, and demand my hard-earned knowledge? Hah! A merchant does naught for naught, especially when dealing with would-be heroes.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_52: If, on the other hand, you had some tasty “morsel” to curry my favor, then I might reconsider your request.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_53: Come now, this whole encounter reeks of Miounne's handiwork─and more specifically her baking. Don't look so surprised, ─I smelled that eel pie of yours a malm away. Hand it over!
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_54: Mmm, that flaky crust...just divine. Very well, I am a man of my word. Pay close attention, for I shall only explain this once.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_55: The aspiring adventurer need look no further than the Rosewood and Ebony Stalls. Both are but a short stroll from where we stand.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_56: If you mean to do battle, you'd best be prepared with a quality set of weapons and armor.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_57: Such goods are the province of the Rosewood Stalls, directly south of here. You will be pleased to learn that the merchants of Gridania are exceedingly particular when it comes to craftsmanship, so you needn't fear defective straps and the like.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_58: If it is potions and paraphernalia you seek, head north to the Ebony Stalls.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_59: The shelves there are lavishly stocked by widely traveled Ul'dahn merchants, and I may truly say that I have seen things amongst their myriad wares that I scarce knew existed.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_60: Do you follow me thus far? The first step in any purchase is to select the stalls that meet your needs. Then you may concern yourself with price and profit.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_PARSEMONTRET_000_61: There is little more I can teach you with mere words. Go, peruse the stalls, and see for yourself what wares they offer. There is no substitute for firsthand experience, after all, and I am weary of talking...unless you have another eel pie?
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_70: The conquering hero returns. You have completed my little tasks, I trust?
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_71: The three locations you visited will feature prominently in your life as an adventurer─it is best you grow familiar with them as soon as possible.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_72: And you took the time to listen to the woes of the citizenry? I cannot emphasize enough how important it is to lend your talents to one and all, no matter how trivial the matter may seem.
TEXT_MANFST002_00085_MIOUNNE_000_73: I am thankful that you are an obliging sort, . It is adventurers like you who will win the hearts of the locals and pave the way for those who follow. I pray Gridania can rely on your aid in its struggles to come.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_1: Right, then. Let's start ye off nice an' easy with three tasks what'll 'elp ye get used to life 'ere in Limsa.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_2: Firstly, if ye 'ead down a floor then point yer nose to the west, ye'll get an eyeful o' the great glowin' crystal in the middle o' the courtyard.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_3: That's an aetheryte─a device what can move ye from one place to another in the blink of an eye. Ain't no swifter way to travel─providin' there's an aetheryte where ye want to go, o' course.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_4: 'Ave a chat with the Yellowjacket on guard down there an' ye'll be treated to a lecture on the workin's o' the device. 'Fore ye do that, though, remember to touch the thing. Strange as it sounds, it won't work till you 'ave.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_5: Second on the list is the marketplace. Ye'll find weapons an' armor an' all yer 'venturin' bits an' pieces fer sale in the district what lies beyond the aetheryte.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_6: Don't go throwin' yer gil around just yet, though, or ye'll get fleeced quicker'n ye can say, “Why's me coinpurse so light?” 'Ave a word with Swozblaet, instead. 'E's the 'ead o' the Merchants' League, by the way.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_7: Give 'im this old octant, an' 'e'll treat ye well.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_8: Fer the last o' me 'elpful 'ints, I suggest ye meet some fellow axe-wielders at the Marauders' Guild.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_9: I guarantee ye'll learn a few new tricks fer swingin' that 'ead-splitter o' yours if ye join their crew. Blauthota at the front desk is the one to get ye started.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_10: Got all that, ? Seein' to them three tasks'll take ye on a little jaunt 'round the city, an' 'elp ye work out where everythin' is. Now, I've best be gettin' on. Run along, eh?
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_11: Bugger it! There I go, sendin' ye off without tellin' ye summat crucial. That bloody Calamity's made a right mess o' me memory, I swear. Well, that or the ale... Anyroad, while yer out, if ye 'appen to pass any poor sods what look like they might need yer 'elp, consider givin' their tale o' woe a listen, eh?
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_12:
Sounds like a chore, I admit, but ye never know what interestin' opportunities could be lurkin' out there, just waitin' fer ye to stumble on 'em. Fer example, Niniya over yonder's been castin' glances at ye since ye waltzed in.
Why not lend an ear an' see what she 'as to say? Aye, yer like to find yerself runnin' odd errands in the beginnin', but once ye build a reputation as a  folk can trust, the jobs'll get 'arder an' the rewards more generous.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_13: If ye've the time, I'd also seek the advice o' the Smith 'ere in the Wench. The lads as bear that title 'ave some fine advice fer them what're just startin' out in the profession. An' that, my , is 'ow ye go about becomin' a legend among 'venturers.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SYSTEM_000_14: To leave the Drowning Wench, you must accept the quest “Making a Name” by speaking with Niniya.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SUNDHIMAL_000_20: (-???-)Ah, another novice adventurer. Aye, Baderon has sent more than a few of your kind this way of late.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SUNDHIMAL_000_21: I am Sundhimal, one of the Yellowjackets tasked with keeping the peace in the city. It is also my charge to provide guidance in the use of this device. Fear not, I shall be brief.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SUNDHIMAL_000_22: Aetherytes are crystalline structures that tap into aetherial energies. They are primarily used as a means to travel swiftly from one place to another.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SUNDHIMAL_000_23: Return and Teleport─the most common transportation spells─make direct use of the aetherytes and their connection to the flow of aether.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SUNDHIMAL_000_24: And as these devices are found in almost every corner of Eorzea, any adventurer worthy of the name will wish to seek out and attune  to each one.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SUNDHIMAL_000_25: Once you have expanded your horizons beyond the walls of the city, you will soon find yourself performing the act of attunement as a matter of course.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SUNDHIMAL_000_26: There is, however, no need for unseemly haste. The aetherytes found in and around the city will be sufficient for the present, I assure you.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SUNDHIMAL_000_27: Should you wish to learn more about aetherytes or transportation magic, I will be here to answer your questions.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SYSTEM_000_28:
You attune with the aetheryte.
You are now able to use the Return spell!
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_31: A fine  to you, ! Welcome to the most replete marketplace in the grand realm of Eorzea, where every shelf groans under the weight of wonders borne from all four corners of the world!
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_32: Pray browse the stalls until your eyeballs ache from ogling the overabundance of unbelievable bargains! Now, as much as I would love to elaborate upon the unrivaled quality of our merchandise, I must tend to some cargo but recently arrived at the docks─
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_33: Hm? You bear a gift from Baderon? Whatever could it─ Ah! My octant! By the Navigator, I must have left it behind in the Wench─along with a week's pay and several bells' worth of intoxicated memories!
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_34: I am most grateful to have it back! This tool is a keepsake from my days as a ship captain, you see. Needless to say, your good deed must be repaid, and what better recompense than the wisdom of a master merchant?
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_35: If it is simple and sturdy adventuring equipment you seek, you need look no further than the East and West arms of Hawkers' Alley.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_36: Lest you doubt, each gil you invest in arms and armor will be money well spent. Adventuring is, after all, a dangerous profession by its very nature.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_37: It goes without saying that Hawkers' Alley boasts stalls specializing in the tools of every martial discipline imaginable.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_38: And within but a few steps are bazaars and apothecaries that will most amply supply all your potion and perishable needs.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_39: Our keen-eyed agents procure a frankly befuddling range of wares during their sojourns to distant shores, so it pays to become familiar with the type─and price─of the goods offered by each stall.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_40: Such knowledge will serve you well if your purse is light or your time is short.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_SWOZBLAET_000_41: Ah, but verbal instruction of this kind will only profit you so much. Experience has ever been the surest teacher─if not the kindest. I invite you to explore the markets for yourself.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_50: Ho there, adventurer. Curious about the Marauders' Guild, are ye?
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_51: Any axe worth swingin' needs two hands on the haft, an' has a blade what can make short work of a galley's mast. That's the kind o' weapon our members train to use with deceptive swiftness an' all too predictable force.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_52: Are ye interested in hearin' more, ? Then why don't I give ye the short version o' the guild's foundin' history, an' we can go from there.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_53: It all started with ships, ye see. What've ships got to do with axes, ye ask? Well, buildin' 'em would be pretty bloody difficult without a sturdy tool to lop down trees for timber.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_54: An' since only the Navigator Herself knows when a ship'll run afoul of a storm or worse, it makes sense for the crew's carpenter to carry an axe on board. Aye, it all started with shipbuildin' an' ship repair. What? Am I borin' ye?
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_55: Hmph. As I was sayin', any tool on a ship can become a weapon, an' the axe was perfect for hookin' yerself over the rail of an enemy vessel, lettin' loose in a whirl o' steel, an' generally layin' waste to all about ye.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_56: As more seafarers took up the axe as their weapon o' choice, so did the bloody art o' the marauder begin to take shape─'specially among pirates, where strength an' skill decided yer place in the world.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_57: With an eye to assemblin' crews o' battle-ready raiders, the pirates started teachin' the proper way to wield a choppin' blade to their new recruits. An' that's how the Marauders' Guild first came to be.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_58: But once the Galadion Accord was signed to unite the Maelstrom an' the pirates against Limsa's enemies, the whole game changed.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_59: The accord itself was a dismal failure, o' course, but the Marauders' Guild was never the same─it was taken over, restructured, an' purged of its pirate elements. It had been reborn as an institution dedicated to naught but the teachin' of axe fightin'.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_60: The members o' this new Marauders' Guild weren't no greed-driven cutthroats, neither─they were warriors what sought to use their martial prowess for the good o' society.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_61: If masterin' the axe is yer heart's desire, then ye'll find no better arena in which to practice yer swings.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BLAUTHOTA_000_62: Think it over, then let me know if ye fancy joinin' our ranks. I've a feelin' I'll be seein' more o' ye soon, .
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_70: Ah, there ye are, . Enjoy yer jaunt 'round the city, did ye?
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_71: If ye mean to base yerself in Limsa Lominsa, that won't be the last time ye'll visit them three places.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_72: An' now ye've got some idea o' what's where, ye can start explorin' the rest o' the town.
TEXT_MANSEA002_00108_BADERON_000_73: Ye've shown a good ear fer listenin', . Stick with ol' Baderon, an' ye'll go far.

TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_SWOZBLAET_000_34: I am most grateful to have it back! This tool is a keepsake from my days as a ship captain, you see. Needless to say, your good deed must be repaid, and what better recompense than the wisdom of a master merchant?
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_SWOZBLAET_000_35: If it is simple and sturdy adventuring equipment you seek, you need look no further than the East and West arms of Hawkers' Alley.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_SWOZBLAET_000_36: Lest you doubt, each gil you invest in arms and armor will be money well spent. Adventuring is, after all, a dangerous profession by its very nature.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_SWOZBLAET_000_37: It goes without saying that Hawkers' Alley boasts stalls specializing in the tools of every martial discipline imaginable.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_SWOZBLAET_000_38: And within but a few steps are bazaars and apothecaries that will most amply supply all your potion and perishable needs.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_SWOZBLAET_000_39: Our keen-eyed agents procure a frankly befuddling range of wares during their sojourns to distant shores, so it pays to become familiar with the type─and price─of the goods offered by each stall.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_SWOZBLAET_000_40: Such knowledge will serve you well if your purse is light or your time is short.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_SWOZBLAET_000_41: Ah, but verbal instruction of this kind will only profit you so much. Experience has ever been the surest teacher─if not the kindest. I invite you to explore the markets for yourself.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_50: Welcome to the Arcanists' Guild. It is here that we research and develop the field of arcanima.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_51: Arcanima is the science of employing “arcane geometries”─intricate patterns that map the unlocked mysteries of existence─to draw forth and manipulate the body's aetheric energies.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_52: Ah, but if I am not mistaken, you already possess some rudimentary understanding of the craft. Shall I deepen your knowledge of our history, as well?
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_53: The roots of arcanima can be traced back to the esoteric calculations practiced by the people of the south sea isles. It was these island folk that first discovered a method to express natural phenomena in mathematical terms.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_54: Building on this process, the existing mathematical formulae were further developed into arcane geometries─precise patterns that allowed a practitioner to weave aether into specific magical effects. The mages who invoked this new form of magic became known as “arcanists,” and the school of arcanima was born.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_55: Many such mages, wishing to expand their understanding of the world, took to the seas aboard trading vessels. Upon their arrival in Limsa Lominsa, arcanists found themselves welcomed into the academic elite, and soon secured positions in the realms of governance and counsel.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_56: The knowledge of an arcanist, however, is traditionally passed on from master to chosen disciple. As such, Admiral Merlwyb, counting several wielders of arcanima among her personal staff, became concerned that this exclusionary practice would lead to the eventual extinction of the art.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_57: So, at the Admiral's express orders, an official Arcanists' Guild was established, and funding was provided for research and training.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_MURIE_000_58: The complex and demanding nature of arcanima, however, remains the greatest threat to its own future. If you would continue your study of this challenging discipline, then I must insist that you indicate your commitment to joining our guild.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_BADERON_000_70: Ah, there ye are, . Enjoy yer jaunt 'round the city, did ye?
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_BADERON_000_71: If ye mean to base yerself in Limsa Lominsa, that won't be the last time ye'll visit them three places.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_BADERON_000_72: An' now ye've got some idea o' what's where, ye can start explorin' the rest o' the town.
TEXT_MANSEA003_00109_BADERON_000_73: Ye've shown a good ear fer listenin', . Stick with ol' Baderon, an' ye'll go far.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_1: Let us begin at the beginning, shall we? Now that you are a formal member of the Adventurers' Guild, we must be sure you have a firm grasp of the fundamentals of adventuring. To that end, I have three tasks I wish you to perform.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_2: Your first task is to visit the aetheryte. This massive crystal stands in the middle of the aetheryte plaza, not far from the Carline Canopy.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_3: As a device that enables instantaneous transportation, the aetheryte plays a key role in the life of the ever-wandering adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_4: Once you have located the crystal, all you need do is touch its surface. A member of the Wood Wailers will be present to offer further instruction.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_5: For your second task, you are to visit the Archers' Guild.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_6: There is no better place to learn the arts of the bow. Speak with Athelyna, and she will explain the benefits of joining the guild.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_7: For your third and final task, I would have you visit the markets at the heart of Old Gridania's commercial district. There you shall find weapons and armor, and all the various items that an adventurer might need on  travels.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_8: There is, however, more to the markets than buying and selling goods. Speak with Parsemontret, and listen well to his counsel.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_9: The master merchant can be...uncooperative at times, so be sure to offer him one of my famous eel pies. Like so many men, he is much more charitable when his stomach is full. Here, I made a batch not long ago.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_10: You have your tasks, . May Nophica guide your path.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_11: Ah, and one more thing: should you happen to come across any citizens in need, don't be afraid to proffer a helping hand. I am certain they will be pleased to meet an adventurer in whom they can confide their woes.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_12: Granted, the work they offer is unlikely to be of realm-shattering importance─but prove your worth and build a reputation, and in time folk will be more inclined to entrust you with matters of moment.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_13: I also suggest that you lend an ear to the Smith here in the Canopy. The Smiths are trusted representatives of the Adventurers' Guild, and are an invaluable source of advice for neophyte heroes seeking to attain greatness.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_20: Greetings, friend. You have found your way to the Archers' Guild. Do you seek to uncover the secrets of our art?
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_21: Ah, now that I think on it, you have the look of one who has received Mother Miounne's “gentle” instruction. Very well, I shall give you a brief introduction to archery and the Archers' Guild.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_22: The skills practiced by our archers allow them to gauge an enemy's weaknesses from afar, and turn the tide of a battle with a single, well-placed arrow. Should you join us, you will be taught to do the same.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_23: Archery as practiced in Gridania was born of two distinct styles of bowmanship.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_24: The first was devised by the longbow sentries of the Elezen who once ruled the lowlands, while the second belonged to the shortbow hunters of the formerly nomadic Miqo'te. As you will doubtless be aware, both races ultimately came to call the Twelveswood home.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_25: Though the two peoples began as rivals, they gradually learned to live together in harmony. During this time, they learned from one another, their two schools of archery intermingling to give birth to the art as it is known today.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_26: For a time, the bow was used primarily for hunting. But as the hunters vied with one another to prove who was the better shot, there emerged a group of archers whose ultimate goal lay not in the practical pursuit of prey, but in perfection.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_27: Thus was the Archers' Guild born from the ranks of the Trappers' League.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_28: It is the way of the guild to promote greatness in archery through friendly competition. And the results of our methods can be seen in the vaunted archers of the Gods' Quiver, many of whom spent their formative years loosing arrows at the guild's practice butts.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_29: I hope this gives you a better idea of who we are, and what we do here. Oho, did I see the spark of ambition flare within your eyes?
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_30: If you wish to draw a string with the finest archers in Eorzea, look no further than the Archers' Guild.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_ATHELYNA_000_31: Before you can enlist, however, you must gain the approval of the guildmaster. Once you are ready to proceed, speak with me again and we can begin seeing about your enrollment.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_NICIA_000_40: Greetings, adventurer. I see you are faithfully following Mother Miounne's instructions.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_NICIA_000_41: Allow me to offer you a bit of instruction myself. I am Nicia of the Wood Wailers, and I know a thing or two about the aetheryte─yes, that big crystal right there.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_NICIA_000_42: Aetherytes are devices that tap into aetherial energies, and are primarily used as a means to travel swiftly from one place to another.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_NICIA_000_43: Return and Teleport─the most common transportation spells─make direct use of the aetherytes and their connection to the flow of aether.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_NICIA_000_44: And as these devices are found in almost every corner of Eorzea, any adventurer worthy of the name will wish to seek out and attune  to each one.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_NICIA_000_45: Truly, few things in this world are so useful to an intrepid explorer.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_NICIA_000_46: But you need not locate them all at once. Before rushing out into the wilds, I suggest you start with the aetherytes found here in Gridania.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_NICIA_000_47: Should you wish to learn more about the aetheryte or transportation magic, I am here to answer your questions.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_SYSTEM_000_48:
You attune with the aetheryte.
You are now able to use the Return spell!
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_50: By what right does a fledgling adventurer presume to address Parsemontret, master of the markets?
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_51: You think you can stroll in here, bold as you please, and demand my hard-earned knowledge? Hah! A merchant does naught for naught, especially when dealing with would-be heroes.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_52: If, on the other hand, you had some tasty “morsel” to curry my favor, then I might reconsider your request.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_53: Come now, this whole encounter reeks of Miounne's handiwork─and more specifically her baking. Don't look so surprised, ─I smelled that eel pie of yours a malm away. Hand it over!
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_54: Mmm, that flaky crust...just divine. Very well, I am a man of my word. Pay close attention, for I shall only explain this once.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_55: The aspiring adventurer need look no further than the Rosewood and Ebony Stalls. Both are but a short stroll from where we stand.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_56: If you mean to do battle, you'd best be prepared with a quality set of weapons and armor.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_57: Such goods are the province of the Rosewood Stalls, directly south of here. You will be pleased to learn that the merchants of Gridania are exceedingly particular when it comes to craftsmanship, so you needn't fear defective straps and the like.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_58: If it is potions and paraphernalia you seek, head north to the Ebony Stalls.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_59: The shelves there are lavishly stocked by widely traveled Ul'dahn merchants, and I may truly say that I have seen things amongst their myriad wares that I scarce knew existed.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_60: Do you follow me thus far? The first step in any purchase is to select the stalls that meet your needs. Then you may concern yourself with price and profit.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_PARSEMONTRET_000_61: There is little more I can teach you with mere words. Go, peruse the stalls, and see for yourself what wares they offer. There is no substitute for firsthand experience, after all, and I am weary of talking...unless you have another eel pie?
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_70: The conquering hero returns. You have completed my little tasks, I trust?
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_71: The three locations you visited will feature prominently in your life as an adventurer─it is best you grow familiar with them as soon as possible.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_72: And you took the time to listen to the woes of the citizenry? I cannot emphasize enough how important it is to lend your talents to one and all, no matter how trivial the matter may seem.
TEXT_MANFST003_00123_MIOUNNE_000_73: I am thankful that you are an obliging sort, . It is adventurers like you who will win the hearts of the locals and pave the way for those who follow. I pray Gridania can rely on your aid in its struggles to come.

TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_20: You seek the secrets of conjury, adventurer? Then search no longer, for you have found your way to the Conjurers' Guild.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_21: It is at Miounne's request that you have come? Then allow me to provide you with an overview of what it is to be a conjurer.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_22: Conjury is the art of healing and purification. Its practitioners harness the power of nature, that they might bring about change in the form of spells.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_23: Primitive magic such as that once wrought by individuals known as mages─meaning those with the ability to manipulate aether─has existed since the dawn of time.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_24: It was not until some five centuries ago that conjury emerged from this shapeless agglomeration of spells and charms─an event which led to the founding of Gridania.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_25: In those dark days, the elementals would not suffer man's presence in the Twelveswood, forcing our forebears to make their homes beneath the earth, in the great subterranean city of Gelmorra.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_26: But their desire to settle in the Twelveswood continued to burn fiercely; time and again they sought to curry the elementals' favor.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_27: Unlike men and other creatures bound in temples of flesh, the elementals are beings of pure aether. Recognizing this, the mages of eld reasoned that their talent for aetheric manipulation might allow them to commune with these theretofore enigmatic entities.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_28: It took five long decades, but our forebears finally succeeded. Their reward: the elementals' permission to dwell in the Twelveswood. So it was that the nation of Gridania was born.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_29: Since that time, the elementals have taught us to live as one with nature, speaking to all Gridanians through the Hearers─those mages who are able to commune with them.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_30: And for their intimacy with the elementals, the Hearers would go on to attain greater mastery over the forces of nature. Thus did they conceive the art of conjury.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_31: I hope this has helped you gain a greater understanding of the Conjurers' Guild.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_32: Should you wish to delve further into the mysteries of conjury, then I urge you to consider joining our ranks.
TEXT_MANFST004_00124_MADELLE_000_33: I can begin your initiation whenever you desire. Call upon me when you are ready to take the first step.

TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_2: We have a potential crisis on our hands, and I would appreciate your assistance. Will you hear me out?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_10: Listen well, for we haven't much time.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_11: To the southeast of here lies a dungeon known as Spirithold. It was all but destroyed during the Calamity.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_12: Desiring to offer the ruins back to the forest, a Hearer ventured inside to carry out the Rite of Returning.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_13: Alas, it would seem something has gone awry. Word arrived just moments ago that the Hearer and his guards have been attacked by a towering shadow. Aye, you heard me true─a shadow.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_14: On any other day, I would dispatch my best Quivermen to provide support, but I sent them to repel an Ixali incursion in the West Shroud nary a bell ago.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_15: The timing of these events cannot be mere coincidence. I fear the Ixal somehow caught wind of our plans, and are attempting to disrupt the rite in an effort to weaken the bond between man and elemental.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_16: They must not be allowed to succeed. And so I bid you go to Spirithold and do whatever is necessary to resolve the situation. Please, say you will help us.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_17: I knew you would not let me down. You will have all the support I can muster.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_GALFRID_000_18: Now, we are racing against time, so you had best make haste.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_20: Who goes there? An adventurer, is it?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_21: Here at Instructor Galfrid's request, you say? Thank the Matron!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_22: Doubtless you already know this, but a towering shadow manifested without warning and attacked the Hearer in the midst of the rite.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_23: Most of his party has been successfully evacuated, but five remain unaccounted for.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_24: Please find them, and see them out of harm's way.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_KIKOKUA_000_30: <groan> A great shadow...towering over me... What in the Twelve's good grace?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_KIKOKUA_000_31: A-An adventurer!? Please, you must save the Hearer!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_KIKOKUB_000_33: I am no longer...of use here. Pray help the Hearer...in my stead.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_KIKOKUC_000_34:
Away, vile fiend! Away, I say! I defy you! I defy yooouuu!!!
...Uh? ...Oh! An adventurer!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_KIKOKUC_000_35: W-We were ambushed─ambushed in the midst of the ritual! And then... And then...I'm not sure what happened.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_CONJURERA_000_36: ...You were sent to help? I fear you are too late─the ritual has failed.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_CONJURERA_000_37: I must needs return to Gridania. The Seedseers must know of this.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_CONJURERB_000_38: That thing was no elemental, but a being born of darkness.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_CONJURERB_000_39: The Hearer languishes alone in the depths. You must help him!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_CONJURERC_100_39: Do not mind me... Save the others...
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MASKEDMAGUS_000_40: (-???-)O mournful voice of creation! Grant ye this humble stone a soul, that it may wake to life!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_60: Damnation! He has eluded us yet again!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_61: Oh, fancy meeting you here! How are things?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_71: Shhh! More birds! This makes it how many times today? Seven?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_72: Their movements are beyond our fathoming.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_100_72: They are up to something, that much is plain─the question is, what?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_73: Hmmm. Do you think maybe...they're trying to summon their primal?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_74: I hope not, for all our sakes. Yet we must be prepared for the worst.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_78: Withered. The same fate has befallen Emerald Moss.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_79: It is as we feared: Dalamud's anomaly is affecting life in the Twelveswood.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_80: You mean the disturbance in the aetheric flow?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_81: The very same. The Garleans have a lot to answer for.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_82: The imbalance they have created is plunging the land into chaos, just as Louisoix forewarned.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_83: It's no wonder the primals have started appearing...
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_84: Time is against us, but there is still hope for the land.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_85: We must hold fast to that hope and fight to the very last.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_89: These stupid things happen to be the very latest in Sharlayan innovation! Show some respect!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_91: If you ask me, they're an improvement over that mask of yours.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_92: <sigh> Hard to believe it's already been five whole years, isn't it?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_93: Already? Five years is but a heartbeat in the life of the planet!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_94: I suppose you're right... Now that I think about it, the Twelveswood's barely recovered at all, and the Gridanians still have the same old problems.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_95: Aye, along with some new ones. Just in case the Ixal and Garuda weren't troublesome enough, the sylphs had to go and invite Ramuh, didn't they?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_96: ...Do you ever think about those adventurers who fought alongside us? I do. And then five years seems like ages... I wonder what became of them.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_101: Yet another disturbance in the aether, and freshly manifested at that.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_102: It seems to be emanating from Lifemend Stump. We must hurry!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_000_110: Are you all right? Your eyes glazed over for a while there.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_111: The good news is that the Hearer is unharmed. Somewhat dazed, yes, but whole of mind and body. The bad news...concerns everything else.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_112: Lest you forget, the Twelveswood is the domain of the elementals; it is by their leave that man abides in the forest and avails himself of its bounty. The ground which the dungeon occupies is no different.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_113: Having no more use for the dungeon, the Gridanians sent a Hearer to offer the place back to the elementals by way of the Rite of Returning, which is essentially an expression of gratitude.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_114: Alas, he failed to complete the ritual for obvious reasons.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_100_114: While the poor soul cannot be blamed for this, the fact remains that unless the elementals are given their due, they may well consider it a slight. And the very last thing the Gridanians can afford to do in these uncertain times is risk alienating the Twelveswood's eternal guardians.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_115: But you have more than done your part. We shall see the Hearer to safety, and send for his peers to finish the rite.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_116: In the meantime, please make your way outside and report to Alestan.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_117: Ah, but where are my manners?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_100_117: I am Papalymo, and the tactless woman beside me here is─
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_YDA_100_118: Papalymo and I are surveying the Twelveswood together!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_120: Yda, give me a hand, would you?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_121: Wait. There is something...familiar about you. Could it be that you are...?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_PAPALYMO_000_122: N-Never mind. Doubtless my eyes are playing tricks. Till we meet again!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_130: All this happened inside Spirithold? Twelve preserve us...
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_131: Who was that masked mage, and by what dark ambition is he driven? So many things shrouded in mystery...
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_132: Well, I shan't find any answers on my own. I must needs discuss this with Galfrid. The matter warrants a full investigation, if I am any judge, and that shall certainly be my recommendation.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_133: Your courage has saved many lives this day, adventurer. For this you have my deepest gratitude.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_134: Pray return to Gridania and seek out Miounne.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_ALESTAN_000_135: I understand she wishes to thank you for your efforts on our behalf.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_140: Welcome back, . A little bird tells me that the Hearer and his party owe you their lives.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_141:
A tale for the tavern if ever there were one!
...It is only a shame that I must ask you not to tell it─for the time being, at least. Do I make myself clear?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_142: Until the Hearers have made their will on the matter known, it would be best to avoid unsettling people with stories of walking statues.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_143: Now then, you must have suitable recompense for your valiant service.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_144: For the first half of your reward, I give you leave to make use of the accommodations here at the guild.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_145: Arrangements have been made, so all you need do is speak with Antoinaut whenever you crave the comfort of a firm bed and a soft pillow.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_146: For the second half of your reward, I offer you another path to fame and fortune: guildleves.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_147: Guildleves are records of the various requests we receive from the citizenry. They outline all manner of tasks which ambitious young adventurers like you can elect to undertake.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_148: Gontrant is our guildleve official, or “levemete,” here at the Carline Canopy. I have spoken with him regarding your knack for solving challenging problems, and he is eager to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_149: By the way, have you perchance heard about the coming festival? It is truly a splendid occasion, looked forward to by young and old alike, and one I heartily recommend that you take the time to enjoy.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_150: Don't be too disappointed if the recent troubles cast a shadow over proceedings, however. I fear nothing short of the mysterious interloper's apprehension can prevent that...
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MIOUNNE_000_151: But we were talking about you, . You have made Mother proud. I expect great things of you, young !
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_SYSTEM_000_152: In recognition of your achievements, you are now granted access to guildleves and inn rooms.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_SYSTEM_000_153: As you complete quests and embark on new adventures, the world will draw you ever deeper into its mysteries.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_SYSTEM_000_154: The great realm of Eorzea yet holds myriad roads untraveled and sights unseen. Continue along the path of the adventurer and discover what wonders await you!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_Q1_000_1:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“Spirithold Broken”?
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_MASKEDMAGUS_BATTLET: You are strong. But are you strong enough to withstand this?
Impossible! Never has the golem been so sorely tested!
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_SYSTEM_000_160: You now have access to Recommendations. This feature displays a list of quests or duties currently available in your area.
TEXT_SUBFST035_00129_SYSTEM_000_161: The Recommendations list can be opened from under Duty in the main menu, and will also be displayed automatically when you log in. If you find yourself unsure of what to do next, this tool makes it simple to locate activities suitable for your present class and level.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_001: No! Oh, please gods, no! Leia's egg!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_002: , you must help me! I stepped out of the stables for but a moment, and when I returned it was gone!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_003: I─ What was gone? An egg! Sorry? You are sure the chocobos will lay another!? Gah! You do not understand─the egg is extremely valuable! I must find it!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_004: You will help me, won't you, ? Oh, thank you, thank you!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_005: Someone must have made off with it. There can be no other explanation. I shall scour every ilm of the stable once more just to be sure. While I do so, I should be very grateful if you would ask the others if they noticed anything unusual.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LAODAIRE_000_011: A chocobo egg has gone missing? Hm, well let me think.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LAODAIRE_000_012: Now that you mention it, the chocobos were making quite a racket earlier. So much so, in fact, that I ran over to check on them, almost flattening a passing peddler in my haste. I didn't find anything out of the ordinary, though.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LAODAIRE_000_013: Hm? Could I describe the peddler? Oh...he was an Elezen fellow─didn't recognize his face. Seemed awfully twitchy. Oh gods, you don't think he...? Why in the hells didn't I accost him!?
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_BERNARD_000_021: Have I seen any odd characters about? Aside from yourself, you mean? Not that I recall.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_BERNARD_000_022: I did see someone calming the birds, but only from a distance. I assumed it was Luquelot...
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_BERNARD_000_023: But if you say he was away from the stables at the time...then who was that with the chocobos?
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_EWMOND_000_031: See anyone actin' suspicious? I most certainly did, . A man, it was, runnin' off towards the Tam-Tara Deepcroft.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_EWMOND_000_032: Hm? You say an egg was took? Then I'd say that there was yer culprit.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_EWMOND_000_033: But why would anyone pinch a chocobo egg? Without the proper learnin', it's damn near impossible to get one to hatch.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_041: There can be no mistake, then. The egg was indeed stolen.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_042: And from what you have told me, this was no simple robbery.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_043: That the culprit should take only Leia's egg and disregard all the rest tells me we are dealing with someone well versed in chocobo breeding. I am sorry to say that the individual in question is like to be a citizen of my native Ishgard.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_044: Leia, you see, is of the bloodline of Ouranos─one of the greatest birds ever to grace an Ishgardian stable.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_045: Many a man in my homeland would give his right arm to possess one of Leia's eggs... Gods, I should have foreseen this! We must give chase at once!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_046: Hold your chocobos, Luquelot! If this egg thief's from Ishgard, like you say, why'd he go runnin' off towards the Tam-Tara Deepcroft? Unless I've got me mental map upside down, that's the opposite direction.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_047: W-Well, yes, but...he may seek to lay a false trail, or...uh... Bah! The why of it is not important! Leia's egg is all that matters! Adventurer, I beg of you, hunt the scoundrel down and take back what he stole!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_048: Well, at least you ain't plannin' on chasin' after him yourself...wherever he's from.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_049: We may work wonders with our birds, , but acts of derrin'-do ain't exactly our field. If you don't mind, we'll leave that end of things to you.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_050: With luck, you may catch the thief on the road to the Tam-Tara Deepcroft, but do be careful─we cannot be certain he is working alone in this.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_JANREMI_000_061: <pant> <wheeze> I have caught you at last, you spiteful imp! Now hand over the egg!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KUPULUKOPO_000_062: You can't have it, kupo! This egg belongs to Luquelot!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_JANREMI_000_063: Who in Halone's bloody fury are you? Ah, those sops at Bentbranch hired themselves an adventurer, did they?
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_JANREMI_000_064: Yet another complication. This farce has gone on long enough. Kill the moogle and the farmers' hireling, and bring me that damned egg!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KUPULUKOPO_000_072: What's that, kupo? How did I come to be out here?
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KUPULUKOPO_000_073: Ah, well, this egg here is Leia's. Leia is a very special chocobo, in case you didn't know. Anyway, I was having a nap in the stables when that nasty fellow crept in and tried to steal it, kupo!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KUPULUKOPO_000_074: So I snatched it up as quickly as I could and made a run for it. I was planning to take it back to Bentbranch Meadows myself, but it might be safer if you did it. I'm sure Luquelot will be very happy to see you, kupo!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_081: Do you have the egg!? Is it safe!?
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_082: Yes, it has the right coloring, the right weight... It is most definitely Leia's egg.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_083: I know not how to thank you.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_084: You had me worried for a bit there, . 'Tis good to see you and the egg back safe and sound.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_085: ...So I was correct in my assumption that an Ishgardian was involved─albeit one who did not, in fact, make off with the egg. Well, I could hardly have anticipated the intervention of a moogle!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_086: Bugger me... It couldn't be the same one...could it?
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_087: Might you have encountered our unlikely savior before, Keitha?
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_088: Could be, aye. One of 'em saved my hide back when the Calamity struck.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_089: I was in a part of the woods what we now call the Standin' Corses that day. Seemed like the whole bleedin' forest was ablaze, and I couldn't see a yalm in front of me for all the smoke. Well-nigh given up hope, I had.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_090: Then, all of a sudden, a moogle appears out of nowhere, tugs at me smolderin' sleeve, and leads me straight to a bit of the wood where the fire hadn't taken hold.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_091: And now you know why the business is named “Moogle's Gift Mounts.” Seemed like the least I could do. I'd be dead if it weren't for that plucky little bugger.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_092: Incredible. It may well be that the moogle has stood vigil over us ever since that day...
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_KEITHA_000_093: Ha! We'd better get back to work, then. Wouldn't want to go lettin' our guardian angel down, would we? , you have our thanks. Oh, and I believe Luquelot wants to give you a little somethin' for your troubles.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_111: Leia's egg is irreplaceable. I cannot well express to you the depth of my gratitude.
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_LUQUELOT_000_112: And yet, I find that I am still troubled... While this whole regrettable episode unfolded, I bore witness to a sight that greatly concerned me...
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_INSTANCE_BATTLE_YES:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“Leia's Legacy”?
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_JANREMI_BATTLETALK_: You'll feel this one, you obstinate cur!
TEXT_SUBFST055_00161_MOOGLE_BATTLETALK_0: You'll not have Leia's egg, kupo!
Look out! He's up to something extra nasty, kupo!
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_MONRANGUIN_000_1: Such an embarrassing turn of events... I sent a recruit from the Bannock on a surveying expedition only for the craven to turn tail and flee at the first sign of trouble.
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_MONRANGUIN_000_2: This is not how we treat requests from the conjurers! And as if such a poor showing weren't bad enough, the lily-livered half-wit left behind the surveying equipment provided by Hearer Pauline herself!
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_MONRANGUIN_000_3: While I attempt to instill some backbone into this so-called “soldier,” would you mind recovering the survey gear and returning it to Hearer Pauline at Gabineaux's Bower?
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_MONRANGUIN_000_4: According to my recruit's tale of woe, there should be a set of survey records, a surveyor's rope, and two boxes of surveyor's instruments strewn about the interior of a cave to the south of here. <sigh> It's a wonder the damn fool didn't lose his boots... Ahem. Matron watch over you.
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_PAULINE_000_10: Yes, may I assist you with some matter?
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_PAULINE_000_11: Oh? But this is the equipment I left with the soldiers of the Bannock...
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_PAULINE_000_12:
Fled at the first sign of danger, you say? I see...
Well, all is not lost: it appears the recruit managed to complete the surveying assignment. The records are actually quite detailed.
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_PAULINE_000_13: With the changes wrought by the Calamity, I thought it wise to send the Order of the Twin Adder on a number of expeditions to map the region's topography. As fortune would have it, the officers saw these tasks as an excellent opportunity to train inexperienced soldiers.
TEXT_SUBFST038_00175_PAULINE_000_14: We can no longer rely on our past knowledge of the Twelveswood. If we are to survive these troubled times, we must reacquaint ourselves with our surroundings, that we may better discern the threats we face. Stay vigilant, adventurer.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_MIOUNNE_000_1: How is my favorite fresh-faced adventurer? Oh, do not scowl so─I speak out of habit. You've come a long way since first you walked through my door, and I'll not deny it.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_MIOUNNE_000_2: As a matter of fact, I think it's about time you made yourself useful at Bentbranch Meadows in the Central Shroud.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_MIOUNNE_000_3: Unlike the recruits you see at the Bannock, the men and women out at Bentbranch are fully occupied with their own work. As such, I imagine there are more than a few who would welcome the assistance of a rapidly maturing adventurer like yourself.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_MIOUNNE_000_4: Bentbranch is also home to a very usefully situated aetheryte. It is, in other words, the perfect place for you to begin the next stage of your journey as an adventurer.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_MIOUNNE_000_5: And what better time than the present!? Leave the city via the Blue Badger Gate, and continue to the southwest until you come to a bridge.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_MIOUNNE_100_5: Cross it, and when you spy an aetheryte in the distance, you may congratulate yourself on having successfully found Bentbranch Meadows.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_MIOUNNE_101_5: If you so fancy, you may also make use of the chocobo porter service, doubtless the safest way to get to your destination. Chocobokeep Cingur should not hesitate to lend his birds to a capable adventurer like you.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_MIOUNNE_000_6: Oh, and be sure to introduce yourself to Keitha, the head chocobo wrangler, when you arrive.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_KEITHA_000_10: You must be the 'venturer Miounne sent word about. I'm Keitha, head wrangler 'round these parts.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_KEITHA_000_11: I've heard many and more things about you─good things, lest you worry.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_KEITHA_000_12: When the Elder Seedseer bade us welcome 'venturers, 'tis fair to say we had our doubts─till hardworkin' folk like yourself set about provin' us wrong, that is. Consider me a convert!
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_KEITHA_000_13: Anyroad, you've a mind to help out at the ranch, have you? Good. We could always do with a hand or two to keep the place runnin' smoothly.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_KEITHA_000_14: As a matter of fact, I've a task right here that wants doin'.
TEXT_SUBFST027_00176_KEITHA_000_15: Let me know when you're ready to get busy. Oh, and you come highly recommended, so don't go lettin' no one down, eh?
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_GALFRID_000_1: I see you are eager to lend a hand, . That is well. But I cannot in good conscience send you into the forest until I have established that your equipment is equal to the task.
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_GALFRID_000_2: It bears repeating that, in the five years since the dawn of the Seventh Umbral Era, many of the Twelveswood's creatures have transformed into vicious, bloodthirsty monsters. Venturing into the forest without the proper gear is tantamount to suicide.
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_GALFRID_000_3: I suggest you take some time to evaluate your equipment. Once you deem your armor to be of sufficient quality, present yourself to me for inspection.
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_SYSTEM_000_4: Equip your head, body, hands, legs, and feet with gear of item level 5 or above before returning to speak with Galfrid.
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_GALFRID_000_10: Ready for inspection are we? Right, then! Eyes forward! Back straight!
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_GALFRID_000_11: Hmmm... Yes, I think you pass muster.
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_GALFRID_000_12: You would be surprised at how many young, promising soldiers get themselves killed by rushing off into the woods without first donning a decent set of armor.
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_GALFRID_000_13: Your equipment, however, should provide the required degree of protection. Consider yourself ready for duty, .
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_GALFRID_000_14: <sigh> You may as well be strolling around in your nameday suit. Come back when you've acquired some sturdier gear.
TEXT_SUBFST045_00201_SYSTEM_000_15: Equip your head, body, hands, legs, and feet with gear of item level 5 or above before returning to speak with Galfrid.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_5: I thank ye fer takin' the time to 'elp me out. Now, I'm sure yer busy, so I'll come straight to the point.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_6: Word 'as it some suspicious-lookin' buggers 'ave been sneakin' in an' out o' the Sastasha Seagrot, an' I need a trustworthy sort to 'ead up north of Aleport an' find out who they are an' what they're up to.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_7: Don't sound like much, I know...
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_8: But since that nasty business over in Swiftperch, folk've been a bit uneasy. Well, I say “a bit”... 'Tis all they can do not to soil 'emselves every time the bloody floorboards creak.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_9: But it weren't so long ago as the fishbacks' pet pirates paid us an unwelcome visit, an' folk are feelin' a bit nervous.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_10: If you would permit me, Master Baderon, I should be happy to elaborate.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_11: Well, well, if it ain't the chief Yellowjacket 'imself. To what do I owe this rare honor, Commodore Reyner? Come to make sure me patrons are behavin'─or just thirsty?
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_12: Neither, in fact. I came to welcome  back to Limsa Lominsa. It is well you have returned.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_13: Neither, in fact. I was informed that you had requested an adventurer to assist in my investigation, and I came to offer what information I could sift from recent reports.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_14: Over the course of the past moon, there have been several sightings of an unfamiliar vessel off the coast of Aleport, in the vicinity of the Isles of Umbra.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_15: This information came to my attention no more than a few weeks after a squad of my own soldiers had completed a routine patrol of the region, the Sastasha Seagrot included.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_16: Their search revealed little, save that a family of coeurls had taken up residence in the caves. Nothing to concern us, in short.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_17: In light of recent developments, however, it would seem wise to search Sastasha again.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_18: But with the Sahagin testing our defenses daily, I am loath to assign the task to the limited forces at my disposal. Our line is stretched as it is.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_19: Thus I sought the services of a competent adventurer to conduct an investigation in our stead. Any aid you can offer in this matter would be greatly appreciated.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_REYNER_000_21: Sastasha is located in western La Noscea. For more detailed instructions on how to reach the place, I suggest you consult V'mellpa. She can be found at the ferry docks on the lower decks.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_22: You 'eard the man! Good luck to ye, !
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_VMELLPA_000_25: You're here about Commodore Reyner's investigation? Then you'll want to board a ferry bound for Aleport.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_VMELLPA_000_26: Once you arrive in western La Noscea, though, you'd best pay a visit to the Hall of the Novice before you blunder into Sastasha.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_VMELLPA_100_26: The Adventurers' Guild runs the Hall, and the folk there will prepare you─train you with the skills you'll need to face the dangers undoubtedly waiting for you in the Seagrot.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_VMELLPA_100_27: The Hall is on the way to Sastasha, just north of Aleport. Head inside and one of their seasoned adventurers will take you in hand. Best of luck to you, friend!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_VMELLPA_000_27: No matter what they've told you, be ready for pirates. There's never any shortage of the bastards. This is Limsa Lominsa we're talking about...
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AIDE00675_100_30: Ah, you must be the adventurer of whom the Yellowjackets sent word. I hear you are to brave the depths of the Sastasha Seagrot.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AIDE00675_100_31: The occupants of those caves are rumored to be as numerous as they are bloodthirsty. No matter what the epic tales would have you believe, strolling into such a den of savagery alone would be the height of foolishness. No, you shall need companions.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AIDE00675_100_32: And you shall need the training we here at the Hall of the Novice can provide! I strongly suggest that you study the fundamentals of group combat before continuing on your mission.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AIDE00675_101_32: The Smith here oversees the training schedules. Speak with him, and you can register for exercises tailored to your particular field of expertise.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AIDE00675_100_33: When you have mastered all that our masters have to teach, then it will be time to head north once more. Report to the Yellowjacket scout at the mouth of the Sastasha Seagrot, and he will furnish you with the details of your duty.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AIDE00675_100_34: When your skills have been honed and your mind sharpened, continue onwards to the north. The Yellowjacket scout stationed before the Sastasha Seagrot will have the details of your mission.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_30: Please tell me you're here on Yellowjacket duty, and not some daft sod out for a stroll. I can't take any more of this blasted waiting. You are? Thank the gods.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_31: I assume you already know about the ship seen slipping around the Isles of Umbra?
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_32: We've been on the lookout for pirate activity ever since that vessel was sighted, thinking a crew of cutthroats might have a den nearby.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_33: So when we received word that men of questionable quality had been seen passing in and out of Sastasha here, we weren't entirely surprised.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_34: I've yet to see them for myself, but if this lot belongs to those fishback-fancying Serpent Reavers...
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_35: Well, you can imagine the panic it'll cause. The kidnappings are still fresh in people's minds.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_36: Anyway, your task is to poke around in the caves, and find out exactly who we're dealing with. While you do that, I'll be keeping watch out here...praying you don't spot any blue face tattoos.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AVERE_000_40: What took ye so bloody long, Edda? If me purse was too light, ye might've considered usin' some of yer own bleedin' coin to get us what we need!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AVERE_000_41: Ye've only ever been as useful as the contents o' yer pockets─the gods know ye can barely 'eal a scratch!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AVERE_000_42: We took up the 'venturin' life to take on the big jobs an' claim the big rewards. How're we meant to do that if ye can't even get our supplies in order?
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AVERE_000_43: Hm? It's ─the one Baderon was talkin' to!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_AVERE_000_44: Well, we'll see who gets the glory! This job should've been ours in the first place!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_LIAVINNE_000_50: Bwahahaha! Edda, you're so slow, you'd lose a footrace to a tree slug.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_PAIYOREIYO_000_55: This is perfect for our inaugural outing as a party─wandering around in the caves, turning over a few rocks... How difficult could it possibly be?
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_PAIYOREIYO_000_56: I never expected our first visit to the Adventurers' Guild would yield such a straightforward way to win fame and fortune.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_EDDA_000_60: <gasp> I-I'm sorry, Avere! I came as fast as I could!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_EDDA_000_61: I tried haggling with the merchant, but two potions was the best I could get with the money you gave me. I had no idea how expensive they were!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_ISILDAURE_000_65: Ah, a fellow adventurer. You, too, are here to unravel the mysteries of Sastasha?
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_ISILDAURE_000_66: I have adventured across this wide realm for more seasons than I dare to count, yet still Eorzea manages to surprise me with her beauty and splendor.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_ISILDAURE_000_67: Our journeys are not ended by the attainment of riches or fame. It is an unquenchable thirst for the unknown that drives us into the wilds time and again.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_ISILDAURE_000_68: Even if I explored the world for a thousand years, I would never grow weary of this life.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_ALIANNE_000_70: Grandfather and I are companions on the road.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_ALIANNE_000_71: We travel where the wind takes us, and drink in all the wonders this world has to offer.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_ALIANNE_000_72: Only an adventurer can understand the joy of such freedom─of discovering hidden places and experiencing sights and sounds that few may ever know.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_ALIANNE_000_73: The passing years have begun to take their toll on the old man, but no force save death itself will sate his appetite for adventure!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_75: The fishbacks and their Serpent Reaver lackeys cannot be allowed to establish a permanent base in these lands.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_YELLOWJACKET_000_76: You must uncover the truth behind who or what is lurking in these caves, adventurer. The peace of western La Noscea may depend on it!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_80: Aye, such a task was on the books. “Was,” mind. I'm afraid that ship 'as already sailed, friend.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_81: Ah. Might you be the adventurer who accepted the job of investigating Sastasha?
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_82: Hmph. It would seem that ship has not only sailed, but now returns to harbor, none the worse for its voyage. A pity. We dragged our boots too long on this one.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_EMANAFA_000_83: No matter. The wheel will turn and our chance will come.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_84: You are right, of course. But there shall be no rest till we have attained our goal, lofty though it may be!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_KIKINA_000_85: Not a wink of sleep, great leader!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_86: Our aim, lest you wonder, is to perform such feats of heroism as will earn us a place in the songs of every alehouse in Eorzea. We mean to write a legend which will inspire adventurers as yet unborn to follow our shining example.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_87: Do you have such a goal? Large or small, it matters not. Only have a star to reach for and you will reach higher.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_88: Purpose can sustain you through times of hardship. Keep your eye on the prize, and all obstacles will be overcome in time.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_89: You would not think to stride into battle unclad, would you? Well, goals are as arms and armor for the spirit! I wish you fortune in your endeavors, !
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_90: Back then, are ye? With all yer limbs, an' a tale to tell, I'll wager.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_91: Fishbacks? An' there I was thinkin' ye'd only 'ave to crack a pirate skull or three. Seven hells... Ye turn yer back fer five bloody minutes, an' the scaly bastards've set up shop on yer bleedin' doorstep...
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_92: Still, sounds like ye left 'em in pieces, so I don't s'pose they'll be carryin' out whatever mischief they was plannin'─unless they was plannin' on feedin' 'emselves to the fauna o' Sastasha, o' course. Anyroad, all's well that ends well!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_93: Thanks fer sheddin' some light on this mystery. I knew ye'd get the job done, ─ye always do!
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_94: On behalf o' Limsa, I thank ye fer sheddin' some light on this mystery. Ye've lived up to yer reputation, an' I couldn't ask fer no more'n that.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_95: Now, I'll bet yer dyin' fer a rest, but just in case yer not, I was wonderin' if ye might be interested in takin' on another job? It just so 'appens that I've 'ad a request from our sister guild in Gridania, see.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_96: Seems the forest folk're in need of a 'venturer what can get things done.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_97: Fer them to ask fer 'elp like this, ye can bet the task won't be no skip through a sunny glade. But after the way ye dealt with our fishback infestation, I doubt it's anythin' ye can't 'andle.
TEXT_MANSEA203_00245_BADERON_000_98: Give us a shout when yer ready, an' I'll lay it out fer ye.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_1: Though we seek a peaceful solution to the primal problem, we must needs be ready to fight for our cause. That you might take to the field suitably prepared, I would have you meet with a goblin acquaintance of mine. His name is Mutamix Bubblypots, and he is a scholar of no small repute.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_2: Mutamix is renowned for having introduced a revolutionary method of enhancing equipment to Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_3: The knowledge of this method was once a closely guarded secret, but thanks to Mutamix and his students, it has now been disseminated to the great benefit of all the realm.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_4: It would serve you well to acquire an understanding of the process. For this purpose, I shall lend you a blade. Take it to Mutamix, and bid him use it to demonstrate his craft to you.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_5: Mutamix is ever to be found at his camp in central Thanalan─a place known as the Bonfire. Look for a pillar of smoke, and the way will become clear.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_10:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...?
Who is uplander come to tent-ring of Mutamix Bubblypots?
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_FHOBHAS_000_21: When full of airyself, fighty-tool changes to stonyshine, name of materia.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_KOKOSAMU_000_22: If materia join with other fighty-tool...
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_23: Then bigeyes! Fighty-tool gains power of airyself!
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_24:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Mutamix is reckoning that uplander is friend of Minfilia.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_25: Yesss, tongueflaps reach ears of Mutamix with fastness.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_26: Minfilia wants uplander to see power of materia. Uplander brings fighty-tool to Mutamix, yes?
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_27: Shkohhh! Fighty-tool is unstrong as eating-tool! Make good teachy-show of power of materia!
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_29:
Now eyes of uplander point at fighty-tool, yes?
Pshhh... Shkohhh... Materia join with fighty-tool...
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_30: Fighty-tool gains power of materia! Fighty-tool reborn! Here, uplander take fighty-tool to Minfilia!
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_SWYNBROES_000_31: Materia, strictly speaking, is a kind of crystal. It is created by drawing out the aetheric constituents from a piece of equipment and then crystallizing them.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_FHOBHAS_000_32: Not just any old equipment will serve, mind you. It must have sufficient spiritbond─that being a measure of how fully an item has been imbued with its owner's spirit.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_KOKOSAMU_000_33: When ye attach a piece o' materia to gear, ye imbue the host item with its power. That's how Master Mutamix turned that dagger o' yours from summat as would've struggled to cut steak into a weapon worth wieldin'.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_34:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Uplander wishes to be joiner of materia?
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_35: Then uplander best fill braincase with knowings of crafty-making.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_36: With knowings of crafty-making, uplander can become joiner of materia.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MUTAMIX_000_37: If uplander wants braincase to rattle with knowings of materia, uplander best trade tongueflaps with learny-ones of Mutamix.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_40: Welcome back, . I trust your visit to the Bonfire proved fruitful.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_41: Ahhh...what a remarkable difference a single piece of materia can make! Granted, the skills needed to manipulate the substance are not easily acquired, but one need only look upon the results to realize such efforts are worthwhile.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_42: As I am sure you are aware, the quality of one's equipment can be the difference between victory and defeat. Materia may well give you the edge you need, , so make it your ally.
TEXT_MANFST208_00272_MINFILIA_000_43: Now, it is time we discussed the matter of your next mission. Pray speak with me when you are ready to begin.
