TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_CICIDOA_000_1: You're an adventurer, yes? If you're not otherwise occupied, I've a favor to ask. I've resolved to repay a debt of gratitude, which I owe to the owner of the Coffer & Coffin.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_CICIDOA_000_2: For this purpose, I've purchased from the Royal Plantations a prodigiously plump pumpkin─a particularly popular piece of produce.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_CICIDOA_000_3: Alas, I cannot part this place to procure and proffer the pumpkin. You see, the scheduled shipment from the Nanawa Mines, for which I wait, is late.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_CICIDOA_000_4: I would prevail upon you to pick up the pumpkin in my stead, and see it safely to the Coffer & Coffin. Present this receipt of purchase to Gagari at the Royal Plantations, and she will yield it to you.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_CICIDOA_000_5: I apologize for asking you to attend to this time-consuming task, but I truly appreciate your assistance!
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_GAGARI_000_10: If Cicidoa doesn't come calling soon, this spectacular specimen shall sadly be past its prime...
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_GAGARI_000_11: Oh, so you're to deliver this decadent delight? I can say with confidence that any gourmand would be grateful for such a grand gift.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_GAGARI_000_12: Here is the pumpkin. I hope it meets with Roger's approval.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_GAGARI_000_13: Fresh produce is somewhat scarce in these parts, and as such we are always deluged with demand.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_GAGARI_000_14: You know the way to the Coffer & Coffin, correct? It is beyond the bridge to the northwest. Look for a place where local laborers lounge.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_ROGER_000_50: Drink fer ye, ? Ye won't get better ale or spirits fer yer coin than at me place.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_ROGER_000_51: What's that? Wee Cicidoa asked ye to bring this here to me? Ha! Heh, so even that foul-mouthed drunk knows the meanin' o' remorse. Reckon this is fer the time I carried his drink-sodden arse back home.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_ROGER_000_52: But hells, an honest-to-gods pumpkin from the Royal Plantations! I can't wait to see what the cooks'll do with her.
TEXT_SUBWIL060_00303_ROGER_000_53: The lads here scoff down beastly amounts o' meat, an' it's startin' to tell on their health. It'll be good to get more vegetables in their bellies─assumin' I can get the stubborn bastards to try somethin' new. Thanks fer the help, !
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_WARIN_000_1: Let's get to it then, shall we?
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_WARIN_000_2: Ore wagons pass through this station every day─but not without incident.
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_WARIN_000_3: Wagons coming and going from the Dispatch Yard to the south must pass through a tunnel by Fesca's Watch─a tunnel in which some genius saw fit to put an ore storehouse, creating ideal conditions for a coblyn nest!
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_WARIN_000_4: So now the ore-loving beasts have taken up residence in a tunnel we dug, and we're practically delivering meals to their doorstep!
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_WARIN_000_5: But no more. Inside the tunnel in question, you will find a narrow fissure where the coblyns hide. Use this silver ore cluster to lure out the creatures, then slay them.
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_WARIN_000_10: Well done! It shan't be easy work to keep the tunnel free of coblyns, but our wagons should be able to go unmolested for a time.
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_WARIN_000_11: Disruptions to ore shipments threaten not only the interests of Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern, but of Ul'dah herself. One might liken these train tracks to veins that bear our nation's lifeblood.
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_WARIN_000_12: If only we had more  like you to lend a hand.
TEXT_SUBWIL064_00307_POP_MESSAGE: A soft skittering sound begins to echo in the tunnel...
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_1: Ah, the altruistic adventurer! I was hoping we'd bump into each other. Why? Because the most fascinating piece of news recently reached my ears, and I'm eager to share it! May I?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_2: Rumor has it that there is a vast, untapped vein of ore beneath the ruins of Sil'dih.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_3: But that is not all! Inconceivably, the Concern appears to be entirely ignorant of its existence. And even as we speak, a young upstart─a self-made merchant from Stonesthrow of all places─is moving to claim it!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_4: The fellow's name is Wystan, and he is a very, very ambitious young man. Not only does he intend to secure exclusive excavation rights, but they say his master plan is to use his new fortune to curry favor with the Sacrarium.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_5: Of course, the thaumaturges only consider the opinions of the most wealthy when drafting the laws of Ul'dah. If you would have your voice heard, you must be prepared to pay a sultan's ransom.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_6: One voice which is invariably heard belongs to Lord Lolorito. He has long lavished gil upon the thaumaturges, and some claim that he devises new laws with the express intention of ruining his competitors while protecting his own interests.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_7: Suffice it to say, if Wystan thinks he can compete with the likes of the Syndicate, he's in for a rude awakening. But that eventuality may yet be a little way off. For the present, he is moving ahead with his plans, and assembling a team to survey the site.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_8: I'm told he's at the Coffer & Coffin right now, recruiting able-bodied adventurers to escort his prospectors.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_ZUZUMEDA_000_9: Warin said you were looking for work. Mayhap you should meet Wystan and volunteer for his expedition?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_15: Come to join? Sorry, but you're too late.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_16: Some Brass Blades looking for extra coin volunteered, and the team's already en route to the ruins.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_17: But look, I know it's not easy to find work these days. If you're interested, there's something else you can do for me.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_18: There are these children outside─little ones from Stonesthrow. I look after them when I've time to spare, and so they've taken to following me around, even when I tell them not to.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_19: But what with overseeing the search for the vein, I barely have a chance to visit the privy at the moment, much less entertain younglings. Can you give them these ginger cookies and convince them to go home for me?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOA_000_30: I ain't goin' nowhere, ! I'm too hungry to move, besides, so you'll have to carry me!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOA_000_31: A cookie!? ...Well, if Wystan really wants me to go home, then all right. But I want two next time!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOB_000_32: I like playing with Wystan. He makes sure no one bullies us.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOB_000_33: Wystan's worried about us? Oh, I don't want to make him worried. I'm a good girl, so I'll go home.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOC_000_34: But Wystan always plays with us! Why won't he come out and play?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOC_000_35: Wow, a ginger cookie! I'd better save some for my brother. I know─I'll go home and eat it with him!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOD_000_36: Wystan's kind to us. I like him.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOD_000_37: This is for me? I want to eat it, but then again I don't, because then it'd be gone.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_KODOMOD_000_38: Tell Wystan thanks, and...tell him I'm sorry for getting in the way.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_40: Give the children those cookies and convince them to go home without me. I'll see that you're rewarded for your trouble.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_50: Thank you, adventurer. I only wish I could do more. Stonesthrow is no place for a child.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_51: ...Not that my childhood was much happier. Never enough food to go around, nor work to earn it─but no shortage of contempt from the great and the good.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_52: I remember thinking things could only get better... Yet now, after the Calamity and everything else...for us refugees to be forced to live outside the gates like bloody beastmen is a disgrace.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_53: They say with enough money you can change the laws here. So I'm going to make a fortune and do just that!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_54: I'll buy the excavation rights and start my own mining business. Then I'll give my fellow refugees the work they're crying out for, and pay them fairly!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_55: The mining companies have profited from our suffering for too long. But in their hubris they've grown complacent─presenting us with a golden opportunity.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_56: And we will take it, adventurer─we will reclaim our dignity, and with it our place within those walls.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_BRASSSENTRY_000_57: We found her! We found the vein! Wystan, ye must come an' see!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_58: Already!? Amazing! We leave at once!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_59: You should join me, my friend! Come and bear witness to history in the making!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_INSTANCE_BATTLE_YES:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“Way Down in the Hole”?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_BRASSSENTRY_000_500: Thal's balls, son! A vein of ore in the middle of a ruined bloody city? Godsdamned idiot!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_BRASSSENTRY_000_501: What did ye think was gonna happen? That ye'd strike it rich and get cozy with the Order, while the masters of Ul'dah looked on? No one crosses the Syndicate!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_BRASSSENTRY_000_503: Hah! Finally sunk in, has it?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_BRASSSENTRY_000_504: Well look at this! Not all yer friends've deserted ye, it seems... Lucky boy! Now ye won't have to die alone!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MASKEDMAGUS_000_505: (-???-)O mournful voice of creation! Grant ye this humble stone a soul, that it may wake to life!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_BRASSSENTRY_000_506: Who's that spoutin' gibberish!? Show yerself!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_BRASSSENTRY_000_507: This ain't part o' the plan! Bloody hells, does Lord Lolorito mean to kill us too!?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MASKEDMAGUS_BATTLET:
You are strong.
But are you strong enough to withstand this?
Impossible! Never has the golem been so sorely tested!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_700: Damn, seems I've missed all the fun.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_701: I see you didn't need my help this time.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_800: I would compose a ballad in your honor, but I fear no words would do you justice. The Songstress of Ul'dah herself could not rival your beauty.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_802: I have oft heard it said that a blossom's beauty can move a man to love and long, but I never truly believed it until I met you two desert roses.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_BURNTMERCHANT_000_8: I hear they attacked another caravan...
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MERCHANT2_000_804: Aye, an' business is sufferin' for it. Bloody Amalj'aa... What's stirred 'em up, do you reckon?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_805: Another raid...and I'll wager that caravan was carrying crystals, much like the last.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_806: If they truly mean to summon a primal, we must act quickly.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_AGGRESSIVEGIRL_000_: You wouldn't keep a girl waiting, would you!?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_810: So tell me, where in this marvel of a city might you lovely ladies be staying?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_811: At this rate, grain will soon be more precious than gold.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_812: A result of the uncommonly bad harvests, to be sure...
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_813: And we have you to thank for them, do we not?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_814: Aye, this weakening of the aetheric flow must surely be linked to Dalamud's descent.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_815: And, of course, to the primals.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_816: A fine mess. But we must not lose hope.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_817: Louisoix will know what to do. We need only trust in his judgment.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_818: Truly a marvel of Sharlayan ingenuity... It's as if I could reach out and touch the aether.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_819: Time to focus... No more gallivanting about like before. The Scions are counting on you.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_820: Have faith. Just have faith. You can do this.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_822: The Sultantree? Maybe Papashan will know something of it.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_900: Looks like they gave you quite a thrashing. Can you walk?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_901: It's me. I was too late. Our person of interest had already quit the scene. The General? Very well. I shall be there anon.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_902: My colleagues went to great lengths to provide me with the means to detect aetheric disturbances, but every time I find one, you seem to be in the middle of it. I'm starting to wonder if it might not be simpler just to follow you around. Sadly, I have business elsewhere.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_903: Tread softly, my friend. The carefully laid trap you dismantled was clearly sanctioned by Lord Lolorito. I heard the Blades mention him as they fled. Believe me when I tell you that he is not a man to be trifled with.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_904: The sultana's enemies grow bolder by the day, and I suspect they have the support of outside forces.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_905: Thank you. If you hadn't come along, those bastards would surely have slaughtered us all.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_906: I would speak with you further, but it isn't safe for us to linger here.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_907: Find me at the Coffer & Coffin later. Until then, stay safe.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_908: I shall accompany Wystan and his men. They need protection─and I need more information.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_909: Ah, but where are my manners? I have yet to properly introduce myself. I am Thancred, a humble scholar surveying the flow of aether in Thanalan.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_910: It is an honor and a privilege to make your acquaintance. I hope when next we meet it is under more auspicious circumstances. Farewell!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_THANCRED_000_911: ...Ah. Wait a moment. It occurs to me that we may have...
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_90: Twelve bless you, my friend. You risked your life to save ours.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_91: Betrayed by my own guards... Gods, I was a fool to trust those men.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_92: Lolorito owns the godsdamned Brass Blades. I should've questioned their motives from the start.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_93: Even so, I could hardly have predicted that the wealthiest man in Ul'dah would want me dead for the heinous crime of seeking to change the law! I'm just a merchant, for gods' sakes!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_94: That ruthless bastard! And what of that monstrosity? Those were his own men! It beggars belief!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_95: Well, that's it. I'm finished. If I stay in Ul'dah any longer, I'm as good as dead.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_96: My associates, my friends─gods, even the children may not be safe if I don't disappear. And you...godsdammit, if Lolorito learns of your involvement, you'll be next.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_97: I'll speak with the others and make sure your part in this stays secret. Beyond that, I don't know what to suggest... Maybe you should seek the counsel of Mistress Momodi.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_98: She's helped countless adventurers in her time. Mayhap she'll know what to do.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_99: Go quickly now, my friend. Lolorito's spies may be watching.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_110: Settle down, . You've got nothin' to worry about. No one seems to know you were at the ruins.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_111: Wystan, on the other hand, is now a pariah─about as welcome 'round here as a rabid wolf, poor bugger. Suffice to say, that boy risked the wrath of the wrong man.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_112: Lord Lolorito: chairman of the East Aldenard Trading Company, generous contributor to the Order of Nald'thal, and member of the Syndicate.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_113: Didn't get where he is by leavin' loose ends, that one.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_114: Which is why he ain't above killin' his own men.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_115: Hells, even if those Blades knew what was comin', it's not like they could refuse to do their benefactor's biddin'.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_116: <sigh> Don't let this color your view of Ul'dah, ... It's true that there are some here who ain't afraid to crack a few skulls if it gets 'em what they want. But most of us are decent folk just tryin' to make ends meet.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_117: You know, a lot of people would call you a damn fool for riskin' your life to save a marked man...
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_118: But I believe you did a good thing, , and for that you have my respect.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_119: Listen: you've been through a lot lately. Why don't you rest a spell?
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_120: I'll have the boys at the Hourglass set you up with a room, my treat. Just have a word with Otopa Pottopa whenever you feel like stayin'.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_121: And when you've got your appetite for adventurin' back, consider takin' on a guildleve or two.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_122: We've a lot of requests from locals lookin' to hire adventurers for various jobs. It'd be a good way for you to earn yourself some extra gil.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_MOMODI_000_123: Eustace can tell you more about how the system works, so go and speak with him if you're interested.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_SYSTEM_000_150: In recognition of your achievements, you have been granted access to guildleves and inn rooms.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_SYSTEM_000_151: As you complete quests and embark on new adventures, the world will draw you ever deeper into its mysteries.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_SYSTEM_000_152: The great realm of Eorzea yet holds myriad roads untraveled and sights unseen. Continue along the path of the adventurer and discover what wonders await you!
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_120: If I don't disappear, everyone I know will be in danger─and that includes you, my friend.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_WYSTAN_000_121: I pray you do not come to harm because of me.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_SYSTEM_000_160: You now have access to Recommendations. This feature displays a list of quests or duties currently available in your area.
TEXT_SUBWIL066_00320_SYSTEM_000_161: The Recommendations list can be opened from under Duty in the main menu, and will also be displayed automatically when you log in. If you find yourself unsure of what to do next, this tool makes it simple to locate activities suitable for your present class and level.
TEXT_SUBWIL080_00328_DADANEN_000: It so happens that I've a situation that must be resolved posthaste─and I do mean posthaste.
TEXT_SUBWIL080_00328_DADANEN_001: I'm plumb out of premium product, and my latest order has yet to arrive! If I keep my customers waiting any longer, this could irrevocably damage my reputation!
TEXT_SUBWIL080_00328_DADANEN_002: What's worse, I paid my man in advance for his services. Despite his assurances that it would be a simple affair, I've heard nothing since he departed for Copperbell Mines days ago.
TEXT_SUBWIL080_00328_DADANEN_003: Find Drunken Stag and give him this notice. I cannot afford any further delay.
TEXT_SUBWIL080_00328_DRUNKENSTAG_010: What do you want? Hm? Dadanen's product?
TEXT_SUBWIL080_00328_DRUNKENSTAG_011: He can send all the notices he likes, but it won't change a thing.
TEXT_SUBWIL080_00328_DRUNKENSTAG_012: The Concern has closed the mines due to some incident in the depths.
TEXT_SUBWIL080_00328_DRUNKENSTAG_013: It's a godsdamned shame too─lost a decent haul just over yonder during all the chaos...
TEXT_SUBWIL081_00329_DRUNKENSTAG_000: You'd like a chance to make some money, right? Then I know just how I can repay you for your kindness.
TEXT_SUBWIL081_00329_DRUNKENSTAG_001: Swarms of sun midges have been harassing travelers along the road connecting Horizon to here. It's gotten so bad that the Brass Blades have started paying folks to keep the roads clear.
TEXT_SUBWIL081_00329_DRUNKENSTAG_002: If you find it hard to believe that swarms of tiny midges could be so troublesome, then you've never seen a chocobo driven into a frenzy by one. There've already been some terrible accidents.
TEXT_SUBWIL081_00329_DRUNKENSTAG_003: Do your part and slay a few swarms. After that, let Fufulupa know. He'll reward you for your trouble, and maybe even offer you more work.
TEXT_SUBWIL081_00329_FUFULUPA_010:
Greetings and salutations, adventurer. To what do I owe this─
What, you've slain how many swarms of sun midges!?
TEXT_SUBWIL081_00329_FUFULUPA_011: You have my sincerest thanks! The Brass Blades have been struggling to keep them in check, so your assistance is greatly appreciated.
TEXT_SUBWIL081_00329_FUFULUPA_012: Will you be staying in Horizon long? If so, there is much and more you can do to help here.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_FUFULUPA_000: Pray allow me to enlist your aid, brave adventurer. I would have you ascertain the whereabouts of a missive I sent to Lost Hope the other day.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_FUFULUPA_001: Captain Leofric is stationed there. Ever since he was transferred, we've exchanged letters, but never before has it taken this long to receive a reply.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_FUFULUPA_002: And so I fear that the courier may have met with some misfortune en route.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_FUFULUPA_003: She must have made it to central Thanalan, or the Brass Blades that patrol the roads between here and Scorpion Crossing would have seen something. But, if she made it as far as Black Brush Station, she would have surely delivered the letter by now. Lost Hope is practically on its doorstep...
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_FUFULUPA_004: I suggest you focus your search on the road to Black Brush Station, in central Thanalan. With luck, you will find her quickly.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_SESELI_010: Huh? A letter? Aye, I've got Fufulupa's missive right here.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_SESELI_011: I won't be deliverin' it any time soon, though. Got to tend to my bird's injured leg first. Even the most minor of cuts can fester if ignored.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_SESELI_012: Fufulupa sent you, right? If this is a pressin' matter, why don't you take it the rest of the way?
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_SESELI_013: Lost Hope's just past Black Brush Station, to the northeast. Look for the tents by the river.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_TALK_SCENE00002_000: Kweh! Or it would be, if this tag was being used.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_LEOFRIC_020: Just passing through, or will you be staying a while?
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_LEOFRIC_021: ...Fufulupa sent you all this way because of a late letter? <sigh> The boy is still far too earnest.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_LEOFRIC_022: Despite my demotion, he continues to call me Captain. I suspect he has no idea what it means to be transferred to Lost Hope either.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_LEOFRIC_023: The Brass Blades don't give a Qiqirn's arse about this settlement. No one in Ul'dah does.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_LEOFRIC_024: All here have been forsaken, adventurer. The refugees, their protectors. And you will be, too, if you're seen associating with us.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_LEOFRIC_025: Thank you for the letter. Now, for your own good, leave.
TEXT_SUBWIL082_00330_TALK_SCENE00006_000: Head northeast, past Black Brush Station. Look for the tents. If you cross the river, you've gone too far.
TEXT_SUBWIL084_00332_LEOFRIC_000: As you may have noticed, I'm in no shape to leave Lost Hope right now. So, in my stead, I'd like you to return to Horizon and give this dagger to Fufulupa.
TEXT_SUBWIL084_00332_LEOFRIC_001: Although it's just an old, ornamental dagger, it belongs with the Brass Blades of the Rose.
TEXT_SUBWIL084_00332_LEOFRIC_002: Aye, I should've given it to the boy before I came here...
TEXT_SUBWIL084_00332_FUFULUPA_010: Ah, ! I received word from Captain Leofric the other day. Thank you for delivering the letter for me!
TEXT_SUBWIL084_00332_FUFULUPA_011: Wh-Why do you have that dagger!? Only a captain of the Brass Blades of the Rose is permitted to possess it!
TEXT_SUBWIL084_00332_FUFULUPA_012: Captain Leofric says I am to have it? There must be some mistake!
TEXT_SUBWIL084_00332_FUFULUPA_013: He couldn't possibly mean to tell me that─ No, no, of course not. I am not worthy to wield it.
TEXT_SUBWIL084_00332_FUFULUPA_014: Nevertheless, I shall respect the captain's wishes and take the dagger into safekeeping until he comes to reclaim it.
TEXT_SUBWIL085_00333_FUFULUPA_000: The Brass Blades of the Rose have need of your assistance once more, !
TEXT_SUBWIL085_00333_FUFULUPA_001: Thaumaturges from the Ossuary are presently surveying the Footfalls for ancient relics.
TEXT_SUBWIL085_00333_FUFULUPA_002: As the area is rife with wild beasts, the Horizon garrison has been charged with their security.
TEXT_SUBWIL085_00333_FUFULUPA_003: But Captain Baldewyn sent only a handful of Brass Blades! Despite his assurances to the contrary, such a small unit cannot possibly be sufficient to protect our patrons.
TEXT_SUBWIL085_00333_FUFULUPA_004: I would have you offer your assistance to my comrades. Pray travel to the Footfalls and speak with Totoruna.
TEXT_SUBWIL085_00333_TOTORUNA_010: A bleedin' 'venturer, come to help? I ain't heard nothin' from Cap'n Baldewyn 'bout this. He said trusted men only...
TEXT_SUBWIL085_00333_TOTORUNA_011: Anyroad, we've got this under control─an' besides, this operation ain't got nothin' to do with Fufulupa.
TEXT_SUBWIL085_00333_TOTORUNA_012: Boy's got a stick up his arse the size of a sabotender. It's no wonder the cap'n told him to stay at Horizon...
TEXT_SUBWIL086_00334_NUNUZOFU_000: Hey, adventurer! Mind runnin' a message to Crescent Cove for us?
TEXT_SUBWIL086_00334_NUNUZOFU_001: Captain Baldewyn's plannin' some festivities for the thaumaturges, see, and he wants 'em treated to the finest food and drink. Nothin' but the best for our distinguished guests, eh?
TEXT_SUBWIL086_00334_NUNUZOFU_002: Head west and south to the village and tell Raffe that he's to deliver a bounty of fresh fish to Horizon for the feast.
TEXT_SUBWIL086_00334_RAFFE_010: F-Fresh fish for Captain Baldewyn? Of course, of course! We will do our best, .
TEXT_SUBWIL086_00334_RAFFE_011: U-Unfortunately, we've had a poor catch in recent days on account of the rough seas. More boats should be returning soon, but I cannot promise that their catch will please.
TEXT_SUBWIL086_00334_RAFFE_012: But don't worry, ! The captain will have his fish! I swear it!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_MERILDA_000: You are an adventurer, are you not? I know this is sudden, but I have no one else to turn to.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_MERILDA_001: Last night, a gang of bandits from the Quiveron Manse were in their cups, and I overheard them discussing their plans...
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_MERILDA_002: It seems they've come to collect gemstones stolen from Copperbell Mines. Nashachite, I think I heard one say. They are to meet with their co-conspirator soon, at the Footfalls─
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_004: Illicit exchanges and shadowy dealings! The Brass Blades cannot abide such malfeasance!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_005: Forgive my eavesdropping, ─I came to Crescent Cove merely to thank you in person.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_006: I never imagined I'd uncover a criminal conspiracy right outside Horizon's gates!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_007: We must act quickly if we are to apprehend these thieves! I will notify Captain Baldewyn at once!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_MERILDA_008: No, wait! You mustn't! Oh, gods...
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_MERILDA_009: You must stop him before it's too late! Captain Baldewyn himself is working with the bandits!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_020: Captain Baldewyn, sir! I've discovered something shocking, something horrible!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_021: Someone has been stealing gemstones from Copperbell Mines and─
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_022: Wait, those gauntlets, those boots─why, you're one of Quiveron's men! Sir, that man is a thief and a scoundrel!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_023: ...And? What of it? His coin's good, and that's what counts.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_024: What!? Captain Baldewyn...are you working with these men!? It cannot be...
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_025: I told you to stay in Horizon, Fufulupa. It didn't have to be like this...
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_026: They'd get their Nashachite, I'd get my gil, and none would be the wiser.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_027: B-B-But, sir, what if your crimes are uncovered!? What if Lord Lolorito finds out!?
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_028: You godsdamned fool, don't you see!?
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_034: I am acting under the authority of Lord Lolorito himself!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_035: No... No! That can't be true...
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_035: Why do you think people join the Brass Blades, Fufulupa? To serve and protect? Hah!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_029: We're not the bloody Flames here! We do this for the coin!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_ENEMY_031: (-Ser Baron von Quiveron IV Esquire-)You there, adventurer! Do you remember me? Well, I remember you!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_ENEMY_032: (-Ser Baron von Quiveron IV Esquire-)I am Ser Baron von Quiveron IV Esquire! You killed my brother, and now I'm going to return the favor!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_033: Well, that settles it! It's clearly in everyone's best interests that both of you die!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_041: Your partner is dead and your plans are undone. You've no reason left to fight.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_042: Stay out of this, Leofric! I don't take orders from you!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_043: I may have spared your life before, but if you interfere, I will not show you mercy!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_044: And what mercy will he show you, I wonder? You who have done so much in another man's name.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_045: What are you blathering on about!?
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_046: Every fisherman in Crescent Cove knew about your meeting, you arrogant fool. Quiveron's men couldn't keep their mouths shut.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_047: Imagine Lord Lolorito's surprise when he learned that a rank-and-file Brass Blade was using his name to advance a personal agenda...
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDEWYN_048: He knows!? Seven hells! But I'm a captain, he wouldn't─
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_049: I was once a captain too, remember? And we both know what happened to me.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_050: Well fought, boy. You've done the Brass Blades of the Rose proud.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_051: Captain Leofric! Captain Baldewyn, he...he said that Lord Lolorito─
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_052: Lord Lolorito wouldn't waste his time on a small-scale smuggling operation. This is all Baldewyn's doing.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_053: What else did he say? That all our brethren are no better, and that each and every one cares for naught but coin? Hah! Mere excuses to justify his schemes.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_058: Aye, we've no shortage of greedy sods, some who'd probably sell their own mothers into slavery if the price was right.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_054: But there are men like you, Fufulupa─men good and true, whom the smallfolk respect.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_LEOFRIC_059: Which is why I gave you the dagger. The Brass Blades of the Rose need a leader with honor, and you're the most honorable man I know.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_056: Thank you for all your help, ! The captain and I will escort Captain Baldewyn back to Horizon.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_057: Pray visit me in town when next you return!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_060: Welcome back, ! So much has happened!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_061: Captain─ahem, Baldewyn has been arrested and stripped of rank, which means the Brass Blades of the Rose no longer have a captain.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_062: Until a new one is designated, I've been ordered to serve as acting captain of the Horizon garrison.
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_063: Though doubtless this is only a temporary arrangement, I will do my utmost to represent my brethren and protect the people of Horizon!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_064: Thank you, , for your service to the sultanate. You are a true hero!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDWIN_BATTLETALK_:
It's time to do your duty, Fufulupa!
Time to die for your country!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_FUFULUPA_BATTLETALK: Why, Captain, why!? I trusted you!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_BALDWIN_BATTLETALK_: Heh, you're stronger than I thought!
Damn you both, you're ruining everything!
TEXT_SUBWIL088_00336_SCENE00001_INSTANCE: Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with “SUBWIL088”?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_00: Word has arrived from Thancred concerning our ongoing investigation.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_01: It appears he was able to extract some information from our friend Ungust, the false priest.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_02: He revealed that he is due to meet with the Amalj'aa to discuss their dealings.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_03: The Immortal Flames believe that the meeting will present an ideal opportunity to ambush and capture the Amalj'aa responsible for the abductions, and so they mean to have Ungust attend as planned.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_04: As the Amalj'aa are anticipated to offer fierce resistance, the Immortal Flames have requested our support.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_05: I would have you provide it to them, . Thancred is presently attending to another matter, but will join you as soon as he is able. Until such time as he does, you will be the Scions' sole representative on the ground.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_06: Before he left, he bade me tell you to “save some for him.” Such is his confidence in you─a confidence I share.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_07: When you have made ready, pray take yourself to Camp Drybone and report to the flame sergeant leading the mission. May you walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_10: Ah, you're  of the Scions? My thanks for coming, friend. We're stronger for your assistance.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_11: Allow me to brief you on our mission. Our objective is to capture Amalj'aa and prise from them the whereabouts of the abductees.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_12: The lizardmen aren't aware that their man, Ungust, has been exposed. When they come to the rendezvous point to meet the traitor, we'll spring the trap.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_13: Owing to the clandestine nature of the mission, we can deploy only a small contingent. Every member must count, and so we requested the aid of the Scions.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_14: The rendezvous will take place at the Invisible City. Please make your way there and lie in wait.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_15: We stand to learn much and more of the Amalj'aa plot if the mission succeeds, . Let's make sure it does.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_20: We stand to learn much and more of the Amalj'aa plot if the mission succeeds, . Let's make sure it does.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_Q1_000_1:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“Lord of the Inferno”?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMEPRIVATE_000_41: Our man is in position, sir.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_42: Good. We make our move as soon as the Amalj'aa appear.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_AMALJAA_000_45: What is the meaning of this!?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMETRAITOR_000_49: I'm afraid your little ambush ends here!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TRAFFICKER_000_50: (-Ungust-)I eluded the Immortal Flames' clutches for moons before finally being caught. Did you not wonder how I managed it?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMETRAITOR_000_51: 'Twas almost as if someone was feedin' him information from the inside! Gahahaha!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TRAFFICKER_000_52: (-Ungust-)Aye, your every movement was known to me ahead of time! Hee hee hee!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TRAFFICKER_000_53: (-Ungust-)Now, as much as I'd love to chat awhile, I have appointments to keep.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMETRAITOR_000_60: Put up your weapon, or your comrade's a dead man!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_67: I fear the Amalj'aa mean to give us to their god as an offering. If I must die, then let me die a soldier's death─with steel in hand!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMEPRIVATE_000_70: The lizardmen marched us to their stronghold.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMEPRIVATE_000_71: They're preparing for something...and I for one do not want to be around when they finish.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_72: Damn it all... A traitor in the Flames! What has become of us...?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_000_73: I'm sorry you were dragged into this. Were I a better judge of character, we wouldn't be in this mess...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMEPRIVATE2_000_7: They're going to kill us, aren't they!? Gods, I don't want to die! I want to go home! <sob>
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_AMALJA_000_75: Rejoice, heathens, for your worthless lives shall soon have meaning!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_ADALA_000_085: <gasp> You mean to go and rescue our comrades!?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_SYSTEM_000_80: You are about to be transported to the battle area for the quest “Lord of the Inferno.” This is a provisional measure for phase 3 of the beta test.\Beta 3 only
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_Q2_000_1: Proceed to the battle area?\Beta 3 only
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_AMALJAA_000_90:
(-Amalj'aa Zealots-)Lord of the Inferno, hearken to our plea!
Lord of the Inferno, deliver us from our misery!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TEMUGGZOH_000_91: O mighty Ifrit, Lord of the Inferno!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TEMUGGZOH_000_92: Your humble servants beseech You! Grace us with Your divine presence!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TEMUGGZOH_000_93: O mighty Ifrit! We bring before You ignorant savages who know not Your godhead!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TEMUGGZOH_000_94: If it please You, Lord, scorch their heathen souls with Your cleansing flame, and mark them as Your own!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMETRAITOR_000_98: Wh-What's going on!? Th-This ain't what we agreed!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_AMALJAA_000_99: None but servants of Lord Ifrit may behold the rite of summoning. The souls of unbelievers are forfeit!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_000_101: Pitiful children of man! By my breath I claim you!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_000_102: Arise once more as my loyal minions! Feed my flames with your faith, and all who stand against us shall burn!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TEMUGGZOH_000_106: Impossible! By what sorcery do you resist my master's will!?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_TEMUGGZOH_000_108: Your soul already belongs to another!? Yes, that is the only explanation!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_000_109: Forsooth, thy frail mortal frame can serve as vessel to the blessing of but One.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_000_110: Yet I smell not the taint of another upon thee...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_000_111: The truth of thine allegiance waxeth clear─thou art of the godless blessed's number.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_000_112: The Paragons warned of thine abhorrent kind. Thine existence is not to be suffered.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_BATTLETALK_20: My flames shall consume thy flesh and soul both!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_BATTLETALK_22: Surrender thyself to the fires of judgment!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_BATTLETALK_23: Thy soul shall burn for all eternity!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_IFRIT_BATTLETALK_25: Such energies have I spent...yet the blessing of Light shieldeth thee still...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_121: I was delayed by a congregation of Amalj'aa zealots. I swear, each seemed more evangelical than the last.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_124: I see the Bloodsworn wasted no time extracting the captives. No less than I'd expect from the Flame General's handpicked men.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_125: As for those two...it is fair to say their hardships have only just begun. They have much to answer for.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_126: I feel I owe you an apology, . Had I known this mission would prove so dangerous, I would never have left you to face it alone. You have been given a veritable baptism of fire.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_127: But let us continue this conversation in more agreeable surrounds. Camp Drybone, shall we say?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_NERO_000_129: So that was the mighty Ifrit...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_NERO_000_130: And what a disappointment he was. The readings are nowhere near what I had anticipated, even taking Ul'dahn interference into account.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_LIVIA_000_131: (-???-)You should know better than to rely upon five-year-old data left by the VIIth Legion.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_LIVIA_000_132: (-???-)Nor can we expect any form of support from the motherland, given the troubles at court. We have only ourselves to rely upon.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_NERO_000_133: Ever the pessimist, my dear Livia. Promise me you'll never change.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_LIVIA_000_134: We've wasted enough time here. That meter of yours is too old to give any reading worth a damn.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_NERO_000_135: Not that there was aught worth a damn for it to read...but I take your point. I suppose we must content ourselves with the knowledge that we've achieved our primary objective.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_NERO_000_136: Yet I find that I am troubled by that adventurer's unexpected show of strength. Could such a foe prove a hindrance to our plans?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_LIVIA_000_137: Perhaps─but that is a consideration for another time.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_LIVIA_000_138: You have been given a task. That is your priority. I suggest you treat it as such.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_LIVIA_000_140: Fail to do as my lord commands...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_LIVIA_000_141: ...And I will spare him the trouble of punishing you.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_NERO_000_143: Beware a woman in love. I shall need to be on my best behavior.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_150: Ah, there you are, . Come, rest awhile─you will have no better opportunity. After witnessing their god's ignominious defeat, the Amalj'aa will be less inclined to risk our wrath─for a time, at least.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_151: Now, where were we? Ah yes, I was in the process of apologizing. I do hope you can forgive me. I arrived too late to be of any use...to you or the abductees.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_152: They may be whole of body, but the same cannot be said of their minds. For once a man is tempered...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_153: Ah, but it ill suits me to dwell on the negatives. Amidst all our misfortunes, there is still reason to rejoice. Ifrit is slain, and by your hand, no less!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_154: That is the deed of no ordinary individual, . Not that I ever thought you were ordinary. On the contrary, I have long suspected that you have the potential to shape the fate of this realm. What can I say? My fine eye for talent remains undimmed.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_155: Minfilia will be proud beyond all reckoning when she hears of your deeds. I trust you shan't object to my bearing the tidings to her. That way I can claim to have contributed something to this mission.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_156: You, meanwhile, have earned yourself a rest. Take some time to relax, and return to the Waking Sands when you are good and ready. We can discuss matters in more detail then. Just don't take too long, will you? The realm's problems won't solve themselves.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_GUIDE_000_161: Thancred told us the news upon his arrival. He is presently in the solar, giving a full report to Lady Minfilia.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_GUIDE_000_162: You should join them at once. Lady Minfilia is most eager to see you.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_170: ...My late arrival nearly cost   life. I wasn't there when the Amalj'aa took  prisoner...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_171: And I wasn't there when they served  to Ifrit...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_172: Yes, by some miracle,  survived─but that does not excuse the fact that  should never have had to face such dangers alone. I failed  utterly.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_173: Just as I'm failing you all...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_174: What's done is done, Thancred. You can ill blame yourself for every─
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_175: ! It is so good to see you again!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_176: Impeccable timing, my friend. I had just finished regaling Minfilia with your heroic exploits.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_177: Thancred has told me everything. You have done well to return to us.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_178: The perils you faced were undeniably great, yet a part of me believes that I had no cause to fear. And now we can put paid to our long investigation.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_179: As we suspected, the Amalj'aa undertook both the robbery and the abductions with the aim of summoning their primal, Ifrit.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_180: Nor is this tale limited to Ul'dah. Similar incidents have been rife in both Limsa Lominsa and Gridania of late.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_181: I daresay you've been curious as to how these crimes are linked to the primals. Permit me to explain.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_182: Having manifested in the physical realm, primals must consume aether if they are to maintain their presence here. And the stronger they become, the more aether they require.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_183: Now, aether exists throughout creation. It flows through all life, and permeates the very air that we breathe.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_184: Alas, this alone will not suffice to sustain the likes of Ifrit. Nay, he and his kind require a more concentrated source of aether─crystals.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_185: It is for this reason that incidents involving crystals can often be traced back to a primal.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_186: Which leaves us with the why of the abductions. To understand this, you must first understand how primals are born.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_187: When all is well with the world, primals possess no physical form. Their essence is dispersed across the great river of aether.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_188: However, when the world is plunged into chaos, those who worship the primals cry out to their gods for deliverance from suffering.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_189: These cries serve as a beacon toward which a primal's essence is irresistibly drawn. It is this coming together─or “aetheric coalescence”─which grants the beings physical form.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_190: Once born, a primal gains strength from its followers' worship. The more numerous and fervent they are, the more powerful their god becomes.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_191: But the primals are seldom satisfied with such reverence as their adherents freely give, and in order to gain more power, they do not scruple to create followers. They do this by “tempering” mortals─a process to which you yourself were subjected.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_192: Yet even as Ifrit took your comrades in his thrall, you alone remained unaffected. This is thanks to the power you possess─the Echo.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_193: We know not the why of it, but those blessed with the Echo are immune to primal influence.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_194: It is as though a greater power protects us...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_195: When first you came to us, I told you that the Echo would be instrumental in dealing with the primal threat. I trust you now begin to see why.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_196: The recent incidents all share a common trait: meticulous planning. Such elaborate designs are a new development, and one which fills me with an unshakable sense of foreboding.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_197: While I share your concern, my presiding feeling is one of relief at your safe return.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_198: Ah, the Immortal Flames assured me that they will deal with the aftermath, so you need not concern yourself with that. We may rest easy for a time.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_199: I suggest you take full advantage of the respite, .
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_MINFILIA_000_200: You may be sure it won't last long. Once the people learn the identity of the hero who felled Ifrit, I fear you will have nary a moment to yourself!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_201: Whether she intended to or no, Minfilia neglected to tell you something─something I think it would be best you heard from one of us.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_202: It concerns the tempered abductees that were rescued... I am sorry to report that all are to be put to death, the Flames with whom you were imprisoned included. Needless to say, this information must not be made known to the public.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_203: I swear to you that we would not do this if there were any other recourse─but once a man is tempered, he is tempered for life. His very existence lends strength to the primal whom he cannot choose but worship.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_204: And so we Scions continue our fight, that no more innocents need be sacrificed. I hope that you will continue to stand with us, .
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_205: But I should be going. I must offer my apologies to the Flame General for the losses his people suffered. Till next time!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_206: Gods forgive me... How many more lives...? Louisoix would never have allowed this to happen.
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_THANCRED_000_207: I have to do better... I have to be stronger...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_QIB_UNGUST_BATTLETA: Hee hee! Our Amalj'aa friends will keep you company!
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_BATTLETALK: Filthy traitors! When I get my hands on you...
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_QIB_UNGUST_BATTLETA: Hee hee! How long will you last, I wonder!?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_FLAMESGT_BATTLETALK: Godsdammit, is there no end to them!?
TEXT_MANFST209_00343_QIB_UNGUST_BATTLETA: Hee hee! The show is only just beginning!
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_TALK_KEITHA_000_1: Seven hells! Some bastard Qiqirn has gone and broken one of me chocobo eggs!
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_TALK_KEITHA_000_2: The filthy little thief was busy lootin' the barn when a guard startled it, promptin' the damn thing to drop the egg it was clutchin' and run. Some of the lads gave chase, bless 'em, but when three more of the vermin appeared, me lot had no choice but to turn back.
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_TALK_KEITHA_000_3:
Somethin' has to be done about those Qiqirn...
Would you mind headin' over to the Matron's Lethe and havin' a word with a soldier named Roseline for me? The ratmen nest in her neck of the woods, see... She'll know what to do.
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_ROSELINE_000_11: You're here on Keitha's behalf? Hm? I see. Broke one of her eggs, you say? And there were four of the creatures?
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_ROSELINE_000_12: The Qiqirn are a nuisance at the best of times, but we must now add trespass and chocobo murder to their list of transgressions... They have forced our hand. Our retribution must needs be swift and decisive.
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_ROSELINE_000_13: And who better than you to deliver it, adventurer? Find the lair to the west of here and make an example of exactly four Qiqirn scramblers. We can send no clearer message.
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_ROSELINE_000_21: The deed is done? Good. A grim task, but a necessary one.
TEXT_SUBFST049_00376_ROSELINE_000_22: You have shown them the folly of inciting the wrath of those who consort with adventurers. Perhaps now the Qiqirn will think twice before giving in to their larcenous proclivities.
TEXT_SUBFST056_00377_OSHAJAAB_000_1: Ho there, adventurer. You seem light on your feet. Fancy a quick skip along the root of the heavenspillar here? I need someone to pick off a blue trumpet or two.
TEXT_SUBFST056_00377_OSHAJAAB_000_2: I know what you're thinking: it's naught more than a mushroom, so why the commotion? I'll tell you why. You allow that fungal menace to multiply, and within a moon they'll be covering the whole damn root and rotting the wood clear through.
TEXT_SUBFST056_00377_OSHAJAAB_000_3: Just watch your step while you're up there, though─the diremites on the ground won't waste any time adding insult to falling injuries.
TEXT_SUBFST056_00377_OSHAJAAB_000_4: Once you're done, head up to the top end of the root and report to Theodore. He'll be glad to hear someone's taken care of one of his more dreaded chores.
TEXT_SUBFST056_00377_THEODORE_000_11: Oh, you've cleared the root of blue trumpets? Wonderful! To be quite honest, I have this teeny-tiny problem with heights. <sigh> No, this is not my ideal posting, but we all do what we must.
TEXT_SUBFST056_00377_THEODORE_000_12: Keeping the root passable is an important job, you see. It's one of the few ways folk can traverse the Central Shroud since the Calamity all but split the area in twain.
TEXT_SUBFST056_00377_THEODORE_000_13: It is not, perhaps, the easiest pathway to walk, but there are those who believe the will of the Matron Herself caused this tendril of a heavenspillar to remain thus suspended, that it might serve the forest's people. I'm rather fond of the notion, myself.
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_THEODORE_000_1: It is─regrettably─my duty to stand watch over the road from here to Bentbranch Meadows.
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_THEODORE_000_2: The ranch has become a veritable institution of Gridania, so any threats to its continued operation are taken quite seriously by the Wood Wailers.
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_THEODORE_000_3: Which reminds me─mayhap it was my imagination, but I believe I caught a glimpse of some shadowy fellow not too long ago. Would you mind passing word to Roseline down below? I would go myself but, well...it's hard enough marshaling the courage to walk the root for my shift...
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_ROSELINE_000_11: A shadowy fellow? Hmmm...now that you mention it, I may have seen something.
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_ROSELINE_000_12: I dismissed it as a trick of the light before, but I thought I saw a shadow in the forest to the north. Still, I suspect it is nothing more than a Qiqirn thief on the run.
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_ROSELINE_000_13: If you must sate your curiosity, by all means investigate. Should you actually find something of note, I would like very much to see it.
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_ROSELINE_000_22: Remnants of a campfire and a forgotten bag...this could belong to any adventurer or traveler. And inside we have...a chocobo grooming brush and roseling oil?
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_ROSELINE_000_23: But wait─why would a traveler make camp here, when it would be far safer to beg the hospitality of Bentbranch Meadows?
TEXT_SUBFST058_00379_ROSELINE_000_24: Bugger me, I think this belongs to that stranger said to be meddling with the chocobos! Thank you, adventurer. We have been lax in our duties, but no longer─I swear we will find this shadow.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_ROSELINE_000_1: We cannot allow other sentries to dismiss similar sightings─they must know what we have learned. To that end, I've prepared this letter containing everything we know about our mysterious stranger.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_ROSELINE_000_2: I need you to show it to my comrades throughout the Shroud. Once each sentry has committed the details to memory, have them write their name at the bottom for confirmation.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_ROSELINE_000_3: Start with Elmar at the Bannock, then find Bernard at the eastern gates of Bentbranch Meadows. They ought to relay the information to the others.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_ROSELINE_000_4: Finally, make sure Eylgar sees the letter. He stands watch within the stables, so if this stranger's aim is to harm the chocobos, Eylgar may have to personally put an end to it.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_ELMAR_000_11: You don't look like you're here for training...
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_ELMAR_000_12: A shadowy figure... Understood. I'll pass word to the recruits as well as the sentries.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_ELMAR_000_13: Let me just make my mark...there, that should do.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_ELMAR_000_14: If you follow the road south, you'll find Bernard by the bridge to Bentbranch. Godsspeed, adventurer.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_BERNARD_000_21: You have business with me, adventurer?
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_BERNARD_000_22: Roseline is right to be cautious. For this stranger to venture so close, yet go to such great lengths to remain undetected, is highly suspicious. They clearly have designs on Bentbranch.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_BERNARD_000_23: We appreciate the help. I should write my name here, yes?
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_BERNARD_000_24: And...here, take it. You'll find Eylgar in the stables, past the aetheryte.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_EYLGAR_000_31: Mind the birds, adventurer. They get nervous around strangers.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_EYLGAR_000_32: What's this? A shadowy stranger near the Matron's Lethe... You've already shown this to Bernard and Elmar, I see. Good, good.
TEXT_SUBFST059_00380_EYLGAR_000_33: Then all that's left is to inform the staff here. Not everyone here is a Wood Wailer, true, but even our stableboys wouldn't hesitate to take up arms to defend these chocobos.
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_EYLGAR_000_1: You're quite the compassionate adventurer, by the sound of it. Well far be it from me to look a gift chocobo in the mouth─I have need of a capable  like yourself.
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_EYLGAR_000_2: We received a peddler at the gates the other day─an excitable Lalafell that was sweating and swearing that he had been attacked by large winged beasts. Yet other than hornets, I know of no flying creatures in this region.
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_EYLGAR_000_3: If there's any truth to what he said, it might prove problematic for other travelers. Follow the road south and see if you can find any evidence to support his claim.
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_EYLGAR_000_4: And, should you find something, kindly tell Lothaire to patrol his area sometime instead of just standing beneath the spire and staring at the godsdamned road. In those words.
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_LOTHAIRE_000_11: ...A northern vulture? Two? And they were defending a nest!?
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_LOTHAIRE_000_12: Well, I, uh...perhaps we could omit that last detail from any official reports. I would rather not give Eylgar any further cause to be cross.
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_LOTHAIRE_000_13: Thank you for slaying the beasts. You may rest assured that I will not permit this to happen again.
TEXT_SUBFST060_00381_POP_MESSAGE: You hear the beating of wings...
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_LOTHAIRE_000_1: I have another task for you, adventurer. I need you to head to the Hedgetree to the southwest of here and speak with Hearer Leonnie.
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_LOTHAIRE_000_2: After tending to the Hedgetree, the Hearer was scheduled to board a boat from the Mirror Planks... Well, the vessel's departure time has come and gone, but there is still no sign of her.
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_LOTHAIRE_000_3: Knowing how absorbed the Hearer becomes in her work, I am not unduly concerned. Armelle, however, was responsible for organizing Leonnie's transportation and is likely wondering if her wayward passenger is ever going to arrive. Perhaps a gentle reminder is in order?
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_LEONNIE_000_11: Yes, what troubles you, my de─? Ah. Yes. The boat. I had quite forgotten.
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_LEONNIE_000_12: Hm? Oh, my task with the Hedgetree is well and finished, but the elementals murmur of a malevolent presence in the vicinity of the Tam-Tara Deepcroft.
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_LEONNIE_000_13: I must abide a while longer, that I might better divine the source of the elementals' distress. Please inform Armelle that I shall be late in arriving.
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_ARMELLE_000_31: You bear a message from Hearer Leonnie? An evil presence in the Deepcroft? That does sound grave, indeed.
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_ARMELLE_000_32: I shall organize a vessel for a later time, then. Perhaps a bell from now? Two? Better make it three, just to be safe. Thank you for your trouble.
TEXT_SUBFST068_00384_LEONNIE_000_21: I must linger here a while longer. Please head to the Mirror Planks and convey my apologies to Armelle.
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_ARMELLE_000_01: Might you assist me with another matter, ? A wagon that departed from Quarrymill was overturned on the road when some large, ill-tempered forest beast chose that moment to defend its territory.
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_ARMELLE_000_02: By Nophica's grace, the driver escaped without serious injury, but the wagon's cargo was not so fortunate. With none willing to risk another encounter with the creature, I can only assume the goods remain strewn across the ground where the incident occurred.
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_ARMELLE_000_03: Simply follow the road here to the south and you should come across the wreckage. Salvage what cargo you can, and deliver it to Keitha at Bentbranch Meadows if you would be so kind.
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_KEITHA_000_11: You have a delivery for me?
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_KEITHA_000_12: Ah, this's the shipment I was waitin' on from Quarrymill. I heard the wagon ran afoul o' some great monstrosity just up the path from the Mirror Planks, but I see you've managed to scrape together a few bits and pieces.
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_KEITHA_000_13: Seems I can't get through two bells these days without hearin' some new tale o' horrors in the Deepcroft or bandit cutthroats prowlin' the woods hereabouts.
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_KEITHA_000_14: Makes me wonder if me chocobos are safe at night, it does. If we're ever in need of a 'venturer's skills, I hope you'll be around to lend a hand.
TEXT_SUBFST073_00387_POP_MESSAGE: You feel the ground tremble beneath your feet...
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_BADERON_000_1: 'Ow do ye fare, ? Rested and ready to expand yer 'orizons?
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_BADERON_000_2: Well, then, I've an idea o' where ye might try 'eadin' next. 'Ave ye 'eard o' the Skylift out in middle La Noscea?
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_BADERON_000_3: If ye've ever visited Woad Whisper Canyon, then ye must've been up and down the thing at least once. It's that big bleedin' scaffoldin' attached to the Descent.
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_BADERON_000_4: Ye've likely seen the lads and lasses out there usin' it to 'aul cargo up the cliff face. 'Ard labor, that, and I 'ear they could use an enterprisin' soul to pick up the odd jobs what no other bugger 'as time to deal with.
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_BADERON_000_5: Track down the 'ead o' the operation─bloke by the name o' Wyrkrhit─and 'e'll be sure to put ye to work on a task or two.
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_WYRKRHIT_000_11: Baderon sent ye out here, did he? Then consider yerself welcome at the Skylift.
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_WYRKRHIT_000_12: Look at that bloody cliff, will ye? One blast o' fiery hell from that huge dragon was all it took to split the ground in half.
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_WYRKRHIT_000_13: Cargo still needs to get through, though, so this mess o' wood an' pulleys was our solution to the problem.
TEXT_SUBSEA100_00397_WYRKRHIT_000_14: Well, one of 'em, at least. If the gods were kind─an' they ain't─I'd have about a dozen more workers to handle me growin' list o' headaches...
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_WYRKRHIT_000_1: Glad I am to see ye again, . A wagon driver just returned in a great bloody hurry, screamin' about some monstrosity what sprang out from a millioncorn seedling in his cargo.
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_WYRKRHIT_000_2: Seems the gutless bastard tossed it over the side afore turnin' tail an' runnin' for his life. I need ye to head down the road, recover that seedling, an' deliver it to Lyulf over at Swiftperch in western La Noscea.
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_WYRKRHIT_000_3: Whatever he pays ye for the cargo is yers to keep. After all, I don't rightly know what else is lurkin' inside that plant, an' ye deserve to be rewarded for yer troubles.
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_WYRKRHIT_000_4: Oh, an' ye'll also find an aetheryte in Swiftperch, so the journey should be worth yer while.
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_LYULF_000_11: Has Nymeia Herself forsaken this desolate land? Though I understood there were risks in gambling my entire fortune on a crop of millioncorn, I at least expected the seedling to be delivered before disaster struck!
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_LYULF_000_12: Is...is that my millioncorn seedling!? O joyous day! It may seem a paltry beginning, but the yield of this particular variety of crop plant is nothing short of astonishing.
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_LYULF_000_13: As you have undoubtedly noticed, Swiftperch lacks a certain, shall we say, vital energy? Thus I mean to restore a modicum of hope to its residents by growing a veritable ocean of corn!
TEXT_SUBSEA105_00402_LYULF_000_14: You, , seem fit to burst with vim and vigor! Might I persuade you to abide a while and help nurture this ailing settlement?
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_FRAELOEF_000_1: You there. Adventurer. Cast your eyes towards the Brewer's Beacon. Does the light not seem uncommonly weak?
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_FRAELOEF_000_2: It cannot possibly be bright enough to guide the ships sailing in the bay. I would march over to the lighthouse and investigate myself, but I am duty-bound to remain at my post.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_FRAELOEF_000_3: I would consider it a favor if you could make a visit to the Brewer's Beacon and see if aught has befallen Khanswys, the lighthouse keeper.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_KHANSWYS_000_11: Ye say a Yellowjacket sent ye here? Eh? Me light's grown dim, has it? Well, o' course it bloody has!
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_KHANSWYS_000_12: The bomb what fuels me furnace has up an' buggered off, ye see. If I don't get that beacon fixed up soon, there'll be trouble on the water...
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_KHANSWYS_000_13: I know yer just the messenger, , but I can tell a 'venturer when I see one. I'm goin' to need ye to chase down that bomb an' bring back a claw what ye ripped from its smolderin' corpse.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_KHANSWYS_000_14: Take this here iron brazier an' set her down in the middle o' the Flock─somewhere near the scarecrow, I'd say. Ye get a nice fire goin', an' that frisky bomb'll soon be about. Watch ye don't singe yer eyebrows, .
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_FRAELOEF_000_31: The furnace is damaged, is it? Very well, I shall write up the relevant reports, but these repairs must needs be effected without delay.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_FRAELOEF_000_32: It seems I have another favor to ask of you, adventurer. Take yourself straightway to the Armorers' Guild in Limsa Lominsa and explain the situation to Forgemaster H'naanza.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_HNAANZA_000_41: The furnace in the Brewer's Beacon needs repairs? Byregot's beard, I just sent someone out to tinker with it not a week past. Mayhap the bomb Khanswys had trapped in there was a touch too volatile...?
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_HNAANZA_000_42: I'll have an artisan visit the lighthouse and pay special attention to reinforcing the casing of that furnace. Your work is done here, adventurer. May the Navigator guide you on your journeys.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_KHANSWYS_000_21: All ye need do is take down that runaway bomb an' bring me one of its little claws.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_KHANSWYS_000_22: Ah, ye got the ashy bastard, did ye? Once I put this little firecracker in the furnace, that should keep things runnin' for a while.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_KHANSWYS_000_23: I had meself a bit of a look while ye was gone, an' Llymlaen curse me if the furnace weren't all bent an' broken. Small wonder the bloody bomb was able to escape.
TEXT_SUBSEA106_00403_KHANSWYS_000_24: I patched things up as best I could, but I ain't no smitty. Ye might want to have a chat with that Yellowjacket friend o' yers in Swiftperch, an' have him pass the word back to someone in Limsa.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_HNAANZA_000_1: What say you to taking on some work from Naldiq & Vymelli's? We've a great hulking warship to build and could certainly use an extra hand for any number of tasks.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_HNAANZA_000_2: For your first job, I need you to run this missive over to Ahtbyrm, the head shipwright at the Moraby Drydocks.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_HNAANZA_000_3: We forge most of the ship's bits and pieces here at the Armorers' Guild, but the actual construction takes place at the docks found in the south of lower La Noscea.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_HNAANZA_000_4: That's also where you'll find the main offices of Naldiq & Vymelli's. The Moraby Drydocks is one of Limsa Lominsa's most important districts─at least as far as I'm concerned─and I'm sure you'll not regret attuning yourself to the area's aetheryte.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_HNAANZA_000_5: If you've no confidence in your sense of direction, you'd be best served making use of the chocobo porters. First floor of the Mizzenmast, in case you were wondering.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_HNAANZA_000_6: Should you choose to make the trek on your own two feet, leave the city through the Tempest Gate and follow the road south. May the Navigator guide your steps.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_AHTBYRM_000_11: You have a missive for me from Forgemaster H'naanza? I assume it pertains to the pending arrival of the materials I ordered over a moon past. Let's see it, then.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_AHTBYRM_000_12: Blast and botheration! Another delay? I am well aware of the shortage of skilled artisans, but this is insufferable!
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_AHTBYRM_000_13: <sigh> My apologies. The messenger does not deserve to bear the brunt of my frustration. Might I have your name?
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_AHTBYRM_000_14: , is it? Well, , this proud maiden you see taking shape before you is the Victory, the first new vessel to grace the docks since the Calamity.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_AHTBYRM_000_15: We may have lost the bulk of our ships that fateful day, but starting with this beauty, we will restore the Maelstrom's fleet to its former glory. The Victory is more than a simple warship─it is the symbol of Limsa Lominsa's rebirth from the wreckage wrought by the coming of the Seventh Umbral Era.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_AHTBYRM_000_16: Thus we are striving to complete her construction as swiftly as possible, even going so far as to hire veteran shipwrights from outside the thalassocracy.
TEXT_SUBSEA109_00406_AHTBYRM_000_17: Yet even with such unprecedented measures, there are never enough hands to handle the abundance of tasks. Should you choose to linger at the docks for a time, there is no end of odd jobs for a hardworking adventurer. Be you fair warned─there is no place here for layabouts and troublemakers.
TEXT_SUBSEA115_00412_AHTBYRM_000_1: Where in the seven hells is that man!? Not once in twelve moons has he been late with a shipment, and now two whole turns of the sun without a single word.
TEXT_SUBSEA115_00412_AHTBYRM_000_2: A shipwright of mine─a young man named Fyrilsmyd─recently left Candlekeep Quay to retrieve several crates of supplies ordered from Limsa Lominsa...but has yet to return.
TEXT_SUBSEA115_00412_AHTBYRM_000_3: I have sent several missives to Haldbroda, but his replies are always the same. He does not recall ever seeing the wright, nor the supplies he was scheduled to collect. That man knows something, and I severely doubt he is telling me the whole truth.
TEXT_SUBSEA115_00412_AHTBYRM_000_4: As I cannot leave my post, I would ask you to travel to Candlekeep Quay in my stead and inform Haldbroda that if he insists on playing these games, I will personally see that he is transferred to Turtleback Island, where he can rot alone in the middle of the sea for eternity.
TEXT_SUBSEA115_00412_HALDBRODA_000_10: Eh? Does that self-righteous dog Ahtbyrm doubt that I've never told him anything less than the truth!?
TEXT_SUBSEA115_00412_HALDBRODA_000_11: Turtleback Island!? He cannot do that...can he?
TEXT_SUBSEA115_00412_HALDBRODA_000_12: I swear on my poor nana's grave, Navigator rest her soul, I know naught of this Fyrilsmyd, nor his precious supplies.
TEXT_SUBSEA115_00412_HALDBRODA_000_13: Hells, we here at the Quay have had enough trouble these past few suns, what with the sinking of that Lominsan cargo ship off the Salt Strand. I haven't the time to take a proper piss, let alone make note of every scrag that wanders in off the Grip.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_AHTBYRM_000_1: . While I originally had doubts about your motives, you have repeatedly proven yourself an asset to Naldiq & Vymelli's. I still do not like you, but that does not mean I do not trust you.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_AHTBYRM_000_2: Ghimthota, head of the watch here at the Drydocks, believes that pirates may be plotting an attack on the Victory, and she requires assistance investigating a group of unsavory individuals making camp nearby. I have recommended you for the task.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_AHTBYRM_000_3: Despite all Limsa Lominsa endured before, during, and following the Calamity, the fact that there are still those who would turn their backs on the city-state so that they might line their pockets with a few handfuls of coin... Just the thought of it sickens me.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_GHIMTHOTA_000_10: Ah, yes. I had a feeling you would be the one Ahtbyrm sent. Since you first arrived at the Moraby Drydocks, I have had my men watch you. Oh, there's no need to get angry. I make it a point to keep an eye on all those new to the area. It is simply protocol.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_GHIMTHOTA_000_11: And you'll be pleased to know that nothing...incriminating was found. You appear to be a model citizen. That, and the foreman seems to think somewhat highly of you...which I must admit is quite shocking. The man doesn't even trust his own mother.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_GHIMTHOTA_000_12: Very well, then. I assume Ahtbyrm informed you of what your task would entail. The pirates we believe are conspiring to raid the Drydocks were last seen making camp near an ancient stone called the mark of the Spinner. I would have you approach the men, posing as a lost adventurer, and see if you cannot somehow learn of their intentions. C'nangho stationed at the rear gates can provide you with an exact location of the camp.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_CNANGHO_000_20: ! Ha ha! I knew it! No more sardines for C'nangho. Tonight, I shall dine on the finest salmon on the peninsula! Why? Well, I had a little wager going with some of the other guards on who Ahtbyrm would recommend for the next job. My money was on you!
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_CNANGHO_000_21: Ah, the job. Yes, of course. If you follow the road past the gates to the southeast, you will eventually come to a barren cape with a single large stone half-buried in the cliff overlooking the sea. Followers of the Twelve say it's a holy place dedicated to Nymeia, the Spinner. I'd be surprised if the pirates camped up there were aware of that, though.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_CORSAIR_000_30: I'm givin' ye to the count of nine to step back on that path, and carry yer 'venturin' arse back down to whatever rock it is ye crawled out from under.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_CORSAIR_000_31: Ye see, I's 'ad it up to me ears with yer type, roamin' the 'ills like they was yers to roam. It's gettin' to be that a man cannae enjoy a mug o' rum wivout some shite-breath outlander runnin' up askin' which is the way to the local levemete. Seven 'ells if I know! I'm a bloody pirate, godsdammit!
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_CORSAIR_000_32: Thal's balls! Once we 'ave me boy back, I'm puttin' this godsforsaken piss'ole of an island so far behind me, ain't no one'll remember I was ever 'ere. Come on, scrags. We's knives to sharpen.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_CORSAIRFOLLOWA_000_: What do we 'ave 'ere? A li'l lost lamb come lookin' for  mummy? We's a nice fire goin'. Why not come and sit yer tender arse down by old One-Tooth? I'll keep ye all warm an' toasty, like. Heh heh heh.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_CORSAIRFOLLOWB_000_: Bugger off, ye unbloodied whelp. Ye reek of an old maid's teats, and it's makin' me wine taste more sour than it already is.
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_GHIMTHOTA_000_50: So the trespassers are indeed pirates, and they are indeed planning something. But what is this talk of getting “me boy back”?
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_GHIMTHOTA_000_51: Could it be that their target never was the Victory?
TEXT_SUBSEA116_00413_GHIMTHOTA_000_52: Something is not right, and I won't sit by idly waiting for those pirates to make the first move. I shall order increased patrols immediately. Thank you again for your help, . It appears we were wise to put our trust in you.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_0: I am concerned, . It appears that the pirates I had you investigate are on the move.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_1: They creep ever closer to the Drydocks, so I must assume they mean to target the Victory herself.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_2: That ship is the symbol of everything Limsa Lominsa strives to become, and I will not allow these base scoundrels to lay a single finger upon her hull.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_3: We must apprehend them before they put their plans into motion! And you, , are just the  to do it.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_4: Without your capable assistance, I fear the security of the Drydocks cannot be guaranteed.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_5: Not moments ago, my guards submitted reports of suspicious activity in the area. Pray begin your efforts by listening to one of their accounts firsthand.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_6: It matters not whom you choose to speak with, but be sure to question either Urswyrst at the front gate or C'nangho at the rear.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_7: Any suspect saboteurs you encounter during the course of your investigation are to be interrogated. Report any and all findings directly to me.
