TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_URSWYRST_000_10: Ghimthota sent you to follow up on my report?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_URSWYRST_000_11: Well, it was not too long ago that I saw some unsavory sort slinking along the top of the bluff near Empty Heart, just over yonder.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_URSWYRST_000_12: It may be that he's still about. If you've got the time, adventurer, I'd much appreciate you getting up there to take a look.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_CNANGHO_000_20: Hail, adventurer. Glad to have another hand aboard to help shore up security.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_CNANGHO_000_21: The gods know our reports would sit on Ghimthota's desk gathering dust if it weren't for the assistance of those such as yourself.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_CNANGHO_000_22: Speaking of reports, though, I saw one of those mangy pirates lurking around the cliff near Empty Heart. I'd take a closer look before he has a chance to cover his tracks.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_CORSAIRFOLLOWA_000_: Bah, spotted me, did ye? Well, yer too late─what's to 'appen is already 'appenin'.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_Q1_000_1:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“Victory in Peril”?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_40: So, you found me one of those pirates, did you?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_41: I knew you were the right adventurer to ask for aid.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_42: But what could these knaves be planning? “What's to happen is already happening”...?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_44: Easy now, soldier. Who did this to you?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_MAELSTROM_000_45: <pant> Pirates... Out of nowhere... <cough> Stuck me good...
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_46: Gods below, we are not prepared for this!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_47: The pirates, soldier, how many do they number?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_MAELSTROM_000_48: Not sure... More than I could quickly count... Seemed to be carrying...explosives...
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_49: Explosives!? Then there is no time to lose!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_50: , you heard the situation. Make your way to the shipyard and engage these intruders!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_51: I will see to this man's wounds, then follow after.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTZAPFYN_000_60: Gahahaha! Never reckoned it'd be this easy! Still don't trust those slimy bastards, but their plan worked like a charm!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_000_61: Da! What are you doing, you great bloody fool!?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTZAPFYN_000_63: This'll all be over soon. All that's left now is to blow this ugly pile o' driftwood into splinters.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_000_64: Why would you do such a thing!? Have you any idea how important this ship is? What it represents?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTZAPFYN_000_65: Aye, an' that's what makes it all the sweeter! Whatever it takes to knock some sense into me treacherous, backstabbin' son!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTZAPFYN_000_66: Imagine, a boy o' mine givin' up the pirate life to become a shipwright! An' buildin' a bleedin' Maelstrom vessel at that! What under Llymlaen's wide, green ocean made ye take up with these self-righteous shites!?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_000_67: You're the one with no bloody sense, Da! Don't you see? The pirates had their glory days, but that era is over!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_69: Ah! I wondered why Ahtbyrm never spoke of his father. I never would have thought...
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTZAPFYN_000_70: This ship's a symbol alright─of everythin' what went wrong with the world. An' I mean to shatter it into a hunnerd thousand pieces!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414AHTBYRM_000_71: Ghimthota! ! Pray beat the tar out of this bloated sea slug, and make sure no harm comes to the Victory!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTZAPFYN_000_80: I...I must be gettin' old, lettin' some green 'venturer get the best o' me.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTZAPFYN_000_82: <cough> That's one big bloody ship. Big...an' nasty lookin'. Ye made that, did ye...?
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_000_90: My thanks, . I shudder to think what may have become of the Victory without your intervention.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_000_91: <sigh> The pirates have made a right mess of things─I'd best get to sorting out the docks.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_000_92: ...And my thoughts could use some sorting out as well. Ever did my father have a way of turning my life upside down.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_000_93: Pray convey my thanks─and my apologies─to Ghimthota.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_100: How fare you, ? I cannot begin to thank you for the role you played in preventing this madness.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_101: You defended more than a simple ship─you saved the budding hope of Limsa Lominsa from a violent demise. The day was yours.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_102: It seems our security regimen will require much in the way of improvement if we are to truly keep the Drydocks safe.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_103: ...Ahtbyrm apologizes? Well, I suppose I can understand why he would feel responsible for his father's actions. Of all those involved, this incident was hardest on him.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_104: But, in time, I believe he will come to a single conclusion: the most fitting way of moving past his anguish is to see the Victory completed and in the water.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_105: Ah, by the by, the pirates we defeated have been handed over to the Yellowjackets. Reyner's men will be taking over the investigation.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_000_106: Before the Yellowjackets moved in, however, we recovered a most unusual object. Should you have the time to spare, I would ask of you another favor...
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_QIB_TODO001: Defeat the pirates and protect the Victory!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_BATTLETALK_: My father... You must stop him!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_GHIMTHOTA_BATTLETAL:
Leave him to us.
, C'nangho, to me!
I'll take the Mamool Ja. You focus on Ahtzapfyn.
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTZAPFYN_BATTLETAL: Ye've no idea who yer up against!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_AHTBYRM_BATTLETALK_: Please! You cannot let him win!
TEXT_SUBSEA117_00414_CNANGHO_BATTLETALK_:
Ware, adventurer!
Ahtzapfyn has a crazy glint in his eye...
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_HALDBRODA_000_1: Now, the way I see it, if you have time to be standing here questioning my character, then you most certainly have the time to get that arse of yours down to the Salt Strand and help us search for survivors of the wreck.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_HALDBRODA_000_2: Who knows? You may just run across this Fyrilsmyd everyone seems so eager to find. Here's to hoping the Navigator hasn't found him first.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_FYRILSMYD_000_10: Aye, I'm Fyrilsmyd. Ye say the foreman's wonderin' on me whereabouts? I thought he might be. But ye must know, I cannot show me face at the Drydocks until I've righted the terrible wrong I caused.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_FYRILSMYD_000_11: Two nights past, I made the trip from the Drydocks to Candlekeep Quay, just as the foreman asked. The seas were right rough, and the cap'n of the cargo ship was wary of bringin' her too close to the cliffs, so I paid a few coins to a fisher to take me out to meet her.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_FYRILSMYD_000_12: By the time we was halfway 'twixt shore and ship, the swells had risen to nigh on ten yalms, and 'twasn't long afore the waves had hold of us. Try as we might to steady the boat, nature's grip was too tight, and we was flung headlong into the Lominsan galley.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_FYRILSMYD_000_13: When I awoke, both ships were gone, and the cargo I was to collect lay strewn across the Salt Strand. I's made every effort to salvage it, but the sands are crawlin' with Qiqirn, and I ain't a one with a sword. And now ye see why it is I cannot return to the Drydocks...
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_AHTBYRM_000_20: I am relieved to hear that both Fyrilsmyd and the supplies are unharmed, though it was foolish for him to believe that I would blame him for that which was obviously out of his hands.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_AHTBYRM_000_21: You see, there was no storm that day, and the seas here adjacent the Drydocks were as calm as a slumbering child. This leads me to believe that the trouble the ships encountered off Candlekeep Quay was of a less natural sort─the sort which the Sahagin have been known to conjure.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_FYRILSMYD_000_30: That night, I was tossed into the sea like some doll of rags, and it weren't long afore the world 'round me faded to black as I slipped deeper into the abyss. But lo, the Navigator wouldn't see me to the gates of the seven hells, and I woke to find meself washed ashore. And here I's been, ever since, waitin' for a chance to salvage me master's cargo.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_FYRILSMYD_000_31: The missin' parts! I-I don't know how I can repay you!
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_FYRILSMYD_000_32: I'll deliver the supplies right away...but first I must stop by the Quay so that I might pay me respects to the widow of the brave fisher who gave his life fer a handful o' coin.
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_FYRILSMYD_000_33: Could ye tell Ahtbyrm that I'll be back at the Drydocks by ? Many thanks, adventurer! I will not forget this kindness!
TEXT_SUBSEA118_00415_SYSTEM_000_40: You are discovered by a Qiqirn!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_1: Ah, . By your tireless efforts, you have proven yourself a friend to Gridania. I believe you can be trusted with sensitive intelligence.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_2: I would assign you a mission of considerable import, yet the need for secrecy prevents me from disclosing its details until you have pledged your participation. I am authorized to tell you only that it concerns suspicious activity in the Twelveswood. Say that you will lend us your aid, and I shall proceed with the briefing.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_10: Good. Time is of the essence, so listen well.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_11: You will by now have heard that a suspicious individual has been seen prowling the Twelveswood.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_12: And you may also be aware that Ixali activity has risen sharply in the region of late. What you may not know is that this increase coincided almost exactly with the first recorded sighting of the aforementioned individual.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_13: Suspecting a connection, we tightened our surveillance in hopes of tracking down our unknown visitor. Alas, our quarry is proving to be exceedingly elusive─almost as if he knows our movements ahead of time.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_14: But where whole units have failed, a lone adventurer may yet succeed. Acting independently and covertly, you may be able to close in on our quarry unnoticed.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_15: Fear and anxiety are beginning to take their toll upon the citizenry, . For their sake, I ask that you aid us in this investigation.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_16: You have my gratitude. With your help, I am hopeful we will shed light upon this mystery.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_17: Begin your search at Lifemend Stump. It is there that the majority of the sightings took place.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_18: Be forewarned: my people cannot offer you support, lest our quarry catch scent of our presence and evade us yet again. Proceed with caution.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_Q1_000_1:

“Chasing Shadows”?

TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000020_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)Oh dear. Is that a sword in the stump? Bad idea. Really bad idea...

Why, the first time we came to the Twelveswood, we almost ended up as a treant's dinner just for crashing our airship in the wrong place. It was all Papalymo's fault, of course. Though he'd sooner swallow his staff than admit that he's wrong.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000050_KUPLOKOPP: (-Moogle-)No, no, not this one. Not even close, kupo!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000070_KUPLOKOPP: (-Kuplo Kopp-)Well, not exactly, but we did once share a carriage. Isn't that right?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000090_KUPLOKOPP:
(-Moogle-)Of course not! 's not a stranger at all!

TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000100_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)Ah, now that you mention it, there is something familiar about ...
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000110_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)Hey, you're right! This feels more like a reunion than a first meeting.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000120_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)So, um...when did we first meet again?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000130_KUPLOKOPP: (-Moogle-)I...don't recall exactly. But I do remember  being a good person.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000150_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)Same as the last. There is a disturbance here as well, and newly manifested at that.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000160_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)Kuplo Kopp seems convinced of your innocence. But if this isn't your doing, whose is it?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000170_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)Ever since the Calamity, the forest's been really sensitive.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000180_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)The slightest disruption to the aetheric flow...
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000190_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)And this sort of thing happens!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_000200_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)It seems we have little choice...
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_200250_HYDAELYN: I am Hydaelyn. All made one.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_200260_HYDAELYN: A Light there once was that shone throughout this realm...yet it hath since grown dim.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_200270_HYDAELYN: And as it hath faltered, so hath Darkness risen up in its stead, presaging an end to Life.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_200280_HYDAELYN: For the sake of all, I beseech thee: deliver us from this fate!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_200290_HYDAELYN: The power to banish the Darkness dwelleth in the Crystals of Light. Journey forth and lay claim to them.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_200300_HYDAELYN: By thy deeds shall the Crystals reveal themselves to thee.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_200310_HYDAELYN: Only believe, for the Light liveth in thy heart.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_200320_HYDAELYN: Go now, my child, and shine thy Light on all creation.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300330_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)You fainted. A surfeit of aether, no doubt.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300340_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)Hm? And what have we here?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300350_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)Our culprit, it would seem. An Ixal. And no ordinary Ixal, either─a chieftain.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300360_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)That they would venture this deep into enemy territory... The beastmen may indeed be acting under orders.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300370_PAPALYMO: This is Papalymo. We've found the culprit─it was an Ixali chieftain. Yes, we'll seek Brother E-Sumi-Yan's cooperation in the matter. Yda? Oh, loud, tactless─much the same as always.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300380_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)How are we feeling, then? Better? Good!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300390_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)Giant crystals? Can't say I've seen any... Are you sure you're feeling better?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300410_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)Kuplo Kopp. Please bear word of these developments to Brother E-Sumi-Yan. We shall soon return to give a full report.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300430_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)Here is where we part ways. Till next time, take care!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300440_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)I think that sword might be a clue! You should definitely pull it out and take it back to the Bannock!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300450_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)You don't suppose that adventurer could see Kuplo Kopp, do you!?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300460_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)And this occurs to you NOW!?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300470_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)Yes. It seemed that way. Time will tell...
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300480_YDA: (-Animated Pugilist-)Well, time will have to, because you won't! You never tell me what's really going on! Unless...you don't know what's going on either!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_300490_PAPALYMO: (-Short-tempered Thaumaturge-)Bah! You'd like that, wouldn't you!?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_90: ! It is good to see you back!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_91: One of our patrols sent word that you had been spotted doing battle with enraged treants. I am relieved to find you none the worse for the experience.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_92: But tell me, what were you able to discover at Lifemend Stump?
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_93: A sword in the stump, and a dead Ixal? Hmmm...
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_94: I can say with absolute certainty that this blade is of Ixali origin. It is of a kind used exclusively in the beastmen's rituals.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_95: The Ixal rarely set foot in the Central Shroud, so tight is our guard over the area. What purpose could have driven them to take such a risk? I fear something is afoot...
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_96: What's that? A dubious couple sporting peculiar spectacles? Hah hah hah!
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_97: So you have finally been acquainted with Yda and Papalymo! Lay your suspicions to rest─Gridania counts them among her staunchest allies. Both are scholars hailing from a distant land, and have been with us since before the Calamity.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_98: Their garb may appear outlandish, and their exchanges baffling, but never once have they given us cause to doubt them.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_99: Indeed, they often assist the Gods' Quiver and the Wood Wailers in their work─much as I hope you will in the days to come, .
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_100: Although our unknown visitor eludes us still, owing to your efforts, we have acquired important intelligence on the Ixali threat. You have my gratitude.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_GALFRID_000_101: We are fortunate indeed to have a capable adventurer such as you aiding us. I pray you will continue to serve the people of Gridania in whatever capacity you are able.
TEXT_MANFST005_00445_PAPALYMO_BATTLETALK: Do you want to get eaten!? Hit them harder!
If you value your life, stay close!
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_LUQUELOT_000_1: My thanks for your kindness earlier. I hate to impose again, but I have need of your assistance in another matter─one of grave import, I fear.
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_LUQUELOT_000_2: Of late, I have noticed that Ixali dirigibles have been appearing over the Twelveswood with increasing regularity. The frequency, however, does not bother me near so much as where they choose to fly─the patch of sky directly above the Guardian Tree.
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_LUQUELOT_000_3: The tree is a sacred site, or so I was given to believe when first I came to Gridania, and thus I naturally assumed that the elementals would not suffer the Ixal to profane it. Yet the birdmen have been coming and going as they please, with nary a sign of protest from the guardians of the Twelveswood.
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_LUQUELOT_000_4: And it was that which set me to thinking... Ever since the appearance of the much-talked-about “suspicious individual,” many and more strange things have been occurring in the forest. Could it be that he did something to the elementals?
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_LUQUELOT_000_5: In case it proved useful, I have committed the details of my sightings to parchment, and would ask that you deliver the document to Mother Miounne.
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_LUQUELOT_000_6: Please make all haste─I have an irrepressible feeling that something terrible is about to happen.
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_MIOUNNE_000_10: Hello there, . Word of your tireless efforts at Bentbranch Meadows has reached my ears. The folk there have naught but the highest praise for you!
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_MIOUNNE_000_11: You certainly have a knack for making Mother proud.
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_MIOUNNE_100_11: Keep up the good work, you hear?
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_MIOUNNE_000_13: I haven't the slightest inkling what this could be about...
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_MIOUNNE_000_15: I have a mission for you, . Suffice it to say, it is urgent.
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_MIOUNNE_100_15: I fear it may also prove dangerous, however, so you must be prepared.
TEXT_MANFST006_00446_MIOUNNE_000_16: Make what arrangements you can, and report back to me the moment you are ready.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MIOUNNE_000_1: Time is of the essence, so I shall speak plain.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MIOUNNE_000_2: Based on Luquelot's observations, the Ixal have designs on the Guardian Tree, and they mean to act soon.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MIOUNNE_000_3: The tree is the oldest living thing in this ancient forest, and it is held sacred by every forestborn Gridanian.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MIOUNNE_000_4: Should it come to any harm, the elementals would fly into a rage beyond pacifying. I dread to think of the chaos that would ensue.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MIOUNNE_000_5: There isn't much time. We must act quickly.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MIOUNNE_000_6: , please see this letter to the hands of Bowlord Lewin, at the Seat of the First Bow in Quiver's Hold. Should the need arise, pray put yourself wholly at the man's disposal. I strongly suspect he will need all the able-bodied souls he can muster.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MIOUNNE_000_7: The fate of Gridania hangs in the balance. Go swiftly, .
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_DOORMANSINYU_000_10: An urgent message from Mother Miounne? Very well, you may enter.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_Q1_000_1: Proceed to the Seat of the First Bow?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_DOORMANSINYU_000_11: Mayhap the messenger has forgotten the message? Should you gather your wits, I will be here.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_20: So you are , the adventurer of whom I have heard so much. I understand you wish words with me.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_21: Miounne has information on the Ixal, you say? Speak freely─you have both my ears.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_22: ...Matron forfend! They mean to defile the Guardian Tree?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_23: Before Nophica, I swear those filthy birdmen will not touch it─nay, not so much as a single leaf!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_24: Twelve help me! How can it be that neither the Wood Wailers nor the Gods' Quiver caught wind of this?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_25: I cannot help but think this plot bears the mark of the masked devil who has eluded us for so long. We must be wary─this incursion may be more than it seems.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_26:
Ah, would that the Warriors of Light were still with us...
But this is no time for such idle thoughts. I thank you for delivering this message. You may assure Miounne that I will dispatch a unit of my best men to investi─
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_SINYUSOLA_000_30: It's the Ixal, sir! The Ixal have amassed at the Guardian Tree!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_32: ─Miounne believes you capable, and I can think of no better judge than she. Lend us your strength this day─aid in the defense of the Guardian Tree!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_SINYUCOMMAND_000_35: The Bowlord sent you, yes? Good to have you with us!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_SINYUCOMMAND_000_36: The birdmen have completely surrounded the Guardian Tree, and their calls grow more urgent by the minute.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_SINYUCOMMAND_000_37: Whatever it is they mean to do, we cannot let them go through with it. They must be stopped, no matter the cost!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_Q2_000_1:

“To Guard a Guardian”?

TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_46: The rest, form the main host with me. It is high time we reminded our Ixal guests why we Quivermen are to be feared!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_47: This position is yours, adventurer. May the elementals keep you!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_IXALGURU_000_49: Interrupt us, you dare!? In your own blood, you shall bathe!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_SINYUSOLB_000_61: The Bowlord bids you hold this position. Enemies may yet lurk near, so stay on your guard.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_SINYUSOLB_000_62: We go to bolster the left flank, where the battle yet rages.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MASKEDMAGUS_000_63: The source of  strength becomes clear...
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MASKEDMAGUS_000_64: You may have bested the golem, but you will not fare so well this day.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MASKEDMAGUS_000_65: O mournful voice of creation! Send unto me a creature of the abyss, my thrall to command, that I may smite mine enemies!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MASKEDMAGUS_000_66: Your very being imperils the plan. You cannot be suffered to live.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_MASKEDMAGUS_000_80: Unnngh... That the wisdom of the Paragons should be brought low...by mere mortals...
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_PAPALYMO_102_80: The Bringers of Chaos...or Ascians, to give them their proper name.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_PAPALYMO_103_80: It would seem our suspicions were correct─it is they who have been manipulating the beast tribes.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_81: , are you unharmed!? Had I known this creature was near, I would have sent men, not called them away!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_SINYUSOLB_000_82: There is no mistake, sir─he is the one who stirred the Ixal from their nest. Our intelligence was reliable.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_83: So this is the man who has eluded us for so long?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_PAPALYMO_000_85: We sensed an ominous presence, and came here as swiftly as our legs would carry us.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_YDA_000_92: Well, it's good to know what we're up against, anyway.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_95: To say you played an instrumental role in the success of this mission would scarcely do justice to your efforts this day, adventurer. Upon your return to Gridania, pray visit me at Quiver's Hold. I will see to it that you receive the thanks you are due.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_YDA_000_96: Hmmm...you're probably wondering why we always seem to appear when there's trouble, right?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_YDA_000_97: Well, trust me when I tell you that it's almost never our fault. Despite what it looks like, Papalymo and I are actually helping the Gridanians. And we've been doing so for a good few years, too. Oh! Did I mention that we're not from around here?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_YDA_000_98: Hm? Why, yes, we are Sharlayans! However did you know?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_YDA_000_102: Awww! You always do that! Mumble something loaded with meaning, only to keep it to yourself when someone asks! It's unfair! And it's especially unfair when the someone is me!
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_PAPALYMO_000_103: Oh, do calm down! I'll tell you later.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_YDA_000_104: Hmph! I bet you won't. Anyway, all's well that ends well.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_PAPALYMO_000_105: ...Quite. We'd best be on our way.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_DOORMANSINYU_000_11: Welcome back, adventurer. Your exploits at the Guardian Tree are the stuff of songs. The Bowlord awaits you within.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_Q3_000_1: Proceed to the Seat of the First Bow?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_DOORMANSINYU_000_11: Let me know when you are ready to proceed, and I will admit you.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_120: I have awaited your return, . Allow me to thank you again for helping us to defend the Guardian Tree.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_121: Not only did you put the invading Ixal to rout─you confronted the masked mage and his fell minion, and emerged the victor.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_122: I have good men and women under me, none of whom give me cause for complaint─but you, , are a class apart.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_123: Your strength, your determination, your heart...
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_124: You have all the makings of a great adventurer. Miounne is seldom mistaken in her appraisals, and she is plainly not mistaken now.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_125: Gridania is stronger for your presence. The Elder Seedseer will doubtless be pleased to learn that a capable adventurer like you has come to us.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_LEWIN_000_126: Once more, I thank you. Owing to your valor, disaster has been averted.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400030_KANESENNA: I am come to express my gratitude for your valiant efforts before the Guardian Tree.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400040_KANESENNA: I am informed that an adventurer of singular talent now walks amongst us. You are , are you not?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400050_KANESENNA: Hm? You seem...familiar to me. We have...met before?
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400060_KANESENNA: No...I do not believe we have.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400070_KANESENNA: Forgive me. Mayhap you are merely exactly as I pictured you when the elementals told me of your deeds.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400080_KANESENNA: My name is Kan-E-Senna, and it is my solemn charge to watch over all who call Gridania home.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400090_KANESENNA: Well met and well come to our fair nation.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400100_KANESENNA: It was your valor that won us the day, I believe. On behalf of all Gridanians, I offer you my humblest thanks.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400110_KANESENNA: This gift I present to you as a small token of my gratitude. I hope that you will ever remain a friend to Gridania.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400120_KANESENNA: Greenbliss is coming. It is an age-old ceremony to renew the bond between man and elemental.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400130_KANESENNA: Over the centuries, it has blossomed into a joyous festival encompassing Gridanians from every walk of life.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400140_KANESENNA: I should be most gratified if you would participate in the ceremony as Emissary.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400170_KANESENNA: I look forward to seeing you on that most joyous of days.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_400180_KANESENNA: Till then, fare you well. May you walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_MANFST007_00447_WOODWAILERLANCE_BAT: Protect the Guardian Tree with your lives! For Gridania!

TEXT_MANFST008_00448_LEWIN_000_1: None in Gridania can doubt your worth, ...
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_LEWIN_000_2: But to receive such praise from the Elder Seedseer herself!
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_LEWIN_000_3: And nor is that the half of it! She chose you to play the role of Emissary, for gods' sakes! You! An outsider! Do you have any idea what this means!?
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_LEWIN_000_4: <sigh> But of course you don't. You are not forestborn...which is rather the point. Mistake me not, I think you worthy, but your selection is all but unprecedented. And I'll wager you have not the faintest inkling what is required of you...
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_LEWIN_000_5: There are preparations that the Emissary must needs complete ahead of time. I suggest you consult Miounne regarding the matter─she is overseeing the arrangements for the event.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_LEWIN_000_6:
Now, you had best get going─the ceremony cannot commence without the Emissary.
Oh, and, ...don't make a hash of this!
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_10: Well, well, if it isn't the Emissary ! Had I known you were coming, I would have baked a pie!
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_11: You truly are full of surprises, . Next you'll be telling me you're one of the Warriors of Light, back from a half-decade long holiday!
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_12: But let's speak of preparations. As you doubtless already know, Greenbliss is an age-old ceremony for strengthening the bond between man and elemental. These days, though, the name also refers to the festival at large.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_13: In the ceremony, the Emissary serves as a conduit─a bridge between the people and the guardians of the Twelveswood. Suffice it to say, it is no small responsibility─nor does the Elder Seedseer choose mankind's representative on a whim.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_14: Seldom in history have non-forestborn been chosen for the role─which should give you an idea of the magnitude of the honor being accorded you.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_15: For your part, you are required to wear a ceremonial artifact, which is presently in the keeping of Timbermaster Beatin.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_16: Go to the Carpenters' Guild and collect it from the man, then return to me for further instructions.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_BEATINE_000_20: So you are the Emissary-to-be. Miounne sent word that you would be coming to collect the ceremonial artifact.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_BEATINE_000_21: The good news is that it's ready─painstakingly crafted by these very hands, and from the rarest of materials.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_BEATINE_000_22: Take it, along with this warning: get so much as a scratch on the thing, and I shall make an unceremonial artifact out of you.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_30: Back from your trip to the Carpenters' Guild? Let's see what you have in that box.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_31: Ahhh...this is by far the finest Monoa mask I have ever laid eyes upon. The timbermaster has truly outdone himself this time.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_32: In case he didn't mention, the mask is crafted from consecrated lumber rendered up by the Guardian Tree, solely for use in the ceremony. In other words, it is priceless─Mother bids you to handle it with care.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_MIOUNNE_000_33: And with that, your preparations are complete. The venue should just about be in order as well. If you have any questions, now's the time to ask them.
TEXT_MANFST008_00448_Q1_000_040: Proceed to the Seat of the First Bow?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_1: Now that you have the Monoa mask, all that's left is to participate in the ceremony.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_2: Perchance you are feeling nervous, but never fear─despite all the pomp surrounding the role, there really is nothing to being Emissary.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_3: All you are required to do is wear the mask, stand up straight, and look dignified. The more involved aspects of the proceedings will be handled by others. Simple, no?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_4: The ceremony will be held at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. When you are ready, make yourself known to the caretaker there─a woman named Estaine.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_5: Oh, and be sure to wear your mask or she may not recognize you. Now, off you go, , and good luck!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_ESTAINE_000_10: Ah, you must be the Emissary.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_ESTAINE_000_11: I have been instructed to escort you to your place. You just need to put on the Monoa mask, and the ceremony may commence.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_ESTAINE_000_12: You do have the mask, don't you? If you have misplaced it, you must needs speak with Timbermaster Beatin at once. And gods help you if you don't have a compelling excuse...
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_ESTAINE_000_13: I see you have come prepared. That is well.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_ESTAINE_000_14: I have been instructed to escort you to your place. Please follow me.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000040_KANESENNA: May  find favor with the elementals!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000060_KANESENNA: Could it be...a Crystal of Light?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000070_KANESENNA: Tell me true─has the Mothercrystal revealed Herself to you? Did you bask in Her Light?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000080_KANESENNA: Have you perchance experienced sensations akin to aether sickness of late?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000090_KANESENNA: That Hydaelyn would speak directly to this ...
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000100_KANESENNA: There once were dauntless adventurers who fought in the name of Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000110_KANESENNA: When the primals threatened to bleed the land dry, these brave men and women rose to face them. When the Garlean Empire resumed its war of conquest, they rushed to the realm's defense.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000120_KANESENNA: And when it was foretold that Dalamud would fall, they fought with all their strength to deliver us from certain doom.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000130_KANESENNA: Yet as strong and as brave as they were, they─like so many─disappeared amidst the flames at Carteneau.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000140_KANESENNA: None have forgotten the heroes who gave all for the sake of a realm not their own.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000150_KANESENNA: Yet when we try to recall their names, we find the pages of our memories are blank, as if bleached by the sun.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000160_KANESENNA: And when we try to recall their faces, we see them only in silhouette, as if they stood betwixt us and a blinding glare.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000170_KANESENNA: Hence have these heroes come to be known as the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000180_KANESENNA: Beholding you, illuminated by the glow of the Crystal, I could not help but be reminded of them.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000190_KANESENNA: The Crystal has chosen you for a purpose.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000200_KANESENNA: Trust to its guiding light, and all shall be revealed to you in good time.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000210_KANESENNA: Though none can say for certain what the future will bring, it is my belief that you may yet play a telling role in the tale of this great realm.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_000220_KANESENNA: ...For the power of the Echo resides within you.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100240_RAUBAHN: Victory belongs to the bold! Show those imperial whoresons what we're made of!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100250_MERLWYB: The left flank buckles! Divert the Barracudas!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100260_MERLWYB: Bid 'em hold that position though it cost 'em their lives!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100270_KANESENNA: The Yellow Serpents are in need of succor. Pray send the White Wolves to their aid.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100280_KANESENNA: The adventurers risk life and limb for our cause. We must not fail them.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100330_RAUBAHN: The barrier won't go down so easily! Eyes forward!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100350_RAUBAHN: Raging Bull calling Blood Thorn! Blood Thorn, respond! Respond, damn you!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100370_JAKYS: (-Jakys Ryder-)Raging Bull! This is Mad Snake! Respond!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100380_RAUBAHN: Ryder!? This is Raging Bull! What news!?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100390_JAKYS: (-Jakys Ryder-)We're surrounded by a blaze! There's no way out! Gods preserve, what is that thing!?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100400_RAUBAHN: What's going on!? Speak to me!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100410_JAKYS: (-Jakys Ryder-)Godsdammit! We cannot hold much longer!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100430_RAUBAHN: Mad Snake!? Mad Snaaaaaake! Answer me!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100440_RAUBAHN: Damn it! Damn it all to the seventh hell!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100450_MERLWYB: What of the Barracudas? Can they not be reached?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100480_SERPENTRUNNE: I cannot say, my lady! That monstrosity appears to be disrupting our communications!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100490_KANESENNA: We must keep trying. Call till they respond.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100510_KANESENNA: Admiral, General─we can do no more. We must give the order to withdraw.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100530_KANESENNA: General, please! Victory may belong to the bold, but there will be no victor this day!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100540_KANESENNA: You know this to be true. Let us not sacrifice lives in vain.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100550_KANESENNA: The adventurers fight bravely, but to no avail. Let them withdraw, and let us be the ones to stand with Louisoix.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100560_MERLWYB: Belay previous orders! All Maelstrom units are commanded to fall back, effective immediately!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100570_MERLWYB: Give the Foreign Levy priority! Let the main host cover their retreat, and bring up the rear!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100580_RAUBAHN:
Damn it... Relay the order: all Flames are to withdraw.
I don't care if our linkshells are useless!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100590_RAUBAHN: You still have a working pair of legs, don't you!? Well, use 'em, you bloody half-wit!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100600_KANESENNA: The outcome of this battle was long since decided.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100610_KANESENNA: Better to retreat now, than risk a massacre.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100620_KANESENNA: This dark, stifling presence... Who...or what...?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100630_KANESENNA: We go to take our place beside Archon Louisoix! To your positions!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100640_LAHABREAANCI: (-???-)That I should live to behold Bahamut once more...
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100650_LAHABREAANCI: (-???-)Magnificent. The eons of imprisonment have only made him hungrier.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100660_LAHABREAANCI: (-???-)I am aware of them. Pay them no mind. They are powerless to act.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_100670_LAHABREAANCI: (-???-)It has begun. Soon the planet will regain its true form.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_130: Ah! Look who's back in the land of the living!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_131: Hm? You mean to say you don't remember a thing?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_132: You collapsed in the middle of the ceremony─gave us all a good fright. So we carried you back here. I must say, you're heavier than you look!
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_133: You've hardly stopped of late─your exertions must have caught up with you.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_134: But you adventurers are nothing if not resilient! Seeing as the worst is past, I shall take my leave and return to my duties.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_135: Oh, I almost forgot─the Elder Seedseer told me she'd like to see you when you felt well enough.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_MIOUNNE_000_136: The gentle soul was almost as worried about you as I was, bless her. When you're back on your feet, be sure and visit her at the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_BEATINE_000_20: Twelve as my witness... I will not bother speculating how you lost the mask, though I find it hard to believe it was not intentional.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_BEATINE_000_21: See that you don't lose this one. Now stop wasting time and continue your quest. This minstrel's tale cannot reach its climax till all the players be assembled.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_DOORMANLOTUS_000_14: Ah, you are , are you not? I bid you welcome, . The Elder Seedseer left word that you would be joining her at the Lotus Stand. May I show you in?
Very well. Yet know that it is not meet to keep the Elder Seedseer waiting.
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_KANESENNA_000_150: I have looked forward to your coming, . But tell me, are you recovered?
TEXT_MANFST009_00449_KANESENNA_000_151: I am most glad of that. Now, I hope you will not doubt the earnestness of my concern...but I would ask a favor of you. Nor can I deny that I summoned you here in part with this in mind. Know, however, that I proceed only upon the understanding that you are rested and well.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_BADERON_000_1: Still in Limsa, are ye, ? 'Ow'd ye fancy a trip outside the city walls?
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_BADERON_000_2: I'd like ye to visit an orchard by the name o' Summerford Farms. Ever 'eard o' the place? The owner, Staelwyrn, is an old mate o' mine.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_BADERON_000_3: 'E's got 'imself a crew o' mostly reformed pirate types, if ye can believe that, and 'as been tryin' to bring a bit o' life back to the fields after the Calamity ruined the soil. 'E mentioned needin' another 'and or two, and yer name sprang to mind.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_BADERON_000_4: I gave ye a glowin' recommendation, so make sure ye work 'ard and impress the old bastard. Ye need directions? The place ain't 'ard to find: just take the Zephyr Gate out o' the city, and follow the road northeast.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_STAELWYRN_000_11: Ah, you must be the adventurer Baderon promised to send along. , wasn't it?
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_STAELWYRN_000_12: You honored his word, so that's a good start. I'm Staelwyrn, the “old bastard,” as Baderon likely described me, and this here is my humble orchard.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_STAELWYRN_000_13: A good number of the lads and lasses workin' here once terrorized the high seas. And if you're wonderin' why I employ these scrags, well, they used to crew my pirate ship.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_STAELWYRN_000_14: But the Calamity did for our ship, like it did so many others, and I was sore wounded into the bargain.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_STAELWYRN_000_15: I had to feed myself and my crew somehow, and Admiral Merlwyb's initiative to get us landlocked buccaneers workin' the fields seemed too fine an offer to refuse.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_STAELWYRN_000_16: Well, it turns out you can take the pirate away from the sea, but you can't take the sea away from the pirate. A lot of my blokes just never took to tendin' the soil, you see.
TEXT_SUBSEA050_00462_STAELWYRN_000_17: And unfortunately, the botanists I called in to train 'em have been wringin' their hands in black despair. With so much work pilin' up, I need a tougher soul like you to step in and help where it's needed.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_STAELWYRN_000_1: I've a mind to set you a task, , but before I do, I need to be sure you're properly kitted out.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_STAELWYRN_000_2: Pirates don't care to parley with dandies, you understand. It might well be that the ones here have traded in their cutlasses for coulters, but they're still rogues at heart.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_STAELWYRN_000_3: I know a solid set of gear when I see it. Come back when you think you're more suitably equipped.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_SYSTEM_000_4: Equip your head, body, hands, legs, and feet with gear of item level 5 or greater and speak with Staelwyrn.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_STAELWYRN_000_11: Let's have a look at you, shall we?
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_STAELWYRN_000_12: Oho! As long as you're this well covered, I won't feel any guilt throwin' you to the sharks.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_STAELWYRN_000_13: Erstwhile buccaneers are an ornery lot. They rage in love for the sea, and care little for the laws of the land.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_STAELWYRN_000_14: But they respect strength, and by the looks of you, I'd say you'll have little trouble gettin' their attention.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_STAELWYRN_000_15: No, no, , I fear I can't give you work lookin' like that. It's not about just handlin' yourself in combat. You want to dress in such a way as to terrorize your foes, causin' them to regret challengin' you in the first place.
TEXT_SUBSEA051_00463_SYSTEM_000_16: Equip your head, body, hands, legs, and feet with gear of item level 5 or greater and speak with Staelwyrn.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_STAELWYRN_000_1: That sea-sloth Sevrin and his lot─never around when there's work to be done!
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_STAELWYRN_000_2: I'd sooner hire you for the sake of gettin' things done, but then the rapscallions would never learn.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_STAELWYRN_000_3: Round them up and let them know that Staelwyrn would like a word... And don't take no for an answer!
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_SEVRIN_000_11: Aye, I'm Sevrin. You the old man's errand , now?
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_SEVRIN_000_12: Tell my dear old captain not to wet his britches. I'll be along.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_SEVRIN_000_13: Oh, and just so we're clear─I don't care for landlubbers. Go find the chocobo you rode in on, and ride on out.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_AYLMER_000_21: So, Staelwyrn sent you. And what do you reckon I say to that?
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_Q1_000_1: What do you reckon he says?
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_A1_000_1: Work is for the weak and witless.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_AYLMER_000_23: Damn right! Didn't get where I am by takin' guff from any glorified gardeners! ...But I s'pose I could see what he wants to get him off my back.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_EYRIMHUS_000_31: Axes were made for splittin' skulls, not stumps! You know what I did in my sailin' days?
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_Q2_000_1: What did he do in his sailing days?
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_EYRIMHUS_000_33: You bet your  I did, ! Aye, those were the days... <sigh> I reckon now I'll have to be satisfied takin' my axe to the trees.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_SOZAIRARZAI_000_41: <groan> How am I supposed to work on an empty stomach? Go on, have a guess at what I had for breakfast.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_Q3_000_1: What did he eat for breakfast?
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_SOZAIRARZAI_000_43: Wha─ Gods, how'd you know!? It's my breath, ain't it? It probably smells as wooden as the food tasted... But I know why you're here. <sigh> I'd just as soon get some real food in me, but I ain't one to reject a summons from the cap'n.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_WAUTER_000_51: Work? Ha! Can't work when me hands are full liftin' this mug. Ye know, I'd wager me last gil ye'd never guess what I'm drinkin'.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_Q4_000_1: What do you think is in his mug?
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_WAUTER_000_53: Well, yer right about the “swill” part. I reckon it might be worth a day o' doin' Staelwyrn's chores if it'll afford me a taste o' proper grog.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_STAELWYRN_000_61: You continue to impress, . All but Sevrin are accounted for.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_STAELWYRN_000_62: It's no fault of yours he squirmed out. I've let that worm wriggle through my fingers more times than I can count.
TEXT_SUBSEA053_00465_STAELWYRN_000_63: But rest assured, the next time I see him, I'll put him squarely in the dirt, where all such worms belong.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_STAELWYRN_000_1: Pains me to say, but all the gil in the world can't buy loyalty. There are some, like you, who can be trusted. But then there are others...
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_STAELWYRN_000_2: Until now, I've had no choice but to rely on that charlatan Sevrin, even though I am full aware he's been doin' shady deals behind my back. More than once I've heard tell of improper tradin' with goblins.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_STAELWYRN_000_3: I wouldn't be the least surprised if that were happenin' right now. Not a bell ago, a sack of oranges vanished, as did Sevrin. I want you to find and confront the bastard for me, . I'm sure there's wrongdoin' afoot, so be sure to doubt anythin' that comes out of his mouth.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SEVRIN_000_11: Bloody hells! I'm up the strait without a paddle!
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SEVRIN_000_12: What's this now? Staelwyrn sent you for the oranges? Huh... So the old bugger had known all this time... Argh, what does it matter anyway?
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SEVRIN_000_13: Listen, you're one o' those goody-goody adventurer types, right? Go rescue me mates from those double-dealin' goblins! They're just over yonder by the bonfire.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SEVRIN_000_21: You save me mates and, by the Navigator, you'll have your sack o' scurvy snacks!
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_AYLMER_000_31: I owe you one. Would've gotten away meself if not fer Sevrin shovin' me aside.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_EYRIMHUS_000_31: Sevrin sent you? Hah! The way he flew out of here, I was sure he'd sold us down the river!
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SOZAIRARZAI_000_31: If you hadn't come, my dodo would've been cooked! Mmm...cooked dodo.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SEVRIN_000_41: You saved me mates, and for that, I owe you.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SEVRIN_000_42: S'pose I should be ashamed I couldn't clean up my own mess...
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_SEVRIN_000_43: ...But a pirate knows no shame! I've no qualms about goin' back on my word! I'm only givin' you this sack 'cause I like the cut of your jib. Take it to Ossine, an' send him my regards.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_OSSINE_000_51: What have we here? A delivery from Summerford Farms, and as scheduled? Hah! There's a first time for everything!
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_OSSINE_000_52: Well, look at that... Not a single one missing, either! About the only things not here are those bagmen, and I don't miss them one bit.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_OSSINE_000_53: Here's Staelwyrn's payment in full. With you, I can trust it'll reach him!
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_STAELWYRN_000_61: Back in one piece! That's a relief. How did you fare, ?
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_STAELWYRN_000_62: Ah, this is what I was aimin' for! Looks to be all I was owed, all right. Though, I'd be tellin' you false if I claimed I had not held out more hope for Sevrin.
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_STAELWYRN_000_63: I was even willin' to overlook the skimmin' off the top, but to sell us all short in favor of those godsforsaken goblins... <sigh>
TEXT_SUBSEA054_00466_STAELWYRN_000_64: You'd do well to mind yourself around that two-gil cheat. If he'd leave his own mates for dead, there's no tellin' what he'd do to you.
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_GURCANT_000_1: Blast! At this rate, the crops will never be ready for harvest.
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_GURCANT_000_2: If only we had blackloam... Just a bit could send our stalks soaring!
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_GURCANT_000_3: I'll bet Rhotwyda knows where you might find some. Perhaps you might pay her a visit in the orchard?
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_RHOTWYDA_000_11: That Gurcant's got a head of cabbage if he thinks I'm fetchin' him any blackloam!
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_RHOTWYDA_000_12: But if you dare to pinch some from the Cookpot, then be my guest. Just mind you don't get trampled upon by the aurochs that dwell there.
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_RHOTWYDA_000_13: Once you've three bushels' worth, take the blackloam to Pfrewahl at Tiller's Rest. He'll know what to do.
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_PFREWAHL_000_21: Argh, even the weeds wither and die in this desolate dirt.
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_PFREWAHL_000_22: But a bit of this blackloam ought to change all that! I haven't seen any in ages. Gathering blackloam's not for the weak of will...nor the weak of stomach, eh? Hahaha!
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_PFREWAHL_000_23: ...Oh, don't tell me Gurcant and Rhotwyda neglected to mention where blackloam comes from.
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_PFREWAHL_000_24: Well, surely you figured it out on your own from the cloying stench! It comes from the aurochs' lair, of all places!
TEXT_SUBSEA055_00467_PFREWAHL_000_25: Ahem, well, why dwell on who misled whom about what? What matters is that your efforts have brought us the blackloam, and we can expect a bountiful harvest as a result. Thank you!
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_PFREWAHL_000_1: Confounded pirates! They know nothin' of tillin', only killin'! Stealin' our shovels to melt and forge into axes, of all things.
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_PFREWAHL_000_2: They're bitin' the hand that feeds 'em, the mangy mongrels. I'd love to teach those curs a lesson in obedience myself, if I hadn't sworn to Staelwyrn that I wouldn't fight no more.
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_PFREWAHL_000_3: So I need you to bring back our farm tools, and make sure those dogs reap what they've sown!
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_STAELWYRN_000_21: Pirates makin' off with our tools? Pfrewahl did well not to take matters into his own hands. Last thing I need is blood on my crops.
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_STAELWYRN_000_22: But I'll be damned if Sevrin thinks he can take us for fools. His treachery won't go unpunished.
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_PFREWAHL_000_11: I wonder what those sea dogs will try an' steal when there's no harvest!
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_PFREWAHL_000_12: Ah, good to see the tools back, and in serviceable condition. Which will be more than we can say of Sevrin when we get our hands on him. The wretch likely had a role in the theft.
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_PFREWAHL_000_13: Spied him meetin' the pirates in secret, I did. I couldn't care less if the wastrel won't work, but when he consorts with cutpurses that take our tools away, he's crossed the line!
TEXT_SUBSEA056_00468_PFREWAHL_000_14: Staelwyrn ought to know what sort of scalawag he's dealing with. Take word to him, would you?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_100_1: I've come to expect a great deal from you, , and you've never once let me down.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_101_1: Yet what I'd ask of you now goes beyond aught I've asked before. Would you hear my plea all the same?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_1: It eases my mind to have your ear.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_2: You're no doubt familiar with that scoundrel Sevrin by now.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_3: Well, the schemin' scapegrace is at it again. Since that letter came for him, he's been skulkin' about in that manner he does when he's up to no good.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_4: Now he's rounded up his rogues and buggered off, with nary a word to anyone.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_5: I've grown accustomed to his insolence, but somethin' tells me this is different. It ain't exactly damnin', but when last I had words with him, he didn't look defiant so much as hunted. I can't help thinkin' he's gone lookin' for trouble and found more than he wanted.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_6: So I was hopin' you might hunt his sorry hide down and drag it back here before it's too late.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_7: The ungrateful little cur bites me every chance he gets, but I can't quite bring myself to cut him loose. I s'pose he reminds me a bit of my younger self.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_8: Suffice it to say, I'd rather he didn't come to a sticky end. As for how to find him, I'd try askin' Grynewyda at the aetheryte. She was the last one to see him.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_9: I daresay she'll be able to tell you where he was headed.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_GRYNEWYDA_000_11: Nothing that passes through those gates escapes my notice!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_GRYNEWYDA_000_12: I saw the rouser and his rabble set out for Woad Whisper Canyon not long ago, singing about drinking themselves stupider. Cheeky sods said I should join them!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_GRYNEWYDA_000_13: I told them I'd rather shrivel up than sip whatever it was that had pickled their brains. If you find the idle swine, be sure and give them a cuff 'round the ear from me, will you?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_AYLMER_000_21: Of all the dirty, deceitful, downright dastardly deeds that slippery bastard's done!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_AYLMER_000_22: Claimin' to take the lads out for a drink, only to lead us straight into a bloody trap! It don't get no lower than that!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_AYLMER_000_23: 'Course, I've learned to stay a step ahead of ol' Sevrin, so I was ready─but the others weren't so lucky. You've got to help 'em!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_35: It ain't safe here! Take the others an' get out while you still can!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_EYRIMHUS_000_25: My axe may as well've been a white flag for all the good it did... Hope you fare better, or the sorry bastards in there are done for.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_45: Can't move...my leg. Leave me. Save the others.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_IREZUMI_000_50: At long last, you will have the dog's death you deserve...deserter.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SOZAIRARZAI_000_30: Sevrin might've got us into this mess, but I ain't about to let him give his life for us. I'd sooner bow to a fishback than be in that connivin' bastard's debt! To arms!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_Q1_000_1:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“Just Deserts”?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_IREZUMI_000_60: A true knave! You betray even yourself, Sevrin.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_IREZUMI_000_62: We were prepared to overlook the matter of your desertion on the condition that you provided us with suitable replacements. That was the agreement.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_IREZUMI_000_63:
Yet your latest change of heart leaves your debt to us unpaid.
Few are they who betray the Serpent Reavers twice. You will not do so a third time.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_IREZUMI_000_64: Cowering behind your protector will only delay the inevitable. Honorless wretch...your life is all you have left.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_IREZUMI_000_65: And worthless though it be, we shall take it!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_MASKEDMAGUS_000_66: (-???-)O mournful voice of creation! Grant ye this humble stone a soul, that it may wake to life!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_MASKEDMAGUS_BATTLET:
You are strong.
But are you strong enough to withstand this?
Impossible! Never has the golem been so sorely tested!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_81: I am only glad he did not have the chance to sink his fangs more deeply into you.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_90: Those pirates do not belong to any of the known Lominsan factions... Whom then do they serve? The beast tribes? Surely not.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_91: But the timing of their appearance coincides all too neatly with the recent surge in Sahagin and kobold activity... Something is afoot. The question is: what?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_92: ...Could it be that the tribes are planning to summon their primals?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_93: Twelve help us if it should prove so. Limsa would be hard-pressed to keep a single primal at bay, let alone two. But all is yet speculation. I must needs find evidence.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_95: While the lesser moon continues to fall...
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_96: And ilm by ilm, the world becomes ever more unlike itself.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_98: The coming of chaos has rendered the laws of nature mutable, blurring the boundary between the material and aetherial planes... Little now stands between us and the primals.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_99:
...But they are not here yet.
“Though time be against us, hope shall ever be on our side.”
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_100: Never did the creed of Sharlayan ring more true.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_101: Never did I dream that I would possess the means to see aether...yet now that I do, I do begin to take it for granted. How swiftly do the wonders of Sharlayan seem commonplace...
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_GIRL_000_103: Here, for you. Have you come for the festivities?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_GIRL_000_104: Today the Maelstrom officially makes that great hole in the sea its training ground. Join in the celebrations!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_105: Wait. A disturbance in the aetheric flow. But whence does it emanate?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_110: What have we here...? Can you walk?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_111:
'Tis I.
Regrettably, no. He eluded me.
Understood. I will inform the commodore.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_112: You collapsed from your exertions. Are you suitably recovered?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_113: Sevrin here has apprised me of all that transpired. His account shed some light upon how you came to be attacked by a golem of all things.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_114: A golem is a mindless automaton, inert save when commanded to be otherwise. Common pirates could not hope to control such a thing, so arcane are its workings.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_115: But then these tattooed wretches are no common pirates─they are the minions of the Sahagin. As to their purpose...well, I shall get to the bottom of it.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_116: But first I must escort Sevrin back to his place of employment. I daresay Staelwyrn will be wondering what has become of him.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_117: And you too, for that matter. I will bear word to him of your preservation, but I am certain he would like to thank you in person. Pray pay the man a visit.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_118: Ah...he told me of you, but perchance he did not tell you of me. My name is Y'shtola.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_119: I am...a naturalist of sorts, surveying the aether in the hope that it might offer up some clue as to our predicament.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_120: I'd say I owed you my life...but that don't cover it. If it weren't for you, my friends would be dead, an' all...
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_121: 'Tis a debt I can never repay. But I'll not make things worse by runnin' away. Take me to Summerford Farms, an' I'll face the consequences.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_122:
For reasons I cannot fathom, you seem...
Forgive me. Mayhap we shall have a chance to speak again when I have marshaled my thoughts.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_YSHTOLA_000_123: Until our paths next cross, farewell.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_131: Y'shtola delivered Sevrin a bit ago. Tales of your heroic deeds precede you!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_132: The rest came shufflin' back, too─the lot of 'em sportin' the same haunted expression.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_133: It's me who's to blame for that─that an' the rest.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_134: I was once a Serpent Reaver.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_135: ...A thrall to the Sahagin? Seven hells... Reavers may look and sound and act like pirates, but they're naught but the fishbacks' flunkies.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_136: Us pirates ain't much for laws, but there's things we won't do. We've got a code, see─but the Reavers've never followed a word of it. A few years back, they started snatchin' law-abidin' Lominsans.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_137: I'd only just taken my oath when our captain bent the knee to his new Sahagin masters. I knew I had to get away.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_138: So I crept off one night, got myself a new name, an' found myself a new home─Summerford Farms. Trouble is, secrets don't stay secret for long 'round here, an' word soon spread...all the way back to the sea.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_139: The penalty for desertion is death, but the Reavers offered me a way out instead─my freedom in exchange for my mates'.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_141: I dunno what I was thinkin'... <snort> I wasn't bloody thinkin'. Too busy soilin' meself.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_142: Aye, but you got there in the end, didn't you? When the time came, you made the right decision.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_143: The men say little to me, but I hear 'em talk of how you stood up to the Reavers at the last─of how you tried to give your life to save theirs.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_144: Be that as it may, no deed, however good, can atone for the crime of betrayin' your brethren.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_145: I know that─I do. That's why I'm going to hand myself over to the Yellowjackets. I'll bring shame to the farm no more.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_146: Hm. You'll hear no arguments from me. Each man must sail accordin' to his own moral compass.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_147: I just hope yours guides you back here someday. There will always be a place for you at Summerford Farms, lad.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_148: An' I'll always be in your debt, Staelwyrn.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SEVRIN_000_150: An' yours an' all, adventurer. I've caused more than my fair share o' trouble durin' my time here─not that you need tellin'.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_151: I owe you a debt too, . Not once have you let me down. Thank you for savin' the men of my farm.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_152: If I could ask one more favor of you, it'd be this: tell Baderon what's happened, from start to finish. I'm certain he'd put in a good word for Sevrin if he knew the whole story.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_153: And he's one of the few people I know who the Yellowjackets'll listen to.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_STAELWYRN_000_154: Well, I reckon I've asked all I can possibly ask of you. Safe travels, .
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_161: ...Bloody 'ells! Life on the farm ain't quite 'ow I pictured it!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_162:
Ah, but ye needn't worry yerself over young Sevrin. The Yellowjacket as 'ands out the punishments is a good mate o' mine. If I ask 'im nice, I reckon 'e'd be willin' to commute the lad's sentence from 'angin' to keelhaulin', kindly gent that 'e is.
...Ah, I'm only jestin' with ye! I'll see 'e's treated fair.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_163: Now, it sounds to me like ye've done everythin' ol' Staelwyrn asked o' ye an' more─justifyin' me generous finder's fee in the process. Much obliged, !
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_164: As fer a reward...well, she's a lonely lady, this Drownin' Wench o' mine. 'Ow'd ye fancy keepin' 'er company fer a spell...with free room an' board?
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_165: 'Venturin's a tryin' business, after all. Them as don't rest their bones every now an' again tend to end up with broken ones. An' take it from me: fightin' ain't nearly so much fun when yer nursin' a shattered arm. Got that? Good. There'll always be a free bed fer ye, so make use of it.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_166: Not that ye'll 'ave much time fer lyin' around, what with all the leves ye'll be doin'. Oh, didn't I mention? I'm puttin' yer name down fer leves.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_167: Our guild draws all manner o' clients, offerin' all manner of odd jobs. Honestly, ye'd be amazed 'ow much folk'll pay to avoid doin' an honest day's labor.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_168: Just give T'mokkri a shout whenever ye feel like makin' a few extra gil. She'll always 'ave some task or other fer ye to do.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_169: Oh, an' it's all above board, 'case yer wonderin'. We're careful to stay on the Admiral's right side in 'ere─unlike some pirates I could mention... I tell ye, if it turns out they 'ad aught to do with them kidnappin's, there'll be seven hells to pay. A proper bleedin' reckonin'...
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_170: Mayhap that's what Limsa needs, though. On rough seas, sometimes ye 'ave to rock the boat to right it.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_BADERON_000_171: But we'll 'ave time fer such talk when yer well an' rested. Till then, enjoy the Wench's 'ospitality!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SYSTEM_000_181: In recognition of your achievements, you have been granted access to guildleves and inn rooms.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SYSTEM_000_182: As you complete quests and embark on new adventurers, the world will draw you ever deeper into its mysteries.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SYSTEM_000_183: The great realm of Eorzea yet holds myriad roads untraveled and sights unseen. Continue along the path of the adventurer and discover what wonders await you!
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SYSTEM_000_190: You now have access to Recommendations. This feature displays a list of quests or duties currently available in your area.
TEXT_SUBSEA057_00469_SYSTEM_000_191: The Recommendations list can be opened from under Duty in the main menu, and will also be displayed automatically when you log in. If you find yourself unsure of what to do next, this tool makes it simple to locate activities suitable for your present class and level.
TEXT_SUBWIL095_00503_DRUNKENSTAG_000: The “product” you heard Dadanen going on about is a valuable gemstone known as raw Nashachite. I managed to dig up a goodly amount just before the mines were closed off, actually.
TEXT_SUBWIL095_00503_DRUNKENSTAG_001: Packed it up and hauled it out, even. But then them Twelve-damned coblyns came along. Not like any coblyns I'd seen before, and hungry only for the good rocks. They had eyes for my gemstones, so I had no choice but to oblige.
TEXT_SUBWIL095_00503_DRUNKENSTAG_002: The Stone Torches had their hands full evacuating the mines, so they ignored the beasts. Even now, they're only concerned with keeping people out. Please, friend, if you're willing to face the coblyns, would you bring me my Nashachite?
TEXT_SUBWIL095_00503_DRUNKENSTAG_010: How did you fare, friend? Did you find the raw Nashachite?
TEXT_SUBWIL095_00503_DRUNKENSTAG_011: Beautiful, isn't it? Rarer than many stones, and more expensive than most. They say the green is the same as the eyes of Nanasha Ul Nasha, who once ruled as the sultana.
TEXT_SUBWIL095_00503_DRUNKENSTAG_012: This should save Dadanen from his troubles...if there's enough left. There's far less here than what I found. I reckon those coblyns made a meal of the stuff. Bloody waste...
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_1: Thank you for hearing me out.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_10: I have written a letter to my counterparts in the Eorzean Alliance.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_11: The Battle of Carteneau and the Calamity that followed claimed countless souls, and left countless more bereft and alone. In the dark days that followed, many were the survivors who thought themselves less fortunate than the dead.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_12: Five years have come and gone, but the land and the people still bear the wounds of the devastation.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_13: Nor are we any closer to learning the fate of the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_14: Yet so long as we live, never must we give up hope. We owe this to those who laid down their lives that we might behold another dawn.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_15: In remembrance of them, a memorial service will soon be held upon the anniversary of the Battle of Carteneau. This missive bears the details of that service.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_16: You graciously accepted the part of Emissary in the recent ceremony.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_17: Should you be so willing, I would now make you my envoy, and have you bear my message to our allies.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_18: Your dedication to the people of Gridania rouses fond memories in me, and I would choose no other for the role. Will you do me this favor?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_20: As you are no doubt aware, our partners in the Eorzean Alliance lie some considerable distance away. Nor are Ul'dah and Limsa Lominsa close to one another.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_21: Yet fear not, for I have no intention of subjecting you, mine own newly anointed envoy, to a journey which would take weeks by land.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_22: No, I mean for you to travel by air. Receive of me this airship pass. With it, you may make use of the skyways that connect the three city-states of the Alliance.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_23: The airship landing is situated upon the lower floor of the Carline Canopy. Simply show your pass, and you will be admitted to the departure area. Before you embark upon your journey, however, you would do well to seek the worldly wisdom of Miounne. Few forestborn Gridanians know more of the lands beyond the Twelveswood than she.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_24: In better times, airships were available for the convenience of one and all. Alas, the risk that our crafts may fall to imperial attack has forced a reduction in the number of flights.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_25: Consequently, it has become necessary to restrict air travel only to those whose need is great. Such individuals may petition the relevant parties to be issued an airship pass. As you may have deduced, I myself am one such party.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_26: ...Yet I was not alone in desiring that you be granted the privilege of air travel.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_27: Such is the potential you show.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_28: We have no doubt but that you will reward our faith in you, .
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_29: By the power vested in me, I bid you journey forth as my envoy into the great realm of Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_30: Walk her fields, brave her seas, and strive to know her better.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_31: And wheresoever you go, go without fear, for the path shall ever be revealed to those who are true of heart.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_KANESENNA_000_32: Guided by the Crystal's light, set forth, and discover your destiny.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_40: 'Tis good to see you up and about again, . Tell me, did you pay the Elder Seedseer a visit as I bade?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_42: And now you are to bear the Elder Seedseer's missive to our allies...
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_43: Well! It seems you've made an impression on the great woman! I can't argue with her judgment, though. You've earned this honor with tireless hard work, and anyone who says you don't deserve it had better not do so in my hearing!
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_44: I find myself praising you often of late, but Mother is truly proud of you.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_45: Short of a Warrior of Light, I can imagine no better adventurer to represent us─and that, my , is some compliment!
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_46: But I've flattered you enough for one day. And I don't want your head to get too big, or you'll struggle to lug it around the realm. Speaking of which, Eorzea is a big old place.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_47: Now that you have an airship pass, you can really start to broaden your horizons. The sky's quite literally the limit.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_48: Even if your errand didn't call for it, I would strongly suggest visiting the two other city-states of the Alliance before you go anywhere else. They are, of course, Limsa Lominsa, city of pirates, and Ul'dah, jewel of the desert.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_49: Once you've acquainted yourself with them, you can turn your sights on whichever lesser-trodden region takes your fancy.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_50: The Calamity changed the face of Eorzea, and much of her now lies in shadow, beyond man's ken. It's a veritable playground for a wide-eyed adventurer like your good self.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_51: Mind you, it won't all be fun and games.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_52: Each nation faces its fair share of problems, from internal strife to conflict with the beast tribes and their primals. So don't be too surprised if you find yourself embroiled in the odd unsavory situation on your travels.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_53: But no matter what difficulties you encounter, I am confident that you will pull through, and emerge the stronger for the experience.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_54: These are interesting times for Eorzea, . It's been five years now since the Calamity, but folk are finally beginning to look to the future.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_55: A period of great change is upon us, and you have a part to play in it. And if that prospect doesn't excite you, I don't know what will!
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LIONNELLAIS_000_60: Greetings, good . This is the reservation counter for Limsa Lominsa-bound flights.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LIONNELLAIS_000_61: Oh, are you not , the Elder Seedseer's personal envoy? We at Highwind Skyways are honored to serve you! Will you be flying with us today?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LIONNELLAIS_000_62: Very well. When you are ready to board, please let me know.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_CABINCREW_000_65: Do you wish to leave the landing area?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_CABINCREW_000_66: We hope you have a pleasant voyage.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LIONNELLAIS_000_70: The airship bound for Limsa Lominsa will be departing shortly. Are you ready to board, ?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LIONNELLAIS_000_71: Thank you for using Highwind Skyways. The airship to Ul'dah will be departing shortly.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LIONNELLAIS_000_72: Very well. When you are ready to board, please let me know.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_ANNOUNCE_000_80: Attention, all passengers: the airship bound for Limsa Lominsa is about to depart. Please make your way to the boarding gate.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_82: One day, minstrels will sing of your deeds.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MIOUNNE_000_83: May you ever walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_000010_GAIUS: (-???-)It has been fifteen years, but the bitter taste of defeat lingers still...
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_000020_GAIUS: (-???-)Fifteen years since the imperial fleet set course for Mor Dhona, led by the Agrius, mightiest of all vessels.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_000030_GAIUS: (-???-)Silvertear Lake lay ripe for the taking, and all of Eorzea would soon be ours...or so we believed.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_000040_GAIUS: (-???-)But an innumerable host of dragons met us that day, at the heart of which flew the great Midgardsormr.
