TEXT_MANFST200_00507_000050_GAIUS: (-???-)Though we succeeded in slaying that lord among wyrms, the dread serpent's defeat was bought at too high a price.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_000060_GAIUS: (-???-)Our invincible flagship was lost, and all hope of victory with her. So ended our glorious conquest.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100070_GAIUS: (-???-)Eorzea... A blighted realm, riddled with false gods...
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100080_GAIUS: (-???-)Twice now it has eluded the Empire's grasp.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100090_GAIUS: (-???-)For all the destruction it wrought, even Meteor, the Great Sin, failed to yield us control over it.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100100_GAIUS: (-???-)And for this failure, the realm has sunk deeper into depravity.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100110_GAIUS: (-???-)It is twisted beyond all reckoning─rotten nigh to the core.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100130_GAIUS: (-???-)Only Garlean rule can bring order to Eorzea. It falls to us to deliver the misguided masses from their ignorance.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100140_HUKUKANS: (-All-)We are of one mind, Lord van Baelsar.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100150_ANNOUNCE: Senior engineers, please report to magitek research following the scheduled inspection.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100160_ENGINEERA: Hey. Is the legatus really planning to take another tilt at Eorzea?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100170_ENGINEERB: Eh!? What hole have you been hiding in? We're in the midst of preparing for a new campaign, and a huge one at that!
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100180_ENGINEERA: But...I thought the Emperor had given up the western lands for lost after Carteneau. What could the legatus possibly hope to gain by acting alone?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100190_NERO: (-???-)I sense you harbor certain doubts over the wisdom of the legatus's plan.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100210_NERO: Please, call me Nero. Tell me, where were you born?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100260_NERO: Silence. Your denials will not change your fate.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100290_NERO: Clean up this mess. And do not miss any, or I shall be most displeased.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_100310_NERO: Garlond... Soon you will be made to know the true power of magitek.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_CABINCREW_000_85: Ah, you must be the envoy from Gridania! Welcome to Limsa Lominsa, . Admiral Bloefhiswyn awaits your arrival.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_CABINCREW_000_86: Please let me know if you require any assistance.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_STORMA_000_90: You are the Gridanian envoy? Welcome to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_STORMA_000_91: The Admiral has been looking forward to your arrival.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_STORMA_000_92: Please proceed to the Crow's Lift at your earliest convenience. It will take you to Bulwark Hall.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_STORMA_000_93: Once there, pray speak with Zanthael. He will be pleased to show you in to the Admiral's command room on the Bridge.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_STORMA_000_95: Pray speak with Zanthael in Bulwark Hall. He will be pleased to show you in to the Admiral's command room on the Bridge.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_ZANTHAEL_000_100: Greetings, , and welcome to our fair city. If you would permit me to examine the seal on the missive you carry...
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_ZANTHAEL_000_101: Yes, everything seems to be in order. My apologies. We cannot afford to be complacent, you understand. Please, step this way.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_200330_MERLWYB: I did not expect the Gridanian envoy to be an adventurer. It speaks highly of your character that the Elder Seedseer would choose an outsider to represent her nation's interests.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_200360_MERLWYB: I am Merlwyb Bloefhiswyn, Admiral of Limsa Lominsa, and commander of the Maelstrom.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_200370_MERLWYB: Now, what news from the Black Shroud?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_200380_MERLWYB: Before you begin, I would know your name.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_200390_MERLWYB: Strange. I would readily have sworn that I knew you, but it seems I was mistaken.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_200400_MERLWYB: I may not recall old friends' faces, but I surely remember my enemies'. Woe betide the Admiral who fails in that!
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_200410_MERLWYB: But I jest. Please, do continue.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_110: Hm. A memorial service to honor the fallen.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_111: Seven hells... Has it been five years?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_112: Five years since the Garlean Empire sought to wrest Eorzea from our grasp...
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_113: It was in answer to the imperial threat that the city-states formed the Grand Companies, and forged the Eorzean Alliance anew. But Garlemald was not content to wager all on a simple contest of martial might. They had other plans─the Meteor project.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_114: Legatus Nael van Darnus─hells take him─intended to “cleanse” our realm by snatching the lesser moon, Dalamud, from the heavens and casting it down upon our heads. Desperate to prevent this lunatic scheme, we marched our forces to the Carteneau Flats and there met the VIIth Imperial Legion in battle.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_115: Never have I seen a fight like the Battle of Carteneau─and I have seen full many.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_116: But though we gave no quarter, spared not one onze of effort...we could not prevent what followed.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_117: From inside the shell of Dalamud came a winged nightmare─a dragon the size of a bloody city. 'Twas the elder primal Bahamut, bent on making an eighth hell of Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_118: In the space of a breath, the legions of the Empire were set aflame, while our own armies fared little better. 'Twas as if the whole world was burning... Words cannot well describe the scene.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_119: And yet...by some miracle, a few among us were spared.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_120: Even as I steeled myself for death, a blinding white light enveloped me, robbing me of my senses.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_121: When I regained them, the dragon was gone, and the still-smoldering land was warped beyond all knowing.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_122: Were Archon Louisoix still with us, he would doubtless shed some light on these unfathomable happenings. Alas, he is not, and I fear we will want for his wisdom in the days to come.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_123: For while our nations struggle to recover from the devastation, the beastmen call forth their damned primals to torment us anew.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_124: Unless we put aside our differences and rebuild now, our foes will catch us unprepared.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_125: And I speak not only of the beastmen. Do not imagine that the Empire has forsaken its claim on Eorzea. The imperials crowd our borders, waiting to strike.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_126: Damn it all, we need champions to replace those we lost...
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_127: But such thoughts are worse than worthless. Time is short, and none will save us, save ourselves. It is the duty of every soul who survived the Calamity to work together for the good of Eorzea...and this memorial service may be the very thing to unite us.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_128: Aye, Kan-E-Senna has the right of it. I accept her proposal.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_129: Your duty is done here, adventurer─I will see to it that the Elder Seedseer receives my reply.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_130: You travel next to Ul'dah, yes?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_131: Pray give my regards to General Raubahn. Oh, and tell him the wolf has been sniffing around the stables. A private jest─and one in poor taste─but I would have you tell it all the same.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_MERLWYB_000_132: Fare you well, . May the Navigator guide you on your journey.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LNOPHLO_000_140: Greetings, . This is the counter for passengers traveling to Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LNOPHLO_000_141: A pleasure to serve you again, . Are you ready to board the airship to Ul'dah?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LNOPHLO_000_145: Very well, . I'll be glad to assist you when you are.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_CABINCREW_000_146: Do you wish to leave the landing area?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_CABINCREW_100_146: We hope you have a pleasant voyage.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LNOPHLO_000_147: Are you ready to depart, ? The airship bound for Ul'dah will be leaving shortly.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_LNOPHLO_100_147: Very well, . I'll be glad to assist you when you're ready.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_CABINCREW_000_200: Ah, you must be the envoy from Gridania! Welcome to Ul'dah, . The Flame General awaits your arrival.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_CABINCREW_000_201: Please let me know if you require any assistance.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_FLAMEA_000_150: Welcome to Ul'dah, . We have been expecting you.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_FLAMEA_000_151: Flame General Raubahn will receive you in the Fragrant Chamber. Please take the lift down to the Hustings Strip and speak with Bartholomew at the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_FLAMEA_000_153: The lift over yonder will take you to the Hustings Strip. From there, proceed south to the Royal Promenade, and speak with Bartholomew to gain admittance to the Fragrant Chamber.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_BARTHOLOMEW_000_160: The Gridanian envoy, I presume? Would you be so good as to allow me to inspect the missive you bear, ? My thanks.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_BARTHOLOMEW_000_161: Ah yes, the seal of the Elder Seedseer. Please proceed.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_300420_RAUBAHN: Ah, a guest from Gridania. I thought I smelled leaf mold.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_300430_RAUBAHN: I won't hold it against you. If you're half the warrior Kan-E says, 'tis a wonder you don't reek of dead Ixal.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_300440_RAUBAHN: Welcome to the sultanate of Ul'dah. I am Raubahn Aldynn, General of the Immortal Flames.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_300450_RAUBAHN: But you did not come all this way to trade formalities.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_300460_RAUBAHN: There's something familiar about you... For a moment, I mistook you for an old .
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_300470_RAUBAHN: Like , you have the eyes of a hero. Eyes that have looked upon the horrors of battle, unblinking.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_300480_RAUBAHN: I've no doubt Kan-E saw them, too. Mayhap there is hope for Gridania yet! Come, let us talk.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_172: Do you know what happened that day, adventurer? When we took the field against the Garleans?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_173: So my counterparts have educated you.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_174: Hm? Oh. Trust Merlwyb to make light of our wolf problem. Woman always did have a black sense of humor.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_175: Wolves are bloodthirsty beasts upon which one cannot turn one's back. 'Tis only a matter of time before they bite.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_176: So it was with the Garleans, fifty years ago.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_177: No sooner had they learned how to use magitek than they began seizing territory from their neighbors.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_178: Led by then legatus Solus zos Galvus, they swiftly brought the other nations of Ilsabard to heel. And so the legatus became an emperor, and his republic an empire...
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_179: An empire which then set its sights upon Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_ROAILLE_000_180: But the conquering emperor is now an old man of four score winters. His health is failing, and he has no clear successor. Like as not, this is why the Garleans have been quiet of late.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_181: But the XIVth Imperial Legion is still entrenched within our borders.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_182: And their commander, Legatus Gaius van Baelsar, has long harbored ambitions of conquest.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_183: Were he to strike now, I fear we would fall like so many others before us. And not only Ul'dah, but Gridania and Limsa Lominsa as well.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_184: For the Calamity brought the lot of us to our knees, and we've yet to get up. We barely have the strength to stand against the beast tribes, never mind the primals they mean to summon.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_185: We are a realm divided, adventurer. An alliance in name only.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_186: But the wolf cares not for the plight of its prey.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_187: The Garleans stir, and the Admiral would not let it go unnoticed.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_188: All other concerns pale in comparison to the Empire─even the beast tribes and their bloody primals.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_189: We must stand united once more, that much is clear. And if we're to do so, we must remember the cause which last brought us together. Kan-E will have her memorial.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_190: We will honor the memory of the fallen. We will remind the people what their brothers and sisters fought and died for.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_ROAILLE_000_191: Shall I inform the sultana and the Syndicate?
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_192: I will speak with Her Grace myself.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_RAUBAHN_000_194: The Elder Seedseer will have my reply anon.
TEXT_MANFST200_00507_SYSTEM_000_300: You may now make use of the airship routes connecting the three nations. Before you may board an airship, you must pay the requisite fare in gil.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MOMODI_000_1: So you want to know more, then, do you? Well, ain't that a surprise... I swear, if I painted “CERTAIN DEATH” on one door and “LIMITLESS WEALTH” on another, nine out of ten adventurers would go through the first, and the other bloke wouldn't be able to choose, on account of bein' Ul'dahn. Anyway, don't say I didn't warn you.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MOMODI_000_2: First of all, if you're wonderin' whether you can trust these “Scions of the Seventh Dawn,” you can. They're good people who've made it their mission to solve some of Eorzea's most pressin' problems. 'Course, that ain't no small task, and so they're always lookin' for dependable individuals to join 'em─individuals like you, .
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MOMODI_000_3: Now, I've been given leave to tell you where to find the Scions, but you must promise to keep this information to yourself. As you can probably imagine, it's somethin' Eorzea's enemies would very much like to know.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MOMODI_000_4: The Scions are headquartered in Vesper Bay, out in western Thanalan. The place you're lookin' for is called the Wakin' Sands. Give your name to whoever's at the entrance, and you'll be let in.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MOMODI_000_5: You're a  in demand, , and the days ahead promise to be busy, but I hope you won't forget . Drop in and tell  how you're farin' from time to time, you hear? Right, well, I've said my piece. Off you go.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_20:
Deep in the desert of my heart,♪
A lonely flower blooms...♪
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_21:
Yearning for the heavens above♪
To quench my thirst for you.♪
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_25: I would thank you not to sneak up on me like that!
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_26: Now, please be advised that this is private property. Unless you have pertinent business here, I must ask you to─
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_27: Here at the behest of Yda and Papalymo!?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_28: Here at the behest of Thancred!?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_29: Here at the behest of Y'shtola!?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_30: My sincerest apologies! May I please have your name?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_32: Um...where have I heard your name before?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_34: Wait a minute! Weren't you the shady merchant who tried to sell me imitation Fen-Yll wares the other day? No? Then...are you the persistent peddler who wouldn't leave Lady Minfilia alone, and received a slap for  troubles?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_35: Not  either? Oh well, my mistake!
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_37: Ahem! I bid you welcome to the Waking Sands, headquarters of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn!
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_38: My name is Tataru, and I look forward to assisting you during your time with us.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_39: The Antecedent is within the solar. I shall let her know to expect you.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_41: The Antecedent awaits downstairs, within the solar. You may enter whenever you are ready.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_GUIDE_000_45: I take it you are . Tataru sent word that you had arrived.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_GUIDE_000_46: Lady Minfilia has eagerly awaited your coming. This way, if you please.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100010_MINFILIA: (-???-)So you are the adventurer of whom I've heard so much.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100020_MINFILIA: Well met, friend. My name is Minfilia, and I lead the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100040_MINFILIA: After five long years...you've come back to us, just as Louisoix said you would...
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100050_MINFILIA: Words cannot describe the joy I feel at this moment. Welcome home.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100060_MINFILIA: Aye, I remember you still, and everything you fought for. Know that you are not entirely forgotten.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100070_MINFILIA: If Louisoix is watching us, as I choose to believe, he may now rest in peace, his mission finally fulfilled.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100080_MINFILIA: Please, be at ease. You are among friends here.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100090_MINFILIA: No doubt you're ripe to burst with questions, but have patience─all will be revealed in time.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100100_MINFILIA: First, let me begin by telling you who we are and what we do.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100110_MINFILIA: We are the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, an order that transcends political boundaries. Our single objective is the preservation of the future of Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100120_MINFILIA: Among our gravest concerns are the godlike beings known as the primals.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100130_MINFILIA: Their existence is a bane upon Eorzea─nay, the world at large, and we have striven to find a lasting solution to the threat they pose.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100140_MINFILIA: Our order is home to a number of individuals who, like you, possess a rare and special talent.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100150_MINFILIA: This talent takes various forms, but one holds particular interest for us.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100160_MINFILIA: Tell me, have you ever experienced a sudden, inexplicable loss of consciousness?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100170_MINFILIA: Have you ever had the sensation of being pulled away from reality? Felt as though you were hovering in space, a mind without a body?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100180_MINFILIA: All these things are the manifestations of your talent. Yours is the power to transcend the boundaries of the soul─a power known as the Echo.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100190_MINFILIA: The Echo allows you to pass through the walls of a man's soul, and hear the resonations of his past.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100200_MINFILIA: You will be there in his memories, and see things as he saw them. You may even interact with that which you see, though you cannot change the outcome of events.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100210_MINFILIA: For another blessing, the Echo will enable you to know a man's mind even if you cannot comprehend his words.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100220_MINFILIA: In short, the Echo is a truly extraordinary power. And this power is strong within you.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100230_MINFILIA: It is only a shame that we cannot use it whensoever we choose.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100240_MINFILIA: That's right. I too possess the Echo.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100250_MINFILIA: With that established, let us return to the subject of the primals.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100260_MINFILIA: So long as they exist, the realm cannot take so much as a single step towards true peace.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100270_MINFILIA: Measures must be taken─measures which transcend boundaries, be they of faction, race, language, or creed. And to do so, the Scions require the aid of those with our talent.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100280_MINFILIA: Make no mistake─the Echo will be instrumental in dealing with the primal threat. Without it, we cannot hope to save the realm.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100290_MINFILIA: I know not what it is you desire for yourself, nor what it was that first brought you to Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100300_MINFILIA: But I firmly believe that the power we possess was given to us for a purpose.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100310_MINFILIA: Why else would the gods entrust man with a gift so extraordinary, if not to have him use it?
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_100320_MINFILIA: And so I implore you: lend us your power.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_50: Naturally, your aid will not go unrewarded. We are fortunate to have a number of influential allies, and at a word from me, they will gladly afford you certain privileges that might otherwise be denied you.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_51: The right to employ retainers, for example. Are you familiar with them? They are individuals who may be relied upon to manage your assets and belongings on your behalf.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_52: The papers you requested, my lady.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_TATARU_000_54: The pleasure is mine, my lady!
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_55: By way of a welcoming gift, I have taken the liberty of adding your name to the retainers' registry. As of now, you are entitled to employ the services of a retainer.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_56: You will need to consult a retainer vocate regarding the particulars of this arrangement, but believe me when I say that retainers will prove invaluable to you in your adventuring endeavors.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_57: Let this gesture serve as evidence of our commitment to do all in our power to facilitate your personal objectives.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_58: In return, we ask that you aid us to the fullest extent of your talents.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_59: A mutually beneficial relationship, I am sure you will agree, and one which serves the greater good besides.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_60: Well, that was a veritable lecture, was it not? Forgive me, but it is important that all concerned are aware of what is expected of them. Now you know our purpose, and what we can offer you, I invite you to consider joining us. When you have come to a decision, you may tell me without fear of censure.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_61: In good faith, I shall entrust you with our order's password, which our members use to reach one another when afield.
TEXT_MANFST206_00509_MINFILIA_000_62: It is “wild rose.” Pray keep it safe.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_MINFILIA_000_1: We Scions have but one objective: to safeguard the future of Eorzea. Among our gravest concerns are the godlike beings known as the primals. Long have we striven to find a lasting solution to the threat they pose.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_MINFILIA_000_2: I know not what it is you desire for yourself, nor what it was that first brought you to Eorzea, but I firmly believe that the power we possess was given to us for a purpose. Pray consider this when you give me your answer, .
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_A1_000_1: I will go whither the wild rose blooms.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_MINFILIA_000_3: Small? No. Worthy? Undeniably. We labor for the good of all the realm.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_MINFILIA_000_4: They are. Yet the risks we take are justified, given that which is at stake.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000010_MINFILIA: I take it you will help us.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000020_MINFILIA: Wonderful! I knew you wouldn't let us down!
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000030_MINFILIA: Forgive me for treating you as a stranger. I know you deserve better than this, considering all you've done for the realm.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000040_MINFILIA: It remains unclear why no one remembers you. We can only assume that it is a consequence of the power that Louisoix invoked to save your life.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000050_MINFILIA: But irrespective of the cause, know that whatever shroud has fallen upon people's memories, there will surely be a way to lift it.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000070_MINFILIA: But come, I would introduce you to your friends in the order.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000080_MINFILIA: Tell me, does the name Sharlayan ring any bells?
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000090_MINFILIA: It used to be one of Eorzea's six city-states, and was situated in the northwest of Aldenard.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000100_MINFILIA: The Sharlayans were the keepers of wisdom both old and new. Their mastery over magic and aether was unsurpassed, and even the Garleans knew to fear them.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000110_MINFILIA: Among their number, there were a noble few who devoted their lives to safeguarding the future of Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000120_MINFILIA: When the realm began its descent into chaos, and their countrymen fled for the motherland, they alone chose to remain here. These noble men and women were called the Archons.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000130_MINFILIA: Those same brave souls stand before you now.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000140_MINFILIA: The masked woman is Yda, and beside her is Papalymo. The two are charged with surveying the Twelveswood.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000170_PAPALYMO: I had every confidence that you would agree to help us.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000190_YDA: Okay, my turn to introduce someone! That there is Thancred!
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000200_PAPALYMO: He is our man here in Ul'dah, jewel of the desert.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000220_THANCRED: I never doubted that you'd come!
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000230_THANCRED: If I may, the lovely maiden beside me is named Y'shtola. Limsa Lominsa has the pleasure of being under her care.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000260_YSHTOLA: Last but not least is Urianger, who presides over all affairs within these halls. Pray seek him out whenever you have questions.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000270_URIANGER: Dawn may banish even the darkest night...
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000280_URIANGER: ...The words of a dear friend. I am glad of our meeting.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000290_YSHTOLA: At the Battle of Carteneau, our leader was taken from us. But we did not stray from our purpose.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000300_YSHTOLA: We sought out Minfilia and others with her talent, and together established the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000310_MINFILIA: Along with the Archons, those blessed with the Echo play a pivotal role in our endeavor to forge a brighter tomorrow for the realm.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000320_MINFILIA: Oh, I should also introduce you to Tataru, our clerk. She ensures that everything runs smoothly.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000340_MINFILIA: In time, I hope you will come to think of us as family.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000360_MINFILIA: I would assign you your first task.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000370_MINFILIA: Urianger. Have the documents arrived from the Students of Baldesion?
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000380_URIANGER: Aye, my lady, they arrived but recently.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000390_MINFILIA: We have received a request for aid from the Immortal Flames.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000400_MINFILIA: Thancred, would you do the honors?
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000420_THANCRED: Some days ago, a crystal caravan registered to Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern was waylaid and divested of its cargo.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000430_THANCRED: But there is more. Within a bell of the robbery, several people were reported missing from the shantytown outside the city.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000440_MINFILIA: At a glance, one would assume the involvement of bandits, kidnappers, and coincidence.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000450_MINFILIA: Such crimes are hardly uncommon, and the Immortal Flames deal with their like almost every day.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000460_MINFILIA: However, this time we have reason to believe that a primal is involved.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000470_THANCRED: Aye, the evidence left behind implicates the Amalj'aa, who are known worshipers of Ifrit.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000480_THANCRED: If we then consider the objects that were taken, there is no room left for doubt─the crimes were committed in the name of a primal.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000490_MINFILIA: That you may better understand the nature of our struggle with the primals, I would have you play the leading role in this investigation.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_000510_MINFILIA: If there is aught you wish to know, I recommend you speak with Thancred. He is well versed in the affairs of Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_THANCRED_000_10: Ready to begin, are we? That's the spirit!
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_THANCRED_000_11: So then, your mission is to investigate a crystal robbery and a spate of abductions.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_THANCRED_000_12: ...Crimes which we believe to be connected. Assuming we are correct, it is like that any discoveries we make in relation to one will further our understanding of the other.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_THANCRED_000_13: Now, since the attack on their caravan, our friends at Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern have doubled security over all their shipments.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_THANCRED_000_14: In light of this, it is my judgment that the abductions should be our priority.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_THANCRED_000_15: According to our preliminary findings, the majority of the missing were last seen in the vicinity of Camp Drybone, so that would seem a fine place to begin.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_THANCRED_000_16: A fellow by the name of Isembard serves as the camp's de facto leader. Pay him a visit, and see that he gives us his full cooperation.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_ISEMBARD_000_20: Aye, I'm Isembard. Here to search for the missing folk, I take it?
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_ISEMBARD_000_21: Minfilia sent word that an adventurer fitting your description would be along.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_ISEMBARD_000_22: She also warned us to be wary of the Amalj'aa. It seems we know who the culprits are, at the very least.
TEXT_MANFST207_00510_ISEMBARD_000_23: Now, I bear no official title at this camp, but the people here have come to look to me for leadership. You have my word that I'll do all I can to help see the victims safely returned.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_10: Until not so very long ago, you were but one of the many adventurers seeking to make their way in Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_11: But for your character and courage, you were raised to the esteemed post of envoy. Thereafter, you traveled the realm, aiding those in need without thought of reward, confirming to  that the Scions would benefit from your aid. And no sooner had you joined us than you personally bested the primal Ifrit.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_12: You have achieved a great deal in a short time, and won fame in so doing. Alas, fame does not come without a price, as you will soon discover.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_13: We have guests, ─or rather...you have guests.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_FLAMEOFFICER_000_15: Ahhh, Lady Minfilia. Radiant as always!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: I am given to understand that the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have but recently welcomed a new hero into their midst!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_STORMOFFICER_000_17: I am here on behalf of the Maelstrom, Grand Company of Limsa Lominsa, to offer said hero a place of honor within our ranks!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_18: As you can see, , your recent exploits have garnered you the attentions of the Grand Companies of Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_19: Each organization would have Ifrit's bane for its own. To this end, all three have sent officers to court you.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_20: They would not ordinarily go to such lengths to enlist a new recruit. That they have is evidence of their high regard for you.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_21: I find myself wondering how word of 's deeds spread so quickly. That the Immortal Flames should know of  triumph is to be expected...but what of the other Grand Companies?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: Your reputation precedes you,  ! 'Tis no ordinary  who can face a primal and emerge the victor!
And imagine our pride when we learned that you began your journey as an adventurer in our own Gridania! Know that the people hold you in high esteem, and that you will always be welcome among us.
The Order of the Twin Adder has need of valiant  such as you. Join your strength to ours, friend, and together let us ensure that peace ever reigns over the Twelveswood!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_FLAMEOFFICER_000_26: What a pleasure it is to finally meet you,  ! My comrades speak of you in the most glowing terms!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_FLAMEOFFICER_000_27: Why, even before you aided us against the Amalj'aa and their dread primal, yours was already a respected name in Ul'dah. Our people know you and love you well.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_FLAMEOFFICER_000_28: A  of your talent belongs with the Immortal Flames. Join your strength to ours, friend, and together let us secure a prosperous future for Ul'dah!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_STORMOFFICER_000_29: The Admiral was not exaggerating when she said you have the look of a hero! Full often does she speak of you, friend.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_STORMOFFICER_000_30: ...As do many others in Limsa. Long before the rest of Eorzea took note, your name was well known to us, owing to your valorous deeds on behalf of our citizens.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_STORMOFFICER_000_31: It is only natural that we should want you for the Maelstrom. Join your strength to ours, and together let us see the grand vessel of Limsa Lominsa to the shores of glory!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_34: Though I am quite sure you need no reminding, mayhap a brief summary of the situation would help to clarify your thoughts on this matter. As you know, the Grand Companies are all-encompassing organizations empowered to call upon the martial, economic, and technological resources of their respective city-states in times of strife.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_35: There are presently three such organizations in Eorzea: the Maelstrom of Limsa Lominsa, the Order of the Twin Adder of Gridania, and the Immortal Flames of Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_36: Serving a Grand Company means serving the nation to which it belongs. You will be charged with its defense, and tasked with advancing its cause.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_37: In return for your faithful service, you will be furnished with various rewards, some of which may well prove useful to you in your other endeavors.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_38: If you are agonizing over which of the Grand Companies best deserves your loyalty, be at ease─the commitment you make this day need not be permanent. Should you wish to shift your allegiance at a later date, you are entitled to do so. And yet...I concede that it is no small choice you face...
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_39: Ah! A thought occurs to me! You will, of course, recall that the three city-states are planning to hold remembrance services.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_40: Well, as part of the proceedings, I am given to understand that the leader of each Grand Company will deliver an address.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_41: Hearing these addresses ought to help you make an informed decision. What say you, my dear officers?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_FLAMEOFFICER_000_43: You are as wise as you are beautiful, my lady!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_STORMOFFICER_000_44: Very well! Let  hear our leaders speak, then return here with  decision.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_THREEOFFICER_000_45: (-Grand Company Officers-)We eagerly await your answer!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_46: I know full well that adventurers are by their nature a liberty-loving breed, and not best suited to the discipline of military service, but I strongly urge you to join a Grand Company nonetheless. While the promise of reward is enticing in itself, it is not the only benefit.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_47: You are possessed of great power, , and with it you are capable of doing untold good. Yet know that great power is wont to attract attention─not all of it friendly.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_48: There will be those who wish you ill, and you must needs be on the lookout for them. Yet however vigilant you are, you are but one . In the midst of a Grand Company, however, you will be one  amongst many─a friend amongst friends. Your achievements will be shared, and so will the danger. I can think of no better arrangement.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_49: Of course, joining one organization need not mean leaving another. I hope that we can continue to rely upon your aid─the Twelve know that we will have need of it in the days ahead.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_50: The Grand Companies seek to protect their own nations. We Scions, on the other hand, seek to preserve the future of Eorzea as a whole. Similar, yet not quite the same.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_51: Now then, I expect that you will be afield more often in the future.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_52: As such, I would have you carry this linkpearl with you at all times. It will allow us to stay in touch regardless of location.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_53: Eorzea is changing, , and you have the power to help shape it anew.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_54: None can say what the morrow will bring, but so long as we believe in ourselves, there is naught we cannot achieve.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_55: Now, it is time you made ready for your journey. Before you depart, be sure to speak to Tataru. She will apprise you as to where and when the remembrance services are due to take place.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_FLAMEOFFICER_000_90: The Flame General is a passionate man, and his words never fail to light a fire in the belly of those who listen. I am sure you will be no exception!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: The Elder Seedseer speaks only truth, and her words have the power to touch the soul. At the sound of her voice, all fall silent and attend her.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_STORMOFFICER_000_90: When the Admiral speaks, even pirates listen, and that is no small thing. She is a born leader─the kind one would gladly follow to the seventh hell!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_TATARU_000_60: I, um... I'm sorry about all the attention you're getting, ... I might have sung your praises a little too loudly...and often...to a few too many people. Ahem. Next time, I'll be sure to hold my tongue─literally, if necessary.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_TATARU_000_61: Anyway, I expect you want to know where and when the remembrance services are taking place?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_TATARU_000_62: If all goes to plan, Gridania's Grand Company, the Order of the Twin Adder, will hold the first of the three services, and Elder Seedseer Kan-E-Senna will deliver her address at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_TATARU_000_63: I should probably mention at this point that due to the organizational challenges involved in assembling all of the involved parties, it's possible that the order of the services might change... Still, there's not much we can do about that, so make Gridania your first port of call.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_TATARU_000_64: Next, you'll need to go to Ul'dah, where Flame General Raubahn Aldynn will be addressing the masses at the Royal Promenade. Oh, and it's rumored there's to be a special guest! How exciting.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_TATARU_000_65: Last but not least, you must make your way to the Stateroom in Limsa Lominsa, where Maelstrom Chief Admiral Merlwyb Bloefhiswyn will be giving her address.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_TATARU_000_66: The room is accessible via the Admiral's Lift. Identify yourself to the sentry, Zanthael, and he will admit you. Got all that?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_TATARU_000_67: Well, off you go, then. I hope you find the remembrance services suitably educational! I suggest visiting the city-states in my prescribed order, though with your record of impeccable timing and luck, the schedule may well change in favor of your preferred travel plans. Farewell!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100010_CLATTERM: Behold, it is the Sultana Nanamo herself!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100030_RAUBAHN: Hark you, souls of flame, drawn to the bosom of the desert, where the fire burns brightest and shall rage forevermore!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100060_RAUBAHN: Where since antiquity, under the sage and judicious rule of the Ul Dynasty, we have wrought sand into gold!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100070_RAUBAHN: Where by the Grace and Glory of Nald'thal have our brave sons and daughters flourished and prospered─I speak of Ul'dah!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100080_ALPHINAUD: (--)There, at the Flame General's back flies the Grand Company's standard.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100090_ALPHINAUD: (--)Note the sigil. The golden scales of order balance the jewel of prosperity with the flame of might.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100100_RAUBAHN: Great and many are the gifts our nation has given the realm.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100110_RAUBAHN: In Eorzea's darkest hour, on the killing fields of Carteneau, none spent more in blood and gold than we.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100120_RAUBAHN: Thus was the VIIth Imperial Legion laid low!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100150_ALPHINAUD: (--)So that's how it happened! How soon history forgets.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100160_RAUBAHN: Yet many left our gates, never to return.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100170_RAUBAHN: Let us pray for our absent brothers and sisters, that they might know happiness in the great beyond, as Thal's honored guests.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100180_RAUBAHN: If the fates were fair, the price we paid that day would have bought us victory. Alas, they are not.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100190_RAUBAHN: And now, but five years into this Seventh Umbral Era, the spirit of sacrifice which granted us our strength is all but dead.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100200_RAUBAHN: Look around you. What do you see? A people divided, downtrodden and enthralled!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100210_RAUBAHN: Where are the merciful alms of the rich? Where is the just steel of the righteous?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100240_RAUBAHN: I ask you: is this the great nation our brothers and sisters gave their lives to save?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100250_RAUBAHN: You who call this “living” dishonor the name of the Immortal Flames─it is but a slow death!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100260_RAUBAHN: Our enemies surround us. The savage hordes of the Amalj'aa wait beside our roads, strangling the lifelines of trade.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100270_RAUBAHN: Meanwhile, the Garleans make mock of our borders, and despoil our land of its natural wealth.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100280_RAUBAHN: We stand on a precipice...yet we do not act.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100290_RAUBAHN: Whether trader or soldier, Monetarist or Royalist, all must recognize that a divided Ul'dah stands to fall.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100300_RAUBAHN: Victory and Fortune walk hand in hand!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100310_RAUBAHN: Ye who seek glory and wealth! Look not to what little you can snatch from your neighbor, but to the boundless wealth of the world beyond!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100320_RAUBAHN: Now is the time to unite! Now is the time to ride forth!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100330_RAUBAHN: In the name of the sultana, I beseech you!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100340_RAUBAHN: Line not your own coffers, but those of the Immortal Flames! Seek not to prosper from Ul'dah, but to restore her to prosperity!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100350_RAUBAHN: As the realm prospers, so shall Ul'dah. As Ul'dah prospers, so shall her people!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100400_NANAMOULNAMO: People of Ul'dah! I, Nanamo, seventeenth in the line of Ul, address you.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100410_NANAMOULNAMO: Much has been made of the wealth of Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100420_NANAMOULNAMO: Yet those who measure that wealth in coins and carats are gravely deceived.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100430_NANAMOULNAMO: For the true wealth of Ul'dah lies in the health, happiness, and hopes of her people.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100440_NANAMOULNAMO: Beloved subjects, I bid you raise aloft the torch of Ul'dah, that her Flames might serve as a beacon for all Eorzea to see!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100470_RAUBAHN: For Victory and Fortune, stride fearless into the inferno, for we are by fire reborn!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100520_ALPHINAUD: ...And my sister, Alisaie, at your service.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100530_ALPHINAUD: I saw at a glance that you were a fellow traveler.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_100540_ALPHINAUD: You might call us students of history, sampling the realm's remembrances in pursuit of...enlightenment.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_80: The Ul'dahns have a long history of conflict with the Amalj'aa, the beast tribe that worships the primal Ifrit.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_81: Judging by your look of distaste, I take it you have encountered them.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_82: The Ul'dahns do not shy from confrontation. If aught threatens their precious prosperity, they will seek to crush it.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_83: So have they dealt with Ifrit thus far, smothering his flames each time he is stoked to life.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_84: Yet he is but one of several problems. Though they have been quiet these past five years, the Garleans have not gone away.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_85: Meanwhile, refugees continue to arrive in droves, and Ul'dah has no clear policy on how to deal with them.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_86: After all, not even the sultanate's coffers are bottomless. And even assuming they had the coin, resources will ever be finite.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_87: Which brings me back to the subject of Ifrit. It has been observed that the Amalj'aa are summoning him with ever-increasing frequency.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_88: Every time they do so, the Ul'dahns send their forces to smite the primal, and though they invariably succeed, each victory is bought with blood. It is a war of attrition which they cannot well sustain.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_89: Small wonder, then, that the Immortal Flames are eager to recruit more members.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_90: At such a desperate hour, an adventurer of your experience would be a most welcome addition to their ranks.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_91: For their sake, I hope that the Flame General's words struck a chord with you.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300560_CLATTERM: I lost my son to the Calamity...
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300570_CLATTERM: Some say you couldn't take a step without stumbling over a body.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300580_CLATTERF: The three Seedseers are all together!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300590_KANESENNA: Our forebears were once strangers in the Twelveswood.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300600_KANESENNA: Fearful of the greenwrath, they hid themselves in the dark recesses of the earth. Yet they dreamed of basking in the dappled sunlight of the forest.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300610_KANESENNA: Through great effort, they proved their worth to the elementals, and were granted a place beneath the boughs. So it was that Gridania was born, some five centuries ago.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300620_KANESENNA: Working hand in hand, the Hyur and the Elezen settlers sowed the seeds of our civilization. And soon they were joined by folk of all races.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300630_KANESENNA: So nourished by the waters of unity and blessed by the light of the Matron, Gridania flourished into the great nation it is today.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300640_ALPHINAUD: (--)Do you see the Gridanian standard? There, hanging behind the Elder Seedseer.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300650_ALPHINAUD: (--)The entwined serpents represent the unity between Hyur and Elezen. An elegant symbol, do you not agree?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300660_KANESENNA: In accordance with the will of the elementals, we have embraced a life of peace. Alas, our neighbors have not always sought the same for themselves─nor for us.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300670_KANESENNA: Though we Gridanians have no love for war, we have still less for those who would threaten our way of life. Ever have we fought to protect the sanctity of the Twelveswood.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300680_KANESENNA: When the Garlean Empire brought its war of conquest to Eorzea, we rallied under the noble standard of the Twin Adder, that we might push back the encroaching darkness.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300690_KANESENNA: And it was we who prepared the ground for the reformation of the Eorzean Alliance, that all the peoples of this realm might stand united against the common threat.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300700_KANESENNA: Five years ago, the Alliance met the armies of the Empire upon the fields of Carteneau.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300710_KANESENNA: It would prove the bloodiest battle in recent memory. Countless Gridanian lives were lost.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300720_KANESENNA: As supreme commander of the Order of the Twin Adder, ever shall I bear the weight of our people's sacrifice.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300730_KANESENNA: Alas, their loss was not the only tragedy to befall us that day, for soon came the Calamity.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300740_KANESENNA: The scars borne by our forest are a constant reminder of its violence. Our lives have been irrevocably changed, each waking hour a struggle to survive.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300750_KANESENNA: Driven to desperation, some among us have strayed from the path of righteousness, resorting to banditry, poaching, and other unconscionable deeds.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300760_KANESENNA: To compound our woes, the Ixal have returned in force, emboldened by our suffering. They test our defenses nigh without cease, and prey upon the vulnerable.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300770_KANESENNA: So beleaguered from within and without, it is of little wonder that our unity now falters. Dark times are upon us.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300780_CLATTERM: Time was a man could walk the highroads without fear.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300790_CLATTERM: A pox on the bloody Ixal!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300800_KANESENNA: On this day, five years ago, countless Eorzeans laid down their lives that we might behold another dawn. Please join with me in honoring their memory.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300810_ALISAIE: (--)And how do you propose to honor the memory of those you cannot remember, pray tell?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300820_KANESENNA: The destruction wrought by the Calamity was indiscriminate─it dealt death to Eorzean and Garlean alike.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300830_KANESENNA: Yet while we have labored to rebuild our homes─to rebuild our lives─the Empire has set about raising steel fortresses here in the Twelveswood.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300840_KANESENNA: Let none be mistaken─the Garleans remain the greatest threat to our survival. If we are to stand against them, we must remember what it is to be united.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300850_KANESENNA: Our many troubles blind us to the woes of our fellow man. Thence is harmony lost. Yet harmony is the founding principle of Gridania.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300860_KANESENNA: We are gathered here to honor the fallen.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300870_KANESENNA: Let them be honored not only in word and thought, but through concerted action!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300880_KANESENNA: I bid you join hands with me once more beneath the Twin Adder standard!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300890_KANESENNA: And together, let us heal the forest's wounds, that our progeny might live in harmony beneath these ancient boughs. For serenity, purity, and sanctity!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300900_CLATTERF: We must think of the children!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300920_CLATTERM: It's up to us to protect the forest!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300950_ALPHINAUD: ...And my sister, Alisaie, at your service.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300960_ALPHINAUD: I saw at a glance that you were a fellow traveler.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_300970_ALPHINAUD: You might call us students of history, sampling the realm's remembrances in pursuit of...enlightenment.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_110: The Gridanians are unfortunate enough to have to contend with two beast tribes.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_111: The Ixal are unquestionably the more troublesome, being of a naturally warlike disposition, and wont to summon their bloodthirsty primal, Garuda.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_112: The sylphs, by contrast, are peaceful in nature, being mischievous rather than malevolent, and have long been on friendly terms with the Gridanians─until recently, at least. Alas, they have grown aloof, a change observed at roughly the time they summoned the primal Ramuh.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_113: The Gridanians have no love for war, and they consider open conflict a last resort.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_114: Though they clash with the Ixal ever more regularly, you may be assured that they do so in self-defense. As for the sylphs...they are as yet bound by a peace treaty, though one wonders how long it will be before it is broken.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_115: The Twelveswood was grievously wounded during the Calamity, leaving Gridania vulnerable to attack. The people are hopeful that restoring the wood─and thereby the power of the elementals─will put an end to their woes. Yet how long will that take? Centuries, I'd wager.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_116: Meanwhile, the Ixal will continue their incursions, spurred on by Garuda and her insatiable appetite for destruction.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_117: Whether the Gridanians like it or not, sooner or later it will come to all-out war. And when it does, the Order of the Twin Adder will need all the help it can muster.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_118: ...How valuable might the aid of a capable adventurer prove to them then?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_119: Well, perhaps we will find out─if the Elder Seedseer's words fell on fertile ground...
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ZANTHAEL_000_130: Here to attend the remembrance service? Be quick─the Admiral is due to give her address at any moment.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ZANTHAEL_000_131: If you're not interested in attending, make way for those who are.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_500990_CLATTERM: The Garleans are another matter altogether.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501020_MERLWYB: Brothers and sisters of the sea, hearken unto me! Look upon this, our mighty crimson standard, and tell me your hearts do not swell with pride!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501040_MERLWYB: Seven hundred summers have come and gone since our forefathers first ran aground in this fertile bay.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501050_MERLWYB: In that time, guided by the Mother of Oceans, Limsa Lominsa has grown from humble fishing village to uncontested ruler of the five seas and beyond!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501080_ALPHINAUD: (--)Did you look, as the Admiral bid you? It is a rather stirring standard, I must say.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501090_ALPHINAUD: (--)The crimson field is meant to signify the blood of fallen crewmates, while the black longship represents a pirate vessel.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501100_MERLWYB: When the Garlean Empire marched upon Eorzea, we assembled beneath the Maelstrom's standard, and our Grand Company was reborn.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501110_MERLWYB: All answered the call, from the Knights of the Barracuda to Hyllfyr's Bloody Executioners, and together we met our would-be conquerors upon the field of Carteneau.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501120_MERLWYB: That day, the world bore witness to the united strength of Limsa Lominsa!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501130_MERLWYB: I swear to you─no army ever fought harder, or with more courage. Yet many of ours did not survive.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501140_MERLWYB: Join me now in remembering those who fought in the name of freedom, and fell. May their souls be returned to the sea.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501150_ALPHINAUD: (--)Freedom... Yes, they have always been rather fond of their freedom.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501160_ALPHINAUD: (--)Much as the beast tribes have. Small wonder─beneath the surface, one would struggle to tell them apart.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501170_MERLWYB: It has been five long years since the Calamity struck. Five long years of tireless rebuilding.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501180_MERLWYB: Yet still the wounds of the Calamity fester and weep.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501190_MERLWYB: But when I stand atop the Mizzenmast, and gaze out upon our battered and broken vessel, I see an undying spirit. Did we not build all this from the wreck of the Galadion all those centuries ago? Shall we not do so again!?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501200_MERLWYB: Yet there are those who would see this ship of ours sink beneath the waves of the restless Rhotano.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501210_MERLWYB: The Sahagin creep ashore seeking blood for their accursed god.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501240_MERLWYB: While the mines of O'Ghomoro spew forth kobolds who push ever south, despoiling our lands as they go.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501250_MERLWYB: These savage beast tribes will be the first waves to crash against our creaking hull.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501260_MERLWYB: And behind them swells the grim tide of the Garlean Empire.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501270_MERLWYB: Even now, the curs fly their flags within our borders. Doubt not but that they will be upon us ere long.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501280_MERLWYB: We are well-nigh surrounded. Yet there are those among us who would rather turn their swords against their crewmates than our cannons against our foes.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501290_MERLWYB: How can we hope to repel our many enemies when mutiny breeds below deck?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501300_MERLWYB: There is but one course left to us!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501310_MERLWYB: One bearing that will bring us victory over the beast hordes and the Empire both, and see this ship safe to port.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501320_MERLWYB: We must mend the rift the Calamity has reopened 'twixt pirate and Maelstrom, and stand fast with our adventurer brothers against the coming tempest!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501330_MERLWYB: Mark ye well: a crew without unity is no crew at all─'tis but a mass of drowned men.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501340_MERLWYB: To me, then, brothers and sisters of the sea! Gather beneath the undying crimson standard and pledge me your strength, your skill, your wisdom!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501350_MERLWYB: And with the guidance of the Navigator, this great vessel of ours shall ride the waves till sea swallows all!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501400_CLATTERM: I'll follow ye to the seven hells, Admiral!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501420_ALPHINAUD: ...And my sister, Alisaie, at your service.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501430_ALPHINAUD: I saw at a glance that you were a fellow traveler.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_501440_ALPHINAUD: You might call us students of history, sampling the realm's remembrances in pursuit of...enlightenment.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_140: As the Admiral mentioned in her address, Limsa Lominsa is plagued by two beast tribes.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_141: The first are the fishlike Sahagin, worshipers of the primal Leviathan.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_142: The second are the kobolds, who dwell beneath the earth, and take the primal Titan for their god.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_143: As if the beast tribes' presence weren't troublesome enough, the Garleans have also chosen to erect a fortress right in the Lominsans' backyard.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_144: And that is to say naught of internal strife. As a nation of pirates, there is no end to the blood feuds between the various factions. And while they fight amongst themselves, the Garleans whet their blades and watch.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_145: If the Lominsans are to have any hope of withstanding the Empire, they must first resolve their own affairs. Differences must be set aside, and the primal threat dealt with once and for all.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_146: To this end, I expect that they will soon take decisive action against the beast tribes. Mark my words, the Maelstrom standard will be drenched a deeper shade of crimson ere long.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_147: That a capable adventurer like you would be a valuable addition to their crew is beyond question.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_ALPHINAUD_000_148: But will you sail with the Admiral?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_150: , this is Minfilia. You are well, I hope? Would I be correct in thinking that the final remembrance service has now concluded?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_151: A moment ago, you say? What a coincidence!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_152: Jesting aside, I trust you remember our guests from the Grand Companies? Well, delighted though we are to have them here at the Waking Sands, it would not do to keep them in suspense any longer than necessary. In short: hurry back!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_160: Welcome back, . Were the Grand Company leaders' words as illuminating as you had hoped?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_161: Aye, each nation is beset with problems. I trust you see now why your services are in such demand. Would that there were more of you, .
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_MINFILIA_000_162: But you must be tired from your journey. Why don't you rest awhile, and take a moment to reflect on your decision? Once your mind is made up, pray give the Grand Company officers your answer.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701460_ALPHINAUD: The gods only know what “grand” company our adventurer friend will keep.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701470_ALPHINAUD: Hmph. The wheels of change are in motion regardless.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701480_ALISAIE: Brother, are you certain this course is best?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701490_ALPHINAUD: Whatever do you mean, dear sister?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701500_ALISAIE: The so-called “remembrance” ceremonies were little more than standard-waving rallies.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701510_ALISAIE: ...As though the Calamity and Seventh Umbral Era warranted scarcely a mention!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701520_ALPHINAUD: Well, of course they were “standard-waving rallies.”
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701530_ALPHINAUD: Since you are so observant, mayhap you noticed what mention was made of the Warriors of Light? None.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701540_ALPHINAUD: I suppose they must have forgotten the heroes who spared Eorzea a fate worse than the Calamity?
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701550_ALPHINAUD: No, dear Alisaie, they haven't “forgotten” these details. They have elected to omit them.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701560_ALPHINAUD: Deep are the wounds the Calamity inflicted upon Eorzea. So deep, in fact, that the realm still bleeds.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701570_ALPHINAUD: Needless to say, the beast tribes and their primals do little to alleviate the pain.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701580_ALPHINAUD: So the task of salving Eorzea's wounds falls to the Scions of the Seventh Dawn─with a little help from our friends the Grand Companies.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701590_ALPHINAUD: Remembrance will yield no remedy. If our world is to heal, we must put the horrors of the Calamity behind us.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701600_ALISAIE: Our grandfather would never entrust the fate of the realm to despots who rewrite history to their convenience!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701610_ALISAIE: There must be another way to cure what ails this world─and I mean to find it!
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701620_ALPHINAUD: You are most welcome to try. Our paths may differ, but our destination is the same. In time, I daresay we will see eye to eye.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701660_ALPHINAUD: Hope does not come into it. We share the burden of this fate, dear sister, and will prevail together or not at all.
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701670_ALPHINAUD: The salve will serve not only to close up our present wounds...
TEXT_MANFST300_00511_701680_ALPHINAUD: ...but prevent old ones from opening anew.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100010_MINFILIA: Now, having set aside the formalities...
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100020_MINFILIA: ...We have a favor to ask of you.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100030_MINFILIA: Urianger. Have the documents arrived from the Students of Baldesion?
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100040_URIANGER: Aye, my lady, they arrived but recently.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100050_MINFILIA: We have conducted a study at the behest of the Order of the Twin Adder.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100060_MINFILIA: Papalymo, Yda─a synopsis, if you would.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100070_PAPALYMO: Our task was to survey the behavior of the sylphs, a beast tribe indigenous to the Twelveswood.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100080_YDA: Oh, how to describe them... They look like...gysahl greens? Floating ones! That worship the primal Ramuh.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100090_PAPALYMO: Ahem. Though technically a “beast tribe,” sylphs are blessed with a comparatively personable demeanor, conducive to peaceful communication.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100100_MINFILIA: Offering us an invaluable opportunity to learn what the beast tribes know of the primals.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100110_PAPALYMO: While Ramuh's existence is well documented, the sylphs do not─or perhaps, can not─summon the primal any longer, insofar as can be ascertained. Until such time as we know...
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100120_PAPALYMO: ...It would be unwise to assume that the threat posed by the primal has passed.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100130_YDA: Which leaves Gridania with the added worry of not knowing what they should be worrying about!
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100140_PAPALYMO: In that regard, they are hardly alone. What we can say with absolute certainty is that Gridania has its hands full fending off Garuda.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100150_PAPALYMO: Who, I need hardly remind you, is among the most savage and terrible of all known primals.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100160_MINFILIA: In short, it is essential that we approach the sylphs in as diplomatic a manner as possible.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100170_MINFILIA: Words and actions can be misconstrued. The only sure way to communicate our intentions is the Echo.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100180_MINFILIA: Winning the sylphs' favor may well bring us a step closer to mitigating the threat of the primals. Will you help us?
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100200_THANCRED: Lovely! Well, as much as I'd like to help, I'm afraid I would be of little use to anyone in Gridania. A veritable babe in the woods.
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_100210_THANCRED: Yda and Papalymo, however, should be able to see the forest for the trees. Is that not so, Minfilia?
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_VORSAILE_000_010: We know far too little of the sylphs to lay any worthwhile plans. We must call upon the Scions once more if we are to─
TEXT_MANFST304_00513_VORSAILE_000_011: Ah, beg pardons. 'Tis a terrible habit of mine to think aloud. But tell me, what brings you to the Adders' Nest?
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_000: It's taken us a fair old while, but we've finally got our hands on some reliable information concerning the whereabouts of your missing green friend.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_PAPALYMO_000_001: Ahem! His name is Frixio, and he is the eldest amongst the sylphs of Little Solace. Long has he represented his kind in dialogue with the Gridanians.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_YDA_000_002: Yes, he's like a bridge between us and them─a small, leafy, green bridge that we can't find at the moment. And bridges are no use if you don't know where they are. That's why it's so important that we find him!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_003: There's an abandoned dungeon called the Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak here in the South Shroud.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_004: 'Twas by the entrance to the place that Frixio was seen─and not long ago, neither. If you hurry, I reckon you'll find him.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_KNOLEXIA_000_005: Walking ones, please help this one! This one needs help! Needs help to help elder one! Poor Frixio! Poor, poor Frixiooo!!!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_006: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Hooold your chocobos. Take a deep breath and tell us what's wrong, nice and slow.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_KNOLEXIA_000_007: Elder one went into Toto-Rak, but has not returned! This one is worried, so very worried!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_008: And you're right to be... The place fair crawls with nasties waiting to make a meal of anyone daft enough to wander in.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_009: What in the seven hells was he thinking, entering that bloody death trap?
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_KNOLEXIA_000_010: Elder one had no choice! Imperial ones were chasing elder one! Please! Walking ones must help elder one─help elder one now!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_PAPALYMO_000_011: Argh! The fates conspire against us... Forgive my pragmatism, but Frixio is our best hope of reaching an accord with the sylphs. Were we to lose him, all our efforts thus far will have been for naught.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_PAPALYMO_000_012: I will tend to her wounds. Yda, make haste to the Adders' Nest and request assistance.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_PAPALYMO_000_014: ─go to the Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak and see that Frixio comes to no harm. Peace between man and sylph rests upon your success.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BLOISIRANT_000_020: By order of the Elder Seedseer, the dungeon known as the Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak has been placed under the control of─
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BLOISIRANT_000_021: ...What? The sylph elder is inside? And you are sure of this? How in the seven hells did he manage to sneak by? Gods strike me down for a purblind fool!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BLOISIRANT_000_022: You must find the sylph elder before he falls prey to the fiends within. Entrance to Toto-Rak is ordinarily restricted, but these are exceptional circumstances. Pray assemble a rescue party, and enter as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BLOISIRANT_100_022: Entrance to the Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak is ordinarily restricted, but in light of the elder sylph's plight, I shall make an exception. Pray assemble a rescue party, and enter as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000030_LAHABREAANCI: (-???-)The mighty slayer of Ifrit comes now to me.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000050_LAHABREAANCI: (-???-)An intriguing power, the Echo. I must needs choose my words with care.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000060_LAHABREAEORZ: (-???-)Mayhap I might if I deign to speak in my guest's crude tongue. We meet at last.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000070_LAHABREAEORZ: I am Lahabrea of the Ascians, servant to the one true god.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000080_LAHABREAEORZ: Yours is a most fantastical tale. Truly absorbing.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000090_LAHABREAEORZ: It is a tale to tell Eorzea's children before bedtime. And it will soon be dark, Bringer of Light.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000110_LAHABREAEORZ: All that stands between this world and Darkness is an irksome anomaly in the aether─the Echo.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000120_LAHABREAEORZ: Yes...yours is a most fascinating tale.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000130_LAHABREAEORZ: Alas, like all good tales, it must needs come to an end. But fear not...
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_000150_LAHABREAEORZ: For the end of your tale is but the beginning of another... The tale of the Crystal's demise!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_101: (-???-)<sniff> <sniff> Mayhap not so fresh...but better than before.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_102: (-???-)Ah, sinister one is gone! This one can leave this awful place!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_103: (-???-)Hm? Did walking one vanquish the many-legged one? This one is grateful to walking one!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_104: This one is called Frixio, eldest of these ones of Little Solace.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_IMPERIALRUNNER_000_: Alpha squad reporting, sir! Nothing of note at Larkscall, sir!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_IMPERIALCENTURION_0:
Understood. Return to area twelve.
Damn it all...where is that accursed eikon hiding?
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_112: No sign of our wizened friend?
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_IMPERIALCENTURION_0: I'm afraid not, my lord. Shall I order that the search perimeter be expanded?
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_114: Absolutely not. We risk alerting the Gridanians to our presence. His Excellency bid us avoid unnecessary confrontation.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_115: Loath though I am to admit it, I have found no evidence to suggest that Ramuh will be gracing the mortal realm in the near future.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_116: I ask you...what good is a god who does not grant one's wishes? Were I a sylph, I should strongly consider finding myself another idol.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_117: Which reminds me─what of the sylphs we captured? A handful of them seemed to be in reasonably good health when last I looked.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_IMPERIALCENTURION_0: Ah. A-Apologies, my lord. I fear we may have been...overzealous in our efforts to compel them to summon their eikon.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_119: <sigh> ...Really, Centurion─were you not aware that vegetables bruise easily? It is well that I did not entrust you with the important task of making my dinner.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_120: Well, mayhap it was a kindness. Better dead in truth than dead to one's own god, I suppose...if you believe in such things.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_121: Dawn is upon us. Make ready to withdraw.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_123: We are so close to completion, I can fair taste it, but at this rate...
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_124: No, I must be patient. Our efforts will bear fruit in due time.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_125: ...What was it you always said? Ah, yes: “Though it mean bringing down the very heavens, who shall challenge the limits of possibility if not we?” In that alone were you right...Garlond.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_126: But your star is long fallen, while mine doth begin to rise.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NERO_000_127: And it shall burn so bright─so bright that Lord van Baelsar's ultimate weapon will seem a mere candle beside it! Ahahahaha!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NORAXIA_000_128: Those walking ones did for Noxia! This one is certain of it!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_129: This one fears that other taken ones also suffered the same fate...
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_NORAXIA_000_130: This one is convinced! Walking ones have black hearts, seek only to harm these ones! Walking ones are not to be trusted!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_131: Now, now, Noraxia...do not pass judgment too hastily. Not all walking ones are alike. Though there are evil ones among the walking ones, there are good ones also.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_140: Hm? Does walking one feel unwell?
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_141: This one would know, what brings walking one to this place?
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_142: Came to this one's rescue at Noraxia's bidding? Then this one owes walking one a debt of gratitude!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_143: Hm? Walking one has questions about Lord Ramuh? Then this one will provide answers.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_144: But first, let these ones quit this lightless place.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_145: This one will return to Little Solace. When walking one is ready, please come and see this one. These ones may speak properly then.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_FRIXIO_000_146: Then it is settled! Let this one accompany walking one outside!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_030: Ah, you're back! Tell me the sylph elder is well!
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_031: ...Thank the gods for that! I don't rightly know what to make of the rest of your tale, but I'm full glad Frixio didn't come to any harm.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_032: Ah, but there I go tempting fate. Run over to Little Solace and secure us peace with the sylphs before aught else befalls us, eh? Rest assured, I'll send word to our friends of Sharlayan and the Twin Adder both.
TEXT_MANFST306_00514_BUSCARRON_000_033: You've done Gridania a great service this day, ─and earned yourself a place of honor here at the Druthers in so doing. Be sure and come by whenever you feel like a drop of Qiqirn firewater!
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000020_YSHTOLA: Concerning the kobolds they sent such copious notes on, I presume?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000030_MINFILIA: Yes, and no. It has more to do with their findings, which portend a peril far greater than any beast tribe.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000050_MINFILIA: The worst kind. A tribe of kobolds in the vicinity of Limsa Lominsa has reawakened Titan.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000060_MINFILIA: Our task will be to slay the primal. The Maelstrom have sworn support for the endeavor.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000070_MINFILIA: They are no strangers to the havoc kobolds can wreak.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000080_YSHTOLA: Years before the Grand Company's reformation, two primals, Leviathan and Titan, chanced to converge upon the seawall, wreaking untold devastation.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000090_YSHTOLA: There, by the grace of the Navigator, were the mercenaries Merlwyb hired able to fend them off.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000100_YSHTOLA: Yet it did not take long for the beast tribes to regroup, and they summoned their primals once more.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000110_MINFILIA: Thankfully, their second coming was decidedly short-lived─but that is beside the point.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000120_MINFILIA: So long as tormented souls will them to exist, the realm will never be rid of primals.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000130_YSHTOLA: The Maelstrom has kept a watchful eye upon the beast tribes─and the kobolds in particular─ever since.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000140_YSHTOLA: Which brings us to the matter at hand.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000150_MINFILIA: Unlike Ifrit, we know scarcely anything of Titan.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000160_MINFILIA: Unfortunately, the only force known to have bested him─the modestly named “Company of Heroes”─disbanded five years since, and mercenaries are not in the habit of keeping chronicles.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000180_YSHTOLA: The Maelstrom's help is of course appreciated, but even if we had their whole armada at our disposal, we could still find ourselves overmatched.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000190_YSHTOLA: A pity the kobolds lack the gentle sensibilities of the sylphs. A peaceful resolution would be more than welcome.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000200_YSHTOLA: The Echo will not avail you this time, I fear. If you are to survive, your steel must needs speak for you.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000210_YSHTOLA: No one would think you a coward were you to decline.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000240_THANCRED: We can't very well send  to Limsa Lominsa without Y'shtola, can we, Minfilia?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000250_MINFILIA: May I ask that of you, Y'shtola?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000260_YSHTOLA: I never thought it in question.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000280_MINFILIA: Very well. We will spare no effort to win victory.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000290_MINFILIA: You may count on the full support of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000300_MINFILIA: And all not afield will aid the fight from afar.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000310_MINFILIA: Thancred, Yda, go to the Grand Companies. Tell them of our plight and solicit their support.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000320_MINFILIA: Urianger, send word to the Students of Baldesion─and Alphinaud, if you would.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000330_MINFILIA: Papalymo, compile all the information we have on Titan, little though it may be.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000340_MINFILIA: You'll be apprised of the tactical situation when you reach the Sailors Ward.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_000350_MINFILIA: Provision yourself for the journey. May you walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_RASHAHT_000_001: The Scions sent word that you were on your way.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_RASHAHT_000_005: Hail, adventurer, and welcome to Maelstrom Command. If you wish to know more about enlisting, speak with the personnel officer.
