TEXT_MANFST309_00516_RASHAHT_000_006: Unless...you are the guest we were told to expect? Ah...ha. Ahem. Forgive me, .
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_RASHAHT_000_010: To business, then. It is as we told the Antecedent. The kobolds have once again summoned Titan.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_RASHAHT_000_011: A little over a moon ago, we began to observe the beastmen moving south in increasing numbers from O'Ghomoro.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_RASHAHT_000_012: Our scouts subsequently confirmed the object of their aggression─
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_013: Crystals. Fodder for their fell primal.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_014:
Thank you, High Commander. You may leave the rest to me.
. .
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_YSHTOLA_000_015: Forgive the lack of forewarning, High Commander. The Admiral wished to address  personally.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_016: We are no strangers to conflict. Long have the Sahagin and the kobolds plagued our people─nor is this the first time we have had to address a primal threat.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_017: In the past, when Titan rose to threaten the peace, it was to the Company of Heroes we turned.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_018: But they are long disbanded, and we must look to other brave souls blessed with the strength to face this foe.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_019: So it is that we turn now to the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, confident in the belief that you are Limsa's best hope.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_YSHTOLA_000_020: I hope you are right. Yet the situation is far from simple. The kobolds are not prone to unprovoked aggression. Did not the thalassocracy make a pact with the beastmen that each would keep to their own lands, and that no blood would be shed?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_YSHTOLA_000_021: ...And was it not the Lominsans who violated this agreement, dissatisfied with their lot? Shall we then condemn the beastmen for defending their homes?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_YSHTOLA_000_022: Even a pirate must one day reap what she has sown.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_RASHAHT_000_023: I would advise you to choose your words with greater care, Lady Y'shtola!
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_024: Stand down, High Commander. She has the right of it.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_025:
And the wrong is mine. Freely do I claim it. Yet it makes little difference. Remorse will not shield us from Titan's wrath.
...Or would you have us fall upon our swords?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_YSHTOLA_000_026: My apologies, Admiral. The safety and security of Limsa Lominsa's citizenry are, of course, of paramount concern.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_027: Already, we have observed disruptions in the flow of aether further inland. The effects will be felt here in the city ere long.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_028: I ask much of you, I know, but the need is great. ?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_MERLWYB_000_029: You have my thanks, along with the full support of the Maelstrom. I await good tidings.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_YSHTOLA_000_030: That the kobolds should summon Titan demonstrates they are no longer amenable to negotiation.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_YSHTOLA_000_031: This being the case, we must needs prepare for conflict. Before we meet Titan in the field, however, it would be wise to learn all we can of our foe. And I can think of no better source of information than the mercenaries who defeated him once before.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_RASHAHT_000_032: The Company of Heroes may be no more, but several of its former members still live. It is said that one of them is employed at the Grey Fleet mills in lower La Noscea.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_YSHTOLA_000_033: Quite why a mercenary should choose to become a miller, I do not know. When you find him, mayhap you could ask him for me. I, meanwhile, shall seek his fellows.
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_TRACHTOUM_000_050:
Lay down yer burdens, son,♪
Come drain a pint with me,♪
We'll have a grand ol' time,♪
Find ye a lass or three...♪
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_TRACHTOUM_000_051:
Ye gonna say somethin', 'venturer, or just keep starin'?
Eh? Ye want to know about the Company of Heroes?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_TRACHTOUM_000_052: Ahhh hells... Price of bleedin' fame... Can't a miller mill in peace no more!?
TEXT_MANFST309_00516_TRACHTOUM_000_053: Still, seein' as ye've come all this way, I s'pose it wouldn't hurt to oblige ye. Consider yerself lucky, ─ol' Trachtoum was the Company's best axeman. Now, what was it ye wanted to know?
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_YSHTOLA_000_000: Though word will already have reached Maelstrom Command, protocol requires that a representative of our order inform the high commander of the mission's success. The honor is rightfully yours, .
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_YSHTOLA_000_001: Once again, I must commend you on a job well done. We shall speak again soon.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_RASHAHT_000_010: . Word of your triumph reached me some while ago, but I am pleased to have it personally confirmed.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_RASHAHT_000_011: First Ifrit and now Titan... Truly, when I think of your achievements, I feel the loss of the Warriors of Light less keenly─and there can be no greater compliment than that. You and your order are heroes. .
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_RASHAHT_000_012: I shall relay the details of your report to the Admiral forthwith. Please send my regards to the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_MINFILIA_000_015: , this is Minfilia. Y'shtola has informed me of your success.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_MINFILIA_000_016: You have won a great victory for the people of Eorzea, one that shall not be forgotten.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_MINFILIA_000_017: And what is more, both you and Y'shtola emerged from O'Ghomoro unscathed. Why, Tataru and the others seemed as glad of that as they did of Titan's fall!
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_MINFILIA_000_018:
You can look forward to a hero's welcome!
We'll be awaiting your return at the Waking Sands. There is much to discuss. Godsspeed.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_NPCA_000_020: You hear that commotion just now? What in the seven hells were they doin' in there? Wrestlin' a peiste!? You look like the adventurous type. Mind takin' a quick look?
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_NPCB_000_021: ...Was that screaming I heard? I'm not sure I want to know...
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_NORAXIA_000_030: //? use your contrived psychic powers on the dying sylph to figure out what the hell happened
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_NORAXIA_000_100: This one is glad...walking one is safe...
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100010_MINFILIA: We'll be awaiting your return at the Waking Sands. There is much to discuss. Godsspeed.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100030_MINFILIA: Louisoix, do you see? Your light shines brightly in this one. And in time, it will illuminate the realm once more.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100080_DAWNMEMBER: (-Scion of the Seventh Dawn-)Advance no further!
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100090_LIVIA: We have come for the one who slayed Ifrit and Titan!
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100130_MINFILIA: Stay out of sight. I would leave a message with you.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100140_MINFILIA: I surrender myself, on the condition you spare the innocents.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100150_LIVIA: Conditions? There speaks the supreme Scion.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100160_LIVIA: I'll grant you have courage, but you would be better served by armor.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100170_MINFILIA: Search all you will, the one you seek is not here.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100190_MINFILIA: And yet you knew to look here...but how? <gasp>
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100280_LIVIA: Though we have not found our quarry, the “High Priestess of the Scions” should suffice for now.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_100290_LIVIA: They say she also possesses the Echo. I cannot wait to hear her scream.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_NORAXIA_000_110: Walking...walking one Minfilia...asked this one to... <groan>
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_NORAXIA_000_111: In case walking one r-returned...this one was to say...to say...
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_NORAXIA_000_112: At church in eastern Thanalan...walking one must claim sanctuary...
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_NORAXIA_000_113: This one tried...tried to protect walking one Minfilia f-from imperial ones...
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_040: Is something troubling you, my ? You have the look of one who has endured great suffering. If there is anything I can do to help─anything at all─you need only ask.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_A1_000_051: Forgive me, Father, for I have sinned.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_A2_000_052: Curse my enemies, Father! Call down divine vengeance upon those who butchered my friends!
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_A3_000_053: The wild roses are dead, Father, and I know not what to do.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_060: Close your eyes and look within. Acknowledge your misdeeds and your regrets. Pray endeavor to atone with an earnest heart, and you shall surely find salvation, my .
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_061: The crimes of which you speak are grave...yet I cannot do that which you ask of me. Be assured, however, that the gods see all. If you would ask them for anything, let it be justice and not vengeance.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_062: ...The wild roses? I see. You may speak freely here. We are all friends of the Scions.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_141: And you are certain that Minfilia was among those taken by the Garleans?
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_142: Let us pray no further harm comes to them...
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_143: You may stay here for as long as you wish. It is the least I can do for a friend of Minfilia's.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_144: I have known her since she was but a child... Well do I recall the day of our first meeting.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_145: I swore then to do everything in my power to support her, and I will gladly offer the selfsame service to her brother and sister Scions.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_146: So please─no matter what you require, you need not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_147: Marques, would you come here for a moment?
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_149: If you require assistance, pray speak with Marques. He is a trifle shy, but I assure you he means well.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_150: I should explain─Marques is a survivor of the battle of Carteneau. Alas, his experiences took a terrible toll upon his mind... Had we not taken him into our care, he would surely have perished in the desert.
TEXT_MANFST313_00517_ILIUD_000_151: Marques, I want you to look after . Do you understand?
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_MARQUEZ_000_000: I...I'm not imagining it, . I know I'm being watched...
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_MARQUEZ_000_001: This is different─sinister. It is as if I am...under observation.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_MARQUEZ_000_002: The feeling comes and goes...but I felt it when last I ventured outside. Yes. I know I felt it. Will you look outside for me...please? It will only take a moment.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_MARQUEZ_000_020: You were attacked, weren't you? Are you unharmed? Thank the gods.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_MARQUEZ_000_021: I knew it. He was watching me. ...But why was he watching me?
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_MARQUEZ_000_022: What did he want with me? Did he, perhaps...know something of my past? If only I could have asked him...
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_MARQUEZ_000_023: I...I need to think. Please, allow me a moment alone. Wait. Father Iliud must hear of this. Will you tell him for me? It's important. I think others may come for me again.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_ILIUD_000_030: Heavens forfend... That such a thing should happen on holy ground! Do you have any idea who this man was? Did you notice anything distinctive about his garb or possessions?
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_ILIUD_000_031: This...this is Garlean steel. Which means the man who was watching Marques was...
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_ILIUD_000_032: Make haste to Camp Drybone at once! We must summon the Immortal Flames before more imperials come!
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000010_ALPHINAUD: Hmph. I fondly hoped that I might be the first to speak with you... Would that I had been so fortunate.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000020_ALPHINAUD: At ease, adventurer─I come not on behalf of the Empire. On the contrary, I mean to revive the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000040_ALPHINAUD: I have come in search of a legend─the greatest engineer of our time. Master Cid Garlond─I have come for you.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000050_PRIEST: I fear you are mistaken, child. He is but a poor soul who bore witness to the horrors at Carteneau.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000060_PRIEST: I beg of you, leave us in peace...
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000090_ALPHINAUD: Hear me, Cid! Eorzea needs you!
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000100_MARQUEZ: You... So familiar... We... It's... all a blur.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000120_PRIEST: Cid, was it? Here...these belong to you.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000130_PRIEST: I thought you bore the mark of greatness... It seems that I was right.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000140_PRIEST: Our time together was all too brief, but it felt as though my son had returned to me. You have brought joy to an old man's life.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000150_PRIEST: But it is time for you to help those who truly need you.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000180_ALPHINAUD: As a Scion of the Seventh Dawn, I stand against our primal and imperial foes─as my grandfather once did.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000190_ALPHINAUD: 'Tis no secret what befell our order at the Waking Sands. Word has already spread across Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000200_ALPHINAUD: The repercussions are far greater than you realize. In the wake of the Calamity, the three city-states focused their efforts solely on reconstruction.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000210_ALPHINAUD: Leaving the Scions to combat the primal threat unaided.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000220_ALPHINAUD: And lo, we are all but destroyed. Yet even as the nations mourn our demise, and abandon what little hope they have left, we cannot forsake our duty─now least of all.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000230_ALPHINAUD: The Ixal have summoned Garuda once more, and she torments the people of Coerthas as we speak.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000240_ALPHINAUD: Her appetite for destruction far exceeds that of other primals.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000250_ALPHINAUD: Worse, in her present incarnation, our Baldesion colleagues believe she surpasses both Ifrit and Titan in strength.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000260_ALPHINAUD: Yet therein lies an opportunity. Were we somehow to defeat Garuda, it would serve as a warning to the other beast tribes that even their mightiest gods can be felled.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000270_ALPHINAUD: If we are to face our foe, we must first circumvent the tempest that shields her sanctuary.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000280_ALPHINAUD: And for that, we need an airship─your airship, Cid.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000300_ALPHINAUD: Yes, Cid, you do. Your very own airship.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000310_ALPHINAUD: It was last seen in the skies over Gridania, not long before the Calamity, so let us begin our search there.
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000340_ALPHINAUD: Come, let us put an end to the primals! Together, we will show the world that the Scions are still a force to be reckoned with!
TEXT_MANFST401_00518_000350_CID: They need my airship... They need...me.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_000: According to my tests, the device is now functioning in perfect harmony with the crystal─meaning we can leave whenever you're ready.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_001: But you must understand: tests can only tell one so much.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_002: Until we approach the Howling Eye─until we attempt to breach the barrier itself...I cannot be sure that this will work.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_003: I think it only fair to tell you that there is a small but statistically significant chance that the crystal could trigger a massive...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_004: Hmmm... Mayhap it is better that we remain positive.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_005: , I want to thank you. For reuniting me with my ship, for trusting in me to develop this plan...for everything. You've helped me to rediscover a part of myself I'd forgotten. I am not the man I once was, and I do not know if I ever shall be...but I do know one thing: this feels right.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_006: ...My apologies for the sudden outpouring of sentiment. I would have waited until after the mission, but...well, you understand.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_000030_ALPHINAUD: To Coerthas! And an audience with the harpy queen Garuda!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_000070_CID: I...I once flew in this airship. And I was not alone.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_000080_CID: There were adventurers on board...adventurers like you.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100090_CID: Just how long have I worn these damn goggles?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100100_CID: Ah, yes. I fancied myself a trendsetter in my younger days.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100110_CID: The young prodigy, admired by all...exactly like his father.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100130_CID: It was only natural that the precocious young student should become an engineer. Had his father not done the same?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100140_CID: Father... When did we stop seeing eye to eye?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100150_CID: When did Meteor become your everything, and your loved ones cease to matter?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100160_CID: You abandoned us all. But he was there for me, Father─there for me when you were not.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100170_CID: Though he proved no better in the end. Gaius was just another man with an all-consuming obsession.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100180_CID: And so I ran─left the Empire behind and came to Eorzea, where I built the Ironworks.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100190_CID: Ah, yes! It was then that I first donned these goggles.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100200_CID: Eorzea opened my eyes. It was home to so many manner of people, each with their own hopes and dreams. People worth saving. And so I fought beside them.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100210_CID: I wanted to prove that my knowledge could serve a nobler purpose.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100220_CID: I wanted to prove that there was another way...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_100230_CID: And it all began that day, when I found my new home...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200240_CID: I had forgotten how wonderful it was. The wind in your hair, the endless sky...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200250_CID: That light─it was you, wasn't it?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200260_CID: It's surprising how few people know this, but all pureblood Garleans have a third eye.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200270_CID: Perhaps mine helped me recognize you─or perhaps it was just a lucky guess.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200280_CID: The Enterprise was made for this! To carry Eorzea's protectors into battle!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200290_CID: I am proud to be able to call her my own.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200310_CID: Alphinaud, my boy─sorry to have been such a burden.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200330_CID: My name, my people, and my purpose. Everything.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_200340_CID: Come! It would be rude to keep Garuda waiting!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_300350_CID: It took a while for the memory to return, but I remember you.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_300360_CID: The floating isle, van Darnus... We ended it, that day─or so we thought.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_300370_CID: Listen─let's keep this between the two of us, for the time being.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_300380_CID: If word got out that one of the Warriors of Light had returned, the eyes of the world would soon be upon us─our enemies' included. And that's the kind of attention we could well do without.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_300390_CID: What, isn't it enough that I know the truth?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_300400_CID: Don't worry. A  of your talents won't go unnoticed for long. Someday, they will remember you─and you'll never know another moment's peace!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_300410_CID: There, up ahead! Ready, old friend?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_300420_CID: Hah! Some things never change! We're going in!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_020: All our efforts...all our travails...all of it was for this.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Make ready, , for the end is nigh─be it hers or our own.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_100_021: Beyond those gates awaits our foe. Are you prepared to meet with her?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_052: (-???-)Your insolence shall not go unpunished, landwalkers!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_056: Amalj'aa and kobold prisoners. But why would the Ixal bring them here...?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_057: Heehee HAHA hahaha HEEHEE haha HEEEEEE!!!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_058: Wherefore come you hither, foolish mortals!?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_059: Garuda! We are come to put an end to your reign of terror!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_060: Hear you this blasphemy, my children? These landwalkers would bring me low!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_061: You who are bound to crawl upon the earth should revere me─FOR I AM THE WIND!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_062: Did we not take to the skies, and slip your defenses!? We are bound by nothing, Garuda!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_063: You think your playthings give you strength?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_064: They will not help you here, landwalker. This is my realm, where none can challenge my supremacy! Struggle though you may─I shall slake the roots with your blood, and festoon the canopy with your ENTRAILS! HAHAHAHAHAAA!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_IXALGURU_000_065: Squaaawk! Slay the unfeathered ones, we shall! As an offering to Garuda, they will serve!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_000_066: Leave the Ixal to us, ! We will keep them distracted while you deal with her!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_067: Do not fail, ! Remember: you fight for the Scions! For Eorzea!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_068: This worm would die by mine own hand! Come, then...I shall grant you that which you seek!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_082: HAHAHAHAHAAA! This...is...MY REALM! You have no hope here! None! NONNNE!!!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_083: Did you truly believe you could defy a god, landwalkers!?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_084: My power is limitless! My children legion!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_085: And they have rendered unto me a wealth of crystals.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_086: Their gifts sustain me, their faith empowers me!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_087: None save my children will escape the reckoning, mortals! And those who would use my crystals to waken the rest shall realize the folly of their faith!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_088: Then all shall worship none but me! The one true god! HEE HEE HEE HEE HEEEEEE!!!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_089: ...Of course! Worship! So long as the Ixal keep praying, she will never fall!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_092:
HAHA hahaha HEEHEE heehee HAHAHA!!!
No harm will come to you, my children!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_093: This is only the beginning, landwalkers! All who oppose me shall suffer for their defiance!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_094: Soon, the worms of the forest shall receive my judgment! The desert vermin next─their walls of stone will not shield them from the tempest!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_095: And then will I take vengeance on the sea lice! Their wooden boats cannot outrun the wind!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_096: Tremble, mortals, for I shall visit you all in time! And all shall be mine! ALL MIIINE!!!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_097: You, landwalker─you who dared to raise your hand against me─you shall be the first to pay for your sins! Not with your death─but with your LIFE!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_098: You will serve me, landwalker...to your last breath!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_099: No, NO!!! I claimed you! You should be MINE!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_100: What...what are you? What have you done to me!?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_GARUDA_000_101: No mortal should possess such power! This...this is impossible!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600430_GARUDA: Why do you not tremble at my might? Why do you not beg for mercy!? Why do you not DIE!?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600480_GAIUS: O Lady of the Vortex! O mighty Garuda!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600490_GAIUS: Of all primals, the most terrible. I say again...IS─THAT─ALL!?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600510_GAIUS: Ah, Cid, my boy. You look well─for one who has forsaken kin and country. I wonder, what else you will forsake before the day is done.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600530_GAIUS: What exactly did you hope to accomplish here this day?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600550_GAIUS: Well, I shall accomplish far more!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600570_GARUDA: Insolent mortal! I shall make you suffer!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600580_GARUDA: That foul stench... I see now... She has touched you!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600600_CID: Seven hells, does she still mean to fight!?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600610_ALPHINAUD: What is she─ Twelve preserve, she cannot mean to─
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600620_AMALJAA: (-Amalj'aa-)O Lord of the Inferno! Almighty Ifrit! Grant us succor in our hour of need!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600630_KOBOLD: (-Kobolds-)Save us, Titan, Lord of Crags! Ah, it hurts us so, the pain, the pain...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600640_ALPHINAUD: No... No, this is all wrong...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600650_CID: Stop gawping, boy! We must run!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_600660_GARUDA: Surrender yourselves unto me... I would feast upon your aether. NONE SHALL STAND AGAINST THE WIND!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700670_GAIUS: BEAR WITNESS TO THE GLORY OF THE EMPIRE!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700680_GAIUS: It is you who will suffer, Garuda!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700690_GAIUS: Ancient Allag had ways of dealing with your kind. Now, look on their ultimate weapon, eikon, and despair!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700720_LAHABREAEORZ: With each primal it consumes, it grows more powerful. A marvel, is it not?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700730_GAIUS: Such is the fate of those who oppose the Empire!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700740_GAIUS: There will be no Warriors of Light to save you this time.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700750_GAIUS: If your leaders are as wise as they are reported, they will surrender.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700760_GAIUS: Your skills are impressive, but they will not be enough.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700770_ALPHINAUD: Twelve have mercy! What chance have we against such an ungodly creation!?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700780_ALPHINAUD: And who was that armored devil!?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700790_CID: That was Gaius van Baelsar, legatus of the XIVth Imperial Legion, and supreme commander of the Garlean invasion force in Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700800_ALPHINAUD: Of course, the Black Wolf─how could I not realize? Grandfather mentions him in his journal!
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700810_CID: I was never so naive as to think the man would abandon his ambitions, but these developments are beyond my worst expectations...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700820_CID: What have you been doing these past five years? How could something of this magnitude have escaped the Alliance's attention?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700830_ALPHINAUD: We heard no whispers, saw no signs. In the wake of the Calamity, the Empire seized land and built outposts, but that was the extent of their aggression.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700840_CID: Damn it, Gaius, where in the seven hells did you find that thing?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700850_ALPHINAUD: It has been a day of unexpected developments, but the fact remains: Garuda is no longer a threat.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700860_ALPHINAUD: While I take no comfort in the manner of her downfall, it does mean that we may safely put the matter of the primals to one side─for the time being, at least.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700870_CID: Which just leaves the matter of Gaius's new toy.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700880_ALPHINAUD: Indeed. That weapon poses the greatest threat to Eorzea. It must be destroyed.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700890_ALPHINAUD: But first, we must needs find out all we can.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700900_ALPHINAUD: Let us make for Vesper Bay. We shall rebuild the Scions.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_700910_ALPHINAUD: All is not yet lost, my friend─for we bear the light, and shall surely lead our people from the darkness.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_900: Well, that was an experience I would rather not have again.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_901: Something has been troubling me, . Shortly before the Black Wolf took center stage, when Garuda attempted to claim you as her own, I could have sworn I saw...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_902: Ah, but I'm sure I was mistaken. In times of great stress, the evidence of the eye is apt to be misread by even the most inquiring mind. Forget I mentioned it.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_903: Returning to the subject of our earlier discussion, we may consider the matter of the primals closed until further notice. No beast tribe will dare summon their god so long as that weapon exists.
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ALPHINAUD_000_904: Truly, a more effective deterrent I could not imagine. It almost seems a shame to plot its destruction...
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_CID_050_031: You know, it's not easy guiding the Enterprise through a ceaselessly swirling wall of wind. I would rather not risk our lives again until you're sure─meaning absolutely certain─that you're ready. Are you?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_LIONNELLAIS_050_032: Greetings, . Do you wish to proceed to your vessel?
TEXT_MANFST404_00519_ELYENORA_050_033: Greetings, . Do you wish to proceed to your vessel?
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It is past time that we return to the Waking Sands.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_001: To leave our headquarters in disrepair any longer would be to dishonor the memory of those who fell there.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_002: We have been brought to our knees, but we will rest, rebuild, and rise once more.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Tell me, ...does aught here strike you as odd? I see signs of recent habitation. Could it be that we have trespassers?
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Hm. Mayhap it is just my imagination. Come, let us proceed into the solar.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_102: Now, now, Yda─is that any way to greet a friend?
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YDA_000_104: Cid!? Wait, is this a dream?
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_CID_000_105: Not that I'm aware of! It's been a while, Yda.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YDA_000_106: I...I don't believe it... I was sure you'd been─
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_CID_000_107: This place has seen better days.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YDA_000_108: Uh...you know, I wasn't actually here when... I-I was still in talks at the Adders' Nest...
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YDA_000_109: The first I knew about it was when I came back, and...and I saw...
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YDA_000_111: The church had taken care of the bodies, but that still left...the stains... I-It was hard to know where to start... If Y'shtola hadn't been here to help me─
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YDA_000_113: Yes. But she's not here right now. She's gone to Ul'dah to meet a man who might know what happened to the others.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YDA_000_114: Papalymo and Minfilia weren't among the dead, according to the church. Y'shtola thinks they were taken somewhere.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_115: Upon the orders of the Black Wolf, no doubt.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_117: Because they possess something he desires: knowledge of another power that can be brought to bear against the primals─one that Gaius has yet to harness...
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_119: Gaius will be aware of its existence, as well as the immunity it grants the gifted to the primals' influence.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Powerful though his Allagan weapon may be, he would doubtless desire such protection.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_121: He means to use Minfilia to gain an understanding of the Echo.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_122: ...None of which explains how the Empire came to know the location of the Waking Sands in the first place...
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_123: No matter. The Empire has shown its hand, and now we must act. It is up to us to rebuild the Scions and save Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_124: Can I count on you, Yda?
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YDA_000_125: What? Oh, yes─yes, of course! Whatever you need!
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_126: We can discuss our next move upon Y'shtola's return.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ALPHINAUD_000_127: For now, I say we rest.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_200030_HYDAELYN: Brave gatherer of the Crystals...thy soul burneth bright!
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_200040_HYDAELYN: I am Hydaelyn. All made one.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_200050_HYDAELYN: Hearken unto me now, for the Darkness doth begin to spread.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_200060_HYDAELYN: Ware thee the bearer of the Crimson Brand, for he is the Avatar of Shadow, whom death attendeth always.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_200070_HYDAELYN: The Crystals shall be thy salvation─thy blade and shield both.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_200080_HYDAELYN: Steel thyself, for at the appointed hour...
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_200090_HYDAELYN: Thou shalt stare into the Heart of Darkness.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_200100_HYDAELYN: Go with caution, my child, but fear not─for I am ever with thee.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YSHTOLA_000_131: . I see you and Alphinaud are safe. And...and Cid.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YSHTOLA_000_132: That we five should meet each other thus defies simple explanation. It is as if the benevolent hand of Master Louisoix guides us still.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YSHTOLA_000_133: He would not see us undone so easily. Not now, when the need is so great.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YSHTOLA_000_134: I know where Minfilia and the others are being held.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_YSHTOLA_000_136: An imperial stronghold in the heart of Mor Dhona─Castrum Centri.
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_ELYENORA_000_140: Greetings, . Do you wish to proceed to your vessel?
TEXT_MANFST405_00520_CID_000_160: I...I had no idea, . I can only imagine how you felt when you returned that day...
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_000: How go your preparations, ? We leave as soon as you're ready.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_002: Aye─thought I'd give you all a roarin' send-off. 'Tis the least I can do for the fine men an' women what're about to make my lifelong wish come true.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_003: Well, we'll do our best! Hmmm... It occurs to me, for all the help you've afforded us, we know little and less about you. What did the Empire do to earn your ire? ...Ah, but I fear I've put curiosity before consideration. I quite understand if you'd rather not relive those memories.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_004: No, no, I don't mind, really. Truth be told, a part o' me was itchin' to tell you my tale. Mind you, 'tis hardly novel─I ain't the first to suffer at imperial hands.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_005: Like most folk, I used to have a mother. She was a sweet, carin' woman with a smile never far from her face. There was a sister too. Pretty little thing, she was─gentle as a lamb, but tough as nails. We were poor folk livin' simple lives, but we knew happiness just the same.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_006: An' then the imperials came an' took it all away. When Ala Mhigo fell, they put my family in a camp. Bein' a lad, I was made to do hard labor, while my mother an' sister were forced to do far worse... They hid their sufferin' from me as best they could, but I knew, an' the thought of it drove me mad. We had to escape. An' so I hatched a plan to get us out o' the city.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_007: We were pickin' our way around a gorge not far outside the walls when they caught up with us... An' rather than allow 'emselves to be taken again, my mother an' sister leaped over the edge before my very eyes. Heartbroken as I was, I didn't put up a fight when the imperials clapped me in chains an' dragged me back.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_008: 'Twas some years after that I escaped again, an' that time, I got away. I swore then that I'd get revenge on the Empire, an' became an adventurer so as to hone my skills an' earn the coin I needed. But nigh on two decades've since gone by, an' what've I achieved? Bugger all, that's what.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_009: Not like you lot. You ain't been here ten minutes, an' you've already done more'n I managed in ten bloody years.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_010: You give us too much credit, Glaumunt. We seek only to rescue our friends.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_011: Well, what's more important than that? An' anyroad, after you've got your friends back, you're plannin' on goin' after the Empire, an' don't pretend you ain't.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_012: I've helped a few folk take on the imperials over the years, an' every time I have, it's helped stave off my appetite for revenge. But summat tells me I won't be goin' hungry for a while what with everythin' you've got planned.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_013: And you are sure that will satisfy you? If you wish to strike back at the Empire with your own hand, you need only say the word. We would be glad to have you with us.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_014: Temptin' though your offer is, I'm afeared I must decline.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_015: I swore I'd get revenge on the Empire, 'tis true, but I've long since realized that the front lines are no place for a man like me.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_016: Aye, there's some as would call me craven, but I prefer to think o' myself as a realist. My talents lie in schemin', ye see, not swordplay. Helpin' folk like you is how I can make the most difference.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_017: ...But that's quite enough storytellin' for one day. Best not keep your friends waitin' any longer. I'll be prayin' for your safety an' success. May Rhalgr give you strength!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_018: Wherever the Empire goes, misery invariably follows in its wake.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_019: For the sake of all who call Eorzea home, we must put an end to Gaius's ambitions.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_020: But first, we have friends to rescue.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_021: Biggs, Wedge, and I will lie in wait east of Castrum Centri, just outside the stronghold's patrol perimeter.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_022:
Join us when you're ready.
Oh, and don't forget to wear your disguise, or this will be the shortest rescue mission in history.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_SLAFBORN_000_030: Want to go in? It hardly needs saying, but try not to be seen.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_040: There you are. A patrol should be heading back to the castrum any moment now, so for gods' sakes, don your disguise.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_041: If you've misplaced your disguise, hurry back to Revenant's Toll. Glaumunt told me that he'd acquired some additional helms and robes for just such an eventuality. Whatever you do, though, do it swiftly. We need you here and in imperial uniform if this plan is going to work.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_GLAUMUNT_000_042: ...Eh? Lost your imperial disguise? You daft sod! 'Tis lucky I thought to acquire some spares... In case you've forgotten, these ain't exactly easy to get hold of. Be more careful with 'em this time.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_050: This is it, . Time to rescue our comrades.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_100: Forgive me for saying so, but you  in imperial black and crimson! Ahhh, but now is not the time for jests.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_101: Let's review the infiltration plan. Castrum Centri lies just beyond.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_102: A short while ago, an imperial patrol left to do its rounds.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_103: Alphinaud and I will create a diversion out here and keep them occupied for as long as we are able. Meanwhile, the three of you will enter the stronghold, posing as the patrol returning from duty.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_104: Should Alphinaud and I prove less distracting than hoped, I will contact you via linkpearl. Be ready to beat a hasty retreat.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_105: Wedge will lead the way in the reaper. Stay close to him.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_106: And I hardly need tell you this, but don't do anything suspicious!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_107: Oh, and lest you wonder, Yda and Y'shtola left shortly before you arrived. We had planned that they should linger in the vicinity, to cover our retreat in the event that Alphinaud and I attracted too much attention─but the approach of an imperial vehicle forced us to improvise.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_108: Don't be too disappointed─they did at least leave a message for you. Something along the lines of “don't do anything reckless,” if memory serves. Wise words.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_109: All right, the imperial patrol should be returning any moment now. You'd best be off.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_CID_000_110: Good luck, ! May the Twelve keep you!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_000010_LIVIA: You have spirit, that I will allow. Yet you struggle to the benefit of none, least of all yourself.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_000030_LIVIA: This “Echo” of yours intrigues us. We desire only to understand it. And for that, we need your help.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_000040_LIVIA: You wish to be rid of the eikons, do you not?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_000050_LIVIA: You would have saved yourself a great deal of torment had you accepted our aid from the beginning.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_000070_LIVIA: Tell me everything, and I shall end it quickly. Refuse, and though you beg for death, you shall not have it.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_000100_LIVIA: As you wish, my dear Minfilia.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_000110_LIVIA: Unpleasant though it will be for all concerned, you leave us no choice but to employ more rigorous methods of study.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_000120_LIVIA: Be so kind as to deliver the prisoners to Castrum Meridianum.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_IMPERIALSOLDIER_A_0: Part of the maintenance crew from Occidens, are you? I don't know what they teach you over there, but being an engineer does not exempt you from saluting your superiors!
Why aren't you in uniform!? Dressed as you are, you're like to be mistaken for an adventurer!
Part of the maintenance crew from Occidens, you say? I don't know what they teach you over there, but being an engineer does not exempt you from saluting your superiors!
Hm, that's a fine salute. Part of the maintenance crew from Occidens, are you? Welcome to Castrum Centri, engineer.
Hm, that's a fine salute...but why aren't you in uniform? As you are, you're like to be mistaken for an adventurer!
What? Prisoners? Ah, you've heard the rumors, then. Yes, they're being held in the storage tower─but I strongly suggest you pay them no mind.
You were summoned here to work, not to gawp at Eorzea's defeated heroes. Now show a bit of enthusiasm, or I'll have you reported.
What was that supposed to be? A salute? I'll have you know, being an engineer does not give you license to be sloppy! Do it till you get it right!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_IMPERIALSOLDIER_B_0: Huh? Doesn't your senior officer have anything to say about your outfit? Not that I'm complaining, by the way─I for one would appreciate a bit more variety. I'm so used to seeing this uniform, I've caught myself saluting reflective surfaces.
I'd best get back to my duties. The supplies aren't going to move themselves─and neither are the prisoners, come to that.
Oh, my apologies! I didn't notice you there, so engrossed was I in my task. You'd be engrossed, too, had the tribunus commanded you to arrange for the prisoners to be transported.

Ah, your spirited salute reminds me that, uniform or no, we are all proud soldiers of the Garlean Empire. Everything we do is for the greater glory of Garlemald, be it scrubbing the privy floor or arranging for prisoners to be transported.

What prisoners do I speak of? ...You mean you haven't heard? Only the infamous “Scions of the Seventh Dawn,” captured by the tribunus herself! If you don't believe me, have a look in the storage tower when next you pass that way.
The officers constantly tell me that I have the sloppiest salute in all the western lands, but in you I'd say I've finally met my match. Perhaps we could practice together?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_IMPERIALSOLDIER_C_0: Whoa... Where did you leave your uniform!? If one of the brass hats sees you, you'll be in for the dressing-down of your life!

Hm? Shouldn't I be at my post? <sigh> I suppose so, but such things don't seem to matter anymore. I've...I've fallen for one of the prisoners. She's all I can think about of late. Am I...am I a deviant for wanting her to salute me?

Greetings, comrade. Forgive me for asking, but you haven't visited the storage tower recently, have you? I only ask because I dropped something in there, and...um... Oh, who am I fooling!? I've fallen for one of the prisoners, all right!? I daresay you know the one I mean. ...Eh? The svelte blonde? Goodness, no!

It's the Lalafellin lass I'm smitten with! She's so adorable, it hurts! I want to sweep her up into my arms and squeeze her till my arms ache!
What do you reckon it would take to convince the centurion to lend me the key so I can see her?

No, no, no! You're doing it all wrong! Unless you can master a good old-fashioned imperial salute, you'll never amount to anything in this army. Take the centurion, for example: his every salute's the same. It's no wonder he's been entrusted with such responsibility. Which is probably why he's been trusted with the keys to the storage tower.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_IMPERIALSOLDIER_D_0: Why are you not at your post? If you have business, salute me before opening your mouth.
Unless you can explain why you are not in uniform, and during a period of heightened security, to boot, you have earned yourself time in a black cell.
What's this? You need access to the storage tower? What business have you there?
What's this? You need access to the storage tower? What business have you there?
...At the tribunus's behest, you say? This is highly irregular, but it would not do to make my lady wroth. Take my identification key. See that it is returned when your errand is concluded.
What mummery is this? You have just earned yourself a fortnight in a black cell. Report to detention at the end of your shift.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_BIGGS_000_100: Security's tight, just as we expected. We're going to need a special key if we want to get past this bulkhead.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_BIGGS_000_701: Minfilia...and the rest! Thank goodness they're safe!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MINFILIA_000_702: I am the one you want! Leave the others be!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MINFILIA_000_703: If you harm my friends, I swear I shall take my own life─and you shall answer to your mistress!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_BIGGS_000_705: We risk letting the entire castrum know we're here.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_BIGGS_000_706: Aye...you're right. We may not get a better chance.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_IMPERIALGUARD_000_7: This is the third squadron. What is it?
...And this came to light only NOW!?
The culprits will have left a trail. Take as many men as you need and scour the area! I want that reaper found!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MINFILIA_000_741: It was foolish of you to come here. You might have been killed!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MINFILIA_000_742: But...thank you. I shudder to think what might have happened had you not arrived when you did.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_PAPALYMO_000_743: I say, did you not see Thancred anywhere? I'm beginning to fear for the fellow...
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_PAPALYMO_000_744: To linger here shall yield us no answer. Let us away, ere the window to our liberty closes shut.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_LIVIA_000_746: Then recapture them! Fail and I shall have your head.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_YSHTOLA_000_748: ...The tribunus herself, just as you said. You have the eye of an ahriman, Yda.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_YDA_000_749: Well...she's kind of hard to miss in that showy armor of hers.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_LIVIA_000_750: Accursed Scions... How did you slip our defenses?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_YSHTOLA_000_751: With unexpected ease, if truth be told. There chanced to be a commotion outside the castrum's walls which allowed us to avail ourselves of the comforts of your vehicle.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_YDA_000_752: Y'shtola's just being polite. That was one of the most uncomfortable things I've ever stowed away in. It's no wonder it's called the Phantom Train─no passenger would be seen dead on it!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_LIVIA_000_753: So you scuttled in amidst the freight, like the vermin you are. I shall be sure to have words with our ratcatcher. Such negligence is unforgivable.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_YSHTOLA_000_754: That is far from your most pressing concern. First, you must answer for your own wrongdoing, Livia sas Junius.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_YSHTOLA_000_755: 'Twas you who led the raid on the Waking Sands─you who butchered unarmed men and women for the crime of being unworthy of capture.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_YDA_000_756: You killed our friends! We'll never forgive you!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_YSHTOLA_000_757: Nor shall we suffer you to plague Eorzea a day longer. Betake you to your guard.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_IMPERIALGUARD_000_7: In the hangar, my lady─in discussion with our guest!
There they are! Fan out and surround them!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_WEDGE_000_767: Must...protect...Tataru! Biggs─I'm going in! See everyone to safety!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_BIGGS_000_769: Oh, no... ─hold them off! I'll look after Minfilia and Tataru!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_300150_IMPERIALSOLD: Take the leader! Kill the rest!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_300220_YDA: Well, it's nice to see you too!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_300250_PAPALYMO: Yes, let's get back to being heavily outnumbered...
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_300270_BIGGS: You ditched your magitek armor!? Fool of a Lalafell!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_300280_WEDGE: Well, excuse me! She's all yours if you think you can do any better!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_300300_IMPERIALSOLD: But there's no one in there!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_300310_CID: This is Cid! Can you hear me!?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_300320_CID: I need you to count to five, then jump! Understood!?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400370_GAIUS: I know not which is more pitiful: the charlatans who rule Eorzea...
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400380_GAIUS: ...or the masses that clamor for their implausible panaceas.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400390_GAIUS: I see that which they cannot. This realm founders for want of a ruler with true power─the power to cast down eikons.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400400_GAIUS: If you continue to deny this truth, it is the people who will suffer. Embrace reason.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400440_MINFILIA: Twelve preserve us... They finished it. Ultima Weapon...
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400460_MINFILIA: It is a relic of ancient Allag, excavated from its resting place deep beneath Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400470_MINFILIA: The Allagans used it to crush primal and foe alike...and now the Garleans mean to do the same!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400490_ALPHINAUD: Look! There, beside the Black Wolf!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400510_ALPHINAUD: An overlord, no less. His garb attests to that.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400520_MINFILIA: Lahabrea! It could only be him!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400540_MINFILIA: He was Lahabrea...? No... No, this cannot be!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_400550_CID: We have to go now! Hang on!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500580_ALPHINAUD: All that time, the enemy was beside me, and I never even suspected.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500590_ALPHINAUD: And to think that it was I who suggested that Thancred investigate the Ascians! How could I have been so blind!?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500600_ALPHINAUD: Small wonder the enemy knew our every move─and where to find us! Confound it all!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500610_ALPHINAUD: No... No, this is not the time for self-doubt. The Alliance leaders staked their hopes on the Scions, but now they believe us all dead or missing.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500620_ALPHINAUD: When they learn of the Empire's new weapon, we cannot be certain what they will do.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500630_ALPHINAUD: We must go and offer them what assurances we can that defeat is not inevitable!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500640_MINFILIA:
Krile? This is Minfilia. I am in some haste, so forgive me if I seem brusque. The item I requested─is it ready? Wonderful! I am sorry to press, but we need it urgently. How soon can it be delivered?
...I am in your debt, my friend.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500650_ALPHINAUD: The situation may have taken an ill turn...
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500660_ALPHINAUD: But the battle is far from over. And so long as we stand together, there shall ever be hope of victory.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500670_ALPHINAUD: The people of Eorzea falter for want of such hope. Let us provide it. Let us bear to them the tidings that the Scions of the Seventh Dawn are returned!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500680_ALPHINAUD: Matters are coming to a head. I hope we can count on you.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_500700_MINFILIA: I am ready. Let us pay a visit to the council of the Alliance leadership.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_RAUBAHN_000_800: Hells take the Black Wolf and his new toy...
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MERLWYB_000_801: Rally all available forces. I want them ready to move upon my word.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MERLWYB_000_802: And relay to Slafyrsyn the order to sail. That is all.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MERLWYB_000_803: The Maelstrom stands ready. What of the Flames?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_RAUBAHN_000_804: Ready as we're like to be. I need only give the word to Roaille.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_KANESENNA_000_805: Has there been no word from Ishgard?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_RAUBAHN_000_806: None. The dragons have got their tongues.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_KANESENNA_000_807: Silent to the last. I was unwise to hope for better.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MERLWYB_000_808: What would stir the archbishop to open his holy mouth, if not this!? And he claims the Fury for his god... 'Tis bad comedy!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_NANAMOULNAMO_000_80: The Holy See has made its choice. We will proceed without its cooperation.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_NANAMOULNAMO_000_81: I believe we are all acquainted with the terms of the Black Wolf's ultimatum.
We must agree upon a course of action. Naught less than the fate of Eorzea hangs upon the decision of this council.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_RAUBAHN_000_812: Van Baelsar claims to wield the power to smite primals.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_KANESENNA_000_813: Should we yield to him, he pledges to rid the realm of its false gods. Yet offer resistance, and he swears that we shall share the primals' fate.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MERLWYB_000_814: Pardon me my bluntness, but I like not these choices.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_NANAMOULNAMO_000_81: This is too great a decision for any one of our nations to make alone.
Choose we surrender or resistance, we must answer as one, for if but one surrenders, the rest shall surely fall. Let us pray for the wisdom to do right by all our peoples.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MINFILIA_000_900: Thancred's plight troubles us all, yet we cannot allow anything to come between us and our goal.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MINFILIA_000_901: So long as the Ultima Weapon exists, Eorzea will never know peace.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_MINFILIA_000_902: Let us go to the Alliance leaders, , and help them to make the right decision.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_ELYENORA_000_940: Greetings, . Do you wish to proceed to your vessel?
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_QIB_TODO001: Defeat the enemy and rescue the Scions!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_QIB_TODO002: Defeat the enemy and escape from Castrum Centri!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: Unbind us, . Together we may yet win free.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_PAPALYMO_BATTLETALK: ! Get these shackles off us, quickly!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_IMPERIALSOLDIER_MAN: All units, to emergency stations! Do not let the prisoners escape!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: This infernal creation is shielded by energies not its own.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_PAPALYMO_BATTLETALK: Whatever is generating its shield must be near! Find it, !
Ack! There's no end to them!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: We labor in vain! Till the beast be divested of its shield, our blows shall not find their mark.
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_IMPERIALGUARD_MANFS: You're not getting away! Bring forth the colossus!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_BIGGS_BATTLETALK_11: What in the hells...? A new design!
TEXT_MANFST407_00521_PAPALYMO_BATTLETALK: So that's a colossus, is it!? More like a colossal waste of iron!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_MINFILIA_000_000: Grim tidings, . It seems that word of the Ultima Weapon's existence has already reached the Alliance leaders...in the form of an ultimatum. They have gathered in the Fragrant Chamber, and are deliberating their answer even as we speak.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_MINFILIA_000_001: Beleaguered as they are, I fear they may well elect to lay down their arms in the belief that surrender will spare their people untold suffering. Yet nothing could be further from the truth.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_MINFILIA_000_002: That which the Black Wolf offers will doom Eorzea, not deliver it, and the leaders must be made aware of this. Let us hurry to them, , and ensure that they do not act in ignorance of the consequences.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_BARTHOLOMEW_000_010: The council of the Alliance leaders is presently in progress in the Fragrant Chamber. I must ask that you step away from the doors, .
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_BARTHOLOMEW_000_011: ...I'm sorry? You're here on behalf of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn!? A thousand pardons, my ! Of course you may enter!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000010_RAUBAHN: Bah! We keep treading the same ground.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000040_RAUBAHN: I've never been one to shy from a fight. But if this weapon of theirs can do all they claim...
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000050_KANESENNA: It has been five years since the Calamity, and our people have scarce begun to rebuild their lives.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000060_KANESENNA: Can we now, in good conscience, call upon them to risk what little they have left? I would spare them the pain of further conflict.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000070_KANESENNA: Conflict, I say, though that would imply forces set in opposition. If the combined might of three primals could not stay Garlemald's new terror...
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000090_KANESENNA: What meaningful resistance can we offer? We who struggle to quell the foes who rise up within our own borders...
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000100_MERLWYB: Long have we fought the primals, but to what end? We strike them down at no small cost, only for them to rise again and again.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000110_MERLWYB: Are we to play this profitless game for the rest of days? I for one grow tired of it.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000120_MERLWYB: Mistake me not, I do not propose to trade one tyranny for another.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000130_MERLWYB: I love liberty. But conciliation need not mean oppression.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000140_RAUBAHN: By the Twelve... Though neither of you cried “surrender,” your every word betokened it.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000150_RAUBAHN: Not that I deny there is truth in what you say. Nor can I rightly claim that Ul'dah is ready to fight.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000160_RAUBAHN: Refugees flood our gates, and beastmen swarm our land, while the great and the good do nothing. My Flames struggle to bear the burden.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000170_RAUBAHN: I put on a grand show at the remembrance service, made all manner of lofty promises... I've made good on not a bloody one.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000180_NANAMOULNAMO: Do not blame yourself, Raubahn. You said only that which the people needed to hear. All present have done the same.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000190_NANAMOULNAMO: Our citizens had become lost to hope. If our words served to kindle it in them anew, better we speak than remain silent.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000200_NANAMOULNAMO: Our enemy condemns us for failing our people, yet what does he care for their well-being?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000210_NANAMOULNAMO: While we labored to rebuild their lives, the Black Wolf built instruments of murder with which to end them.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000220_KANESENNA: Her Majesty speaks true. For all our failings, the people's well-being has ever been our foremost priority.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000230_KANESENNA: While none among us ever doubted that the Empire would one day resume its war, we scarcely had means enough to solve the problems of the present.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000240_MERLWYB: Aye, which is why we looked to others to safeguard our future─
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000250_MERLWYB: The Scions of the Seventh Dawn. Alas, they are gone, and the Black Wolf is at our door.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000260_ALPHINAUD: Admiral, I fear you are mistaken!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000290_RAUBAHN: By Rhalgr... You're alive! All of you!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000300_ALPHINAUD: As we approached, I would swear I heard talk of surrender, but I know that cannot be! It is not the Eorzean way!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000310_MINFILIA: Hear me, my friends! Accepting the Garleans' offer to vanquish the primals would be folly.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000320_MINFILIA: Folly, I say, for might is not the answer to the primal threat. Indeed, the more the Empire exerts its strength, the worse matters will become.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000330_MINFILIA: Primals enter this world when mortals call upon them, and mortals are wont to appeal to a higher power when they are desperate.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000340_MINFILIA: Nothing is more certain to breed desperation in the beast tribes than the Garleans' proposed solution.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000350_ALPHINAUD: The true answer lies in a lasting peace, but the Garleans only know war and conquest. Should Eorzea fall into their hands, there will be such suffering as none can imagine.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000360_MINFILIA: We are not blind to the many challenges that each of your nations face. Yet you must not give in.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000370_ALPHINAUD: Aye! Remember five years ago, when you wagered all for the sake of the realm! Remember what you fought for, what you were willing to die for!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000380_ALPHINAUD: Let the memories rekindle the fire in your heart, for Eorzea has need of it again!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000390_MINFILIA: Come what may, we Scions will never give up the fight.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000400_MINFILIA: And so I bid you stand with us, and together we shall safeguard the future of the realm!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000410_CID: A great man once said that a shrewd merchant grasps not for the quick profit, but invests in the future. Wise words...eh, Raubahn?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000430_KANESENNA: Your words stir...and shame me in equal measure. How could I contemplate surrender...?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000440_KANESENNA: I know full well that all we have, we owe to the sacrifices of those who went before us. Yet the seeming hopelessness of our plight robbed me of my insight.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000450_KANESENNA: We Gridanians have no love for war...
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000460_KANESENNA: Yet we have still less for those who would threaten our homeland. Ever have we fought to protect those things we hold dear, and this shall never change.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000470_KANESENNA: Gridania will go to war. We will fight the Empire, for the sake of the realm and all who abide here!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000520_NANAMOULNAMO: At long last, I hear words worthy of a founder of the Alliance!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000530_NANAMOULNAMO: Raubahn! Are we to be outdone!?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000540_RAUBAHN: I lost one homeland. The thought of losing another had blunted my resolve.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000550_RAUBAHN: But no man knows better than I that if you want aught, you'd best be ready to die for it.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000560_RAUBAHN: With great danger comes the chance for great glory, and great profit─we Ul'dahns, who have turned sand into gold, know this well.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000570_RAUBAHN: How many times have we fallen into the pit of despair, only to have you pluck us out? I've fair lost count.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000580_MERLWYB: Reckless, the lot of you─like bloody pirates! Well, I won't waste my breath trying to talk you 'round...
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000590_MERLWYB: ...On account of being a pirate myself. And the pirate who shrinks from a challenge is no pirate at all!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000600_MERLWYB: Those who would pick a quarrel with us must choose: back down, or go down with all hands.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000610_MERLWYB: Let the Garleans come. The united strength of Limsa Lominsa will be waiting for them!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000620_NANAMOULNAMO: If our realm is to be free of this pall of darkness, let it be by our own hands!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000640_KANESENNA: We must needs consider how the weapon may be brought to bear against us.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000650_MERLWYB: The Maelstrom will secure strategic points along the coastline.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000660_RAUBAHN: In the meantime, the Flames will deploy at...
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000670_NANAMOULNAMO: Be at ease, my friends. You have banished our doubts.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_000680_NANAMOULNAMO: Pray leave the military matters to us, and retire to the Waking Sands. We will send word anon.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100690_MINFILIA: I cannot well express my relief. To think that the Alliance came so close to surrender...
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100700_CID: But the fire in their hearts has been rekindled, and they will fight to the last.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100710_ALPHINAUD: This warmth inside... Did you feel it too, Grandfather?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100720_ALPHINAUD: I would know something─was that your power at work earlier?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100730_MINFILIA: Nothing of the sort. The leaders of Eorzea had lost their way─I merely helped them to find it again.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100740_MINFILIA:
Oh, hello!
...Yes, our party returned just a moment ago. How close are you?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100760_ALPHINAUD: We must needs plan our next move. Pray continue liaising with your respective nations. Cid, would you be our man in Ul'dah?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100770_CID: I'll be whatever and wherever you need me to be!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100780_YSHTOLA: We haven't a moment to waste.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100800_MINFILIA: Thancred's fate weighs heavy on my mind. I cannot bear to think of him in thrall to an Ascian.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100810_MINFILIA: Mayhap you know this already, but the Ascians are immortal beings without physical form. Since time immemorial, they have fanned the flames of chaos from the shadows.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100820_MINFILIA: That they might work unseen, the Ascians entrap and possess mortal men by means of malign artifacts known as Crystals of Darkness.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100830_MINFILIA: One such Crystal may yet be the key to saving Thancred.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100840_ALPHINAUD: This is a Crystal of Darkness?
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100850_YSHTOLA: A mere replica, created using data obtained from anomalous crystals found across Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100860_MINFILIA: It comes to us courtesy of the Students of Baldesion, our distant allies.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100870_MINFILIA: Even for an Archon, Thancred's talents are exceptional. We all had complete confidence in him.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100880_MINFILIA: It was for this reason that none among us foresaw the danger in sending him to investigate the Ascians alone.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100890_PAPALYMO: Thancred had been striving to fill the void left by Louisoix. Yet it was plain that he was overtaxing himself.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100900_YDA: Yeah... He would volunteer for everything and work till he was dizzy.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100910_ALPHINAUD: And the toll taken by his exertions made him vulnerable to Ascian influence...
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100920_MINFILIA: The Crystal that binds Thancred must be somewhere on his person. If we could but destroy it, his Ascian possessor would be compelled to relinquish control over him.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100930_MINFILIA: You have proven the stoutest of allies, standing with us through thick and thin.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100940_MINFILIA: Yet the most perilous struggle is still to come. For the sake of the realm─and Thancred─I ask that you lend us your strength once more.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100950_MINFILIA: Thank you. From the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100960_MINFILIA: As I am sure you are aware, the realm was saved from certain doom five years ago by heroes known as the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100970_MINFILIA: What you may not be aware of is that your many feats in service to the Scions have prompted folk to make certain...comparisons.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100980_MINFILIA: I must confess, you do remind me of them.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_100990_MINFILIA: One can only wonder at their insight. Perhaps a touch of the Echo resides in everyone.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_101000_MINFILIA: Yet remember this: however glorious the past, it is the hero's lot to be judged on the deeds of the present.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_101010_MINFILIA: A new darkness threatens the realm, and the people cry out for a savior.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_101020_MINFILIA: I believe that you are ─a Warrior of Light, here in the present, guided by the Crystal's will.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_101030_MINFILIA: Come, my friends! Let us fight to safeguard the future of our beloved Eorzea!
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_MINFILIA_000_030: I meant to ask you. Are you, perchance, in possession of your own chocobo? I would be remiss to send you into a battle of this scale without a mount.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_MINFILIA_000_031: If you do not, I would encourage you to procure one from your Grand Company as soon as you are able. I can guarantee you that it will serve you well to have your own steed.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_SISTEM_000_032: In order to undertake the next main scenario quest, you must first complete the quest “My Little Chocobo ().”
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_SISTEM_000_040: You may accept the quest “My Little Chocobo ()” by speaking with .
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_SYSTEM_000_041: Furthermore, to better prepare for the impending struggle with the Empire, it is recommended that you first unlock a job and gain access to more powerful actions.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_SYSTEM_000_042: This can be done by completing the level 30 quest of the associated class, and then undertaking the quests for the job by speaking with a nearby NPC.
TEXT_MANFST408_00522_SYSTEM_000_043: To better prepare for the impending struggle with the Empire, it is recommended that you first unlock a job and gain access to more powerful actions.
