TEXT_MANFST408_00522_ELYENORA_050_100: Greetings, . Do you wish to proceed to your vessel?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_1: Listen well, . This will take some time to explain.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_10: I've prepared these letters for my counterparts in the Eorzean Alliance.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_11: Five years ago, we looked on, powerless, as our brothers and sisters were taken from us at Carteneau─first by the Garleans, and then by the thrice-damned primal called forth by their treachery.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_12: Not a day goes by that I do not think of my fallen comrades...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_13: ...And of the Warriors of Light, of whom no trace remained.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_14: The tragedies of the Calamity are not so easily forgotten─nor should they be. In remembering all we've lost, we're reminded of what we still have.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_15: And so I mean to mark the fifth anniversary of the Battle of Carteneau with a memorial service honoring the fallen.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_16: It is my hope that my counterparts in the Alliance will agree to do the same.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_17: And I would have you bear my words to them as my personal envoy.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_18: Why you? Because your deeds mark you out as the nearest thing I have to a Warrior of Light. I can think of none more worthy of the role. The question is: will you accept it?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_20: You will journey to Gridania and Limsa Lominsa as my official representative.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_21: Now, that's a great many malms to travel, but I've neither the time nor patience to wait around while you do it on foot.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_22: I hereby grant you permission to use the airship routes connecting the three city-states. This pass serves as proof of your privilege.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_23: Gone are the days when airship travel was available to all.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_24: The ever-present threat of imperial attack has forced us to impose drastic restrictions out of concern for public safety.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_25: These passes are only granted when circumstance demands it─as in this case.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_26: Though there were others who insisted you be granted one regardless.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_27: Aye, , I am not alone in seeing it...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_29: But I have said enough. In the name of the sultana, I bid you go forth.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_30: See for yourself the wonders of the realm for which the Warriors of Light risked all. Rise to your calling and fulfill your promise.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_31: And should your path be barred by man or beast, strike fast and true, for victory belongs to the bold.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_32: Now go, , and heed the Crystal's guidance should you ever lose your way.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_RAUBAHN_000_35: See that those letters reach the Admiral and the Elder Seedseer, . I would have all of Eorzea remember the fallen.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_40: Ah! Back from your meetin' with Raubahn, are you? What did the big man have to say?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_42: Personal envoy of the Flame General himself!
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_43: So you'll be bearin' the great man's words to the leaders of the Alliance, will you? And by airship! Bugger me...that's an honor and half, that is.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_44: ...But I can't think of anyone who deserves it more.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_45: I'm proud of you, . I truly am.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_46: Now, I daresay Raubahn told you this, but not many people get to go on airships, these days. In fact, most folk go to their graves havin' never once seen Eorzea from above...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_47: Poor buggers shuffle off to meet Thal havin' never known the blues of Limsa Lominsa's shimmerin' seas, or the myriad greens of leafy Gridania...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_48: But not you, . You'll see those sights and more, and everywhere you go, you'll find fascinatin' folk with fascinatin' tales to tell.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_49: The people you meet, the places you go─savor these experiences...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_51: Sayin' that, it'd be remiss of me if I didn't remind you to be careful out there.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_52: Ul'dah ain't the only place beset by troubles, as you'll discover when you visit Limsa and Gridania.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_53: Truth be told, that might well be exactly what the General wants you to realize. I think he knows what kind of  you are, .
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_54: And what kind's that, you ask? Why, the kind that can't resist stickin'  nose in other people's business, of course─and don't you ever go changin'!
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_55: Safe travels, ! I'll see you when you get back.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ELYENORA_000_60: Greetings, . This is the reservation counter for passengers traveling to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ELYENORA_000_61: If I'm not mistaken, you are the Flame General's envoy, , yes? Highwind Skyways is at your service. Will you be flying with us today?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ELYENORA_000_62: Should you change your mind, you need only speak to me, and I will see to it that you are assigned a place on the next airship.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_CABINCREW_000_65: Do you wish to leave the landing area?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_CABINCREW_000_66: We hope you have a pleasant voyage.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ELYENORA_000_70: The airship bound for Limsa Lominsa will be departing shortly. Are you ready to board, ?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ELYENORA_000_71: Thank you using Highwind Skyways. The airship bound for Gridania will be departing shortly.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ELYENORA_000_72: Very well. When you are ready to board, please let me know.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ANNOUNCE_000_80: Attention, all passengers: the airship bound for Limsa Lominsa is about to depart. Please make your way to the boarding gate.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_NANAMOULNAMO_100_80: When first we met beneath the Sultantree, I sensed there was something unusual about . I wonder if they will feel the same...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_82: If I'm right, they'll be singin' your praises from here to the Farreach before long.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MOMODI_000_83: May you always walk in the light of the Crystal...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_CABINCREW_000_85: Ah, you must be the envoy from Ul'dah! Welcome to Limsa Lominsa, . Admiral Bloefhiswyn awaits your arrival.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_CABINCREW_000_86: Please let me know if you require any assistance.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_STORMA_000_90: You are the Ul'dahn envoy? Welcome to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_STORMA_000_91: The Admiral has been looking forward to your arrival.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_STORMA_000_92: Please proceed to the Crow's Lift at your earliest convenience. It will take you to Bulwark Hall.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_STORMA_000_93: Once there, pray speak with Zanthael. He will be pleased to show you in to the Admiral's command room on the Bridge.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_STORMA_000_95: Pray speak with Zanthael in Bulwark Hall. He will be pleased to show you in to the Admiral's command room on the Bridge.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ZANTHAEL_000_100: Greetings, , and welcome to our fair city. If you would permit me to examine the seal on the missive you carry...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_ZANTHAEL_000_101: Yes, everything seems to be in order. My apologies. We cannot afford to be complacent, you understand. Please, step this way.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_700020_MERLWYB: So the silver-tongued merchants send an adventurer to speak for them. It appears the Ul'dahns place great faith in you.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_700050_MERLWYB: I am Merlwyb Bloefhiswyn, Admiral of Limsa Lominsa, and commander of the Maelstrom.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_700070_MERLWYB: Before you begin, I would know your name.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_700080_MERLWYB: Strange. I would readily have sworn that I knew you, but it seems I was mistaken.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_700090_MERLWYB: If I cannot well recall the faces of my friends, I must trust in my ability to remember the faces of my enemies. Woe betide the Admiral who fails in that!
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_700100_MERLWYB: But I jest. Please, do continue.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_110: Hm. A memorial service to honor the fallen.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_111: Seven hells... Has it been five years?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_112: Five years since the Garlean Empire sought to wrest Eorzea from our grasp...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_113: It was in answer to the imperial threat that the city-states formed the Grand Companies, and forged the Eorzean Alliance anew. But Garlemald was not content to wager all on a simple contest of martial might. They had other plans─the Meteor project.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_114: Legatus Nael van Darnus─hells take him─intended to “cleanse” our realm by snatching the lesser moon, Dalamud, from the heavens and casting it down upon our heads. Desperate to prevent this lunatic scheme, we marched our forces to the Carteneau Flats and there met the VIIth Imperial Legion in battle.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_115: Never have I seen a fight like the Battle of Carteneau─and I have seen full many.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_116: But though we gave no quarter, spared not one onze of effort...we could not prevent what followed.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_117: From inside the shell of Dalamud came a winged nightmare─a dragon the size of a bloody city. 'Twas the elder primal Bahamut, bent on making an eighth hell of Eorzea.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_118: In the space of a breath, the legions of the Empire were set aflame, while our own armies fared little better. 'Twas as if the whole world was burning... Words cannot well describe the scene.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_119: And yet...by some miracle, a few among us were spared.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_120: Even as I steeled myself for death, a blinding white light enveloped me, robbing me of my senses.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_121: When I regained them, the dragon was gone, and the still-smoldering land was warped beyond all knowing.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_122: Were Archon Louisoix still with us, he would doubtless shed some light on these unfathomable happenings. Alas, he is not, and I fear we will want for his wisdom in the days to come.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_123: For while our nations struggle to recover from the devastation, the beastmen call forth their damned primals to torment us anew.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_124: Unless we put aside our differences and rebuild now, our foes will catch us unprepared.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_125: And I speak not only of the beastmen. Do not imagine that the Empire has forsaken its claim on Eorzea. The imperials crowd our borders, waiting to strike.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_126: Damn it all, we need champions to replace those we lost...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_127: But such thoughts are worse than worthless. Time is short, and none will save us, save ourselves. It is the duty of every soul who survived the Calamity to work together for the good of Eorzea...and this memorial service may be the very thing to unite us.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_128: Aye, Raubahn has the right of it. I accept his proposal.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_129: Your duty is done here, adventurer─I will see to it that the Flame General receives my reply.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_130: You travel next to Gridania, yes?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_131: Pray give my regards to the Elder Seedseer. Oh, and tell her the wolf has been sniffing around the stables. A private jest─and one in poor taste─but I would have you tell it all the same.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MERLWYB_000_132: Fare you well, . May the Navigator guide you on your journey.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_LNOPHLO_000_140: Greetings, . This is the counter for passengers traveling to Gridania.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_LNOPHLO_000_141: A pleasure to serve you again, . Are you ready to board the airship to Gridania?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_LNOPHLO_000_145: Very well, . I'll be glad to assist you when you're ready.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_LNOPHLO_000_146: Do you wish to leave the landing area?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_CABINCREW_100_146: We hope you have a pleasant voyage.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_LNOPHLO_000_147: Are you ready to depart, ? The airship bound for Gridania will be leaving shortly.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_LNOPHLO_100_147: Very well, . I'll be glad to assist you when you're ready.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_CABINCREW_000_150: Ah, you must be the envoy from Ul'dah! Welcome to Gridania, . The Elder Seedseer awaits your arrival.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_CABINCREW_000_151: Please let me know if you require any assistance.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_SERPENT_000_161: You are the Ul'dahn envoy, are you not? I have received instructions to assist you.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_SERPENT_000_162: Pray make your way into the city proper, and identify yourself to the conjurer at Nophica's Altar. She will admit you to the Lotus Stand, where the Elder Seedseer awaits.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_SERPENT_000_165: Pray make your way into the city proper, and identify yourself to the conjurer at Nophica's Altar. She will admit you to the Lotus Stand, where the Elder Seedseer awaits.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MONK_000_170: You are the Ul'dahn envoy? Begging your pardons, , but might I inspect the missive you bear?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_MONK_000_171: Verily, this is the seal of the supreme commander of the Immortal Flames. Please come with me.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_900110_KANESENNA: So you are the Ul'dahn envoy.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_900120_KANESENNA: On behalf of our fair nation, I bid you welcome.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_900150_KANESENNA: I am Kan-E-Senna, Elder Seedseer of Gridania, and leader of the Order of the Twin Adder, our nation's Grand Company.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_900160_KANESENNA: I understand you bear a message from the Flame General.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_900170_KANESENNA: But...before you begin, might I behold your face more closely?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_900180_KANESENNA: My apologies. It is just that you put me in mind of someone I once knew─a brave and noble soul.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_900190_KANESENNA: But come, let us return to the matter at hand.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_180: A remembrance service for the fallen of Carteneau...
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_181: Pray tell me, adventurer─what do you know of our conflict with the Empire?
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_182: It would seem my counterparts recounted the tale in some detail. That is well.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_183: Hm? A message from the Admiral? ...A wolf has been sniffing around her stables, you say? I see. Well, I shall be pleased to provide her with such counsel as I am able.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_184: But first, friend of my friend, I would tell you more of the Garlean threat.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_185: For the greater part of its history, Garlemald was not even among the most influential nations in Ilsabard, the northern continent. However, its innovations in the field of magitek, some fifty years past, helped to raise it from the depths of obscurity.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_186: Emboldened by this technology, it set about subjugating its neighbors, swiftly absorbing each into its ever-expanding territory. And when all of Ilsabard lay within its grasp, it turned its ravenous gaze upon Eorzea.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_187: Yet Garlemald's transformation did not come about by virtue of magitek alone. Its success owed much to the consummate leadership of its first and reigning emperor.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_188: Solus zos Galvus─the man who built an empire in his own lifetime. Yet he has lived long, and after more than four score winters, it is said that he grows frail, and ever more prone to illness.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_189: If rumors are to be believed, the matter of succession has destabilized the imperial court. This would explain the Empire's relative inactivity in recent years, which has granted us much-needed time to rebuild.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_190: Yet we cannot allow ourselves to become complacent, for Garlemald still maintains a presence in Eorzea, in the form of the XIVth Imperial Legion.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_191: Commanding this great host is Legatus Gaius van Baelsar, a man whose ambitions are well known to us. So long as he breathes Eorzean air, none of us may sleep easy.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_192: The Calamity wreaked such devastation upon the realm that it has been all we could do to nurse our wounds, never mind rebuild our defenses. Simply put, we have not the strength to repel the Empire.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_193: To add to our woes, the beast tribes continue to summon their primals, whose very existence is a bane upon the land.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_194: Each nation is beset with its own primal problem; none has the resources to look beyond its own borders.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_195: The Admiral desires my counsel regarding a brazen wolf.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_196: She means to tell me that the Empire may soon resume its advance.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_197: Though the primals pose an undeniable threat to our survival, the threat posed by the Garleans is greater still. Clearly, each nation can no longer afford to think only of that which occurs within its own borders.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_198: A storm gathers upon the horizon. If we are to weather it, we must needs stand united once more. A remembrance service may help to rekindle the spirit of unity which brought the peoples of Eorzea together when last the Empire threatened our liberty.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_199: The Flame General was wise to make his proposal, and I wholeheartedly approve of it. The necessary provisions shall be made for a service here in Gridania.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_200: Your work here is done, my friend. I shall send my reply to the Flame General forthwith.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_KANESENNA_000_201: I thank you for coming. May the Twelve see you safely home.
TEXT_MANWIL200_00528_SYSTEM_000_300: You may now make use of the airship routes connecting the three nations. Before you may board an airship, you must pay the requisite fare in gil.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_1: Ah, . That aura of confidence tells me you've not been idle since last we met.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_2: I hope I've read you aright, for I've a task that requires the attention of a capable adventurer. Might that adventurer be you?
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_10: Good to hear. Then I shall lay before you the sorry tale.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_11: You will have heard rumors of the abductions. Aye, citizens have been disappearin' from every corner of Limsa Lominsa, as if plucked from the face of Hydaelyn, boots and all, by an unseen hand.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_12: And what's this got to do with Summerford Farms, you might ask. Well, that remains to be seen, but it seems a collection of right unsavory fellows with azure-tattooed faces has been creepin' up to the edges of the fields and spyin' on my yeomen.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_13: Now, I doubt anyone would enjoy bein' scrutinized by such savages at the best of times, but the farmhands are convinced that they're the kidnappers of rumor, come for their hides.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_14: Needless to say, they're beside 'emselves with worry, and their work's sufferin' for it─which is the very last thing I need when my old crewmen are still gettin' used to their new jobs. 'Tis a struggle to get 'em to leave the farmhouse of a mornin'.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_15: That is, as they say, where you come in. Would you be willin' to investigate these tattooed thugs for me?
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_16: Good . The sooner we get to the bottom of this, the sooner this place will start to resemble a workin' farm again.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_17: I suggest you begin by havin' a look around Seasong Grotto. If reports are to be believed, our unwelcome visitors have occupied the place.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_18: Be careful, though, ─I couldn't say for sure what manner of miscreants we're dealin' with here. If they are the kidnappers...well, just be on your guard, all right?
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_SYSTEM_000_30: You are about to enter an instanced battle. Instanced battles only occur during certain quests and missions.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_SYSTEM_000_31: Take a moment to read the information displayed in the active help window before answering the call of duty.

TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000010_YSHTOLA:
(-???-)I am the waves that bear.
I am the winds that guide.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000020_YSHTOLA:
(-???-)I am the evening stars.
I am the morning sky.
I am born of the sea.
And there shall I die.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000030_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Thus reads the Sailors' Requiem carved into yonder stone.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000040_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Such words well describe the manner in which the citizens of Limsa Lominsa live their lives.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000050_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)It is both a litany against misfortune for those out on the waves...
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000060_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)...and a prayer that the souls of those who perish on land might find their way back to the sea.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000080_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Or do we? My apologies, I fear I have mistaken you for another.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000090_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Something about you... Your gait, perhaps? Well, no matter.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000100_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)What brings you to this sacred place of seafarers, if I may ask?
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000110_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Ah, you are the adventurer I've seen around Summerford Farms.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000120_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)I thought myself on the trail of the kidnappers, but it would seem I have missed my mark.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000140_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000150_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Nor is it a coincidence that the two of us should come here in search of those responsible for the disappearances only to be attacked.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000160_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)But who stands to benefit from the keeping of this secret?
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_000170_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Such thoughts must wait. Let us attend to the task at hand, unpleasant though it be.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: I sense something awry with this creature. Be on your guard.
Ware! The disruption of the aether draws others to the fray!

Keep your focus on the battle!
Leave the tending of wounds to me.

More unwelcome visitors?
Slay them quickly lest we be overwhelmed.

The creature falters.
Press the attack and the battle will soon be won.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300210_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Aha. The poor creature's fury was kindled with cruel forethought.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300220_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)See this blade? I found it in the goobbue's back.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300230_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)I have seen knives of this kind before─they are most commonly used for the cutting of rope.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300240_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)It would appear our culprits are seafaring men of some persuasion...piratical being the most probable.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300250_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)In any event, you seem much recovered from your sudden...affliction.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300260_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)I confess, I was rather taken aback when you collapsed at the very moment of our victory. Mayhap a surfeit of aether...?
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300270_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)I beg your pardon? A “towering crystal”? I'm sure I don't─ Oh.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300280_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)Well, well... This has been a day of unexpected revelations.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300300_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)In the meantime, I suggest you deliver this knife to your patron, along with a warning concerning the pirates' probable involvement in this murky business.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300310_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)The days ahead promise little rest, I fear...
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_300320_YSHTOLA: (-Cultured Conjurer-)May our paths cross again under the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_30: ! Right glad am I to see you safely returned!
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_31: My lads were all gabbin' about hearin' what sounded like all seven hells breakin' loose near the grotto, and I feared I'd sent you to your death.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_32: If you were in the middle of that commotion, I hope it yielded somethin' of interest. I'd hate to think you'd risked your life for naught.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_40: Hmmm... A blade pulled from the back of a creature you slew at the cave, eh?
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_41: Aye, I'd agree that such a knife would be part of any seafarin' man's kit.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_42: I'm startin' to think that these ruffians are pirates, come to lure my farmhands back to a life of plunder. Chances are, they didn't take kindly to your appearance on their doorstep, and set a maddened goobbue on you.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_43: Aye, the pirates have been addin' to their numbers of late. I'd best warn the lads and lasses in my employ to be on guard against their schemes.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_44: ...Hm? You met someone else at the grotto? A woman with a strange contraption...? Ah...Y'shtola!
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_45: She's been in Limsa Lominsa for a good while now. Her studies of the aether often bring her out to Summerford, so her presence at the grotto is hardly unusual.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_46: She's an odd-lookin' lass, I grant you, but she's not the kind to associate with kidnappers. You may take my word for that.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_47: Where trust should be lackin' is in those yeomen of mine who have yet to wholly relinquish their pirate pasts. The temptation to return to the free and easy life of a buccaneer may prove too strong to resist.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_48: You have my thanks, . If it weren't for the efforts of stalwart adventurers like yourself, this farm would be in a far worse state than it is.
TEXT_MANSEA005_00543_STAELWYRN_000_49: Just you keep on lendin' your talents to those in need, eh? Help bring Limsa the brighter future she deserves.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_050_1: Good to 'ave ye aboard, . Now then...where to start?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_1: Back when I was younger an' nastier, I earned me livin' as a sellsword. In that business, if ye wanted to know what yer enemy was up to, you 'ad to learn to read the orders ye prised from the cold dead 'ands of 'is mates. That's 'ow I came to know 'ow to read yer message.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_2: Truth be told, the script was only too bloody familiar. Them's Sahagin letters, . An' I should know─I've gutted more fishback messengers than I can count.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_3: It gets worse, though... The plan to blow up the Victory is all in 'ere, right down to the fine details.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_4: Looks like they meant to raise eight kinds of 'ell in western La Noscea, then 'it the Maelstrom's new flagship in the confusion.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_5: The point bein', the attack on the Victory weren't the act of a few rebellious pirates─'twas a key part o' some canny bastard's grand plan.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_6: But if I'm readin' this aright, the attack itself came much too early. I'll wager they panicked when they saw ye was on to 'em, rushed in to do the job, an' buggered it up.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_7: Hmmm... Them tattoo-faced bastards as they say was payin' Ahtbyrm's old man, they're with the Serpent Reavers, right? ...But none o' their crew was there, was they? Did they 'ave summat better to do, or what?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_8: ...Seven 'ells! I've got it all backwards! That mess at the Victory─that was meant to be the bloody distraction!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_9: The fishbacks ain't interested in the Maelstrom's baby! They're after men, just like they've always been. They're sendin' their pirate lackeys after a civilian target.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_10: This bit about raisin' 'ell in western La Noscea...that's where it'll be. Summat tells me Swiftperch is about to get 'it, an' 'it 'ard!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_11: 'Ere's a rough translation o' the message.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_12: Take it to Commodore Reyner at the Coral Tower, an' tell 'im 'e's in fer a busy day.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BADERON_000_13: Oh, an' give 'im an 'and, eh? Ye can be damn sure 'e'll need one.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_20: Yes, I am Reyner. Ah, you must be the adventurer whose name seems to be on everyone's lips.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_21: You are to be commended for your part in thwarting the plot to destroy the Victory. Now, what can I do for you this day?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_22: You bear an urgent message from Baderon? Why do I get the feeling that my hopes for a quiet  are about to be cruelly dashed? Tell me, what is afoot?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_30: An assault on Swiftperch!? But we've seen nothing to suggest the Serpent Reavers are massing for an attack.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_31: Even so, it would be foolish to discount the possibility─Baderon is rarely wrong about such matters.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_32: I will marshal the Yellowjackets for battle immediately.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_33: The only question is where to send them. While I concur with Baderon's assessment that the attack on the Drydocks was intended as a diversion, Swiftperch is but one of several possible targets for the main thrust.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YELLOWJACKET_000_36: It's the Sahagin, sir! They've mounted a large-scale assault on South Tidegate, and threaten to overwhelm our defenses within the day. The garrison requests immediate reinforcements.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_37: By the Navigator... It seems my decision has been made for me.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_38: Muster the troops and give the order to march.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_39: Aye, the Serpent Reavers are in league with the Sahagin.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_40: ...Which means there is every chance this assault on Tidegate may yet prove to be another feint. The fact remains, however, that we can ill afford to ignore it. And that leaves Swiftperch vulnerable to those pirate traitors.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_41: It is at times such as these that I wish the Warriors of Light yet walked among us. But wishes will avail us naught. , you must serve in their absence. Make for Swiftperch with all haste and lend your strength to the squads I can spare for the settlement's defense.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_45: Commodore Reyner sent word we'd be getting reinforcements, but I didn't expect him to send you! You certainly look like you've seen your share of action, though─you bear little resemblance to the wide-eyed whelp I met fresh off the ferry.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_46: In any case, do you know what you're fighting for here? This place─Swiftperch─it was rebuilt by folk who stood strong in the face of every hardship the Calamity threw their way.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_47: And we're not about to let some fish-fancying scum claim the honor of being the ones who finally broke their spirits. Don't give those pirate bastards one bloody ilm, you hear me?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_Q1_000_1:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“Feint and Strike”?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_DECKMAN_000_51: 'Ere now, I thought all them Yellowjacket worms was meant to be busy. That useless scrag ain't followed the plan, 'as 'e?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_HELMSMAN_000_52: Now what? Pull back and wait for our Sahagin brothers?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BAENRYSS_000_53: Piss on that! We ain't turnin' back empty-handed!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BAENRYSS_000_54: Remember, no killin' the smallfolk, or it'll be your blood what stains Lord Leviathan's altars!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BAENRYSS_000_55: The Yellowbellies ye can butcher at will! Them dirt-eatin' slugs'll be crushed under the full might o' the Serpent Reavers!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_56: Seems Swiftperch was the main target after all, eh?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_57: Squads One and Two, protect the townsfolk! Squad Three, you're our rear guard!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_58: The rest of you─we meet their charge where we stand! Let us bear the commodore word of our victory, or no word at all!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_BAENRYSS_000_59: Rargh! I'll gut all you Yellowbellies an' dance on yer gizzards!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_70: Well fought─the Reavers are beaten and scattered.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_71: I'll take some men and hunt down the stragglers. Oh, but there may be more of them lurking about, so don't let your guard down just yet.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_MASKEDMAGUS_000_72: The source of  strength becomes clear...
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_MASKEDMAGUS_000_73: You may have bested the golem, but you will not fare so well this day.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_MASKEDMAGUS_000_74: O mournful voice of creation! Send unto me a creature of the abyss, my thrall to command, that I may smite mine enemies!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_MASKEDMAGUS_000_75: Your very being imperils the plan. You cannot be suffered to live.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_MASKEDMAGUS_000_80: Unnngh... That the wisdom of the Paragons should be brought low...by mere mortals...
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_81: “Paragons,” did he say? Then it is as I feared.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_82: They are known as the Bringers of Chaos...or Ascians, to give them their proper name.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_83: It would seem our suspicions were correct─it is they who have been manipulating the beast tribes.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_84:
Pardon? You would know if we Sharlayans have encountered Ascians before?
...I have never spoken to you of my homeland. How did you know whence I hail?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_85: Wait. I do begin to see. You have been blessed with a special gift.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_86: Are you all right, !? If I'd known a mean bugger like that was hiding in the bushes, I would've left a squad or six to keep you company.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_87: Well, at least now we can call this kidnapping investigation to a close. Those Reavers were the ones spiriting folk away in the dead of night, and this bastard here was pulling all the strings.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_88: A trifle simplistic, but not inaccurate.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_89: I came as soon as I sensed his presence, but I never thought to find such a scene of carnage. Yet we prevailed. And thanks to your heroic actions, I have learned much.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_90: Aye, “heroic” is the word. I don't want to think about what would've happened if you hadn't been here, friend.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_RYSSFLOH_000_91: And your assistance is much appreciated, too, Lady Y'shtola. Please give our regards to the Scions.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_92: I am glad to have played a role in bringing what I hope is an end to this disturbing spate of abductions.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_93: The thread of your fate forms a part of a most intriguing tapestry. Mayhap we will be afforded the chance to speak more in the near future.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YSHTOLA_000_94: For now, however, you must see this particular tale to its conclusion. Pray send my greetings to Commodore Reyner.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_GLAZRAEL_000_97: Feint after bloody feint! Those pirates are getting too damn clever by half!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YELLOWJACKETA_000_9: You've come to aid with the defense? Then well met, and well come!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_YELLOWJACKETB_000_9: Come on, you gutless bastards! Let's see how you fare against trained soldiers!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_100: , eagerly have I awaited your return!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_101: Word of your exploits is already spreading through the ranks. My troops and I owe you a great debt of gratitude for your timely assistance.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_102: You have shown yourself to be possessed of a sure arm, a strong spirit, and sound judgment. Would that Limsa Lominsa had more of your like.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_103: I have little doubt that you shall one day join the ranks of Eorzea's greatest adventurers. It is but a matter of time.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_104: Clearly, Baderon's eye for potential remains as sharp as ever, though I doubt even he imagined you capable of such feats.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_105: Might you favor me with your own account of the day's events? Such victories bear retelling!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_110: Y'shtola has been working with us for quite some time, you see.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_111: And she was only too willing to assist the Yellowjackets in the kidnapping investigation, proving herself a stalwart ally of Limsa Lominsa yet again.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_112: Needless to say, after your part in thwarting the attempted sabotage of the Victory, and the small matter of your deeds at Swiftperch, you too have proven yourself a valued friend of the thalassocracy.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_REYNER_000_204: May I present to you Admiral Bloefhiswyn.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400010_MERLWYB: So this is the adventurer I've been reading about in the field reports.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400020_MERLWYB: You seem familiar. Have we met? Mayhap at a medal presentation or some such?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400030_MERLWYB: No? Have you kin in the Maelstrom?
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400040_MERLWYB: I'll be sworn I─ But it is of little matter. To business.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400050_MERLWYB: I am Merlwyb Bloefhiswyn, Admiral of Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400060_MERLWYB: On behalf of my people, I bid you thanks for the deeds you have done this day.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400070_MERLWYB: A token of our gratitude. What worth is high regard without just reward, after all? Ha!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400080_MERLWYB: Since you first set foot in our city, my good friend Baderon and Commodore Reyner have taken turns at regaling me with tales of your exploits.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400090_MERLWYB: Safe to say, they left an impression. Join me at the coming banquet.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400100_MERLWYB: A seat of honor at the celebratory feast is the least I can offer the  who foiled the Sahagin.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_400140_MERLWYB: Your fellow guests will be eager to take the measure of their newest hero, and some do not take kindly to being kept waiting. Till then, may you walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_RYSSFLOH_01: Leave no pirate scum standing! Show 'em how a Yellowjacket fights!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_GLAZRAEL_01: Bwahaha! Time to split some heads, adventurer! Let's start with the frontline fodder!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_RYSSFLOH_REACT_: Is that a bloody voidsent!? Hold steady, lads!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_RYSSFLOH_02: More of the bastards!? Come on, then!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_BOSS_01: All right, ye scurvy bastards... Here's a trick to make ye soil yer breeches!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_BOSS_02: Dweller o' the Abyss, yer master calls! Heed me words an' smite me foes!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_GLAZRAEL_BOSS_H: Keep on pummeling him! He can't take much more of this!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_MASKEDMAGUS_STA: Soon, you shall take your vile gifts to the grave!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_MASKEDMAGUS_POI: Mwahahaha! Writhe as the venom eats its way through your veins!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_MASKEDMAGUS_01: An unwelcome guest. No matter, all shall fall before me!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_YSHTOLA_ENTER: A fearsome opponent...against whom you shall not stand alone!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_MASKEDMAGUS_HP4: No mortal should possess such strength!
TEXT_MANSEA007_00544_QIB_YSHTOLA_MASKEDM: His power wanes! Afford him no chance to recover!
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_1: Yer ready, then, are ye? Good. The banquet'll be startin' soon. If ye'd waited any longer, I'd've considered it me civic duty to 'it ye over the 'ead an' drag ye there.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_2: Now, make sure yer wearin' them fancy shoes when ye turn up, all right? Carryin' 'em won't do no good. They're meant to make ye look like a , remember, not a 's bleedin' lackey.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_3: As fer directions, the feast's bein' 'eld on the Bridge, in the Admiral's briefin' room.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_4: Speak with Zanthael in Bulwark Hall, an' 'e'll show ye the way.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_5: Just keep that 'ead 'eld 'igh, . After everythin' ye've done fer Limsa, ye've good reason to be proud─an' don't let no 'ighborn bugger tell ye different.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_ZANTHAEL_000_10: Dress shoes... Fancy dress shoes. An adventurer wearing fancy dress shoes...
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_ZANTHAEL_000_11: Godsdammit, Baderon, why could you not have told me this mysterious guest's name, or their hair color, or even their bloody gender!? I'd have settled for a distinctive facial scar! I know nothing about shoes, much less fancy─ What? You say you're the adventurer I'm looking for?
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_ZANTHAEL_000_12: Then where are these “fancy dress shoes” that Baderon described to me in such excruciatingly unhelpful detail? Surely you didn't...? Ahem. He mentioned that if you were so careless as to misplace them, I was supposed to tell you to “get your arse back to J'nasshym, and beg fer another pair.” I never imagined I'd actually have to say it, though...
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_ZANTHAEL_000_13: Oh! Now those are some fancy dress shoes. Come, adventurer, I will show you to the briefing room.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000010_MERLWYB: Brothers and sisters of the sea!
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000020_MERLWYB: Join me now in honoring this  for  services to our great nation!
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000030_MERLWYB: May the Navigator guide and protect  on  journey till sea swallows all!
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000040_MERLWYB: These pirates you encountered with the tattooed faces... They call themselves the “Serpent Reavers.” Their ranks are formed of cutthroats and madmen who have pledged themselves body and soul to the primal Leviathan.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000050_MERLWYB: From what we have gathered, they sought to swell their numbers by spiriting away any soul unfortunate enough to cross their path.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000060_MERLWYB: I need not tell you the depth of the animosity between us and the Sahagin. How any seaman worth his salt could devote himself to the fishbacks' god is a question for a more temperate mind than mine.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000070_MERLWYB: But thanks to you, our citizens may once more go about their daily lives, safe in the knowledge that they will not be dragged into the darkness by those execrable curs.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000090_YSHTOLA: This...is one of the Crystals of Light.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000110_YSHTOLA: After our encounter with the goobbue, you had a vision, did you not? Of a towering crystal?
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000130_MERLWYB: Y'shtola's conclusion is clear, and I see no reason to doubt it. You are the vessel of a higher power.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000140_MERLWYB: This...being from your vision was the Mothercrystal. Your description matches what little we know of Her.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000150_MERLWYB: And if She has chosen you, then your deeds may yet shape the fate of nations.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000160_MERLWYB: As once did the deeds of the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000170_MERLWYB: Know you the tale? Like you, they were not of these lands, yet they fought to protect us all 'gainst the corruption of the primals.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000180_MERLWYB: When the Garlean Empire began its conquest of the realm, these heroes joined the Grand Companies, and helped reforge the Eorzean Alliance.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000190_MERLWYB: And at the Battle of Carteneau, they took the field beneath our banners, to fight for everything we hold dear.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000200_MERLWYB: It was on that day, in the midst of that hell...that we lost them.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000210_MERLWYB: Every soul who survived that battle will never forget how it was to fight beside them. We are proud to call them our comrades.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000220_MERLWYB: Yet, whenever we try to shout their names, the sound dies in our throats.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000230_MERLWYB: And whenever we strain to see their faces with our mind's eye, naught but their shadows appear to us, set against a blinding light.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000240_MERLWYB: Ask any true Eorzean who knew them, and the story will be the same. It is for this reason that we call them “the Warriors of Light.”
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000250_MERLWYB: When I look upon you, I cannot help but be reminded of them.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000270_MERLWYB: In time, I believe the Mothercrystal will make clear Her reasons for bestowing it upon you.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_000280_MERLWYB: Heed well Her words, adventurer. For it is Hydaelyn Herself who speaks.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_30: Mornin', sunshine. All a bit much fer ye, was it?
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_32: Ye keeled over in the middle o' the banquet, an' caused a right stir. 'Ad to carry ye back to the Wench meself. Well, I say “carry”...'twas more a matter o' draggin' an' rollin'. Too much cake, I reckon.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_33: Anyroad, don't fret─'tis little wonder ye was exhausted after everythin' ye've been through lately.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_34: Yer little nap seems to 'ave put some color back in yer cheeks, though, so I'll leave ye to it.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_35: ...Bugger! I almost forgot: the Admiral wants to 'ave a word with ye.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_BADERON_000_36: When ye feel up to it, talk to Zanthael an' 'e'll let ye in to the command room. Oh, an' stay awake, eh? I'm told ol' Merlwyb was in the middle o' tellin' ye a story when ye started snorin' last time, an' I doubt she'd look kindly on it if ye repeated the trick!
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_ZANTHAEL_000_40: Greetings, . Admiral Bloefhiswyn awaits you in the command room. Shall I announce you?
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_ZANTHAEL_000_41: Still not recovered from your...er...sudden illness? I find a brisk walk along the waterfront always helps to blow away the cobwebs. The smell down there could wake the dead...
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_MERLWYB_000_50: Ah, , it is good to see you on your feet again. You are recovered?
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_MERLWYB_000_51: Then let us waste no time. I have a task that needs doing─one I would entrust to no other.
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_JNASSHYM_000_60: What's this? Are you struggling to tell me you have lost the fine pair of shoes I chose especially for you?
TEXT_MANSEA009_00545_JNASSHYM_000_61: Fortunately, I have another such pair available. You may have them out of the kindness of my heart...and the loathing in my soul I bear for your usual “attire.”
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_1: The duty I have in mind for you requires some explanation. I do hope you have not made other plans. To business, then.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_10: I have penned a letter to each of my counterparts in the Eorzean Alliance.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_11: The Battle of Carteneau and the Calamity that followed claimed countless lives.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_12: It has been five years since those of us who were spared dragged ourselves from the ashes to look upon an Eorzea we scarcely knew... Five years, and yet the people still suffer.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_13: Their lives are fraught with worry and hardship, and the Warriors of Light who might once have given them hope are gone.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_14: Yet we must press on regardless. We will never truly do so, however, till we have faced our past.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_15: To that end, I am proposing that a memorial service be held in each of the city-states on the fifth anniversary of the Battle of Carteneau.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_16: These letters contain the details of said proposal.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_17: And I would have you deliver them to our allies as my personal envoy.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_18: You have proven yourself a staunch and able ally to Limsa, but that is not my only reason for choosing you. No. I choose you because you possess a quality which puts me in mind of history's champions. A quality I feared lost. Say that you will perform this duty.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_19: I knew you would not disappoint me.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_20: This task shall take you far from the borders of our nation, to the city-states of Gridania and Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_21: A grueling journey, to be sure...were you to travel by sea and land. But I mean to have you take to the skies.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_22: An airship pass, to be used at your discretion.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_23: Airships bound for the nations of our allies leave from the landing connected to the Bridge. But before you depart, I suggest you trouble Baderon for a few pearls of wisdom regarding each of your destinations. The old bastard is nothing if not well traveled.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_24: 'Tis a pity I cannot issue such passes with a freer hand, as I did in more peaceful times, when berths were not so limited. But in these times of war, every craft we commit to the clouds risks drawing the eye of the Empire, and every voyage must needs be born of necessity.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_25: Lest you doubt, I consider your place well deserved.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_26: Nor am I alone in that opinion. There were other parties who would see you granted the privilege of air travel.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_27: Aye, , your deeds do not go unnoticed.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_28: Full many see great promise in you. But I have flattered you enough.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_29: On behalf of Limsa Lominsa and her people, I bid you go forth, adventurer.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_30: Discover the realm for which so many have fought and died.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_31: Wonder and danger await you in equal measure, but turn not from either. Only by braving the unknown will you achieve the greatness of which you are surely capable.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_MERLWYB_000_32: The light of the Crystal guides you, and I wager that your destiny will be no small thing.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_40: Back from yer meetin' with the Admiral, are ye?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_42: So ye'll be carryin' the word o' the Admiral 'erself to the leaders o' the Alliance!?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_43: Bugger me... I knew ye was goin' up in the world, but I didn't realize ye'd got that bloody 'igh!
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_44: I'm proud o' ye, ! Thinkin' of 'ow far ye've come...why, 'tis enough to bring a tear to me eye! An' that ain't the ale talkin', neither─well, not just the ale, at any rate...
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_45: Bless the Navigator fer steerin' ye my way.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_46: 'Course, this is only the start! Now ye've got yer 'ands on an airship pass, the 'ole of Eorzea's laid out before ye, like a fair maid on a feather bed!
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_47: An' she's a big girl, too, with plenty of enticin' nooks an' crannies!
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_48: If ye think us Lominsans are characters, just wait till ye cross paths with the grim forest dwellers o' Gridania, or trade coins with the crafty merchants of Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_49: An' then there's the wild places where the beasties rule, an' no bugger with an onze o' sense sets foot...
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_50: But yer a 'venturer, so I wouldn't let a little thing like that 'old ye back.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_51: 'Course, it ain't all explorin' an' excitement.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_52: There's an 'eap o' troubles what plagues every nation, see─'tain't just ours. I'm talkin' intrigue an' infightin', beastmen an' their godsdamned primals─aye, there's an ugly side to life, an' sooner or later, yer bound to walk into it.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_53: ...But I'll wager there's bugger all out there as you can't 'andle. Summat tells me yer goin' to be just fine.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_54: The realm's 'ad it rough, 'tis true, but folk're beginnin' to recover from the beatin' the Calamity dealt 'em. Call me an 'opeless optimist, but it wouldn't take much to turn things 'round.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_55:
'Tis the perfect time fer a 'venturer like yerself to get out there an' make a difference!
...Well, what are ye waitin' fer!?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LNOPHLO_000_60: Greetings, . This is the counter for passengers traveling to Gridania.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LNOPHLO_000_61: ...Wait, aren't you that famous adventurer? It's , isn't it? I thought I recognized you! You are an inspiration to us all, ! Highwind Skyways is at your disposal! Will you be traveling with us today?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LNOPHLO_000_62: Take your time, . I'll be glad to assist you when you're ready.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LNOPHLO_000_65: Are you ready to depart, ? The airship bound for Gridania will be leaving shortly.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LNOPHLO_000_66: Thank you for using Highwind Skyways. The airship to Ul'dah will soon be departing.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LNOPHLO_000_67: Take your time, . I'll be glad to assist you when you're ready.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_70: Do you wish to leave the landing area?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_71: We hope you have a pleasant voyage.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_ANNOUNCE_000_80: Attention, all passengers: the airship bound for Gridania is about to depart. Please make your way to the boarding gate.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_82: The day'll come when yer name means the same as “'ero” to the folk o' this realm.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BADERON_000_83: May ye walk in the light o' the Crystal...
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_90: Ah, you must be the envoy from Limsa Lominsa. Welcome to Gridania, . The Elder Seedseer awaits your arrival.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_91: Please let me know if you require any assistance.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_SERPENT_000_96: You are the Lominsan envoy, are you not? I have received instructions to assist you.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_SERPENT_000_97: Pray make your way into the city proper, and identify yourself to the conjurer at Nophica's Altar. She will admit you to the Lotus Stand, where the Elder Seedseer awaits.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_SERPENT_000_98: Pray make your way into the city proper, and identify yourself to the conjurer at Nophica's Altar. She will admit you to the Lotus Stand, where the Elder Seedseer awaits.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_DOORMANLOTUS_000_10: You are the Lominsan envoy? Begging your pardons, , but might I inspect the missive you bear?
Verily, this is the seal of the Admiral of Limsa Lominsa. Please come with me.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_600010_KANESENNA: So you are the Lominsan envoy.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_600020_KANESENNA: And an adventurer besides. The realm owes much to you and yours.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_600030_KANESENNA: On behalf of our fair nation, I bid you welcome.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_600060_KANESENNA: I am Kan-E-Senna, Elder Seedseer of Gridania, and leader of the Order of the Twin Adder, our nation's Grand Company.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_600070_KANESENNA: I understand you bear a message from the Admiral.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_600080_KANESENNA: But...before you begin, might I behold your face more closely?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_600090_KANESENNA: My apologies. You put me in mind of one I once knew─a brave and noble soul.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_600100_KANESENNA: But come, let us return to the matter at hand.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_110: A remembrance service for the fallen of Carteneau...
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_111: To think that five years have already come and gone...
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_112: It seems like only yesterday that the Garlean Empire attempted to seize all that we hold dear.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_113: Rising in resistance, the city-states of Eorzea formed the Grand Companies, and joined hands in alliance.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_114: But unbeknown to us, the Garleans sought not to best us in battle, but moved instead to enact a terrible plot: the Meteor project, by which the lesser moon, Dalamud, would be torn down from the heavens to annihilate all life below.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_115: In a desperate bid to save the realm from certain destruction, our forces marched for the Carteneau Flats, and there met the VIIth Imperial Legion.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_116: More bloody a battle I have never seen, and would never wish to see again. Yet the carnage was but a prelude to the atrocity which followed.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_117: For despite our best efforts, Dalamud continued its descent, and from it emerged the elder primal Bahamut, who proceeded to rain fire upon Eorzea.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_118: The VIIth Imperial Legion was consumed in the blinking of an eye, while our own forces fared little better...
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_119: That any among us were spared defies explanation. All seemed sure to perish.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_120: As the flames converged upon us, I prepared myself for death...only for a brilliant light to envelop me, relieving me of my senses.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_121: When at last I awoke, Bahamut was gone, and the land, which had but moments before been aflame, now seemed to me a place unknown─not simply ruined...but changed.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_122: Archon Louisoix may well have been able to shed light upon these mysteries, but he, like so many, never returned from Carteneau.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_123: And so we were left with countless questions, and no prospect of an answer. Yet such matters did not long occupy our thoughts, for we had far graver concerns.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_124: The Calamity, as the devastation wrought by Bahamut has come to be known, laid our nations nigh to waste, and to this day we struggle to rebuild our lives and homes.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_125: To compound matters, the beast tribes continue to summon their primals, while the Empire encroaches upon our borders, consolidating its foothold in Eorzea. The outlook, in short, is bleak.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_126: In the wake of the Calamity, it has been all each nation could do to nurse its own wounds.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_127: Yet if we are to weather the coming storm, we must needs stand united once more. A remembrance service may well present an opportunity to rekindle the spirit of unity which first gave rise to the Alliance.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_128: I wholeheartedly approve of the Admiral's proposal. The necessary provisions shall be made for a service here in Gridania.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_129: You have done the people of Eorzea a fine service this day, and I would not put you to further trouble. I shall see that my reply reaches the Admiral anon.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_130: You, meanwhile, are bound next for Ul'dah, are you not?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_131: Please send the Flame General my regards. Ah, and if you would be so kind, I should appreciate it if you would inform him that a pet of mine has been ill behaved of late─my wolf, to be precise. Needless to say, he must be brought to heel, and I would very much welcome the General's counsel on how this might be achieved.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_KANESENNA_000_132: I thank you for coming. May the Twelve see you safe to Ul'dah and beyond.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LIONNELLAIS_000_140: Greetings, . This is the counter for passengers traveling to Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LIONNELLAIS_000_141: Oh, are you not , the Lominsan envoy? On behalf of all at Highwind Skyways, may I say what an honor it is to serve you! Will you be flying with us today?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LIONNELLAIS_000_142: Very well. When you are ready to board, please let me know.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_144: Do you wish to leave the landing area?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_145: We hope you have a pleasant voyage.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_LIONNELLAIS_000_147: The flight for Ul'dah will soon be departing. Are your preparations in order, ?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_148: Very well. When you are ready to travel, you need only say the word.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_150: Ah, you must be the envoy from Limsa Lominsa! Welcome to Ul'dah, . The Flame General awaits your arrival.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_CABINCREW_000_151: Please let me know if you require any assistance.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_FLAMEA_000_155: Welcome to Ul'dah, . We have been expecting you.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_FLAMEA_000_156: Flame General Raubahn will receive you in the Fragrant Chamber. Please take the lift down to the Hustings Strip and speak with Bartholomew at the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_FLAMEA_000_158: The lift over yonder will take you to the Hustings Strip. From there, proceed south to the Royal Promenade, and speak with Bartholomew to gain admittance to the Fragrant Chamber.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BARTHOLOMEW_000_160: The Lominsan envoy, I presume? Would you be so good as to allow me to inspect the missive you bear, ? My thanks.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_BARTHOLOMEW_000_161: Ah yes, the Admiral's seal. Please proceed.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_800110_RAUBAHN: Ah, a guest from Limsa. I thought I smelled stale ale.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_800120_RAUBAHN: I won't hold it against you. If you're half the warrior Merlwyb says, 'tis a wonder you don't reek of dead Sahagin.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_800130_RAUBAHN: Welcome to the sultanate of Ul'dah. I am Raubahn Aldynn, General of the Immortal Flames.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_800140_RAUBAHN: But you did not come all this way to trade formalities.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_800150_RAUBAHN: There's something familiar about you... For a moment, I mistook you for an old .
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_800160_RAUBAHN: Like , you have the eyes of a hero. Eyes that have looked upon the horrors of battle, unblinking.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_800170_RAUBAHN: I've no doubt Merlwyb saw them, too. Mayhap there is hope for Limsa Lominsa yet! Come, let us talk.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_182: Do you know what happened that day, adventurer? When we took the field against the Garleans?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_183: So my counterparts have educated you.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_184: Hm? Kan-E's pet is giving her trouble, is it? Well, she should already know my mind on that subject.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_185: Wolves are beyond taming. 'Tis but a matter of time before they bare their teeth.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_186: So it was with the Garleans, fifty years ago.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_187: No sooner had they learned how to use magitek than they began seizing territory from their neighbors.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_188: Led by then legatus Solus zos Galvus, they swiftly brought the other nations of Ilsabard to heel. And so the legatus became an emperor, and his republic an empire...
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_189: An empire which then set its sights upon Eorzea.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_ROAILLE_000_190: But the conquering emperor is now an old man of four score winters. His health is failing, and he has no clear successor. Like as not, this is why the Garleans have been quiet of late.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_191: But the XIVth Imperial Legion is still entrenched within our borders.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_192: And their commander, Legatus Gaius van Baelsar, has long harbored ambitions of conquest.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_193: Were he to strike now, I fear we would fall like so many others before us. And not only Ul'dah, but Gridania and Limsa Lominsa as well.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_194: For the Calamity brought the lot of us to our knees, and we've yet to get up. We barely have the strength to stand against the beast tribes, never mind the primals they mean to summon.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_195: We are a realm divided, adventurer. An alliance in name only.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_196: But the wolf cares not for the plight of its prey.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_197: The Garleans stir, and the Elder Seedseer would not let it go unnoticed.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_198: All other concerns pale in comparison to the Empire─even the beast tribes and their bloody primals.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_199: We must stand united once more, that much is clear. And if we're to do so, we must remember the cause which last brought us together. Merlwyb will have her memorial.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_200: We will honor the memory of the fallen. We will remind the people what their brothers and sisters fought and died for.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_ROAILLE_000_201: Shall I inform the sultana and the Syndicate?
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_202: I will speak with Her Grace myself.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_RAUBAHN_000_204: The Admiral will have my reply anon.
TEXT_MANSEA200_00546_SYSTEM_000_300: You can now make use of the airship routes connecting the three nations. Before you may board an airship, you must pay the requisite fare in gil.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_000: , I have just this moment─ No! No, the time for concealment is past! The truth is, even before I had you deliver those pretzels, I was privy to some most unsettling news!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_001: ...Which is the real reason I sent you to meet those Sultansworn.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_002: A young noblewoman from a very prestigious family has run away from home, and I have been ordered to see to her safe return.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_003: The Sultansworn you met earlier are assisting with the search. Alas, it seems they have found no trace of her.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_004: I apologize for not being frank with you from the start, but we must proceed with caution─should word of her disappearance spread, I fear others with less honorable motives may join the hunt.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_005: And should we allow her to come to any harm, not even a hundred beheadings would be punishment enough...
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_006: That cannot happen, . It must not!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_007: I need you to help me find her!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_008: Praise the Twelve, I knew I could count on you!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_009: I've instructed the others to expand the search, but Thanalan is vast and there are only so many of us.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_010: The young noblewoman's name is Lady Lilira. I want you to go south and look for her in the vicinity of the Sultantree. Good luck!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000010_LILILA: O Sultantree, hallowed spirit of my line, forgive my weakness. My failings have cost us dear...
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000040_THANCRED: (-???-)Forgive my selfish desire to assure your welfare.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000050_LILILA: I don't recall requesting an escort! Simply pretend we never met and continue on your way.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000060_THANCRED: (-???-)We both know I can do no such thing. It isn't safe for you here alone.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000070_THANCRED: (-???-)It isn't safe for anyone─not with this aetheric disturbance... It's as though the dead are watching us...
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000080_THANCRED: (-???-)And I'd prefer not to join them, if it's all the same to you.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000090_THANCRED: (-???-)Ah, you must be the one that Papashan mentioned. Congratulations on finding our elusive young charge.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000100_THANCRED: (-???-)You'll have to forgive Her Impetuousness. What she lacks in discipline, she makes up for in stubbornness.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000110_THANCRED: (-???-)How peculiar... I could swear we've met, but haven't the faintest recollection as to where or when.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000120_THANCRED: (-???-)Must be the damned heat playing tricks on me. I'd best retire before I start having visions.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000130_THANCRED: (-???-)You should return with us. The stationmaster will be eager to thank Lady Lilira's protector in person.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000140_THANCRED: (-???-)Alas, the stationmaster will have to wait.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000150_THANCRED: (-???-)Dear Lilira, for my sake, please stay out of harm's way.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_000160_THANCRED: (-???-)As for you, dear friend─for Lilira's sake─please stay in harm's way!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300200_LILILA: Would you mind telling me what that was?
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300210_THANCRED: (-???-)If I only knew. A denizen of the void, at any rate.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300230_THANCRED: (-???-)The question isn't “how,” but “who”─we're not dealing with bookless bandits.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300240_THANCRED: (-???-)Don't suppose the answer came to you in a dream?
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300250_THANCRED: (-???-)No sooner did you fell the beast than you fell asleep. Too much aether, no doubt.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300280_THANCRED: (-???-)Hm? Oh, just thinking aloud. At any rate, we haven't a moment to spare. I must return and report this at once.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300290_THANCRED: (-???-)I leave Lady Lilira in your capable hands!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300300_LILILA: How dare you pass me about like a swaddled babe!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300310_LILILA: I shall return and tell them myself!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300330_THANCRED: (-???-)I suspect we shall meet again before long.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_300340_THANCRED: (-???-)Until then, do try and stay awake!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_020: Thank the gods you've returned! You had us all so worried!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_021: You do realize what would happen if a person of your noble stature were to be injured─or worse?
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_022: Why, Her Grace the sultana would be beside herself with grief─and so would her subjects! I daresay they'd be weeping in the streets!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_LILILA_023: But I have already given you cause to weep, Papashan...you and the people of Ul'dah...
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_024: Please, Your─ You're not to say such things! We will find it, I swear to you!
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_025: It is not my place to make demands, m-my lady, but I beg you, please stay out of harm's way.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_LILILA_026: ...I apologize for causing you undue worry, Papashan. I shall refrain from traveling unescorted in future.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_028: I understand you fought bravely to protect Lady Lilira from voidsent fiends.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_029: For your gallant service, you deserve all the riches in the royal vaults. Alas, a small token of my gratitude is the best I can offer.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_030: ...Hm? A sarcastic man with a strange contraption strapped to his shoulder?
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_031: I see you met Thancred. He's a scholar who spends his days investigating oddities in the aether. Rather too fond of the sound of his own voice for my liking, but perfectly harmless.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_032: As for you, ─you're just the sort of adventurer we need around here.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_PAPASHAN_033: I pray you show the same kindness to the people of Thanalan as you did to us today.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_SCENE00002_INSTANCE:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“MANWIL005”?
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_SYSTEM_000_40: You are about to enter an instanced battle. Instanced battles only occur during certain quests and missions.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_SYSTEM_000_41: Take a moment to read the information displayed in the active help window before answering the call of duty.
TEXT_MANWIL005_00550_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: Come, let's attend to our uninvited guest!
Leave the big one to me! You handle the rest!
Stay close if you want me to heal you!

More of them!?
Really now, there are limits to our hospitality!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_050_1: Can I count on your discretion, ? If so, then listen closely...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_1: The outside world believes Ul'dah to be a sultanate, ruled by Sultana Nanamo Ul Namo. Truth is, though, it's the six wealthiest citizens that hold the most sway─the Syndicate.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_2: Be that as it may, the sultana's still got the support of the people...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_3: But she might struggle to keep even that if a certain incident becomes public knowledge.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_4: It pains me to say it, but Her Grace's crown, the symbol of the royal dynasty, has been stolen.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_5: And Owyne...Owyne's the Sultansworn who was charged with guardin' it that night.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_6: I'd bet anythin' this letter was written by the bastards who made off with the crown.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_7: It can't be a coincidence that a man we know to have been fraternizin' with thieves had a letter for Owyne of all people, at this of all times.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_8: You need to take this to the man himself, . Tell him Momodi sent you, and that it concerns a lost heirloom.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MOMODI_000_9: If it looks as though the fellow needs help, I want you to lend it to him. The future of our fair city may depend on it.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_SULTANSWORMA_000_10: The Heart of the Sworn lies beyond. State your business.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_SULTANSWORMA_000_11: ...Pardon? Did you say a lost heirloom? Ahem. Proceed.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_Q1_000_1: Proceed into the Heart of the Sworn?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_SULTANSWORMA_000_12: What are you playing at, adventurer? Did Momodi truly send you? If this is some sort of prank, there will be consequences!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_20: Well met, adventurer. What business brings you here this day?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_21: ...A letter? Very well, let's see it.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_23: I see. But you have some inkling as to its contents, I think.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_24: Mistress Momodi has doubtless explained to you the significance of the crown, and what its loss could mean for Her Grace the sultana... <sigh> This theft shames the Sultansworn─and me most of all.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_25: The blame is mine, you see. I grew lax in my duties, and in a moment of carelessness...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_26:
No, it will do no good to recount the tale now.
Since the hour of the theft, we've searched frantically for any signs, any whispers as to the whereabouts of the crown. We have found nothing.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_27: The identity of the thieves, and their motives, seemed fated to remain a mystery─until you arrived, bearing this ransom note.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_28: In it, the criminals state their price for the return of Her Grace's crown.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_29: And though it pains me to say it, I fear I have no choice but to acquiesce to their demands. Too much is at stake to do otherwise. The crown symbolizes Her Grace's birthright, and identifies her as the custodian of the Ul legacy. It must be recovered.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_30: I will travel to the Unholy Heir and pay them their ransom.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_31: Though I am not foolish enough to meet these men alone as they stipulate, I dare not bring a host of my comrades lest the thieves take fright. Friend─would you consent to be present for the exchange?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_32: Mistress Momodi has always spoken of you in the most glowing terms, and I have never yet had reason to question her judgment.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_33: On behalf of all those still loyal to the sultana, I beseech you─help us in our hour of need.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_40: Pray meet me at the Unholy Heir in central Thanalan, east of Black Brush Station. If the gods are good, the exchange will proceed without incident...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_INSTANCE_BATTLE_YES:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“MANWIL007”?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_50: I've come as agreed! Now, show me the crown!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_51: Aye, you'll have your precious crown─once we've been duly compensated.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_52: Do you think me a fool!? What assurance have I that you will honor your part of the agreement?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_53: Now, now, Owyne...you're the least trustworthy man here. Not only was the crown stolen on your watch, but it looks to me as if you've violated the terms of our exchange. Did we not say that you were to come alone?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_54: And given that you are not alone, what guarantee have we that there isn't a company of archers surrounding us even as we speak, ready to feather me and my men the moment they catch a glimpse of the crown?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_55: You have made mock of our trust. The deal is off.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_56: Wait! Here's your payment, as promised!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_58: Ahahaha! A thousand thanks to you, boy! You've succeeded where scores of thieves have failed!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_59: And now, at long last, we have it! The power to create an army of undying soldiers─The Traders' Spurn!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_60: No...no, it can't be! What have I done!?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_61: Surely you must have wondered what it was that you were handing over─what it was that seemed as valuable to us as the crown seemed to you? Or did you assume we were feeling charitable?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_62: Ah, but you must feel terrible, knowing that you've brought us the doom of Sil'dih. Worry not, boy─we'll grant you a quick death and spare you further ignominy.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_63: There's too many, ! Run! Run while you still can! I...I will do my duty.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_64: (-???-)It's your duty to serve the sultana, lad─and you'll be doing it for a good while yet!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_65: Sultansworn! Put these thieves to the sword and secure the crown!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_GARIBALD_000_66: Sultansworn!? Hah! No matter! Kill them all!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_71: The General saw you sneak into the vaults, Owyne.
