TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_72: He suspected something was afoot and ordered us to keep an eye on you.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_73: The Flame General...? He ordered you to look after me?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_SULTANSWORM_000_74: Master Papashan! More of them to the north!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_75: After them, Sultansworn─they have the crown! This lot sought only to delay us!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_76: Let us speak again back in the city!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MASKEDMAGUS_000_77: The source of  strength becomes clear...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MASKEDMAGUS_000_78: You may have bested the golem, but you will not fare so well this day.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MASKEDMAGUS_000_79: O mournful voice of creation! Send unto me a creature of the abyss, my thrall to command, that I may smite mine enemies!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MASKEDMAGUS_000_80: Your very being imperils the plan. You cannot be suffered to live.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_MASKEDMAGUS_000_90: Unnngh... That the wisdom of the Paragons should be brought low...by mere mortals...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_91: Paragons? This is indeed a disturbing revelation...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_92: We had long suspected the involvement of the Bringers of Chaos─Ascians, to give them their true name.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_93: But we could not be sure they were responsible for the recent disturbances until now. As if the sultanate needed any more enemies...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_94: Hm? Have we Sharlayans crossed paths with Ascians before? Well, we've certainly─ Wait. I don't recall telling you about my homeland.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_95: Ah, yes, that's right─you're one of the gifted.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_96: You know, this marks the third time I've found you in the midst of trouble. If I didn't know any better, I'd say you're a lodestone for it!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_97: Anyway, I'm glad I started following you around. Who knows what grand conspiracy you'll stumble upon next!?
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_98: I jest, I jest... Had I truly been watching your every move, I wouldn't have taken so long to intervene in your latest altercation.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_THANCRED_000_99: But all's well that ends well, eh? Our masked friend is no more, and while I very much doubt we've seen the last of his kind, his demise will likely grant us at least some respite. And on that note, I must away. Until next time, .
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_SULTANSWORMA_000_11: Everyone is waiting for you, adventurer.
Pray do not keep my comrades waiting.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_200: Does it surprise you to see me dressed so, ? I was once a Sultansworn, you know, though it's been fifteen years since I put down my sword, and took up the role of stationmaster.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_201: It is a capacity in which I am no less proud to serve, lest you doubt. Whenever Her Grace ventures outside the gates, I have the honor of protecting her person.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_202: Never before had I seen her so despondent as when news of the crown's theft reached her ears.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_PAPASHAN_000_203: But thanks to your valiant efforts, she is returned to her former vibrant self. You have the gratitude of every Sultansworn, .
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400010_LADYSMAID: Exalted vessel of Nald'thal, guardian of Thanalan, seventeenth ascendant to the throne of Ul'dah, Her Royal Majesty Nanamo Ul Namo presides!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400020_SULTANSWORM: Long live Nanamo! Glory to the Sultana! Forever may she reign!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400030_SULTANSWORM: Long live Nanamo! Glory to the Sultana! Forever may she reign!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400040_NANAMOULNAMO: They regaled me with tales of a champion amongst champions, one whose tireless service to the crown merited the highest honor we might bestow.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400050_NANAMOULNAMO: Never did it occur to me that it might be you. Bring it forth!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400060_NANAMOULNAMO: Betokening our gratitude and esteem, I, Nanamo Ul Namo, Sultana of Ul'dah, confer upon you this gift.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400090_NANAMOULNAMO: See to it that our champion is my personal guest at the banquet.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400110_RAUBAHN: If what they say is true, Ul'dah owes you a great debt.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400120_RAUBAHN: Strange that we should not have met before this day...
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400140_RAUBAHN: I am not given to superstition, but I'll be sworn our tales belong in the same saga.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400150_RAUBAHN: I am Raubahn Aldynn. With the consent of Her Grace, I oversee the affairs of the sultanate.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400160_RAUBAHN: Brave souls are few and far between in these times. I count my blessings when I find one.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400170_RAUBAHN: Her Grace invites you to join her at the coming banquet. I trust I will see you there.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_400210_RAUBAHN: For the sake of Her Grace, and the glory of the sultanate, may you walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_OWYNE_000_120: You have my thanks, , for helping to defend Her Grace's good name, and for sparing the Sultansworn further dishonor. I believe Master Papashan would like to thank you personally.
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_TODO001: Defeat Garibald the Fargone and his minions!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_PAPASHAN_BATTLE: Fight for your sultana, boy! Fight for Ul'dah!
Yield or be slain, thief! I will not ask again!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_OWYNE_BATTLETAL:
As you command, Master Papashan!
With me, !
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_GARIBALD_BATTLE: Old men shouldn't play with swords!
I will cut your heart out, old man!
Meddlesome fools! You know not whom you face!

Hearken to me, denizen of the abyss!
Slay these interlopers and feast upon their souls!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_PAPASHAN_BATTLE: Whatever happens, do not let them escape with the crown!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_MASKEDMAGUS_BAT: Soon, you shall take your vile gifts to the grave!

Mwahahaha!
Writhe as the venom eats its way through your veins!
An unwelcome guest. No matter, all shall fall before me!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_SANCRED_ENTER: You certainly have a knack for getting into trouble!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_MASKEDMAGUS_BAT: No mortal should possess such strength!
TEXT_MANWIL007_00551_QIB_SANCRED_MASKEDM:
Keep it up, !
We almost have him!
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_1: This is it, ─your big debut in Ul'dahn high society!
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_2: The banquet is bein' held in the Fragrant Chamber. Head over to the Royal Promenade and Bartholomew will show you in. Oh, but be sure to put on your earrin's first, or he'll send you packin'.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_3: Right, well, I reckon that's everythin'. Try not to let all the pomp and ceremony get to you. Just be yourself and you'll be fine!
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_BARTHOLOMEW_000_10: A banquet hosted by Her Grace the sultana is due to begin shortly. Attendance is by invitation only. Please make way for arriving guests.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_BARTHOLOMEW_000_11: We are honored to receive you, . Please proceed inside.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_BARTHOLOMEW_000_12: Ahem. I must ask that you step away from the doors, . If you have received an invitation, pray consider the terms of admission.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_BARTHOLOMEW_000_13: And Twelve save you if you have misplaced the relevant articles! I can only imagine how horrified Mistress Serendipity would be if she had to furnish you with another pair...
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000040_NANAMOULNAMO: By right of the Royal House of Ul, I, Nanamo, seventeenth of my line, have summoned you here.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000050_NANAMOULNAMO: We are graced this day by the presence of a hero to Ul'dah, and dear friend to the crown.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000060_NANAMOULNAMO: Honored guests, I give you our champion!
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000070_NANAMOULNAMO: And with that, I bid you enjoy the feast.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000080_RAUBAHN: Not to spoil your appetite, but Ul'dah is hardly so bountiful as this meal would have you believe. While we gorge ourselves, children starve in the streets.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000090_RAUBAHN: Nor can Her Grace do aught to help them. She is thwarted at every turn by those on the Syndicate who derive their wealth from the workers' poverty.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000100_RAUBAHN: Beneath her mask of stately serenity, she is aghast at the plight of her subjects.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000110_RAUBAHN: But there will be no hope for the masses until the crown is restored to power.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000120_RAUBAHN: I am truly grateful for all you have done for Ul'dah. But there is so much more to do.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000140_RAUBAHN: So bright... Almost like... By the Twelve!
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000150_RAUBAHN: Tell me true─have you been troubled by strange dreams of late? Visions─of the Crystal?
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000160_RAUBAHN: Mayhap you put them down to an excess of aether?
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000170_RAUBAHN: Yes. You are like they were...
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000180_RAUBAHN: Allow me to explain. Before you came to Eorzea, there were others like you who fought the primals.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000190_RAUBAHN: Though they were not of this land, when the Garlean Empire threatened the realm, they helped bring together the three Grand Companies.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000200_RAUBAHN: And they stood with us at Carteneau, that fateful day five years ago...
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000220_RAUBAHN: None who survived have forgotten the heroes' sacrifice, nor would any man deny they fought alongside us...
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000230_RAUBAHN: But the names of these heroes come not to our lips. The once-familiar pages of their story are now blank to us.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000240_RAUBAHN: And in our mind's eye, their faces are naught but silhouettes amid a blinding glare...
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000250_RAUBAHN: It is for this reason that we have come to call them the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000260_RAUBAHN: When I look at you, I cannot help but think of them, and of what you might achieve.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000270_RAUBAHN: You must protect that crystal at all costs.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000280_RAUBAHN: It is a gift from Hydaelyn, Mother of all─and one She gave to you for a reason.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000290_RAUBAHN: Yours is no ordinary tale. If I am right, the fate of the realm may yet hang upon your deeds.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_000300_RAUBAHN: Only heroes and martyrs are fit to bear such a burden. Let us pray you are the former.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_51: They said you fainted in the middle of one of the General's stories. I had to have you carried back to the Hourglass.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_52: I reckon you made quite an impression on your fellow guests─though probably not the sort you intended.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_53: You sure you're gettin' enough rest, ? The life of an adventurer can be pretty taxin'.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_54: Anyroad, I'm glad to see you're back to normal. No offense, but lookin' after you was gettin' a bit tiresome.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_55: Oh, 'fore I forget, the General left a message for you. Said that when you're feelin' up to it, you should come and see him at the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_MOMODI_000_56: Probably wants to finish the story he was tellin' you when you fell asleep.
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_RAUBAHN_000_60: I've been waiting for you, . I trust you are fully recovered?
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_RAUBAHN_000_61: Good, because there is much work to be done─work that I would have you do...
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_SERENDIPITY_070: You want what!? You can't be serious! Gods...
TEXT_MANWIL009_00552_SERENDIPITY_071: Just this once, but remember─life is not a minstrel's song, and you aren't some chosen hero. So don't go around expecting people to forgive you no matter the reckless, irresponsible things you do.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_1: Before you go chargin' off to find your fortune, I've a few basic tasks I'd like you to perform so as to help you get to know the place.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_2: First of all, I want you to visit the aetheryte plaza. To get there, head west from here till you reach Emerald Avenue, then look to the north. You should see a giant, floatin' crystal called an aetheryte.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_3: If it weren't for aetherytes, travelin' around Eorzea would be a damn sight more troublesome than it is. 'Course, you still need to attune with 'em before you can use 'em, so be sure to do that with the one in the plaza. You ever attuned with an aetheryte before, ? If not, just lay your hand on the thing and you'll see what I mean.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_4: When you've done that, I want you to pay a visit to the Gladiators' Guild, over at the Coliseum.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_5: Assumin' that sword ain't just for show, you might consider trainin' there.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_6: And finally, I want you to visit the Sapphire Avenue Exchange, over on the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_7: Goods from all across Eorzea and beyond turn up there every day. You'll have no trouble findin' armor, weapons, or anythin' else a fledglin' adventurer like yourself might need.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_8: You might say that everythin's for sale here in Ul'dah─as long as you've got the gil.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_9: Just make sure as you don't pay more than you ought, .
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_10: There's plenty as won't scruple to swindle unsuspectin' foreigners like yourself, 'specially if they think no one's lookin' out for their best interests.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_11: Which is why I'm givin' you this letter. When you visit the exchange, find a gentleman named Seseroga and give it to him. He'll be happy to tell you about the markets once he's read it.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_12: In short, then: visit the aetheryte plaza, the Gladiators' Guild, and the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. Simple.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_13: Oh, but before you go, a word of advice: while there're more than a few unsavory characters out there who'll try to take advantage of you, there are also some with honest-to-goodness problems who you should consider offerin' a helpin' hand to.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_14: A lot of folk are lured to this city by the promise of wealth and power. What many of 'em fail to realize is that instead of chasin' after gil the moment they get here, they ought to be makin' friends.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_15: Let it be known that you're willin' to give as much as you get, and opportunities will come your way.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_16: Speakin' of which, you should speak with the Smith over yonder─those lads always have some good advice for up-and-comin' adventurers. Otherwise, that's about it from me. It's past time you got goin'. Oh, and let me know when you've finished, will you? That way, I won't spend my days worryin' that you're down to your smallclothes without a gil to your name.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_20: Welcome to the Gladiators' Guild, friend!
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_21: Tell me, are you new to the thrills of mortal combat? Well, whether you are or not, you are new to us!
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_22: If you would take your place in these hallowed halls, you must be willing and ready to undergo the most rigorous training. You must endure cuts and bruises beyond counting, and like as not far worse.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_23: A daunting prospect, I concede─but there is no other way if you mean to take to the bloodsands one day. And why wouldn't you? The Coliseum is only the most celebrated place of public entertainment in all of Ul'dah!
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_24: Where else could a poor man amass a fortune so vast as to one day allow him to claim a seat on the Syndicate?
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_25: Ahhh...there's not an Ul'dahn alive who isn't inspired by the rise of the self-made man.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_26: And there is no truer embodiment of this than the gladiator who wins riches and fame with his sword.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_27: Throughout its long and storied history, this guild has nurtured countless champions.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_28: Our training methods are second to none, and our members ever strive to develop new techniques.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_29: If you desire true glory─to fight and triumph, 'midst the roar of ten thousand voices─then this is where you belong, adventurer.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_LULUTSU_000_30: ...Think of it. Think of your legacy. And if your soul stirs...join us.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_NENEBARU_000_40: Hail, adventurer! Might you have come at the behest of Miss Momodi of the Quicksand?
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_NENEBARU_000_41: Excellent. Which brings us to the matter of the attunement fee─that will be one hundred thousand gil, if you please, .
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_NENEBARU_000_42: ...AHAHAHAHAHA! Apologies, but I do so relish the opportunity to make that jest. The look on your face was absolutely priceless! Ah, but the fact that you were so easily deceived suggests to me that you are unfamiliar with the use of aetherytes. Allow me to explain.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_NENEBARU_000_43: These crystalline agglomerations tap into aetherial energies, and are primarily used as a means to travel swiftly from one place to another.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_NENEBARU_000_44: Perchance you have heard of Return and Teleport? Well, these transportation spells make direct use of the aetherytes and their connection to the flow of aether.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_NENEBARU_000_45: Given that there is an aetheryte in almost every corner of Eorzea, any adventurer with a mind to explore the realm will wish to seek out and attune  to each and every one!
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_NENEBARU_000_46: But even if you have no intention of wandering beyond the sultanate's borders, it would be prudent for you to attune yourself to any aetherytes you encounter from now on.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_NENEBARU_000_47: I pray you found that informative. Should you wish to learn more about aetherytes or transportation magic, I should be happy to answer your questions.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SYSTEM_000_48:
You attune with the aetheryte.
You are now able to use the Return spell!
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_50:
And you are?
...Ho, a newly come adventurer. But of course. Yes, I am Seseroga. What can I do for you?
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_51: Ah, you would have me teach you the ways of the marketplace? Very wise. As for my fee... What? You expect me to do it for free!? Surely you jest.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_52: My dear adventurer, when you ask an Ul'dahn for a favor, you should at least try to make it worth his while. Judging by your garb, I rather doubt you could afford my services, but the fact you offer nothing is laughable.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_53: Oh. Mistress Momodi instructed you to seek me out, did she? Hmph. Consider yourself fortunate to have such influential friends.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_54: I shall be brief, and you shall be attentive.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_55: You stand in the Sapphire Avenue Exchange, the busiest and most profitable marketplace in the sultanate.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_56: Being advantageously situated in relation to the other city-states, Ul'dah's markets have ever served as both the literal and figurative centers of Eorzean commerce.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_57: All the great overland trade routes lead to our city, and the majority of maritime trade between Vylbrand and Aldenard passes through our ports.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_58: Because of this, countless companies and consortia have chosen Ul'dah as their base of operations. They see to it that this marketplace is awash with merchants and moneylenders, day and night.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_59: Anything a man could ever desire can be purchased here─provided as he has sufficient funds.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_60: Surely there's something you seek, adventurer? A deadlier sword, perhaps, or a shinier trinket? Whatever it is you want, the exchange will have it.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_61: To the north, you will find merchants peddling armor and accessories, curatives and crafting materials.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_62: And to the south, you will find weapons, tools, and an assortment of other useful items for sale.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_63: Seek out a particular merchant, or browse to your heart's content. But do try to remain aloof should you find something that piques your interest. Decisions made in the heat of the moment are usually unwise, especially where coin is concerned.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_64: Ahem. That is all the complimentary aid you shall have from me─and far too much for my taste.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_SESEROGA_000_65: My regards to Momodi. Now, off with you!
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_70: How was your tour of the city, ? Get lost, did you?
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_71: Aye, well, Ul'dah's a big place with lots to see and do─but wanderin' around aimlessly don't pay the bills. If you're serious about makin' a livin' here, you'll need to remember where things are.
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_72: So when you go explorin', explore like you've got a purpose, eh?
TEXT_MANWIL002_00568_MOMODI_000_73: All right, then! All that's left is for you to work hard, make money, and spend it here at the Quicksand!
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_1: Before you go chargin' off to find your fortune, I've a few basic tasks I'd like you to perform so as to help you get to know the place.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_2: First of all, I want you to visit the aetheryte plaza. To get there, head west from here till you reach Emerald Avenue, then look to the north. You should see a giant, floatin' crystal called an aetheryte.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_3: If it weren't for aetherytes, travelin' around Eorzea would be a damn sight more troublesome than it is. 'Course, you still need to attune with 'em before you can use 'em, so be sure to do that with the one in the plaza. You ever attuned with an aetheryte before, ? If not, just lay your hand on the thing and you'll see what I mean.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_4: When you've done that, I want you to pay a visit to the Pugilists' Guild, over at the Platinum Mirage.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_5: Assumin' those weapons of yours ain't just for show, you might consider trainin' there.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_6: And finally, I want you to visit the Sapphire Avenue Exchange, over on the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_7: Goods from all across Eorzea and beyond turn up there every day. You'll have no trouble findin' armor, weapons, or anythin' else a fledglin' adventurer like yourself might need.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_8: You might say that everythin's for sale here in Ul'dah─as long as you've got the gil.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_9: Just make sure as you don't pay more than you ought, .
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_10: There's plenty as won't scruple to swindle unsuspectin' foreigners like yourself, 'specially if they think no one's lookin' out for their best interests.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_11: Which is why I'm givin' you this letter. When you visit the exchange, find a gentleman named Seseroga and give it to him. He'll be happy to tell you about the markets once he's read it.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_12: In short, then: visit the aetheryte plaza, the Pugilists' Guild, and the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. Simple.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_13: Oh, but before you go, a word of advice: while there're more than a few unsavory characters out there who'll try to take advantage of you, there are also some with honest-to-goodness problems who you should consider offerin' a helpin' hand to.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_14: A lot of folk are lured to this city by the promise of wealth and power. What many of 'em fail to realize is that instead of chasin' after gil the moment they get here, they ought to be makin' friends.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_15: Let it be known that you're willin' to give as much as you get, and opportunities will come your way.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_MOMODI_000_16: Speakin' of which, you should speak with the Smith over yonder─those lads always have some good advice for up-and-comin' adventurers. Otherwise, that's about it from me. It's past time you got goin'. Oh, and let me know when you've finished, will you? That way, I won't spend my days worryin' that you're down to your smallclothes without a gil to your name.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_20: Greetings and welcome to the Pugilists' Guild!
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_21: I see you already walk the path of the pugilist. Yet your journey has only just begun.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_22: I highly recommend you add your name to our roll, for there is no better place in all the realm to train in our discipline than here.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_23: The origins of pugilism as we know it can be traced back to the staging of bare-handed bouts at the Coliseum.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_24: These contests attracted fighters from far and wide, bringing their myriad styles crashing together on the bloodsands.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_25: Amidst this chaotic intermingling of styles, there rose a pugilist of singular strength and skill. This woman made it her life's mission to master every form she encountered, that she might refine her art.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_26: Among her many song-worthy exploits, we pugilists remember her participation in a gladiator tournament most fondly. Back when bare-handed fighting was still seen as a pastime for peasants, she took on fully armed and armored gladiators, and effortlessly bested the lot of them.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_27: Word of her feat spread across the realm like wildfire, of course, and Ul'dah swiftly transformed into a center of pugilism, with people flocking from all over to train under this master among masters.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_28: The woman's name was Cornelia, and it is to her that the Pugilists' Guild owes its existence. The art practiced here is based on her all-encompassing style, and this training hall is modeled upon the one which she once built.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_29: And there it is─a brief history of our guild.
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_30: I've told this tale a thousand times, but gods, it never fails to fan the flames of my fighting spirit!
TEXT_MANWIL003_00569_GAGARUNA_000_31: Now then, should you wish to proceed with enrollment, you must first obtain the guildmaster's approval. Let me know if you would like to meet him.

TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_20: Welcome to the Thaumaturges' Guild. It is fate that has guided your steps here this day, friend. I see that you harbor arcane ambitions...though your journey has scarcely begun.
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_21: Within these hallowed halls, the arts of devastation are taught─primeval magicks with which to bring about an enemy's ruin.
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_22: If you would join our ranks and wield such power, you must needs know of our beginnings.
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_23: The nation of Ul'dah inherited its traditions from ancient Belah'dia, a city founded by the descendants of the first mages.
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_24: The secrets of these illustrious sorcerers were ultimately entrusted to the priests of the Order of Nald'thal, who have passed them down from generation to generation ever since.
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_25: Focused and refined over centuries of use in the Order's funereal rites, the arcane magicks of our ancestors eventually emerged as the art we now know as thaumaturgy.
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_26: A freezing blizzard to halt corruption; a raging fire to cleanse the corpse; a bolt of lightning to expel the sins of mortal life... The dweomers employed in the preparation of the dead are equally efficacious when applied to the living.
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_27: It is for this reason that we are feared and respected in equal measure. Thus does our guild thrive, ensconced in the catacombs of Arrzaneth Ossuary─a sanctuary devoted to Thal, divine arbiter of the afterlife.
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_28: What say you, then, adventurer? If you would plumb the abyssal depths of thaumaturgy, let our learned sages guide your descent!
TEXT_MANWIL004_00570_YAYAKE_000_29: Ah, but before you leap into the darkness, you must prove to our guildmasters that you are possessed of the spiritual fortitude necessary to look upon that which waits therein. When you are ready to submit to the judgment of our most eminent mages, say the word.
