TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ISEMBARD_000_1: I'm afraid I have not seen any unusual activity. Nor have any at this camp given me cause to doubt them. But unless we can identify the culprit, and soon, more innocents will fall victim...
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_2: Do not despair just yet, my friend. An idea occurs to me.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_3: Our suspect has been posing as a priest, using leaflets bearing false promises to lure the poor. Let  and me serve like with like by posing as impoverished souls in need of succor.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ISEMBARD_000_4: Ah, I dare to hope that this will yield us the answers we seek. It will be a dangerous undertaking, but you two are more than capable of looking after yourselves.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ISEMBARD_000_5: I'm next to useless in a battle, but I can supply the garments for the disguise. These old tunics and slops should serve your needs, so long as you don't mind the smell and the stains.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_6: These will serve very well. You have my thanks.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_7: Listen, . So as to lay the foundation for our little ploy, we must make it widely known that more vagrants have arrived at camp and are desperate for coin.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_8: To this end, I want you to don the old garments Isembard has lent us, and beg for work around the camp. Before long, the false priest should catch wind and approach us.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_40: I want you to don the old garments Isembard has lent us, and beg for work around the camp. Before long, the false priest should catch wind and approach us.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_41: In case you misplace the tunic and the slops, you'll need to ask Isembard for another set.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_KNERL_000_11: Hmph, another refugee, by the looks of you. The Immortal Flames have neither work nor coin for your like. Begone, and see to it you don't make a nuisance of yourself.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_KNERL_000_12: Ah, an adventurer. You are welcome at Camp Drybone, friend. I hope we can rely on your aid to preserve the peace in the area.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_SWAENHYLT_000_15: I preach the teachings of Azeyma, the Warden. Hast thou come to partake of the honey of Her wisdom?
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_SWAENHYLT_000_16: Azeyma is keeper of the sun and goddess of inquiry. All is laid bare beneath the light of Her divine countenance. Open thy heart to this light, needy child, and thou shalt want for naught till the end of days!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_SWAENHYLT_000_18: Azeyma is keeper of the sun and goddess of inquiry. All is laid bare beneath the light of Her divine countenance. Open thy heart to this light, adventurer, and thou shalt know true fulfillment!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_AURILDIS_000_21: Gods, not again... Look, being poor doesn't give you the right to pester whomsoever you like. Why don't you keep with your own kind out by that muddy pond of yours at Drybone?
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_AURILDIS_000_23: If you don't mind, I'm rather busy at the moment. Go and find someone else to pester.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ERMEGARDE_000_25: Greetings, good . Is there aught I might assist you with?
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ERMEGARDE_000_26: ...Oh. I...don't believe there is. I'm afraid our wares are very expensive. Mayhap you should rejoin your fellows out at the pond north of Sandgate.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ERMEGARDE_000_28: We stock only the finest wares. If you wish to make a purchase, our attendant at the counter will be glad to serve you.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ADELSTAN_000_30: <sigh> And I was about to get to the good part...
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ADELSTAN_000_31: Looking for work, you say? Sorry, but we don't have any openings. Now, get out of here so I can finish my story.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ADELSTAN_000_32: You've got a hunger, adventurer? Then you've come to the right place. You won't find better hot meals for malms around.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_50: You have quite a knack for being a nuisance, . The camp is abuzz with talk of newly arrived vagrants.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_51: And though we were unable to attract our wayward transgressor, we were able to learn that the poor have a commune by the pond north of Sandgate, to the east of here. The eyes of the authorities do not reach that place─rather ideal for spiriting away hapless souls.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_52: Let us go there and wait for the kindly priest to come and offer us aid and comfort. Needless to say you'll need to remain in disguise.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_60: A fine  for catching false priests, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_65: Hm? Why aren't you wearing the lovely soiled garments Isembard gave you? Dressed as you are, our quarry will sense that something is amiss before he's within nabbing distance.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_66: In case you've accidentally disposed of the tunic and slops, you'll need to ask Isembard for another set.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_70: You look absolutely smashing, ─positively dressed for deception. All that's left, then, is to wait for our quarry to appear.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_71: (-???-)Oh, you poor, unfortunate souls. This is no way for men to live. No way at all.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_72: Who are you? What do you want?
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_73: (-???-)Be at ease, child, for I mean you no harm. I am a priest of the Order of Nald'thal, and I come to offer you succor.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_74: (-???-)This leaflet bears the teachings of Nald. Trust to them, and they will surely set you free from the shackles of penury!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_75: Hmmm... A tempting offer, but I'm afraid I must decline...
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_76: ...On account of that atrocious performance. You would have made a gods-awful mummer, Ungust.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_77: Wh-What!? How did you know─!? Y-You bastards tricked me!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_78: P-Please don't hurt me! I was only doing it to protect my people!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_80:
V-Very well...
I'm a man of the Golden Bazaar. Raised there, if not born.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_81: Some moons ago, the Amalj'aa raids began. They would appear sudden as a sandstorm, and plunder and pillage at will. Our defenders couldn't stand against them, few as they were. Everyone lived in fear.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_82: I wanted to save my people, but being a merchant was all I knew. And so I did the only thing a merchant could─I approached the Amalj'aa in hopes of brokering a deal.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_83: In return for sparing the Golden Bazaar, they made demands─outrageous ones.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_84: Demands? Of what kind, pray tell?
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_85: First of all, they wanted the schedule for crystal shipments from the Nanawa Mines. For this, I bribed one of the workers to leak me the information.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_86: Next, they wanted me to bring them people. So, I posed as a priest to lure in the vulnerable and give them over to the Amalj'aa. I...I didn't have a choice...
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_87: Protecting one's home is a noble thing...but at the cost of innocents? You could have sought the aid of the Immortal Flames, yet you did not. I suspect you are not telling me the full story. What made you sell out your own people? Speak!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_90: The coin was good, I said! I could sell mole meat for a score of lifetimes and not see even a fraction of what the Amalj'aa pay me!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_91: You sacrificed innocents so that you could line your own pockets? Words fail to express the contempt I feel for you.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_92: Spare me your contempt! If you want to blame someone for the mess the world's in, then blame yourselves or the gods!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_94: Were you the one leaking the Immortal Flames' patrol routes to the enemy as well? Spit it out!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_UNGUST_000_95: Nooo! I know nothing about that! I swear it!
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_96: At this stage, I'm rather disinclined to believe aught that leaves your mouth. But no matter. There'll be time enough to learn the truth.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_98: . Be a  and take word of these developments to Minfilia, would you?
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_99: I shall prise everything I can out of this filth.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_THANCRED_000_100: The abductees are still somewhere out there. Our foremost priority is to rescue them.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_MINFILLIA_060: Welcome back, . I am pleased that you and Thancred have been getting along.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_MINFILLIA_061: I see... You have done well to uncover the truth. My thanks for the report.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_MINFILLIA_062: As Thancred said, we must ascertain where the abducted were taken...and none but the Amalj'aa know the answer.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_MINFILLIA_063: Suffice it to say they will not willingly part with this information. I fear blood will be spilled before all is said and done.
TEXT_SUBWIL129_00574_ISEMBARD_000_110: Misplaced your disguise, you say? I will give you loan of another set, but do take better care of it.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_MOMODI_000_1: Well, younglin', how are you findin' our fine Ul'dah, then? Got your bearin's about you yet?
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_MOMODI_000_2: If so, mayhap it's time you ventured beyond the city walls. The bustlin' streets of Ul'dah are one thing, but the wilds of Thanalan─that's another altogether.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_MOMODI_000_3: I know a bloke you might fancy speakin' to, and he you. Name of Papashan. You'll find him over at the Ul'dah Dispatch Yard. No doubt he'll have some work for you.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_MOMODI_000_4: The Dispatch Yard's over in central Thanalan. Just head out the door across the hall and you'll see the Gate of Nald staring right back at you. Pass through it and head east. You'll come upon it 'fore long.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_MOMODI_000_5: There's dangers beyond the wall, though. More than I'd care to count. Nothin' too terrible, mind you, but feisty enough to attack if you draw near. Don't say nobody cared enough to warn you.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_10: Well, you certainly look the part of an adventurer, my friend. Might you be the good soul Momodi advised me to expect, hm?
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_11: I am Papashan, stationmaster of this humble Dispatch Yard.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_12: An empty title, I assure you. I truly am no more than a tired old Lalafell passing his final years in quiet and solitude.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_13: Twelve know there have been plenty of both these last five years since the Calamity struck. The devastation...was vast.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_14: Yet now true Ul'dahns work together, doing all in our power to rebuild what was laid to ruin. By the sweat of our brows and the love of our home, we have rebuilt Ul'dah to the grandeur and majesty that you see today.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_15: The railways which run through this Dispatch Yard, too, were born of the noble efforts of a great many souls.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_16: But there is still much work to be done. The wounds left by the Calamity run deep. Isolated areas beyond our lines of supply remain, and there are places yet wanting for relief and restoration.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_17: Ul'dah needs the aid of you and your brethren, friend. In fact, never has our need been more dire.
TEXT_SUBWIL027_00595_PAPASHAN_000_18: Which brings me to the point, I suppose. I do believe I may have some work suited to one of your ability.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_1: Let us get right to it, then. Minfilia names the Amalj'aa culprits in all this. You would do well to investigate them, first.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_2: Much harm has been levied on these lands by Amalj'aa hands. The Flames burn where they might, but their light cannot stay the darkness in all places at all times.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_3: There have been brutal murders of callers at the Church of Saint Adama Landama─innocents wishing no more than to pay their respects to the dead.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_4: The poor souls deserve a proper burial. I would see to the deed before mongrels catch their scent, but I know not if the Amalj'aa still linger.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_5: Would you secure their remains for me, friend? You will find them on the eastern road.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_6: Twelve willing, you may even come to learn something of what the Amalj'aa seek in this area.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_010: It is good to see you returned. Were you able to secure the remains of our fallen?
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_011: With the bodies given back proper to the earth, the souls will find their way across to the other side. You have done a noble deed this day. I thank you.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_012: Now, then, what of the Amalj'aa? Did you see any? Surely such massive monstrosities as they cannot conceal their presence, much less take their quarry unawares.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_013: Ah, so there were Amalj'aa remaining, after all... I feared as much. Their part in the lowborn disappearing is all but confirmed. But I sense there is more to this than meets the eye.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_014: The occasional Amalj'aa raiding party would not account for people going missing in these kinds of numbers. The total is too great, and the questions too many. It would not surprise me in the least to learn of another hand in this.
TEXT_SUBWIL110_00618_ISEMBARD_000_015: But whose? Countless travelers pass through Drybone every day. And even if it were one among them, how would we best discover who may be implicit in these vanishings?
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_ISEMBARD_000_1: What say we turn an eye to the commonfolk themselves? It may be among them that we find the reasons for these vanishings, Twelve forbid it be so.
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_ISEMBARD_000_2: There is a merchant by the name of Ungust who was born here in Drybone and grew up in the Golden Bazaar. A...rough character, but he knows the people here better than anyone else.
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_ISEMBARD_000_3: I'd wager he's at the inn, quaffing away the day's earnings. Here, I'll write a note for you to show him, else he's not like to speak to you.
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_UNGUST_000_10: <belch> Well, gods be damned! You're that bloody adventurer who threatened me back in Ul'dah! What in the seven hells do you want with me now!?
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_UNGUST_000_11: “Dear friend... <belch> Missing people... Please help... <hiccup> Yours, Isembard.”
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_UNGUST_000_12: Folk around here are as wary as they come. They'll turn tail and run if you so much as pass wind nearby. Played them all for fools and coaxed some hard labor out of them, I did.
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_UNGUST_000_13: If anything, they're even more timid than before, what with all the disappearances. You can go talk to 'em yourself if you don't believe me.
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_UNGUST_000_20: The folk around here are more timid now than ever before, what with all the disappearances. You can go talk to 'em yourself if you don't believe me.
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_POVERTY1_000_30: Wh-What do you want from me!? I d-don't know anything, I swear! Please don't kill me!
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_POVERTY2_000_31: I've nothing to say but this: Thal take who─or whatever's been feeding off us low folk.
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_UNGUST_000_40: Just as I told you, wasn't it? The whole lot of them are terrified. <hiccup>
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_UNGUST_000_41: There's been talk of folk getting abducted, but if you ask me, they simply up and moved on to a better place. This place isn't exactly Costa del Sol, if you know what I'm saying.
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_ISEMBARD_000_50: Welcome back, . Have you learned aught of import?
TEXT_SUBWIL111_00619_ISEMBARD_000_51: I see... I suppose I should have expected as much from Ungust. Well, another thought occurred to me in your absence. The commonfolk are nothing if not fervent in their religious beliefs. Perhaps if they speak freely to their gods, then the clergy may know something of use.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_ISEMBARD_000_1: If we would know what the commonfolk speak of to their gods, we've no better place to ask than at the Church of Saint Adama Landama. It is a small and humble church, found to the northwest of here.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_ISEMBARD_000_2: And so long as you are headed there...might I ask you to deliver this embalmed corpse? A morbid request, I grant you, but it must be borne to burial, and I trust none more than you to see it done.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_ISEMBARD_000_3: Seek out a man named Marques─he tends the graves of the lichyard. He will tell you where the body is to be interred.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_MARQUEZ_000_10:
I am Marques, yes. A body? Of course...
There...there have been...so many bodies of late...
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_MARQUEZ_000_11: I... I apologize, . If you seek a place of burial, then there is an empty grave atop the ridge. Take the path and lay him to rest there.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_MARQUEZ_000_15: Bury him well and give his soul peace. Then we will talk.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_MARQUEZ_000_20: Did you bury him? You must pack the earth tight, or they will come... The mongrels will come and defile the body...
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_MARQUEZ_000_21:
May they all walk in Thal's realm...
...What? Missing people? I...I'm afraid I cannot help you.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_MARQUEZ_000_22: But maybe Sister Ourcen can. She has been kind to me. Everyone...everyone has been so kind.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_MARQUEZ_000_23:
I don't know why, though. I...
Pardon me. You will find Sister Ourcen within the church walls.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_MARQUEZ_028: It's all wrong. I...I should have...
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_OURCEN_000_30: I hear you have done us the service of burying a fallen soul. Please accept our gratitude, and extend it to Isembard when next you see him.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_OURCEN_000_31: Hm? You seek knowledge of missing Drybone inhabitants? It is true I am closer to the people than any other of the Order. I confide in them, and they in me. When they wish to speak to their keeper, Thal, I am the medium through which they do.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_OURCEN_000_32: Should I learn anything pertinent, I will be sure to share the information with you. <sigh> I only wish Marques would be more helpful in the matter. I pray he did nothing to offend. He saw...terrible things during the Calamity... His scars run deep. Indeed, he seems to now prefer the company of the dead over the living.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_OURCEN_000_33: While tragic, I fear such behavior ill befits the church. I received word not long ago that one of our recent visitors─a man called Thancred, I believe─took offense at his conduct. I must have words with Marques, and soon.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_OURCEN_000_40: Please extend my gratitude to Isembard on behalf of the Order.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_ISEMBARD_000_50: Thank you, . A burial is no easy thing─even when the departed is a stranger. Were you able to learn aught of the missing commonfolk?
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_THANCRED_000_51: You've been keeping yourself rather busy of late, haven't you, ?
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_THANCRED_000_52: A pleasure, my dear Isembard. The name is Thancred, and I share a passion with you and our mutual friend here for learning what has become of these missing persons and why.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_THANCRED_000_53: I, too, spoke with Ungust─more times than I care to count. There seems to be some truth to this notion of the commonfolk speaking their secrets only to those in service to the gods.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_THANCRED_000_54: Prostration, prayer, penance. Abject deeds done behind closed doors, away from prying eyes. Who better to take the pious unawares than she who takes confession─the good Sister Ourcen herself?
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_THANCRED_000_56: Even the most beautiful roses have thorns, my friend. And you would be wise to keep an eye to this rose.
TEXT_SUBWIL112_00620_THANCRED_000_57: Still, the lichkeeper Marques... I'd swear to the Twelve I've seen that face elsewhere before...
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_ISEMBARD_000_1: Sister Ourcen... It cannot be. Though, she is wont to travel to the Golden Bazaar on her own, and it is not uncommon to see her speaking to the children. But...no. It could not be she...could it?
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_ISEMBARD_000_2: Hmmm... <sigh> I grow weary of these suspicions. I know there is one child in particular that she is fond of. Pray seek out the boy, , and see if you cannot glean something from him about Ourcen's activities.
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_CHILD_000_10: Please help! Sister Ourcen went out all on her own and hasn't come back!
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_CHILD_000_11: She always reads to me right here, about Thal and the Order and the other side. I told her I lost my shiny thing and she went looking for it. But what if the monsters outside hurt her? Please find her!
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_CHILD_000_20: What if the monsters outside hurt Sister Ourcen? Please find her!
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_OURCEN_000_30: You... You are the one from the church. Thank goodness you arrived when you did. It seems my gratitude is yours yet again.
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_OURCEN_000_31: You spoke with the child? Yes, well, I was able to find his lost trinket. It is a ring given him by his mother before she passed. I will see it safely back to him.
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_ISEMBARD_000_60: Sister Ourcen was attacked outside the Golden Bazaar? Gods forfend... I will secure a room at the inn for her should she require any rest.
TEXT_SUBWIL113_00621_ISEMBARD_000_61: Searching for the mementos of orphans? And risking her own well-being in the doing, no less? Certainly not the dastardly deeds Thancred would have us believe.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_ISEMBARD_000_1: I am well glad I reserved that inn room for Sister Ourcen. It seems she received greater injuries from her attackers than she initially let on. Thankfully, she is expected to make a full recovery.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_ISEMBARD_000_2: But now, on to the matter at hand. Thancred came looking for you once more. He left word that he will be waiting at the Amalj'aa encampment to the southeast. I pray the two of you are able to uncover some evidence regarding these disappearances.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_10: Ah, there you are, . So good of you to come!
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_11: Indeed, I've heard all about good Sister Ourcen. Isembard said her wounds were serious. It would seem my suspicions about the poor rose were misplaced.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_12: But false though they were, perhaps my suspicions were not entirely without merit. Whilst following Sister Ourcen near the Golden Bazaar, a band of Amalj'aa caught my eye.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_13: I tracked them as far as this encampment, but... Well, let us say that I would much prefer to keep my distance and remain here. This, of course, brings me to why I requested you, dear . Would you be so kind as to take a look inside?
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_20: I'd much prefer to keep an eye on things from out here. Go and take a look about inside, would you?
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_30: Well? Did anything tickle your fancy?
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_31: This leaflet... “See the wealth of Nald to the hands of your children.” It looks to be some sort of assembly to provide the poor with work.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_32: The lettering, though... Atrocious, is it not? And these bits about Nald'thal seem somewhat...less than studied. I find it hard to believe one among the Order penned this.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_33: Pray take this to the inn at Camp Drybone. Let us see what Sister Ourcen makes of it.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_40: Now, let us see what Sister Ourcen makes of this leaflet.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_OURCEN_000_50: My savior comes again. To what do I owe the honor this day?
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_OURCEN_000_51: What is this? Blasphemous... These are not our teachings at all! This was not made by any true brother or sister of the Order─of that, I can assure you.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_OURCEN_000_52: Come to think of it, weeks ago, the church was plagued by missing garments. Could someone be posing as a priest of the Order to deceive the people?
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_OURCEN_000_60: Who would do such a thing?
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_70: The plot thickens, ! Our culprit pretends to be a priest to lend credence to his deception. There is no doubt an irony in there somewhere.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_THANCRED_000_71: But I suspect we have a worthy adversary on our hands. I shall consider how best to handle this. For now, tell Isembard what we have learned here.
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_ISEMBARD_000_80: Posing as a priest!? To think...
TEXT_SUBWIL114_00622_ISEMBARD_000_81: These troubling notions aside, it is gratifying to finally be able to move this investigation forward. Thank you once again, . I shall keep my ears and eyes open─now more than ever.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_000_1: Look what the coeurl dragged in. Good to see you, . I'd ask what brings you, but I reckon we both know the answer to that already.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_000_2: Well, have I ever let you down before? Wait, don't answer that...
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_000_3: So happens I know a fella by the name of Dadanen who needs a hand. He's a merchant by trade, sellin' precious stones to those in Ul'dah with the means to buy them.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_000_4: He's asked that I send any lookin' for work his way. You can find him over in Horizon, if you fancy.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_000_5: That's in western Thanalan, mind you. Just cross the bridge north of Scorpion Crossing and the road will take you there.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_100_5: Knowin' the circles he deals in, might be he'll have some talk of the royal family that'll interest you, as well.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_000_6: And why not make use of a chocobo porter for the journey to Horizon? If you've the gil for it, that is.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_000_7: You'll find the chocobo stables just across the way from my Quicksand. Find Mimigun─he'll set you straight.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_MOMODI_000_8: Well, off you go, then. I haven't got all day to be holdin' your bloody hand!
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_DADANEN_000_10: , I presume? Aye, Momodi said to expect you, and so I have.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_DADANEN_000_11: Welcome to Horizon. Ours is a trading settlement that sees goods in from the port of Vesper Bay to the west─and trade we do. Nary a day goes by that Horizon isn't bustling with some manner of merchants and officials.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_DADANEN_000_12: They keep us running about busy, they do. Enough so that I wish I had chocobo legs in place of my own. And that's why I've asked Momodi to send me any souls looking for work.
TEXT_SUBWIL026_00623_DADANEN_000_13: Twelve know there is plenty of it to be done around here. Speak to me again when you are ready to make yourself of some use.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_000_1: I salute you, honored friend. As acting captain, I should be much obliged if you would grant me a personal request.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_000_2: In our efforts to ascertain the full extent of the former captain's corruption, we have been poring over his personal correspondence.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_000_3: Our search unearthed this sealed letter addressed to a man named Owyne.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_000_4: But he is one of the Sultansworn elite! I can think of no reason why he should have any dealings with Baldewyn!
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_100_4: We now know that the former captain was consorting with a coalition of criminals... Could it be that Owyne was, too!?
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_000_5: This letter may well serve as evidence of their collusion, and so I dare not tamper with it myself.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_000_6: But given the events of recent days, I knew not whom to trust with this information─until now.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_000_7: I have chosen you, . Pray bear the letter to Mistress Momodi of the Quicksand, and relate the circumstances of its discovery.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_FUFULUPA_000_8: Not only is she a staunch supporter of the sultana, but she is well acquainted with the Sultansworn. She will know how best to proceed.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_10: Ah, ! It's been too long! Dadanen tells me you've been keepin' busy in Horizon.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_11: I want you to know that I'm grateful for everythin' you've done for the people of Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_12: Even though you've seen the seedier side of our city, you've continued to help your fellow man. Believe me, the folk around here love you for it.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_13: Hmmm? What is it? You look like you've got somethin' to say.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_14: ...So that's what this is all about.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_15: Fufulupa's thinkin' Owyne might've been in league with Baldewyn─that this letter could be proof of somethin' shady.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_16: Well he needn't worry. Owyne's as loyal a Sultansworn as I've ever known. I haven't the foggiest what this says, but─
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_17: Wait a minute. Wasn't Owyne the one who...?
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_18: Oh, hells... I've got a bad feelin' about this.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_19: Listen, ─I think I know what this is all about, but I need you to swear to keep it quiet.
TEXT_MANWIL006_00628_MOMODI_000_20: If you'd rather wash your hands of this business, I won't hold it against you. But if you're determined to see it through to the bitter end, say the word and I'll explain.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_OWYNE_000_1: By the Twelve, ! For an adventurer to receive a personal invitation from Her Grace is unprecedented!
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_OWYNE_000_2: Seats at these banquets are offered only to the most distinguished individuals. You will be dining with some of the most influential people in Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_OWYNE_000_3: There are, of course, certain protocols that must be observed.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_OWYNE_000_4: ...But I am no authority on them. Fear not, however─Mistress Momodi has long been responsible for familiarizing foreign guests with our customs.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_OWYNE_000_5: Pray return to the Quicksand and speak with her. She will tell you all you need know.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_OWYNE_000_10: My fellow Sultansworn and I must see to our own preparations. In the meantime, you should speak with Mistress Momodi. She will explain to you the protocols that must be observed by all in attendance.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_MOMODI_000_20: Welcome back, , and congratulations on your invite to the big soirée!
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_MOMODI_000_21: To be honest, I never imagined I'd be explainin' these procedures to you. It's usually only foreign dignitaries who get to hear me prattle on and on about royal traditions. Anyroad, I know you're a busy , so I'll keep it short and sweet.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_MOMODI_000_22: In accordance with ancient custom, all guests to this banquet are required to wear a pair of ceremonial earrin's, made 'specially for the occasion. They're meant to symbolize─ Actually, forget about that. This was meant to be the short version. Ahem. Bein' of a design unique to the occasion, the earrin's serve as a security measure. The Sultansworn won't let you near the hall without 'em.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_MOMODI_000_23: Your set should be ready and waitin' for you at the Goldsmiths' Guild. Mistress Serendipity is expectin' you, so you'll want to head down there now.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_MOMODI_000_24: Once you've got them, bring them back here and we'll continue.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_SERENDIPITY_000_30: Greetings! Is there something I can help you with?
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_SERENDIPITY_000_31: Ah, ! Your earrings are right here. I crafted them myself, I'll have you know. I think you'll be very pleased!
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_SERENDIPITY_000_32: In case Mistress Momodi didn't warn you, the box is locked, and I am not permitted to give you the key. It's a final safeguard, you see─only designated individuals are authorized to distribute the earrings to guests. In this instance, the person in question is none other than Mistress Momodi, so you will need to ask her to open the box on your behalf. Pardon the inconvenience, but the Sultansworn take Her Grace's safety very seriously.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_MOMODI_000_41: Let me just... <gasp> Well, now, looks like the guildmaster outdid herself with this pair!
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_MOMODI_000_42: You'd best take good care of these earrin's! If they fell into the wrong hands, gods only know what might happen!
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_MOMODI_000_43: Now then, I hope you're feelin' sociable, , 'cause you're about to hobnob with Ul'dah's elite! Let me know when you're ready to head to the banquet.
TEXT_MANWIL008_00641_Q1_000_050: Proceed into the Heart of the Sworn?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_3: The petitioner ought to be arrivin' any moment now...
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_4: Gods almighty! Another second under that sun, and I would have been set afire! A tankard of ale, if you would be so kind!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_5: Excellent timin', Papashan. It just so happens the adventurer who'll be handlin' your petition is here.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_6: Oh? Why, if it isn't my good friend !
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_7: It does my spirit well to know that you are the one who will be helping us.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_8: So this  is the much-lauded adventurer, is ? Marvelous, marvelous!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_9: A pleasure to make your acquaintance, . I am Papashan, formerly of the Sultansworn. I thank you for agreeing to lend us your aid.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_10: Mayhap you'd like to apprise  of  mission?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_11: Yes, of course. The petition in question was submitted by an acquaintance of mine at Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern. It relates to an unfortunate development at Copperbell Mines.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_12: To be plain, giants have seized control of the place.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_13: These giants are of the clan known as the hecatoncheires─fearsome creatures who were sealed within the deepest depths of the mines during the bygone Thorne Dynasty.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_14: Alas, it seems they have managed to break through the layer of rock which served to imprison them, and now prowl the tunnels where the miners ply their trade. The creatures are justifiably angry about their treatment at the hands of our ancestors, and their presence has forced the suspension of all mining activities on the site.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_15: It's no wonder they're angry. Didn't the Thorne Dynasty come to an end over three hundred years ago?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_16: You know your history well, milady.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_17: The people of that age used the hecatoncheires to work their mines. By way of enchanted helms, they were able to bind the ferocious creatures to their will. But as is oft the way in such tales, these enchantments eventually failed, and the slaves rose up against their masters.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_18: In a desperate bid to contain the unbridled fury of the hecatoncheires, our ancestors induced the collapse of the mines' lowermost levels. So it was that the Great Giant Revolt was ended─buried beneath a hundred thousand tonzes of rock.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_19: Well, now...that's got me thinkin'... I seem to recall there bein' an article about Copperbell in the Mythril Eye a fortnight or so ago.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_20: It said the mines were bein' reopened so as to meet the risin' demand for buildin' materials. Like as not, our boys dug a bit too deep and freed the giants.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_21: Gods...to think the poor creatures are still alive an' kickin' after three centuries... That's a long time to nurse a grudge. They must be seethin'...
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_22: Indeed. And that makes them a danger to us all. There will be no mining at Copperbell so long as they remain. For the sake of both peace and prosperity, they must be subdued. This is the task which we would have you undertake.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_23: Indeed. And that makes them a danger to us all. There will be no mining at Copperbell so long as they remain. For the sake of both peace and prosperity, they must be subdued. This is the task which we would have you undertake.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_24: I'll not deny that the mission will be rife with danger, but our need is great. And so I beg you: put an end to this sorry business.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_25: Gods bless you! I feared you might have reservations, but I assure you it is for the best.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_26: Hmmm... In case you don't know, Copperbell Mines are in western Thanalan. Do take care, you hear?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPASHAN_000_27: Ah, and one last thing before you depart... An employee of Amajina & Sons is presently at the Quicksand. The fellow's name is Painted Mesa, and he knows Copperbell Mines well. It may behoove you to seek his counsel.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_30: Lookin' for Painted Mesa? You found him.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_31: So you're the adventurer who's volunteered to deal with the mess down in Copperbell, are you?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_32: You've got guts, . I just hope you've got skills to go with 'em, 'cause things ain't pretty down there. The hecatoncheires've left the place in a right state, and nary a week after minin' resumed.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_33: I don't know if you know this, but Copperbell was old when the second Ul Dynasty was still young, and it was abandoned centuries ago. If it hadn't been for the shortage of materials needed for the rebuildin' effort, the Concern would never have thought to reopen it.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_34: We knew full well about the giants beforehand, but the project went ahead anyway. I mean, nothin' could possibly survive bein' buried under a mountain's worth of rock for three centuries, right? Wrong!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_35: Our miners dug up more than they bargained for. One swing of the pickaxe too many, and they found 'emselves in the company of giants. Unless we can subdue 'em, the nation's glorious recovery'll grind to a halt for want of aught to build with.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_36: The Stone Torches're keepin' watch over the entrance in case the giants fancy some sunlight and fresh air. One of 'em will be able to show you the way in. The hope of the nation's restin' on you, friend. Best of luck!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_STONETORCH_000_40: There's been an incident inside Copperbell Mines. We are here to ensure that its effects are contained, but for your own safety, I suggest you stay well away from here.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_STONETORCH_000_41: What? You're the adventurer who's volunteered to quell the hecatoncheires?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_STONETORCH_000_42: I didn't think that Papashan would be able to find someone so quickly...if at all.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_STONETORCH_000_43: The giants are content to wreak havoc inside the mines for now, but it's only a matter of time before they think to come outside. The sooner you see to them, the better. Make ready as best you can, and enter at will.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ISILDAURE_000_50: I have been an adventurer for long years, and borne witness to many a pivotal moment in history. Though the times may have changed, the essence of our trade has not.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ISILDAURE_000_51: Adventuring has ever been a quest for self-betterment through challenges freely faced, and ever shall it remain so.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ISILDAURE_000_52: As an adventurer becomes more experienced, he will naturally acquire a love of justice, and an understanding of the spirit of self-sacrifice.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ISILDAURE_000_53: Such experience cannot be measured in any tangible way, yet it most assuredly shapes who we are, grounded as it is in the decisions we have made on our journey, and their consequences, good or ill.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ISILDAURE_000_54: I sense a light within you, young one, and it tells me that you are destined for greatness.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ALIANNE_000_60: We found Dolorous Bear and his entire party dead. The giants were...thorough in their work.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ALIANNE_000_61: Judging by their tracks, it would seem they tried to rush a horde of the creatures. I cannot say for sure what drove an experienced crew like theirs to throw caution to the wind...but I do have my suspicions.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ALIANNE_000_62: We are all our own worst critics, and our desire to better past achievements can rob us of good sense. Thus do we become more given to recklessness.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_ALIANNE_000_63: While it is important to have goals, one must not fixate upon them to the exclusion of all else. Do so, and one will surely pay the price, as Dolorous Bear and his comrades did this day.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_65: The hope of the nation's restin' on your shoulders, friend. Send them giants back to whichever of the seven hells they escaped from!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_STONETORCH_000_67: Good luck in there, adventurer. We Stone Torches will continue our vigil here, lest the foe slip by you.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_Q1_000_1:
Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“Into a Copper Hell”?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_70: Ah, the conqueror of Copperbell returns!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_71: Thanks to you, our minin' operations can resume, and Ul'dah will have the materials she needs to rebuild. The entire nation's in your debt, friend.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAINTEDMESA_000_72: I'll share the good tidin's with Papashan the next time I see him. As for you, you'll want to report to Momodi. It'll do the woman well to see you alive and in one piece.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_101: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)Shut your mouth, you thieving little swine! You stole from me─don't even think to deny it!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_POORDRESS_000_102: P-Please, sir, I didn't steal nothin'!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_POORDRESS_000_103: I b-bought this─paid for it with me own coin!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_104: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)What rot! You refugees are all the same─couldn't afford maggoty mole meat, much less a choice cut of dodo!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_105: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)I'm going to say it one more time: give back what you stole, or I'll make you wish you'd never set foot in this town!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_106: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)By rights, I should turn you over to the Brass Blades, you know─help keep the streets safe for law-abiding citizens. But I'm a reasonable man. If you agree to serve me in...whatever capacity I require, the authorities needn't hear of your crime.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_POORDRESS_000_107: B-But I ain't done nothin' wrong! Twelve as me witness!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_POORDRESS_000_108: P-Please, adventurer! Help me, I beg o' ye!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_POORDRESS_000_109: I swear on me mother's grave, I didn't steal nothin'! I bought this with the coin I'd saved... <sob> I only wanted to treat me children to a decent meal...
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_110: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)And who the hells are you when you're at home!? This dog's master?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_111: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)I've had enough of this mummer's farce. You lot, teach them a lesson!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_HEAVY_000_120: I ain't gettin' paid enough for this!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_121: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)H-Hey! Where the hells do you think you're going!?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_POORDRESS_000_122: Thank ye, kind adventurer! Thank ye thrice over!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YOUNGULD_000_130: I'd swear there were more refugees than when I last looked...
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YOUNGULD_000_132: But it's been five years since the Calamity! Why are they only coming here now?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_133: It's simple, really─while a number of hamlets survived the immediate aftermath of the Calamity, many were no longer able to support their communities.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_134: The residents found their lands had either been rendered barren, or cut off from trade routes─and problems like those aren't easily solved. Though they tried to make the best of it, it was only a matter of time before they were forced to abandon their homes and seek a new life in the city.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YOUNGULD_000_136: But the Calamity affected the whole realm, didn't it? Is the same thing happening in the other cities?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_137: If the talk is true, yes.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_138: Though perhaps our situation is more pronounced. Ul'dah has a reputation for being prosperous, so it's natural that the refugees would try their luck here first.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YOUNGULD_000_139: My heart goes out to them, it truly does...but I would be lying if I said that I wasn't apprehensive. I hope their presence doesn't foment lawlessness in the city.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_140: Well, if things do take a turn for the worse, we always have the Immortal Flames. I daresay the Brass Blades would welcome their help.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YOUNGULD_000_141: The heroes who fought the Garlean Empire, patrolling the streets for riffraff?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_142: It may well come to that.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_143: Impoverished and desperate as they are, you may be sure that some of the refugees will turn to crime.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_144: You know what this place is like. If you've no coin, you've no hope.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YOUNGULD_000_145: <sigh> What will become of our city?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_RESTLESSULD_000_146: Not all refugees are bad, mind you. Some are able to find employment and lead honest lives.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_SALESPITCH_000_147: Dodo tenderloins! Get yer dodo tenderloins! Guaranteed cheapest in Thanalan!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_SALESPITCH_000_148: Thank ye for yer custom, madam! Please come again!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YOUNGULD_000_149: Looking around, you'd think that Ul'dah was well on its way to recovery.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YOUNGULD_000_150: But peer through the veil of prosperity and you'll see no end to the misery and suffering.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_161: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)Wh-What now!? You mean to threaten a defenseless citizen!?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_162: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)...What? Saw her buy that meat, you say? Th-That's absurd!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_AGENT_000_163: (-???-)Aye, as did I! Leave the poor woman alone, you damnable vulture!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_UNGUST_000_165: (-Obnoxious Merchant-)Grrr! I will overlook this...but just this once!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_POORDRESS_000_166: Gods bless ye, adventurer! If ye hadn't come along when ye did, who knows what that monster might've done!? It don't bear thinkin' about...
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPALYMO_000_172: We have been keeping a close eye on you ever since you left Gridania.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPALYMO_000_173: You discharged your duty as envoy impeccably, and never once faltered in the face of myriad dangers.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YDA_000_174: But more importantly, you were always ready to help those in need, even if you didn't stand to earn a gil by doing so!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPALYMO_000_175: You are possessed of all the qualities we seek in an adventurer, of this we are convinced.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YDA_000_176: Even if you were kind of dragged into that business with the dodo meat.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPALYMO_000_177: Yes, thank you, Yda. Ahem. And then there is the matter of your gift. I daresay you are curious as to the nature of the vision you bore witness to moments ago? Well, we can help you to understand it.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YDA_000_178: You're not the only one with that power, you know. We have a friend who has it too, and we'd love for you to meet her.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPALYMO_000_179: And meeting her is only the beginning, for we would also have you lend your strength to our cause. In return, we should be glad to assist your adventuring endeavors in whatever way we are able.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_PAPALYMO_000_180: Should you decide to take us up on our offer─and I sincerely hope you will─pray speak with Momodi. The proprietress of the Quicksand is a good friend of ours. She will tell you where to find us.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YDA_000_181: Waaait a minute─we haven't even told you the name of our order! We're the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, defenders of justice! Oh, but don't tell anyone. Except for Momodi. She knows already.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_191: It has been a while, adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_192: I have been watching you closely ever since you flew out of Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_193: You discharged your duty as the Admiral's personal envoy with admirable humility, and you have displayed unfaltering courage in the face of danger ever since.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_194: Whensoever you came upon those in need, you gave them succor with no thought of personal gain.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_195: In summary, you have demonstrated all of the qualities we seek in an adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_196: For reasons I cannot well explain, your every deed seems invariably to serve the general good...whether you mean it to or not. It is a happy knack, and one which speaks volumes for your character!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_197: Yet for all your admirable qualities, it is your gift which intrigues me most. I speak of the visions you experience. Visions like the one you had mere moments ago, if I am not mistaken. I can provide you with the means to understand them.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_198: An acquaintance of mine is blessed with the selfsame talent, you see... If you so desire, I can introduce you to her. She and I fight for a common cause─a cause which would greatly benefit for your support.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_199: If you would agree to lend us your strength, we should be glad to do all within our power to aid you in your personal endeavors.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_200: Think on my offer awhile. Should you decide to accept it, pray speak with Momodi. The proprietress of the Quicksand is a close friend and ally of ours.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_YSHTOLA_000_201: Inform her that you have been chosen by the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, and she will tell you where to find us.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_212: Pray do not mistake my intent─for it is always honorable─but I have been watching you ever since you departed Ul'dah.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_213: You played the part of envoy to perfection─confident as a  on a diplomatic mission should be, yet unfailingly courteous to your betters. And when your travels led you into the midst of danger, you faced it without so much as a flinch. You, my , are quite a marvel, and I confess to being  you!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_214: Ah, but my lavish praise continues. Most of all, I was struck by your readiness to aid those in need, even when words were all the reward you could expect to receive. Such selflessness is a rare thing in this day and age.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_215: ...All of which leads me to conclude that you are indeed the one whom I have been looking for─an adventurer possessed of a very rare set of qualities.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_216: To be sure, your rescue of that damsel in distress was more of a happy accident. But rescue her you did, and that is what matters in the end.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_217: I feel I should mention at this point that I also harbor a burning interest in a certain talent of yours. I speak of your visions. You have been experiencing visions, have you not?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_218: Well, it just so happens that I know a woman who shares your talent, and can help you to understand it. She and I belong to the same organization, and we should both be delighted beyond words if you would agree to join our cause.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_219: Naturally, there are benefits to being part of such a collective. For one, we should be glad to assist you in realizing your potential as an adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_220: You need not give me your answer now. Think upon it, and if you feel moved to help us─as I pray you shall─speak with Momodi, the ever-lovely and youthful mistress of the Quicksand.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_THANCRED_000_221: Tell her the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have found their , and she will tell you where to find us.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_230: Hmph. Scenes like that are becomin' ever more common, I'm afraid. Don't worry, though─if you work hard, you'll probably be all right.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_231: Sayin' that, if you ever find yourself in a spot of bother, come and see me. Just don't go pesterin' me every time you graze your knee, eh?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_232: ...'Course, I do enjoy hearin' tell of a gentleman's woes with the womenfolk from time to time...
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_233: Ah, ! Sorry to keep you waitin'─I was just providin' guidance to a fresh-off-the-carriage adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_234: But gods, it's good to see you safe and well! To look at you, no one would ever guess you'd been hard at it with giants in the dark!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_235: I never doubted for a moment that you'd succeed, of course, and neither did Papashan─which ain't to say he won't be overjoyed!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_236: You're every ilm the adventurer Miounne said you'd be, . The stationmaster will be overjoyed when he hears the news!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_237: Oh, before I forget, there's a lass here who wants a word with you. Didn't actually know your name, but hearin' her description, I knew who she meant right away.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_EDDA_000_238: Th-Thank you for sparing the time. I realize you don't know me, but I've been longing to speak with you for a while now.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_EDDA_000_239: My name is Edda. I'm an adventurer like you, though I'm not very good at being one, if truth be told. Anyway, I was adventuring with my friends in Gridania when...when... I-I'm sorry. We were in Gridania...when the leader of our party was killed.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_EDDA_000_240: His name was Avere, and he and I were to be wed in the spring. You may not remember him, but to say that he remembered you would be an understatement. He would sing your praises from dawn to dusk. He saw you for what you are, you see─an adventurer's adventurer─and swore that he would be like you one day.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_EDDA_000_241: I believe that he would have succeeded...had a fiend not robbed him of the chance. Since that day, I have thought long and hard about giving up adventuring.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_EDDA_000_242: But when I think of the  you are─of all that you've achieved─I find that I am inspired, just as Avere once was.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_EDDA_000_243: And so I've decided to start again as an adventurer. I will go back to the village of my birth and begin my training anew.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_EDDA_000_244: But I wanted to meet you first...to ask you your name.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_EDDA_000_246: Thank you, . I pray that we will meet again. Fare you well!
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_247: Adventurin' can be a cruel bleedin' business... Time was, I didn't know why anyone would bother. When they first asked me to take charge of the guild here, I didn't want aught to do with you lot─thought it'd be a right pain in the arse lookin' after you all.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_248: But against my better judgment, I decided to accept the post...and I'm full glad I did. I feel privileged to be a part of your lives.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_249: And that goes double for yours, !
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_250: ...Eh? What did you say? You want to know about the Scions of the Seventh Dawn?
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_251: They're beginnin' to move in earnest, then...
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_MOMODI_000_252: Listen, ─the Scions ain't no ordinary folk, and the work they do ain't no ordinary work. I know full well how capable you are, but even you would think twice about attemptin' some of the stuff they do. Knowin' that, if you're still certain you want to get involved, I'll tell you what I can.
TEXT_MANFST205_00660_QIB_HEAVYA_BATTLETA: <belch> I'll take care o' this. The rest o' ye can watch.
Ugh... I should've stopped at the seventh ale...
Stop bloody gawpin' at me and give me a hand, will ye!?
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_PAPASHAN_000_1: Since you've come all this way, perhaps you can perform an errand for me.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_PAPASHAN_000_2: It just so happens a number of sentries have been sent to guard the area. A dispatch to the Dispatch Yard, as it were.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_PAPASHAN_000_3: They have long been away from the shade and featherbeds of the city. The hot days and cold nights can play hells on the mind and body out here.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_PAPASHAN_000_4: It isn't much, but go and give them these twilight pretzels, would you? I find comfort food always helps when I feel like killing myself.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUA_000_10: Western front, clear! Eastern front, clear!
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUA_000_11: For me? From Papashan? A twilight pretzel... My favorite! How did he know!?
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUA_000_12: Can't fight on an empty stomach, now, can I? Actually...I can't fight on any stomach. I suppose you could say I have no stomach...for fighting.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUA_000_13: Brigands beware! The Sultansworn are here to serve and protect!
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUB_000_20: Halt! , I'm going to have to ask you to put the pretzel on the ground and place your hands above your head!
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUB_000_21: State your name and business! A twilight pretzel from Papashan? By the gods, forgive me! You could say this new post has my nerves in a...twist.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUB_000_22: I'm...I'm terribly sorry for that. Ahem, yes, well, you may rest assured that the Dispatch Yard is safe so long as I stand watch.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUB_000_23: Please give Papashan my thanks, and tell him that I only wish I could repay the favor...
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUB_000_25: Nothing to report, here. Peace reigns another day in central Thanalan.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUC_000_30: Twelve save me. Scorching days... Freezing nights... This post will be the end of me.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUC_000_31: A twilight pretzel? Don't mind if I do!
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUC_000_32: Ahhh, now that's a refreshing godsdamned pretzel! I feel reborn!
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_GINCHUC_000_33: <sigh> Much as I hate to say it, though, the pretzel does nothing to change the fact that these  are bloody intolerable...
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_PAPASHAN_000_40: You've returned─and with a deal fewer pretzels, I see! Tell me, how fare our Sultansworn sentries? Did they have anything to report, anything at all!?
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_PAPASHAN_000_41: What? Nothing? Are you sure? I...oh, oh dear.
TEXT_SUBWIL025_00671_PAPASHAN_000_42: Take this for your troubles, then. And stay a moment─there is more I would ask of you.
TEXT_SUBFST102_00673_SERPENT_000_1: I pray your meeting with the Elder Seedseer went well,  envoy. Correct me if I'm mistaken, but did you not also deliver a message to Admiral Merlwyb Bloefhiswyn of Limsa Lominsa?
TEXT_SUBFST102_00673_SERPENT_000_2: While you were there, did you happen to meet Baderon, the proprietor of the Drowning Wench? Gregarious gentleman, always happy to help his fellow man.
TEXT_SUBFST102_00673_SERPENT_000_3: Well, I am told that he has a task for a capable adventurer. I know not what the task entails, but I daresay the Flame General's personal envoy would make a fine candidate. If you are interested in learning more, pray speak with Baderon at his establishment.
TEXT_SUBFST102_00673_SERPENT_000_10: Should you decide to visit Limsa Lominsa, pray speak with Baderon at the Drowning Wench. The man has a task for a capable adventurer, and I daresay the Flame General's personal envoy would make a fine candidate.
TEXT_SUBFST102_00673_BADERON_000_20: Welcome to the Drownin' Wench! Sit wherever ye like, . I'll be with ye in a─
TEXT_SUBFST102_00673_BADERON_000_21: Hm? Aye, I'm Baderon, all right. Who's askin'?
TEXT_SUBFST102_00673_BADERON_000_22: Ah, 'eard as I've got a job fer a capable 'venturer, ye say? Well, yer bloody right!
TEXT_SUBFST102_00673_BADERON_000_23: Just so yer fairly warned, though, this ain't no job fer the faint of 'eart. Things're liable to get downright bleedin' 'airy. But if ye think yer still interested, let me know, an' I'll fill ye in on the details.
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_FLAME_000_1: Ah,  envoy. I trust your stay in the sultanate has been pleasant. Now, if you do not mind my asking, do you perchance have plans to visit Limsa Lominsa in the near future? If so, I have information that may be of interest to you.
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_FLAME_000_2: I once accompanied the Flame General on an official visit to the seaside city-state, during which time I became acquainted with Baderon, the proprietor of the Drowning Wench. Well, the man sent word just now that he has a job for a capable adventurer.
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_FLAME_000_3: I can think of none with better credentials than you. Baderon would doubtless be pleased were you to offer him your services.
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_FLAME_000_10: Baderon has need of a capable adventurer, and I can think of none with better credentials than you. If you are not otherwise occupied, perhaps you might consider offering him your services.
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_BADERON_000_20: Welcome to the Drownin' Wench! Sit wherever ye like, . I'll be with ye in a─
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_BADERON_000_21: Well, well, if it ain't the one an' only !
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_BADERON_000_22: I was told a distinguished 'venturer might be reportin' fer duty. Fancy that 'venturer bein' you, eh!?
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_BADERON_000_23: Hm? Aye, I'm Baderon, all right. Who's askin'?
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_BADERON_000_24: Ah, 'eard as I've got a job fer a capable 'venturer, ye say? Well, yer bloody right!
TEXT_SUBWIL141_00674_BADERON_000_25: Just so yer fairly warned, though, this ain't no job fer the faint of 'eart. Things're liable to get downright bleedin' 'airy. But if ye think yer still interested, let me know, an' I'll fill ye in on the details.
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_BADERON_000_1: Ready to 'ear about that job, then? Like I said, the request comes from our sister guild in Gridania.
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_BADERON_000_2: ...An' that's all I know. But whatever it is ye get asked to do, I some'ow doubt it'd pose any trouble fer a 'venturer as survived the bedlam in Sastasha.
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_BADERON_000_3: If ye think ye might be interested, ye'll want to 'ave words with Mother Miounne, me counterpart in Gridania. Good luck, !
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_MIOUNNE_000_10: Take a seat wherever you like, friend. Our waitress will come to take your─
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_MIOUNNE_000_11:
Oh, it's you, ! 'Tis so good to see you again!
...What's that? Here at Baderon's suggestion, you say?
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_MIOUNNE_000_12: The foul-mouthed rogue sends me word that an adventurer might be along for the job, and it turns out to be you! Well, this makes things a lot easier, doesn't it?
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_MIOUNNE_000_13:
Oh? Not here to dine? Dare I hope that you're the adventurer Baderon sent word about?
...You are!? The Matron be praised!
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_MIOUNNE_000_14: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Miounne, and the Carline Canopy is my place.
TEXT_SUBSEA150_00676_MIOUNNE_000_15: With regard to the task in question, there is a fair bit to tell. Let me know when you're ready to hear the details, and I shall brief you.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_4: Ready for that briefing? Good! Now then, here's the long and short of it...
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_5: Beg pardons for interrupting, Miounne, but our need grows ever more pressing. Have none stepped forward?
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_6: And good  to you too, Bowlord! Your need must be pressing indeed for you to honor us with a visit. The good news is: your journey hasn't been wasted. I'm pleased to report that we have a volunteer at last, and one who comes highly recommended, at that.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_7: Well, if it isn't our very own  for all seasons! You certainly have a knack for appearing when you're most needed, . My thanks for answering the call.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_8: My thanks for answering the call, friend. My name is Lewin, and I lead the men and women of the Gods' Quiver.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_9: Now, time is of the essence, so I shall proceed directly to the heart of the matter. We wish for you to nip a potential threat to Gridania in the bud.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_10: Beneath the Central Shroud, there lies an underground burial site called the Tam-Tara Deepcroft.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_11: The place was once a Gelmorran settlement, but we Gridanians have long interred our dead there.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_12: Of late, however, shadowy figures have been seen skulking about the Deepcroft, and with ever-increasing regularity.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_13: Based on the accounts of various witnesses, we suspect that these individuals belong to the Lambs of Dalamud, a doomsday cult which sprung up prior to the Calamity.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_14: These zealots have proven themselves dangerous in the past, and we leave them to their own devices at our peril.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_15: Ordinarily, I would have dispatched my best men to scour the Deepcroft with orders to flush the cultists out.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_16: Alas, the Calamity decimated our ranks, and the limited forces at my disposal are constantly required to keep the Ixal at bay.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_17: Since we thwarted their attack on the Guardian Tree, the birdmen have not allowed us a moment's respite. They have probed every ilm of our defenses in search of a weakness, compelling me to spread our forces far more thinly than I would like.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_18: The situation so being, we have no choice but to entrust the task of dealing with the Lambs of Dalamud to others. Can we rely on you to handle this matter, ?
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_19: The birdmen have grown restless of late, and I fear a storm may be brewing. In anticipation of this, I have been compelled to spread our forces throughout the Twelveswood, lest we be taken unawares.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_20: The situation so being, we must turn to others to deal with the Lambs of Dalamud. Can we rely on you to undertake this task, friend?
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LEWIN_000_22: Once you've seen to your preparations, pray make your way to the Deepcroft, and identify yourself to the guard posted at the entrance. He will apprise you of the latest developments. That is all.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_23: Be careful out there, you hear? May the Crystal guide you and keep you!
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_GODSQUIVERBOW_000_3: You're , I take it? Thanks for helping us out, friend.
No doubt the Bowlord has already informed you, but your task is to enter the Deepcroft and purge it of the Lambs of Dalamud.
In case you're unfamiliar with them, the cult emerged shortly before the Calamity put an end to the Sixth Astral Era.
The cultists took the lesser moon, Dalamud, for their god, believing that it would deliver them from the devastation.
And so they were rather disappointed when Dalamud exploded into a thousand flaming pieces before it could complete its descent.
Now, having seen their god turn to ash, one would think that the cultists might feel moved to question their faith. On the contrary, it served only to stoke the flames of their fanaticism.
The Lambs of Dalamud are convinced that “heretics”─that is to say, everyone but them─interfered with the coming of their lord and savior, and that it's now their sacred duty to avenge him.
Whatever it is they're doing in the Deepcroft, you may be sure that no good will come of it. For the sake of Gridania, and Eorzea at large, put an end to their madness.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_40: So we meet again! I cannot say I'm surprised to see you here.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_41: You took the prize back in Limsa, but this time we will give you better sport, or I am no true adventurer!
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_EMANAFA_000_45: Gods, I hate mausoleums... It's not right to disturb the dead in their slumber...
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_KIKINA_000_50: Think of our goal, sister! One day, our adventures will be the stuff of song, and it will all be worth it!
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_ISILDAURE_000_55: <pant> <pant> ...Childish curiosity prompted me to commit the most elementary of blunders.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_ISILDAURE_000_56: Were it not for the fruit that Alianne found, my adventures may well have ended in this forbidding place.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_ISILDAURE_000_57: Always look before you leap... In my haste, this most fundamental rule of adventuring slipped my mind. <sigh> I do believe I shall rest here awhile.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_ALIANNE_000_60: I shudder to think what might have happened to Isildaure had I not thought to pick the fruit I stumbled across on the way here.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_ALIANNE_000_61: Sometimes he has too much vigor for his own good. Age is supposed to mellow us, but if anything it has made him more impetuous.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_ALIANNE_000_62: I understand his desire to make use of the time left to him, but one misstep, and there won't be any.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_GODSQUIVERBOW_000_6: The Lambs of Dalamud are hells-bent on avenging their imaginary god, and will stop at nothing till their dark work is done.
They must not be suffered to desecrate the Deepcroft. For the sake of the souls laid to rest here, and all of Gridania, put an end to their madness.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_70: Welcome back, ! I'm reliably informed that your foray into the Deepcroft was a success.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_71: Nor did I expect anything less. You've made such a habit of succeeding that it's difficult not to take your talents for granted. Rest assured, however: Mother is impressed, even if she isn't surprised.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_72: Nor did I expect anything less. Baderon's ringing endorsement left me in little doubt as to your capabilities. Even so, you are to be commended.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_73: Bowlord Lewin asked me to pass on his thanks.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_74: I must say, it's something of a relief to be able to call upon such a capable adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_75: Sadly, death has become an ever more common occurrence within our fraternity of late. Times being what they are, the guild is constantly inundated with petitions, and we are hard-pressed to find enough hands to deal with them all.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_76: While this means no shortage of work for able souls such as yourself, it also provides ample opportunity for the inexperienced to overreach themselves─with predictable consequences. Ah...as if to illustrate the point...
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LIAVINNE_000_77: Avere's gone, and it's all your fault! If it hadn't taken you an age to heal him, he would still be alive!
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_EDDA_000_78: <sniff> B-But I tried! He bolted out of range before I could finish the spell!
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_EDDA_000_79: <sob> He shouldn't have been so hard-pressed in the first place... We should've done more to lighten his burden...
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_PAIYOREIYO_000_80: Bah! To the hells with this pathetic excuse for a party! I'm leaving, and it'd be too soon if I never see your faces again! Good-bye, and good riddance!
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LIAVINNE_000_81: I'm leaving as well. I doubt this comes as any surprise, but I never liked you. I only suffered you for your healing, but you couldn't even do that one thing right. Cruel though this may sound, you brought this upon yourself.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_LIAVINNE_000_82: Oh, and by way of some parting advice...get rid of Avere's head! Bury it, cremate it, do whatever the hells you like with it─but for gods' sakes, stop carrying it around! It's...it's just... Just get rid of it, all right!?
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_EDDA_000_83: W-Wait! Don't leave me alone! Please!
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_EDDA_000_84: <sob> I'm so sorry, Avere... Please forgive me...
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_85: Scenes like this have become all too common. That makes a dozen times in half as many days...
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_86: Now you see why I'm grateful for adventurers of your experience. I can send  like you on a mission without worrying that you might not return─well, not so much, at any rate.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_87: Speaking of missions, I would entrust you with another.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_88: About a bell ago, I received a message from my counterpart in Ul'dah. She seeks the services of a reliable adventurer, and you are nothing if not reliable.
TEXT_MANFST204_00677_MIOUNNE_000_89: If you think you might be interested in this task, say the word, and I will be glad to share the details with you.
TEXT_SUBFST103_00678_MIOUNNE_000_1: So, you're not averse to taking a little trip? Wonderful!
TEXT_SUBFST103_00678_MIOUNNE_000_2: As I mentioned earlier, the request comes to us from the Adventurers' Guild in Ul'dah. Once you arrive, seek out Momodi, the proprietress of the Quicksand. Think of her as the sultanate's version of myself.
TEXT_SUBFST103_00678_MIOUNNE_000_3: Chances are she'll send you into the midst of danger, but I have every confidence that you will pull through unscathed. Now, off you go, , and good luck!
TEXT_SUBFST103_00678_MOMODI_000_10: Welcome to the Quicksand, friend. I'm a tad busy right now, if you wouldn't mind showin' yourself to─
TEXT_SUBFST103_00678_MOMODI_000_11: Oh, it's you, ! And there I was, spoutin' the same tired line!
TEXT_SUBFST103_00678_MOMODI_000_12: Judgin' by your determined expression, I take it you ain't here for ale. Are you called , by any chance?
TEXT_SUBFST103_00678_MOMODI_000_13: Miounne sent word that you'd be reportin' for duty. She also made a point of callin' you the adventurer of the moment. That ain't no small praise, comin' from her.
TEXT_SUBFST103_00678_MOMODI_000_14: But you didn't come all the way here to listen to my prattle. Doubtless you're eager to get started, so let's talk business, shall we?
TEXT_MANFST302_00680_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: Ah, I take it the Elder Seedseer's words have touched your heart. Have you resolved to entwine your destiny with that of the Twin Adder?
TEXT_MANFST302_00680_Q1_000_1: Join the Order of the Twin Adder?
TEXT_MANFST302_00680_SERPENTOFFICER_000_: You have chosen wisely, my friend! The Elder Seedseer will be overjoyed!
Without further ado, let us speak of practical matters. In order to complete the enrollment procedure, you must report to .
. Give your name to the personnel officer there, and he will guide you through the formalities.
I have no doubt but that your deeds will bring great honor to our order. When next we meet in Gridania, I shall be proud to call you !
Ah...forgive me. In my eagerness to embrace you as a , I mistook your intention.

TEXT_MANFST303_00683_SERPENTPERSONNEL_00: Protocol requires that I apprise you of who we are and what we do, after which I will invite you to swear an oath of your own free will. Ahem!
The Order of the Twin Adder is the Grand Company of Gridania.
It brings together the martial, economic, and technological resources of our nation, that we might stand strong in times of direst adversity, when our very survival hangs in the balance.
Our order was formed in the days before the Calamity, in readiness to fight the Garlean Empire, and to combat the beast tribes and their primals. Needless to say, our struggle continues to this day.
Elder Seedseer Kan-E-Senna is the supreme commander of our forces. Under her wise leadership, we protect the people of Gridania and the sanctity of the Twelveswood.
As the entwined serpents that grace our standard, let forestborn strive as one with friends from afar to ensure that peace shall ever reign in Gridania.
In so doing, we honor the will of the elementals, and theirs is the will of the wood.
Now then, , I ask that you give unto us your oath of allegiance, in whatever fashion you see fit.

The Elder Seedseer is a kind and gentle soul who holds the welfare of her people above all else. Your faith in her is well placed.
The elementals need not words to know your heart, and there is no doubt in mine own that you will prove a stalwart servant to them.
By the power vested in me, I assign you the rank of serpent private third class.
You are now a  of the Order of the Twin Adder. Go forth, Private , and do that which brings peace to the Twelveswood and honor to our name.
