TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_STORMPERSONNEL_000_: Let us start afresh, shall we?

You are welcome here, . That such a well-respected adventurer would choose to join our ranks is most heartening. Before you swear your allegiance to us, however, it is only right that I tell you exactly what it is that you will be joining.

A Grand Company is more than simply a collection of soldiers. It is an all-encompassing organization which draws upon the resources of an entire city-state to form a united military force capable of standing against a nation's deadliest enemies.
We of the Maelstrom are charged with meeting the threats posed by the primals and the Garlean Empire, and solving the many problems caused by the Calamity.

Every man and woman who serves under our colors has a role to play in keeping the great warship that is Limsa Lominsa afloat, and on whatever heading Chief Admiral Merlwyb Bloefhiswyn sees fit to set.
As part of this grand vessel's crew, you will be expected to take your turn at the oars─for the winds do not look favorable, , and strength of arm may be all that sees us safe to port.

...If I've lost you with talk of ship and oar, let me put it another way: a Maelstrom soldier labors till  last breath, fights till  last drop of blood. We give our all in service to this nation, and no less is expected of you.
─it is customary for new recruits to swear an oath of their own choosing upon entering the Maelstrom's ranks. Is there aught you'd like to say?
TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_A1_000_1: You have my sword till sea swallows all!
TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_A1_000_2: What skills I have are yours, till sea swallows all!
TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_A1_000_3: I will follow the Admiral to the very bottom of the abyss!
TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_STORMPERSONNEL_000_: And I've no doubt we'll need it! Keep your weapons close to hand, .
Ah yes, the many and varied skills of the adventurer! I've no doubt that your travels have furnished you with such knowledge as will prove invaluable to our cause.
As would we all! A capable crew is one thing, but unswerving loyalty is a trait that cannot be trained or bought. Well said, .
No love for grandiose proclamations, eh? Ha! Such silent resolve is not uncommon among the brothers and sisters of the sea.
, I hereby assign you the rank of storm private third class. You are now officially a soldier of the Maelstrom.
Welcome aboard, Private. May you serve Limsa Lominsa well, till sea swallows all.
TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_MINFILIA_000_20: Can you hear me, ? This is Minfilia.
TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_MINFILIA_000_21: An officer of the Maelstrom contacted me with news of your enlistment. My congratulations, Private .
TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_MINFILIA_000_22: I have no doubt that you are eager to make the acquaintance of your new comrades, but I would ask that you pay a visit to your old ones first. Remember: though you are now a  of the Storm, you are no less a Scion! Pray return to the Waking Sands at your earliest convenience. There are some friends here whom I would very much like you to meet. We shall be waiting!
TEXT_MANSEA303_00684_STORMPERSONNEL_000_: No rest for the wicked, eh?
Before you make yourself scarce, I recommend having a word with Commander Rhiki. Might be worth your while...

TEXT_MANWIL303_00685_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_: Are you ready, ? Then let us begin.
─you stand poised to enter a sacred trust.
The Flames of Ul'dah burn bright, casting light where there is dark and purging evil wheresoever it lurks.
We are ever ready to meet the nation's enemies in battle, be they beastmen, Garleans, or worse.
And at a word from Flame General Raubahn Aldynn, we would gladly lay down our lives to maintain the peace and prosperity of Ul'dah.
To join our ranks, you must forsake all other nations. Only then may you commit yourself to the fire and be reborn as an Immortal Flame.
Burn as one of us, , and together we shall chase the darkness from Ul'dah!
Will you swear an oath to mark this occasion?
TEXT_MANWIL303_00685_A1_000_2: What skills I have belong now to Ul'dah!
TEXT_MANWIL303_00685_A1_000_3: I will follow the Flame General unto death!
TEXT_MANWIL303_00685_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_: Spoken like a soldier! You'll do well here.
And Ul'dah will have need of them in the days ahead. The knowledge and experience of well-traveled adventurers are valuable assets.
Hah! The Flame General would lead the van in every battle if he could. 'Twouldn't surprise me if you had the chance to fight by his side one day!
I take it you would rather be judged by your deeds. I respect that. We want a  of action, not words.

Very well. Your resolve is plain.
─I hereby confer upon you the rank of flame private third class.
Welcome to the Immortal Flames, Private.
May you fight to the last for coin and country.
TEXT_MANWIL303_00685_MINFILIA_000_20: Can you hear me, ? This is Minfilia.
TEXT_MANWIL303_00685_MINFILIA_000_21: An officer of the Immortal Flames contacted me with news of your enlistment. My congratulations, Private .
TEXT_MANWIL303_00685_MINFILIA_000_22: I have no doubt that you are eager to make the acquaintance of your new comrades, but I would ask that you pay a visit to your old ones first. Remember: though you are now a Flame of Ul'dah, you are no less a Scion! Pray return to the Waking Sands at your earliest convenience. There are some friends here whom I would very much like you to meet. We shall be waiting!
TEXT_MANWIL303_00685_FLAMEPERSONNEL_000_: It seems your presence is required elsewhere.
But before you leave, perhaps you could find a moment to speak with Commander Swift. He is not one to see new recruits go into the field unprepared.

TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_GHIMTHOTA_000_1: . In light of your role in recent events, there are few others to whom I would entrust this task.
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_GHIMTHOTA_000_2: Since last we spoke, a curious missive has been discovered amongst the personal effects of Ahtzapfyn, the pirate behind the plot to sabotage the Victory.
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_GHIMTHOTA_000_3: This missive was penned in the most unusual script─a script we believe to be some manner of code.
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_GHIMTHOTA_000_4: Needless to say, anything which a proven enemy of Limsa Lominsa deems worthy of enciphering is like to be of great interest to the Maelstrom. Unfortunately, none among us can make any sense of the message.
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_GHIMTHOTA_000_5: In cases such as this, I am told the Yellowjackets are wont to turn to Baderon and his convenient...connections.
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_GHIMTHOTA_000_6: Thus I would have you deliver this missive to the proprietor of the Drowning Wench. Into his hand, and no other, do you understand?
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_20: Ahoy there, ! I've been 'earin' about your deeds at the Drydocks!
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_21: Ahtbyrm laid out the entire tale fer me. Poor sod was still reelin' at 'is old man's part in the business, but at least ye kept the Victory from bein' sunk afore she'd sailed.
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_22: An' fer that, I owe ye me thanks!
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_23: Ye've really made a name fer yerself 'ere in Limsa, . Folk know that when they need summat doin'─
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_24: Eh? You need summat doin'? An' what might that be?
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_30: ...Ye want someone to read a message writ in funny letters fer ye? An' Ghimthota thought I might know a man as could? Well, let's see it, then!
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_32: ...I reckon I might know a canny bugger what can read stuff like this. Ugly sod by the name o' Baderon.
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_33: Ye know, yer like one o' me regulars now, .
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_34: Ye've never let me down yet, an', Navigator 'elp me, I reckon I can trust ye.
TEXT_MANSEA006_00689_BADERON_000_35: Ghimthota was right to want this message deciphered... We've got us some trouble brewin', 'ere, an' no mistake. Get ready fer action, an' I'll explain.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_REYNER_000_1: I am not sure you understand just how unusual it is for the Admiral to invite an adventurer to a state banquet.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_REYNER_000_2: It is a highly coveted honor. Why, even the officers under her direct command are rarely afforded such recognition!
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_REYNER_000_3: But I will not deny you have earned it. Many of the tasks you have performed in service to the thalassocracy have been both difficult and dangerous.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_REYNER_000_4: This is a reward for all of your efforts─a nod to your many achievements, both large and small.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_REYNER_000_5: Has the enormity of this moment yet to sink in? Perchance you will realize its significance when you stand before the assembled dignitaries of Limsa Lominsa! ...And now that I have imagined the scene, I realize that you will require attire suitable for the occasion.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_REYNER_000_6: I suggest you visit the Wench and see what Baderon can arrange. He is surprisingly knowledgeable about such things.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_10: Well, well...if it ain't Merlwyb's guest of 'onor! 'Obnobbin' with the 'igh an' mighty, now, is it?
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_11: I tell ye, , I damn near snorted ale out me nose when I 'eard the news. Ye've come a long bloody way, you 'ave, an' that's the truth.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_12: Well, one thing's fer sure─ye'll not want fer decent grub. These banquets are catered by the bleedin' Bismarck, no less.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_13: 'Tis a grand chance to fill yer belly to burstin' with fine an'─more importantly─free food.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_14: But we can't have ye turnin' up in yer shite-caked 'venturin' gear.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_15: No, the 'ero o' the hour needs to 'ave a touch o' refinement about ─if only to stop folk complainin' when  stuffs  face with cake. Take yerself over to the Octant an' speak to J'nasshym o' the Brugaire Consortium. She'll furnish ye with summat  to wear.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_16: I've already 'ad a word with 'er, so all ye need do is pick up the goods, then bring 'em back 'ere, so as I can tell ye what's what.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_JNASSHYM_000_20: Good , . I assume you're the underdressed  Baderon mentioned?
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_JNASSHYM_000_21: <sniff> I see he was not exaggerating...
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_JNASSHYM_000_22: Ahem. I've chosen these especially for your debut in polite society. Fear not, I'm certain you will absolutely adore them.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_30: Been to see J'nasshym, 'ave ye? Let's 'ave that box, then.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_31: 'Ere we go...a nice pair o' dress shoes fer ye.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_32: A  mightn't 'ave much else to  name, but so long as  got a decent pair o' shoes on  feet, there ain't nowhere  can't go.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_33: Think of 'em as a gift from me an' all the other folk ye've done right by along the way.
TEXT_MANSEA008_00690_BADERON_000_34: Aye, aye...'tis a very movin' gesture, I know. Just don't go wellin' up on me, eh? Wouldn't do fer Limsa's new 'ero to turn up at the banquet soaked in  own tears an' snot. Anyroad, that's yer garb sorted. Now, ye just need to settle yer nerves. Tell me when yer ready, an' I'll tell ye where yer meant to go.
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_ROLFE_000_000: Come to learn a thing or two about the sylphs, have you? I'll tell you one thing, they're a peculiar folk. How peculiar, you ask? Well, just let me tell you!
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_ROLFE_000_001: They're... They're... Er... <sigh> Beg pardon, friend. My memory's just not what it used to be. I've seen much and more in my adventuring days, and it's all a clutter in my noggin now. Though, I've shared my stories with those around the hut before. You might have more luck with them.
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_YSABEL_000_010: The sylphs? Yes, Father's told me his stories plenty of times. What I've always found most captivating is how their concept of etiquette is almost completely alien to our own.
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_YSABEL_000_011: You'd do best not to underestimate them on account of their childlike looks, lest your face end up a mess of glyphs, squiggles, and chocobo scratches. Tee hee!
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_BLAISETTE_000_015: The quickest way to a Quiverwoman's heart might be through her stomach, but don't even think of trying to foist your foodstuffs on a sylph. They sustain themselves simply by bathing in the sun, or so Rolfe once told me.
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_MONNE_000_020: The sylphs? Inveterate tricksters and troublemakers, that's what they are! One day they're drawing morbol faces on our masks, the next they're sending our young sentries falling to the bottom of a ravine!
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_MONNE_000_021: Tell them to stop and they just laugh at you. Rolfe claims they harbor no ill will, but I daresay such pranks are no laughing matter.
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_ROLFE_000_030: Oh, of course, of course! Hearing your stories─well, my stories─has brought the memories flooding back to me. I feel...I feel like dancing!
TEXT_GAIUSA003_00709_ROLFE_000_031: Yes, nothing brings people together quite like a little toe-tapping. A sylph told me long ago that dancing is a time-honored greeting among their kind. You'd do well to remember this─it just may help win the favor of our forest friends.
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROLFE_000_000: Oh, still here, eh? Great! There's one more thing you should know about the sylphs. They don't take kindly to guests who show up empty-handed. To earn their trust, you'd do well to bring along a...a... Uh...
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROLFE_000_001: Drat! What was it, again? And my wife Rosa and I were just speaking of the matter not days ago...
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROLFE_000_002: Forgive me, friend. Speak to Rosa at the Comb─her memory should prove more reliable than mine own.
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROSA_000_010: A peace offering for the sylphs? Were it anyone else, I'd recommend a jar of honey, but I fear that wouldn't get you past their front doorstep, dear. No, their tastes run more to the unusual.
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROSA_000_011: Are you, perchance, familiar with milkroot? That's what we call the root of that most fiendish seedkin, the ochu. When chewed, it exudes a cloudy liquid that's said to induce curious visions in the imbiber. You'd not catch me dead trying the stuff, but the sylphs seem to enjoy it to no end.
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROSA_000_012: I've not seen an ochu around the Comb in quite some time, but I did encounter a suspicious clump of grass the other day. Were you to stimulate it somehow─with some of this amber syrup, for example─you might be surprised at what comes out. Good luck.
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROLFE_000_030: Ah, you're back. Was my wife able to direct you to a suitable offering?
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROLFE_000_031: Milkroot! But of course! Those sylphs quaff that cloudy stuff as quick as I do a flagon of mead. The effect's just about the same, as well.
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_ROLFE_000_032: Anyroad, a gift of milkroot will have the sylphs calling you friend and  the moment they lay eyes on it. Now let me wrap that up for you─I'm startin' to feel a bit woozy...
TEXT_GAIUSA004_00710_POP_MESSAGE_000: With branches a-thrashing, the vegetation springs to life!
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_ROLFE_000_000: I've taken the liberty of wrapping your milkroot well and good. This should keep it nice and fresh, not to mention spare you from that gods-awful stench.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_ROLFE_000_001: The sylphs love the stuff, but me, I'd rather bury my nose in chocobo dung. I daresay the reek even rivals the breath of the morbol that put an end to my adventuring days!
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_ROLFE_000_002: But I can tell you that story another time. You've more important matters to attend to today, yes? The sylphs are an eccentric bunch, but I've shared their company enough to know they're kind at heart. They'll not shun one whose intentions are true.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_ROLFE_000_003: May your parley be a fruitful one, friend. And do stop by on your return─there's a flagon of Fullflower mead with your name on it if you'd regale me with your adventuring tales.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_ROLFE_000_004: Ah, and afore I forget, don't go traipsing off just yet. Amelain here would have a word with you. Travel in safety, friend, and do pass along my regards to the winged ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_AMELAIN_000_010: It's good to see your knowledge of sylphic culture has matured. I see no reason to delay your mission any further.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_AMELAIN_000_011: Upon your arrival at Little Solace, seek out a young sylph by the name of Komuxio. He has served as an intermediary between our peoples on many an occasion, and has the close ear of his tribe's elder.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_AMELAIN_000_012: I see that Hawthorne has furnished you with some of that malodorous root the sylphs so adore. I have something of far greater import for you to deliver─a missive from the Elder Seedseer herself.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_AMELAIN_000_013: To summarize the letter's contents in brief, it vouches for the integrity of our envoy─that would be you─and restates Gridania's desire to maintain a harmonious relationship with our long-standing friends of the forest.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_AMELAIN_000_014: The war with the Ixal has taken a toll on our resources; we can ill afford to get mired in another conflict. I need not impress upon you any further the importance of this mission. May the Twelve see you return with good tidings.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_020: Walking one is not familiar to this one. This one does not trust strange walking ones. Strange dancing ones might be a different story, but this one expects no such thing. Walking one should go home, and leave this one be.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_030: Walking one would talk to this one? This one does not talk to rude ones. Walking one comes to the abode of these ones, walking one should pay proper respects.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_031: This one would welcome walking one who moves like these ones. If walking one would talk to this one, this one will answer. This one is a busy one, so walking one should speak with quick tongue.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_032: This walking one is foolish one. Walking one should go home before this one becomes angry.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_040: Walking one would bring gift to this one? Walking one is most kind.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_041: Walking one brings milkroot! Milkroot fills this one with great joy!
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_042: This one gives thanks. Gives many, many thanks.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_100: Walking one carries message for elder one? This one will deliver the message to elder one. Walking one should not worry.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_YDA_000_101: Hello there! We're envoys from Gridania, and we're here to treat with your people!
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_PAPALYMO_000_102: Aye. We come to pay our respects to your elder, and to learn from him more of your Lord Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_103: Who are these ones? These walking ones come from Gridania?
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_104: Walking one became a dancing one and brought milkroot, but walking one tricks this one! This one does not like tricks!
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_105: This one will speak no more. Elder one is busy. Walking ones should go home.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_YDA_000_106: G-Go home, you say!? But the sylphs of Little Solace have always welcomed Gridanian envoys with open wings!
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_PAPALYMO_000_107: The letter carried by  here is an oath of peace penned by the Elder Seedseer herself! Still you would refuse us?
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_KOMUXIO_000_108: This one's reasons are no business of walking ones. Elder one has no words for Gridania. Walking ones waste every one's time.
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_YDA_000_109: Well, I never! Turned away at the gates! Whatever did we do to deserve such a rude welcome? Was 's jig insufficiently jiggy?
TEXT_GAIUSA101_00715_PAPALYMO_000_110: I'm as baffled as you, but something tells me recent events have our erstwhile fluttery friends feeling uncommonly wary. It would seem we've no choice but to ask around and see how we might earn their trust.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_000: This one asks dancing one for forgiveness. These ones have many troubles since walking ones last came to our abode. This one must be careful. Always careful.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_001: But dancing one is not like other walking ones. This one can trust dancing one. This one would ask dancing one for help.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_002: Strange walking ones with bodies of steel come to the home of these ones. This one thinks steel ones come from Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_003: Where Empire goes, many living ones become dead ones. Trees fall and bushes burn. These ones' home is in danger. Danger!
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_004: This one begs of dancing one to help this one know more. Dancing one is friends with these ones and walking ones, yes? Dancing one must speak to these ones here and walking ones in hut-house and find out more.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_005: This one has bad feeling. This one fears steel ones are after something. But this one should speak no more. Go, dancing one. This one depends on kindness of dancing one.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_PELIXIA_000_010: Strange steel walking ones? Yes, this one has seen. Steel walking ones carry big boxes. Maybe walking ones hunt for shiny treasure? This one likes treasure!
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_NATHAXIO_000_011: Shush! Shush, this one says! Steel walking ones are scary, like touched ones... This one hates scary! And scary ones have scary friends...
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_MONNE_000_020: Men clad in strange armor? Why, now that you mention it, I did see some suspicious types of late. They were gathering deep in the forest. I simply assumed they were adventurers...
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_VICTOR_000_021: Fearsome types clad head to toe in steel, you say? Imperial soldiers, no doubt. I couldn't tell you what they're plotting, but I'm sure it's nothing good.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_030: This one is happy to see dancing one return. What did dancing one learn?
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_031: This one sees. Steel walking ones come from Empire. Carry boxes, and go walking deep, deep through trees.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_032: As this one thought! Steel walking ones are up to nasty, no-good things.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_033: This one knows forest well. Steel walking ones try to hide, but this one will find them.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_034: This one would borrow dancing one's map. This one makes mark─right here! This is where steel ones hide, this one knows. Dancing one will go looking for steel ones, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_050: Dancing one is back. This one breathes sigh of relief. This one was worried. Hm? Dancing one found something?
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_051: Dancing one found paper inside of box? This is a message from Empire?
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_052: This one can read walking ones' symbols. Message-paper has names of food and rocks. Food and rocks were inside boxes, this one knows.
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_053: But this one does not understand. Food and rocks mentioned all come from home of these ones. How do steel walking ones know to find them?
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_054: Is there sneaky one hiding behind this one's wings? Snooping one selling secrets to steel walking ones?
TEXT_GAIUSA105_00719_KOMUXIO_000_055: This one fears for this one's home. But dancing one has helped this one much today. Dancing one must promise to always be friend to these ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_000: Helpful one arrives at a good time! This one needs helpful one's help!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_001: One of these ones named Claxio ventured outside Little Solace alone. Alone is unsafe! Helpful one must find Claxio!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_002: Claxio struck west after leaving the settlement. Hurry before Claxio ends up in the belly of a beastly one!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_010: What? Walking one wants this one to return to Little Solace? Don't make this one laugh!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_011: This one is weary of living with those who are not these ones. This one wants to be alone.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_012: These ones rely on walking ones for everything. No better than those ones that summoned a primal one! Small wonder this one chose to leave!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_013: This one thought this a likely place to build a home. But then meddling one arrives─forces this one to go deeper into the forest. Meddling one is forbidden from following this one! Away with meddling one!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_020: What? Claxio refused to return to these ones, and went deeper into the forest!?
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_021: B-But this one saw touched ones lurking in the forest! Helpful one must hurry─hurry and find Claxio!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_022: Helpful one should search for spools of thread on the forest floor. Those things will lead helpful one to Claxio. But hurry! Hurry, before touched ones take Claxio away!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_025: Meddling one is back!? This one told meddling one to be gone! Tell Komuxio that this one will never go back! Never!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_026: T-Touched ones? Touched ones should go away too! This one is good one! Every one should just leave this one alone!!!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_PAPALYMO_000_027: Be on guard, . These sylphs have been tempered―brought under the thrall of the primal Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_PAPALYMO_000_028: Akin to the Amalj'aa tempered by Ifrit, these sylphs exist only to serve their deity.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_YDA_000_029: They'll not answer to words―only steel. I take no pleasure in this, but it must be done.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_032: Th-This one is...safe? This one was so scared...
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_033: Claxio! This one has been worried! So very worried! Is Claxio unharmed? Still in possession of wits?
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_034: K-Komuxio? And meddling one as well... Why are these two here?
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_035: These two came to rescue Claxio! That Claxio is safe fills this one with joy!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_036: Komuxio...forgive this one. This one did not mean to run away from Little Solace. This one was just...afraid.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_037: These ones who live at Little Solace were changing─becoming friendly with other ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_038: This one feared that these ones were forgetting who these ones are...like touched ones did. But this one was wrong. This one can see that now.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_000_039: Meddling─er, helpful one. This one is grateful. This one will return to Little Solace to be with Komuxio and friendly ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_PAPALYMO_000_039: Well, that should see to that. What say we return to Little Solace as well? I, for one, could do with a nice, hot bath.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_040: This one thought Claxio was lost forever. Helpful one saved Claxio―now these ones can be family again.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_041: This one has known many walking ones―even many kind walking ones―but helpful one is kindest and strongest of all. Helpful one is a hero to these ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_042: Helpful one will bring these ones and walking ones closer together―this one knows. This one would take helpful one to see elder one.
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_KOMUXIO_000_043: But elder one is... Elder one is...
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_SYLPHBOSS_GAIUSA201:
Claxio... These ones are your friends...
Come with these ones... Serve primal one together...
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_BATTLETALK_0: No! This one is good one! Will never go with bad ones!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_SYLPHBOSS_GAIUSA201:
Meddling one not smart to anger this one...
This one has many friends in the forest...
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_PAPALYMO_BATTLETALK: A morbol!? And things were going so well...
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_CLAXIO_BATTLETALK_0:
N-No...not stinky one! Stinky one is scary!
Stinky one's stink makes this one's head go spinning!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_YDA_BATTLETALK_06: Ick! ―Papalymo and I can handle this beast. You take care of the sylphs!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_PAPALYMO_BATTLETALK:
There's something not right about this morbol.
Ignore it and focus your attacks on the sylphs!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_YDA_BATTLETALK_10: Hurry up, Papalymo―I can't bear this stench any longer!
TEXT_GAIUSA201_00724_PAPALYMO_BATTLETALK: I'm doing the best I can! If we dispatch the sylphs, surely...
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_KOMUXIO_000_000: This one must ask kind one's forgiveness. This one made promise to take kind one to see elder one, yes? But this one cannot...
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_KOMUXIO_000_001: This one cannot because...elder one is not here. Elder one is not anywhere. Elder one went into forest yesterday, but has not come back...
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_KOMUXIO_000_002: This one is worried. Elder one often goes into forest, but never, never for this long. Kind one will help find elder one, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_KOMUXIO_000_003: Near where elder one disappeared is the home of a walking one named Buscarron. Buscarron may know what happened to elder one.
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_KOMUXIO_000_004: This one would talk to Buscarron...but walking ones do not always trust these ones. Would kind one talk to Buscarron for this one?
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_KOMUXIO_000_005: And kind one comes from Gridania, yes? In Gridania live many kind ones, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_KOMUXIO_000_006: This one begs of kind one. Please go to Gridania and ask fellow kind ones for help. And please hurry─these ones are not safe until elder one returns.
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_VORSAILE_000_010: Well, if it isn't our intrepid ambassador. How fare your diplomatic efforts with the sylph tribes?
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_VORSAILE_000_011: Their elder's gone missing, you say!? Why, if he were to end up in the hands of the tempered ones, we'd have a crisis on our hands.
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_VORSAILE_000_012: You can assure the sylphs that my sharpest-eyed Serpents will be on the lookout night and day.
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_VORSAILE_000_013: No stone must be left unturned. I would ask you to call upon Giah Molkoh at Bentbranch Meadows and deliver the message that the Wood Wailers are needed in the search effort.
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_GIAHMOLKOH_000_020: A message from Commander Heuloix, you say?
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_GIAHMOLKOH_000_021: The sylph elder has vanished? Worry not, friend─the Wood Wailers have eyes under every leaf, behind every branch. If the elder is anywhere in these forests, we shall find him.
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_BUSCARRON_000_030: Well met, adventurer! We have the finest grog and grub this side of─ Eh? Not here to fill your belly, then?
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_BUSCARRON_000_031: Ahhh, a hunger for news, is it? Aye, there's been talk of a sylph lurking hereabouts, but I couldn't rightly say if it be the elder you seek.
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_BUSCARRON_000_032: Those woodland scamps all look alike. Short of painting one red and another one blue, most folk would struggle to tell two of 'em apart.
TEXT_GAIUSA202_00725_BUSCARRON_000_033: If you've the time, mayhap you could stay a while and see what the gods have in store. You never know, you might even stumble across this sylph elder yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSA305_00737_TETEROON_000_000: Teteroon make firewater! Good, good firewater! You take to Buscaroon. Good firewater for good Buscaroon.
TEXT_GAIUSA305_00737_TETEROON_000_001: Tell Buscaroon no drink now. Tell put away one year. One year make best flavor.
TEXT_GAIUSA305_00737_TETEROON_000_002: <sigh> Teteroon hopes Buscaroon happy. Teteroon gives Buscaroon thankies. Many, many thankies. You tell Buscaroon.
TEXT_GAIUSA305_00737_TETEROON_000_003: Teteroon make big shop someday. Biggest shop in Eorzea. Make many, many sparklies. All thanks to good Buscaroon.
TEXT_GAIUSA305_00737_BUSCARRON_000_010:
Ah, you've returned. Thank you for seeing Teteroon's belongings to him.
...What's this? For me?
TEXT_GAIUSA305_00737_BUSCARRON_000_011: Qiqirn firewater! So he remembers my fondness for the drink, does he? Why that old... He... I... Aw, bloody hells! Who's cutting onions back there!?
TEXT_GAIUSA305_00737_BUSCARRON_000_012: He says to shelve it for a year, does he? Aye, that sounds about right. I hate to have to wait, but I reckon it'll be worth it. This stuff has an aroma and body unlike any other drink I know.
TEXT_GAIUSA305_00737_BUSCARRON_000_013: It's going to be a looong year. What say you come back then, friend? We'll see if we can't make it through this bottle together.
TEXT_GAIUSA306_00738_BUSCARRON_000_000: There was word while you were away. Sylphs were seen in the wood, but near no lands of their own. No, this was a place near to here─a place we've never known a sylph to come.
TEXT_GAIUSA306_00738_BUSCARRON_000_001: Something must have given them cause to venture this far. More than like, the missing sylph elder's among them. Here, I've marked the tract where they were sighted on your map. Go see if there's anything to be seen.
TEXT_GAIUSA306_00738_BUSCARRON_000_020:
So, was there aught to be found in the wood? What did you come to─
...Garleans!? In this part of the Twelveswood!?
TEXT_GAIUSA306_00738_BUSCARRON_000_021: Hmmm... First sylphs and now Garleans, and all in the same place. It cannot be mere coincidence. Might the Garleans be following the sylphs? Tracking them or giving chase, mayhap?
TEXT_GAIUSA306_00738_BUSCARRON_000_022: But no, not this far into the forest. The Wailers' spires are everywhere. Imperials could never have stolen past them all. How in the bloody hells could they─ Unless...
TEXT_GAIUSA306_00738_BUSCARRON_000_023: Unless someone guided them through. Someone who knew where the spires stand, and when the Wailers watch. A Gridanian traitor.
TEXT_GAIUSA401_00743_BUSCARRON_000_000: Say, friend, there's something I'd like to ask you to see delivered to the sylphs of Little Solace─this Azeyma rose oil.
TEXT_GAIUSA401_00743_BUSCARRON_000_001: It's a gift to celebrate the safe return of their tribe's elder─and a token of Gridania's desire to unite.
TEXT_GAIUSA401_00743_BUSCARRON_000_002: The wood is not what it once was. The Calamity changed the elementals─weakened them. Until their strength is returned, we must lend them ours to keep the wood safe. But ours alone will not be enough. We must have the strength of the sylphs, as well.
TEXT_GAIUSA401_00743_BUSCARRON_000_003: Only by working together and fighting together will we survive together─and the Twelveswood with us. The gift I ask you to bear is a symbol of the hope that both Gridanian and sylph alike will live to see the light beyond this darkness.
TEXT_GAIUSA401_00743_KNOLEXIA_000_020: A gift from walking one Buscarron? A gift for these ones?
TEXT_GAIUSA401_00743_KNOLEXIA_000_021: Such a lovely scent! This one has never smelled anything like this before!
TEXT_GAIUSA401_00743_KNOLEXIA_000_022: Walking one Buscarron and adventuring one are very kind. Know that this one is deeply grateful.
TEXT_GAIUSA401_00743_KNOLEXIA_000_023: Many walking ones are scary. Many walking ones utter many lies and much deception. But this one is moved. Let all these ones be friends forever!
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_KOMUXIO_000_050: This one has been expecting walking one! This one fetches elder one!
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_051: This one is pleased to see walking one again. Welcome to the home of these ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_052: Ah, there you are, . We have just been hearing tell of your deeds of derring-do. Well done!
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_053: Ah, the walking ones who aided Noraxia! This one is grateful!
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_054: A pleasure to have been of service. If you do not mind my asking, how did your misadventure come about?
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_055: This one does not mind. The misadventures, as walking one calls them, of this one began when imperial ones entered the wood. Fearing trouble, these ones decided to watch imperial ones closely.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_056: But these ones watched too closely, and imperial ones noticed and tried to catch these ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_057: Having nowhere else to hide, this one fled into Toto-Rak. Would that this one had not. In Toto-Rak, a sinister one robed in black tried to feed this one to a many-legged one!
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_YDA_000_058: A sinister one robed in black...? Why do I have the feeling I should be more worried about that than I am?
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_059: Elder Frixio, we come to you as emissaries of the nation of Gridania. This missive bears the words of the Elder Seedseer.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_060: This one sees... So walking ones of Gridania are fearful of Lord Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_061: Plainly put, yes. Your people summoned the Lord of Levin but once, yet that single occurrence occasioned great alarm.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_YDA_000_062: But it's not as if the Gridanians dislike you or anything. Actually, it's just the opposite. They think of you as friends, and they don't want anything to get in the way of that. That's why the Elder Seedseer wrote to you.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_063: Hmmm... This one well knows and respects horned one Kan-E-Senna. Be assured: like walking ones of Gridania, these ones have no desire for conflict.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_064: These ones resorted to summoning Lord Ramuh to protect the wood from imperial ones. This one counseled against doing so, but was not heeded.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_065: Against this one's wishes, Lord Ramuh was summoned...and all those ones who took part became touched ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_066: These ones want so desperately to turn touched ones back to normal ones, but did not know how─and still do not know.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_067: Touched ones, meanwhile, wanted to turn these ones into touched ones, and did know how... So this one fled to Little Solace with all those ones who did not wish to be bound to Lord Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_068: But walking ones of Gridania need not fear touched ones or Lord Ramuh. Unlike other primal ones, Lord Ramuh is not callous and cruel.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_069: So long as walking ones do not trespass on these ones' ancestral homeland, where touched ones reside, walking ones will not suffer thunderous judgment.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_070: But this one has spoken enough of touched ones. This one would speak instead of these ones. As this one said, these ones desire peace with walking ones of Gridania. And so these ones ask for a chance to set things right.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_071: By way of an addendum, mortals who are tempered come to take on the qualities embodied by the primal in question. In the case of the sylphs, Ramuh's influence has made them fiercely protective of their homeland.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_YDA_000_072: That explains why they're so hostile towards trespassers, but what about the abductions?
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_073: A fine question, Yda! The abductions are, I believe, an expression of the tempered sylphs' desire for reconciliation─another quality traditionally associated with Ramuh. In the crudest manner imaginable, they seek to bring their fellows back into the fold. A timely reminder that the challenges posed by each primal are unique.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_074: Elder Frixio, we thank you for making your will known to us. The people of Gridania will rest easier in the knowledge that they and the sylphs are united in their desire for peace.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_075: Wishing to cooperate, this one has written down the feelings of these ones. Please see that these feelings are conveyed to horned one Kan-E-Senna.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_076: And with that, I believe we can lay the matter of Ramuh to rest.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_YDA_000_077: That sylph elder's very reasonable, I must say. You could learn a lot from him.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_078: ...Hm!? Was that a jibe? If so, I feel it only fair to observe that one of us wouldn't recognize reason if it punched her on the nose. Did I say fair? I meant: reasonable.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_YDA_000_079: Anyway, we're going to head back to the Waking Sands and tell Minfilia all about it.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_080: Fear not─we will be sure to mention the instrumental part you played in all of this. And while we see to that, we should appreciate it if you would deliver Frixio's missive to the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_PAPALYMO_000_081: Elder Frixio, we humbly thank you for your time. It has been an honor.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_082: The honor is this one's. Together, let the walking ones of Gridania and these ones find a way to live in peace.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_084: This one has yet to give walking one a token of this one's appreciation.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_085: When these ones summoned Lord Ramuh, these ones were gifted this crystal. This one would now bestow the crystal upon walking one as a symbol of these ones' trust.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_086: <gasp> This one was not mistaken about walking one.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_087: Walking one is destined to walk a fate far crueler than this one can imagine.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_088: A brilliant light from within walking one enveloped the crystal─this one saw.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_FRIXIO_000_089: Mark this one well: that crystal will one day be of use to walking one. Walking one must keep that crystal safe at all times.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_KOMUXIO_000_090: Before walking one returns to Gridania, this one would ask walking one to watch touched ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_KOMUXIO_000_091: So long as touched ones are not troubled, touched ones will not make trouble.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_KOMUXIO_000_092: If walking one witnesses touched ones making no trouble, mayhap walking one can testify to walking ones of Gridania that these ones mean no harm.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_KOMUXIO_000_093: These ones' homeland is fraught with danger. This one marks down safe places to look out for touched ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_SYSTEM_000_010: There are tempered sylphs in the distance. You do not sense that they pose a danger if left alone.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_VORSAILE_000_020: Ah, . How went the meeting with the sylphs?
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_VORSAILE_000_021: A missive from the sylph elder himself!? If I may...
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_VORSAILE_000_022: So the sylphs have no desire for conflict, nor do they intend to summon Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_VORSAILE_000_023: And so long as we leave the tempered ones be, we need not fear any aggression on their part.
TEXT_GAIUSA402_00744_VORSAILE_000_024: The Elder Seedseer will be overjoyed to hear that the sylphs have welcomed our overtures. And in the knowledge that they bear us no ill will, we may channel our resources towards tackling the more conspicuous threats to our security.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_VORSAILE_000_000: The sylphic folk have long been friends to Gridania. The mere thought of being at war with them pained the Elder Seedseer to no end.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_VORSAILE_000_001: But owing to your efforts, she will be able to rest easier. Being the benevolent soul that she is, my lady will surely try to find a way to reverse the tempering process.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_VORSAILE_000_002: Once again, I thank you. Had the Scions of the Seventh Dawn not offered to mediate between our peoples, suspicion and doubt may well have led us into needless conflict. Pray pass on my regards to Lady Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_010: ...Hello? Hello, ? Can you hear me? It is I, Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_011: Yda and Papalymo returned some little while ago. And they wasted no time in regaling me with the tale of your exploits.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_012: Thanks in large part to you, the name of one primal may be struck from our list of enemies, and the Gridanians may turn their attention to more pressing matters. Well done!
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_013: Yet the end of one tale is but the start of another. Pray return to the Waking Sands at your earliest convenience. I would apprise you of the present situation in person.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_TATARU_000_020: Well, if it isn't my favorite adventurer! Welcome back, !
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_TATARU_000_021: Lady Minfilia awaits you within the solar. Please enter at your leisure.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_ALPHINAUD_000_050: I am given to understand that the matter of Ramuh has finally been resolved.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_051: Hm. I fear “resolved” bespeaks a permanence we cannot rightly claim. Yet I am well satisfied that the Lord of Levin will not trouble us in the foreseeable future.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Your satisfaction is assurance enough for me.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_ALPHINAUD_000_054: Well enough. Thancred is sparing no effort.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_ALPHINAUD_000_055: They are many and one, just as you suspected. Their purpose, however, eludes us still.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_057: Ah, I have been meaning to ask, but is Alisaie quite well? I feel as if I have scarcely seen her in recent days.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_ALPHINAUD_000_058: Oh, you haven't─and nor have I, alas. Alisaie has chosen to walk her own path─stubborn girl─but you may be assured that our destination remains the same.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_ALPHINAUD_000_059: And on that note, I take my leave of you. I trust the Baldesion report will serve you well.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_060: I take it we can proceed as discussed?
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Why do you ask? You scarce need my permission to act.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_062: It is good to see you again, !
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_063: I have been looking forward to congratulating you on your triumph in the Twelveswood. Owing to your efforts, conflict has been averted. Truly, you have done the Scions proud.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_PAPALYMO_000_064: With that, we can strike Ramuh from the list.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_YDA_000_065: So who's next? The Sahagin and Leviathan?
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_PAPALYMO_000_066: The Lord of the Whorl has not answered his minions' call of late, nor is he expected to do so in the near future.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_PAPALYMO_000_067: While the Sahagin remain as aggressive as ever, they lack the quantity of crystals required to call forth their god. As with the sylphs, we can leave them to their own devices...for a time, at least.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_YSHTOLA_000_068: “For a time” bears repeating. We can ill afford to fall complacent.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_PAPALYMO_000_069: It is as Y'shtola says. Unless we know the minds of the beast tribes, we cannot predict with any certainty when next a primal will return to plague the land.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_PAPALYMO_000_070: This being the case, we must proceed with as much haste as prudence allows.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_YSHTOLA_000_072: The Maelstrom keeps the kobolds under constant observation.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_YSHTOLA_000_073: We shall hear from them ere long, you may depend upon it.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_PAPALYMO_000_074: Indeed. So, then─of all the known primals that have been active in recent times, we are left with...
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_YDA_000_075: Gridania! Wait, I meant Garuda─who is the primal of the Ixal who live near Gridania. Yes, that's what I meant.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_076: So many malms to cover... Would that there were a more efficient way to conduct our surveys.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_077: Were he still with us, we should not long have wanted for a more practicable solution...
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_BIGGS_000_078: She's not wrong there... <sigh> Where in the world are you, Chief?
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_079: ...But one sure step at a time!
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_080: Henceforth, the Order of the Twin Adder will handle all matters pertaining to the sylphs, under the sage guidance of the Seedseers.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_081: I bid you all enjoy a moment's respite. You have earned it!
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_083: Beg pardon? A man named Lahabrea, sporting a red mask and robed in black...? Twelve preserve...
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_084: Prior to the Calamity, the Ascians took great pains to remain hidden... Why would they choose to cast off their veil of secrecy now? Gods, this bodes ill...
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_085: We must take advantage of the present lull in primal hostilities and investigate this Lahabrea─learn all we can of him and his designs. I dread to thi─
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_NORAXIA_000_089: At long last, this one finds walking one !
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_NORAXIA_000_090: This one is most dependable of these ones! Is sent by elder one Frixio to help walking ones!
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_NORAXIA_000_091: This one is called Noraxia. This one comes as a friend. Let these ones be friends!
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_100: Yes, Tataru is as ready to express her fright as she is to express...everything else! Not all of us are forged of the same steel as you, I'm afraid.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_101: But it takes all kinds to make a family, and it pleases me to no end to see ours continue to grow. One by one, the people of Eorzea are beginning to unite, , drawn to the hope that shines within you.
TEXT_GAIUSA404_00746_MINFILIA_000_102: Yet a darkness threatens to engulf this light. Never have I doubted the Ascians' presence, but that they have grown so brazen as to carry out their work in plain sight fills me with a sense of deep foreboding.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_MINFILIA_000_000: I am afraid there is no rest for the weary, . We must delve further into the motivations of the masked man─the Ascian known as Lahabrea. This is an ideal moment to do so, while our hands are not bound dealing with another primal.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_MINFILIA_000_001: At present, we know little and less about the Ascians─only that destruction follows in their wake.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_MINFILIA_000_002: I should not be surprised if these beings are behind the chaos that racks the realm. If my fears prove to be reality, we must do all in our power to stop them.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_MINFILIA_000_003: Earlier, I sent word to each Grand Company to solicit cooperation. The Immortal Flames responded to the effect that they have information on a potential sighting.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_MINFILIA_000_004: This is intelligence that we can ill afford to ignore. Go speak with Flame Commander Swift at the Hall of Flames in Ul'dah to inquire further. How you go about the investigation thereafter, I leave wholly to your discretion.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_MINFILIA_000_005: But whatever you do, never forget that we are dealing with the unknown. You cannot take too many precautions. Be safe, .
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_SWIFT_000_010: The masked man? Ah, you are come on behalf of the Scions, of course. Yes, as we've already relayed to Lady Minfilia, there has been a sighting of this rogue near about eastern Thanalan.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_SWIFT_000_011: A Brass Blade stationed at Highbridge described him in detail when he alerted us to suspicious activity. I would point you to the witness, but I'm afraid he died not two days ago, slain by a marauding horde of Qiqirn. Fate can be a cruel mistress.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_SWIFT_000_012: But do not be too quick to despair. Being situated on a trade route, Highbridge sees its fair share of travelers. Folk are always coming and going, and some among them may well have caught a glimpse of your target.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_SWIFT_000_013: You could do worse than to speak with a merchant named Hihibaru. The fellow's always starved for customers, and he'd no doubt welcome your attention, whether or not you have coin or the mind to spend it.
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_HIHIBARU_000_020:
Welcome to Highbridge, adventurer! Whatever you seek, I, Hihibaru, can provide it.
...Probably!
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_HIHIBARU_000_021: You're after a masked man? Hmmm, I'm not sure I have one of those in stock...
TEXT_GAIUSA405_00747_HIHIBARU_000_022: Ohhh, you're after a masked man! Why didn't you say so sooner? Such an individual might have featured in one of the many rumors I've heard. If you linger awhile, mayhap you'll learn a thing or two, eh?
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_HIHIBARU_000_000: When the Order of Nald'thal began excavating the ruins below, I had hopes that Highbridge would turn into a bustling hub for pilgrims. But thanks to the nigh-endless beastman raids, folk are too afraid to come within a malm of here.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_HIHIBARU_000_001: I sold everything I owned to get my venture started, and I'm loath to give up without making an earnest effort to stick it out. But if things keep going as they are, I'll be bankrupt before the moon is through...
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_HIHIBARU_000_002: Whining won't do me any good, though. No, for my business to survive, I need business. Speaking of which, perhaps you'd like to browse my wares! Spend a bit of coin to help a struggling merchant!
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_HIHIBARU_000_003: ...The masked man? Bah, Thal take your bloody masked man! I know what I said before, but vague rumors are all I've got. If you want to know about him, go and ask the other merchants!
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_NPCA_000_010: On the trail of a masked man? Aye, I've heard of him...but only in hushed tones and faint whispers.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_NPCA_000_011: It's said he wears a black hooded robe, an' looks right suspicious. An' that's about all I can say, little though it is.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_NPCB_000_020: Have I seen a masked man wearing a dark robe? No, I haven't, nor do I wish to. Business is bad enough without shady characters lurking about.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_NPCB_000_021: Folk have been giving Highbridge a wide berth because of all the Qiqirn raids. None but the most devout of pilgrims are willing to come here anymore.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_NPCB_000_022: <sigh> Mayhap it's best I moved on... Cut my losses before they drag me all the way down...
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_NPCC_000_030: Aye, I've heard tell of the masked devil. Seems he's been appearing not only around Highbridge, but elsewhere about Thanalan, too.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_NPCC_000_031: Enough folk have reported seeing him to convince me he's more than a figment of the imagination, but little is known about him otherwise.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_HIHIBARU_000_040: Judging by your expression, I take it you didn't learn much of use.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_HIHIBARU_000_041: Look, I'm sorry for my rudeness earlier. It's just that things are tough for us merchants at the moment. The Qiqirn raids are so constant, so organized, we're beginning to suspect that someone is orchestrating it all.
TEXT_GAIUSA406_00748_HIHIBARU_000_042: I tend to put my own welfare first, like most of us do, but that doesn't mean I'm a bad person. I promise to keep an eye out for your masked man. If I see or hear anything, you'll be the first to know.
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_000: I've finally got some honest-to-gods information on your masked man! Why so confident? Because I saw him with my own two eyes!
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_001: I was out for an evening stroll, minding my own business, when I noticed a column of smoke rising from a cliff over at Thal's Respite. Curious, I took myself there to find a masked man─your masked man, I'm sure of it─standing by a fire.
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_002: As if in answer, some Qiqirn appeared soon after, and the group began talking at length. I'm afraid I was too far out of earshot to hear much of anything.
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_003: After the group had dispersed, an idea came to me: if you were to use this smoldering coal to start a fire, you might be able to arrange a similar meeting. It will be dangerous, I shouldn't doubt, but you've proven yourself more than a match for a pack of rats.
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_004: So, what do you think? That's some sound, reliable information, even if I do say so myself. Well worth all the lingering about you've been doing, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_020: Back so soon? Were you able to find any clues leading to your masked man?
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_030: <gasp> Th-This scroll! It bears a prayer to Rhalgr, the Destroyer!
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_031: In case you're unfamiliar, Rhalgr is the guardian deity of Ala Mhigo, which is currently under Garlean rule.
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_032: It's highly uncommon for folk of other nations to revere Him. I'd wager my last gil that your assailant was Ala Mhigan.
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_033: It seems this masked man of yours is very well connected. I must confess, the merchant in me envies such a diverse network of contacts.
TEXT_GAIUSA504_00756_HIHIBARU_000_034: That selfsame merchant also senses danger ahead...and darkness besides. Are you certain you'd rather not take things nice and slow here at Highbridge?
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIBARU_000_000: The Ala Mhigan bandit you had a run-in with is somehow connected to your masked man of mystery.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIBARU_000_001: So, it stands to reason that if you want to pick up the trail again, you should head toward Little Ala Mhigo, over in southern Thanalan.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIBARU_000_002: Just so you know what to expect, the settlement is the favored destination for those refugees who couldn't...well, adapt to life in Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIBARU_000_003: The hearts of the denizens are said to be as barren as the wasteland they live in. And for all intents and purposes, it's a lawless place. Be prepared for a not-so-warm welcome.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIBARU_000_004: Now, I'm not certain how much a help she will be, but it just so happens I have a daughter who has, er...relocated to Little Ala Mhigo. Her name is Hihira, and it shouldn't hurt to seek her out first.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIBARU_000_005: And while you have her attention...I'd be obliged if you could send my love. Not a day goes by that I don't think of her.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIBARU_000_006: I suppose this is it, then! I had hoped that you would linger here a while─cull some fiends, spend some coin, what have you─but something tells me you're destined for greater things. Wherever it is you end up, I wish you the best!
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIRA_000_010:
...Hm? Why, yes, Hihibaru's my father... He said what?
<sigh> I wish I could be a better daughter to him. It's just that─ Oh, I'm sorry... I shouldn't bother you with family matters. But I am grateful to you for delivering the message. Now then, what brings you here?
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_HIHIRA_000_011: A masked man? I'm afraid the description doesn't ring any bells, but one of the others here may have seen something. I would recommend you first speak with Gundobald, the leader of the settlement. I must warn you, though, he isn't exactly...accommodating to outsiders.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_GUNDOBALD_000_020: Who are you? State your business, and be quick about it.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_GUNDOBALD_000_021: Looking for a masked villain, you say? And why should we help you, pray?
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_GUNDOBALD_000_022: We struggle enough without having to answer the whim of every outsider.
TEXT_GAIUSA505_00757_GUNDOBALD_000_023: You are not welcome here. Begone.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_GISILBEHRT_000_000: Well met, adventurer. I'm Gisilbehrt, head of security here at Little Ala Mhigo. I heard tell that you had business with Gundobald. Knowing the bristly old bear, I don't doubt he told you to bugger off.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_GISILBEHRT_000_001: Owing to their hardships, the refugees don't trust anyone but themselves. Not even my men and I can get so much as a word of thanks out of them despite watching the place day and night.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_GISILBEHRT_000_002: But thanks or no, I try to help my fellow man when I can, and you seem a decent sort. If you tell me what's brought you here, might be as I can lend a hand.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_GISILBEHRT_000_003: ...On the trail of a masked villain, you say? Hmmm, can't say that sounds familiar, but I have men on lookout for Amalj'aa to the south of here. If there's been any suspicious activity, they are like to have seen it.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_GISILBEHRT_000_004: I had a mind to take them each a cup of sweet Thanalan tea so as to lift their spirits. If you were to run this little errand in my stead, they'd be all the more willing to tell you what they know.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_OSRIC_000_010: Who the hells're you? I'm tryin' to conserve energy here, so leave me alone.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_OSRIC_000_011:
Well, ain't ye considerate! My thanks, friend!
...What's that? A masked villain? Hidin' among the refugees, like as not.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_OSRIC_000_012: Me compatriots as live here go about as though they're dead on their feet. 'Tis near impossible to tell what's on their minds. For all I know, they're all up to no good.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_YAYAZUKE_000_020: Shoo, shoo! Don't bother me! If the Amalj'aa overrun us, I'm blaming you!
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_YAYAZUKE_000_021:
For me? You shouldn't have!
...Sorry? A suspicious masked man? As a matter of fact, I caught glimpse of someone fitting that description during patrol.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_YAYAZUKE_000_022: Well, I couldn't quite make out whether it was a man or not, what with the mask and the robe. But assuming it was a he, he was talking with some Ala Mhigans. I assumed he was one of them.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_ANGRYRIVER_000_030: You there! Are you an Amalj'aa? No? Then carry on!
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_ANGRYRIVER_000_031: Ahhh, this sophisticated aroma! It has been forever since I had a drop of sweet Thanalan! I'm going to enjoy this!
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_ANGRYRIVER_000_032: What? A masked man? Don't know, don't care! Unless he's got dark scaly skin, stands ten fulms tall, and has the face of a lizard, then I don't give a mummer's fart!
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_GISILBEHRT_000_040:
Ah, you're back. So, did my lookouts have aught to share with you?
...Hmmm, that doesn't sound like much to go by.
TEXT_GAIUSA509_00761_GISILBEHRT_000_041: If you're to get any further in your investigation, seems to me you'll need the cooperation of the Ala Mhigans. For this, you'll need to win their trust, and that won't be an easy task.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_GISILBEHRT_000_000: So you're determined to press on with your investigation? Then I have some advice to offer.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_GISILBEHRT_000_001: As I said before, you won't get far without the Ala Mhigans' trust. And the best way to win that trust is to get a compatriot of theirs─someone they respect─to vouch for you.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_GISILBEHRT_000_002: Coin does the talking in Ul'dah, but the Ala Mhigans are bound by something far stronger, if not as tangible: a common purpose. That purpose is, of course, the liberation of their home from the Garleans.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_GISILBEHRT_000_003: Gundobald belongs to the Ala Mhigan Resistance, so your best bet would be someone who's part of the same crew. If you know any well-connected people, you might want to start by asking them.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_MINFILIA_000_010: Welcome back, ! How fares the investigation?
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_MINFILIA_000_011: ...I see. Given all that they have suffered, it is of little wonder the Ala Mhigan refugees have lost faith in their fellow man.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_MINFILIA_000_012: They have had their homeland taken from them, and for the past two decades have had to see it remain in the enemy's clutches.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_MINFILIA_000_013: To compound matters, none of the three city-states have the means to take in all those who were displaced. As a result, a great many Ala Mhigans now live on the margins of society, suffering poverty and discrimination.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_MINFILIA_000_014: <sigh> Would that more could be done to ease their hardships. I fear that nothing short of reclaiming their homeland would be a lasting solution.
TEXT_GAIUSA510_00762_MINFILIA_000_015: But let us deal with one problem at a time. Returning to the matter of your investigation, it just so happens there is an Ala Mhigan native among the Scions. I should be pleased to introduce him to you.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_MINFILIA_000_000: Your Ala Mhigan comrade is named Haribehrt. He joined our cause in the hopes that he might find a way to liberate his homeland.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_MINFILIA_000_001: While he spares no effort towards that endeavor, I have no doubt that he would be glad to assist you.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_MINFILIA_000_002: If I recall correctly, Haribehrt is currently between missions. Try looking for him in the storage area.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_HARIBEHRT_000_010: If it isn't , the Scions' rising star! Is there aught I can do for you?
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_HARIBEHRT_000_011: You wish to win the trust of the people of Little Ala Mhigo! That is a daunting task, my friend, even for our own countrymen.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_HARIBEHRT_000_012: I would like nothing more than to help, but I'm afraid my name no longer carries weight with that lot.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_HARIBEHRT_000_013: I used to be a member of the Ala Mhigan Resistance, you see, but I left in favor of joining the Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_HARIBEHRT_000_014: Though my allegiance may have shifted, my purpose remains ever the same─the liberation of Ala Mhigo. Yet whatever my reasons were, I abandoned my comrades, and they'll have nothing to do with me.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_HARIBEHRT_000_015: Now, while I may have no more friends in the Resistance, I know someone who does. Her name is Albreda, and she is a resident of Quarrymill. Say my name when you meet her, and she won't lead you astray.
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_ALBREDA_000_020: Eh? You want me to introduce you to the Resistance? Hah! Why the hells should I do that? Give me just one reason!
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_ALBREDA_000_021: H-Haribehrt sent you!? Grrr, that worthless whoreson... He abandons his comrades─his woman─and now he has the gall to ask me for a favor!? Simply incredible...
TEXT_GAIUSA601_00763_ALBREDA_000_022: I just... I mean... <sigh> Ugh. I realize Haribehrt was only doing what he felt was right. He's a good man. And if he trusts you, then that's all I need to know. You see that bloke there? That's Meffrid, a captain of the Resistance. I hope he can give you what you need.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_MEFFRID_000_000: Aye, I'm Meffrid, a proud man of the Ala Mhigan Resistance.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_MEFFRID_000_001: What business do you have with me, adventurer?
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_NPCA_000_002: (-Resistance Soldier-)C-Captain! It's...it's Gallien, sir! His wound's gone an' festered, an' he's burnin' up! I don't think he's got much time!
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_MEFFRID_000_002: Godsdammit! I asked the villagers for aid─got on my knees and begged─but they refused to lift a finger! If Gallien dies, his blood is on their hands!
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_MEFFRID_000_003: These Quarrymill cravens would turn a blind eye to our plight, but they might listen to Albreda. I fear my anger will prevent me from rightly convincing anyone at the moment. I realize we scarce know each other, but this is a matter of life and death. Please, adventurer, go to her and try!
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_ALBREDA_000_010: One of Meffrid's in bad shape, you say? I'm...I'm sorry, but there's naught I can do.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_ALBREDA_000_011: I want to help, truly I do─they're my countrymen, after all─but that'd mean going against the elementals' will.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_ALBREDA_000_012: I've been at Quarrymill long enough to know how right terrible the beings can be. I couldn't forgive myself if everyone gets banished because of me.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_ALBREDA_000_013: If there's anyone who can help you, it'd be Charline, the hamlet's resident Hearer. If you take the matter to her, might be as she'll listen...though I wouldn't get my hopes up.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_CHARLINE_000_020: You wish to aid the Ala Mhigans? You are possessed of a kind heart, adventurer, but I'm afraid I have not the authority to grant you your wish.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_CHARLINE_000_021: This authority belongs only to the elementals, eternal guardians of the Twelveswood. All outsiders, be they babes at the breast or men grown, are judged of a night whether they may have a place beneath the boughs.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_CHARLINE_000_022: Alas, the Ala Mhigans' petition has been denied. Harsh though it may seem, they do not have leave to receive of the wood's bounty. Ever has it been since time immemorial, and ever shall it be.
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_MEFFRID_000_030: That's how it's to be, then!? The bloody Hearer might as well kill Gallien herself!
TEXT_GAIUSA603_00765_MEFFRID_000_031: Spit on the elementals and spit on their bloody will! I cannot wait until the Resistance is free of this place!
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_MEFFRID_000_000: I led my men to Quarrymill hoping to find refuge─instead we've found indifference. The cold-blooded bastards here want us out, and I can't oblige them soon enough. The problem is, some of mine aren't fit to travel─hells, Gallien can't even stand!
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_MEFFRID_000_001: As you well know, the people of this accursed hamlet won't help us. So, I've no choice but to turn to you, adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_MEFFRID_000_002: In my homeland, long antelope horn is a traditional remedy with poison-purging properties. If you could bring me, say, four horns, I'd forever be in your debt.
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_SYSTEM_000_000: Dammy: You get four antelope horns!
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_MEFFRID_000_010: Ah, you're back! Tell me you've got four horns with you!
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_MEFFRID_000_020: You're a godssend, adventurer! Praise Rhalgr there's at least one  in this place who gives a damn. Now we just need to find a way to prepare them...
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_MEFFRID_000_021: You wouldn't happen to know a man named Buscarron, would you? Some comrades of mine told me about him once. They said he never turns away folk in need, no matter where they're from.
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_MEFFRID_000_022: Seeing as he runs a tavern, he's like to have the tools to make the medicine. I'd be grateful if you could take the horns over to him to have them ground down. When that's done, bring the powder back, and give it to Faramund here. Godsspeed.
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_BUSCARRON_000_030:
Ah, , ever a sight for sore eyes! How fares the adventuring? Rolling in the coin like there's no tomorrow, no doubt!
...Hm? You've got something to show me?
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_BUSCARRON_000_040: Well, these look like good old antelope horns. Need them ground down to make a medicine, you say?
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_BUSCARRON_000_041: Here's a better idea: I'll give you some of the stuff I have in my stores. Aye, I'm no stranger to the remedy. An Ala Mhigan friend once used it to treat my festering wound, years and years ago. Safe to say he saved my life.
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_BUSCARRON_000_042: What's that? This is for an Ala Mhigan soldier in Quarrymill? Heh, so it comes full circle... Well, I hope it helps the poor sod as needs it. Oh, and don't worry your little head off about payment─I still owe you a deal more than you owe me, I reckon.
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_FARAMUND_000_050: It is well to see you returned. Have you the medicine for our brother?
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_FARAMUND_000_060: Gods bless you, adventurer! I'll see that Gallien receives treatment at once!
TEXT_GAIUSA701_00774_FARAMUND_000_061: Hopefully, this will allow the captain to rest easier. It has been a terrible burden on him, trying to keep every man alive. You've done us a great kindness, friend.
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_000: A-Adventurer! Gallien has gone missing! He's nowhere to be found!
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_001: He shouldn't be walking about, not with those wounds! If he doesn't get the proper medicine and rest, his condition's like to deteriorate to where it was before...or worse.
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_002: We need you to help us find him, and quickly. Start by asking Albreda─might be as the woman's seen something!
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_ALBREDA_000_010: Ah, finally. It's about time you came asking about Gallien. I watched him leave Quarrymill some time ago, and he left me this sealed letter before he went off. Made me swear not to open it until someone came asking...
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_ALBREDA_000_011:
“My brothers,

I cannot bear to be a burden any longer. That is why I must leave you all. Do not worry for me─just find your way safely to Little Ala Mhigo.”
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_ALBREDA_000_012: <sigh> Blast it. Would that I'd known what he was thinking. I'd have stopped this folly myself.
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_ALBREDA_000_013: The love Gallien bears for his brothers is so strong, he's willing to sacrifice himself for them. Make no mistake, entering the wood in his weakened state is suicide.
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_020: Out in the wilds...alone!? That fool! That great big sentimental fool!
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_021: My men and I will scour the wood for Gallien! Please help us find him before something terrible happens!
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_GALLIEN_000_041: C-Captain? But...why? You should all be on your way...
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_042: Who do you take us for!? We're Ala Mhigans, and Ala Mhigans never forsake one another, hardships be damned!
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_043: Remember the oath we swore, godsdammit─the oath to reclaim our homeland! We'll set foot on Ala Mhigan soil again─together─or not at all! Do you understand me!?
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_045: Good. Let us return to our brothers. Oh, and don't even think that you'll get off lightly. As soon as you're healed, I'll give you such a thorough thrashing, you'll wish we didn't find you!
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_046: I can't thank you enough for saving Gallien. I will see you back at Quarrymill.
TEXT_GAIUSA702_00775_MEFFRID_000_050: Gallien's expected to make a full recovery. We'll linger here till he's strong enough to take to the road again. As much as I mislike this place, beggars can't be choosers.
TEXT_GAIUSA703_00776_MEFFRID_000_000: Now that things are relatively settled, I seem to recall that you wanted something of me.
TEXT_GAIUSA703_00776_MEFFRID_000_001: You've proven a true friend to my people. Ask of me anything, and it's yours, so long as it's mine to give.
TEXT_GAIUSA703_00776_MEFFRID_000_002: The cooperation of the people of Little Ala Mhigo? That's all? Far be it from me to question your desires, of course... Very well, I will provide you with a letter to show to Gundobald.
TEXT_GAIUSA703_00776_MEFFRID_000_003: The old bear was my mentor when I first joined the Resistance. He's intimidating to those who don't know him, but he takes care of his own. I've no doubt that he will do all in his power to aid you.
TEXT_GAIUSA703_00776_GUNDOBALD_000_010: Why have you returned? You are not welcome here; I thought I made that clear.
TEXT_GAIUSA703_00776_GUNDOBALD_000_020: You...you spoke with Meffrid? It has been so long since I last heard from him, I had feared him dead... Twelve be praised...
TEXT_GAIUSA703_00776_GUNDOBALD_000_021: Whoever you are, Meffrid sees you as a friend, and any friend of Meffrid is a friend of mine. I know of this masked stranger you seek, and will tell you what I can.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_GUNDOBALD_000_000: An outsider resembling your masked stranger has reportedly been appearing near Little Ala Mhigo of late. What's more, it seems that some of our youngbloods are meeting him in secret.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_GUNDOBALD_000_001: No doubt you'll want to question them about their trysts, but they are not like to yield the information readily to an outsider. If you tell them I sent you, though, they may well feel obliged to talk.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_WALDHAR_000_010: ...A masked man? No idea what yer talkin' about. I ain't done nothin' wrong, so leave me be.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_ADALIND_000_020: G-Gundobald sent you? I, uh─ Listen, I told them it was a bad idea! All that tripe about believing the masked man and─
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_ADALIND_000_021: ...O-Oh. You...you don't know anything about this? Why didn't you say so to start with!? You can't throw the old bear's name around like that and expect me to not think I'm in for it!
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_SIFRID_000_030: What? Have I been meeting any masked men lately? Hmmm, let's see...
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_SIFRID_000_031: Nope, can't say I have! But I'll be sure to tell all my friends you're looking for him.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_TALEBOT_000_040: There's a bunch been skulkin' about right suspicious, like, but I've got nothin' to do with 'em. I know trouble when I see it, an' that there's trouble, mark me words.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_GUNDOBALD_000_050: So, you have indeed confirmed my suspicions about a masked man... That is most troubling. Whatever the young ones are scheming, it can lead to no good end.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_GUNDOBALD_000_051: There's an anger inside them─I can see it in their eyes. I ought to know, for it once burned within me as well.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_GUNDOBALD_000_052: Two decades ago, that same anger drove me and my brothers to rise against the despot who ruled Ala Mhigo. Naught would do but to depose him and usher in a revolution. Well, we got our revolution all right...but it cost us our freedom.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_GUNDOBALD_000_053: Blinded by our hate, we didn't realize that we had been dancing to the Empire's tune. By the time we did, it was too late. Ala Mhigo had fallen.
TEXT_GAIUSA704_00777_GUNDOBALD_000_054: There are times when a man must be patient. Now is such a time, though the young ones know this not. Unless we intervene, they are like to commit great folly. If you learn aught of their plans, I would thank you to bring word to me.
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_HREMFING_000_000: Hey, adventurer. You done talking with the old bear?
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_HREMFING_000_001: I've got a message for you from Wilred. Lad's something of a leader among the young ones here.
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_HREMFING_000_002: He's impressed that you've won over Gundobald, and wants a word with you. Says he'll be waiting over at the craggy area north of here.
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_WILRED_000_010: Thanks for coming, friend. 'Tis no ordinary outsider who can gain the trust of the old bear. That's why I wanted to meet you, to discuss something in private.
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_WILRED_000_011: Tell me...why are you snooping about? Did the Empire send you? Or someone else?
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_WILRED_000_012: Coeurl got your tongue? Hmph, no matter. Whoever it is you work for, your meddling ends here. Get !
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_WILRED_000_020: I won't let you foil our plan!
