TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_WILRED_000_041: This changes nothing! Threaten us, beat us bloody all you like...but nothing short of death can make us give up our fight!
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_WILRED_000_042: We're going to obtain the power to bring down the Empire, and with it we'll reclaim our homeland!
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_GUNDOBALD_000_050: Attacked by Wilred and his cronies!? That they would go to such lengths for the sake of this plan of theirs...
TEXT_GAIUSA705_00778_GUNDOBALD_000_051: Left to their own devices, the young fools are like to harm others, if not themselves. We must uncover their agenda and put an end to this madness.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_000: Wilred mentioned obtaining the power to bring down the Empire. Of what power could he be speaking...?
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_BERTLIANA_000_003: I was out foraging...when the Corpse Brigade came... They took me to their hideout...and they...they... <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_BERTLIANA_000_004:
The whole while, they laughed at me... <sob> They said that I suffer...
b-because I cling on to hope... <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_BERTLIANA_000_005: Is it wrong to dream of home? Is it wrong to call ourselves Ala Mhigans?
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_006: Do not heed such poisonous notions, child. Our dreams are what sustain us. Be strong─I swear to you, those villains will answer for their crimes in due time. But tell me...does anyone else know of this?
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_BERTLIANA_000_007: Wilred... He saw me outside... He was so angry...
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_008: I must tend to Bertliana. In the meantime, I need you to find out what the young ones make of this. I fear that they may do something rash.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_BERTLIANA_000_009: ...Don't worry about me. Just being near everyone again eases my heart...
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_010: O mighty Rhalgr, Lord of Destruction...we implore You, lend us Your strength and put an end to the suffering of Your people...
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_011: Hmph, here to interfere again? Well, you're too late. Our plan is already in motion.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_012: Once we have the crystals, our enemies will pay for their crimes, and no one will dare oppress us ever again!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_NPCA_000_020: What those animals did to Bertliana is unforgivable! And to think they look down on us!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_NPCA_000_021: Well, I'll suffer this humiliation no more! I'm with Wilred to the bitter end! I'm not afraid of a few lizards!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_NPCB_000_030: If this plan succeeds, we'll have the power to lay the Empire low! To change the world for the better!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_NPCB_000_031: Might be as Gundobald's content to eke out an existence in this musty old cave, but I'll be damned if I'm going to spend the rest of my life here. Now, where in the seven hells did I put that bloody map?
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_050: ...Gone? The whole lot of them? Then it is as I feared─they mean to take matters into their own hands. But what exactly is it that they mean to do?
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_051: What's this? A hunting knife...and a map of Zanr'ak? ...Wait. You said Wilred spoke of crystals, did you not? But they couldn't possibly mean to─ By the gods, this is rank madness...
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_052: The young fools are untrained and unblooded, all. They have no notion of how dangerous the Amalj'aa are. They'll be butchered before they get within a hundred yalms of the crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_053: They are headed east. If we hurry, we may yet find them before it's too late.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_NPCA_000_056: Wh-What went wrong? It was supposed to be easy! Damn it all to the seven hells!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_061: This is all wrong... Getting the crystals was supposed to be the start... We were going to reclaim our homeland... We were... We...
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_063: W-We were going to make an offering of crystals to Rhalgr─to summon Him, j-just like the masked man taught us.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_064: We plotted to sneak into Zanr'ak and make off with the lizardmen's cache, b-but they caught us and...and... So many dead... Gods forgive me...
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_AMALJAA_000_065: (-???-)Heathens! You shall pay for your crimes with your souls!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_066: I regret our young ones' transgressions, but a soul is too high a price for youthful folly.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_067: For all their failings, they are the hope of the Ala Mhigan people. This hope I will guard with my life.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_070: Your skill at arms is impressive, adventurer. Our wayward youths could learn much from a  like you.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_071: The battle is won, but it would be unwise to linger here. Let us return to Little Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_072: W-Wait! We've come all this way─we have to get the crystals! They're right there, ripe for the picking!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_073: Have you learned nothing, Wilred? Did you not see those tempered wretches?
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_074: Such is the fate of those who are touched by a god. Is that what you desire for yourself and your friends?
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_075: What!? N-No one said anything about─ The masked man told us we could defeat the Empire if we summoned Rhalgr! He swore─
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_076: Enough. I will hear the rest of this sorry tale back in Little Ala Mhigo. I daresay  will wish to hear it as well.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_080: No more lies, Wilred. Tell us everything.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_081: I was outside with the others when he appeared─the masked stranger.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_082: He told us about summoning Rhalgr, about using crystals, and then just...vanished. We never saw him again.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_083: I wanted so desperately to believe that we could raise ourselves from this squalor that I never stopped to question his motives. But I should have known─there's no solution, nothing we can do to change our lot. Our people are doomed to live and die like beasts...
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_084: Listen to me, Wilred. Our home may be lost to us, but it takes more than stones and mortar to define who we are. No matter where we may be, Ala Mhigo lives on within us all.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_085: It is for you to decide what to make of this legacy. But whatever you choose to do with your life, never forget that you owe it to this adventurer─an outsider.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_000_087: Thank you for saving me. And...sorry I tried to kill you.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_000_088: My thanks as well, friend. It gives us hope to know that there are kind souls such as you out there. Little Ala Mhigo may not have much in the way of comfort, but you will always be welcome here.
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_QIB_TODO001: Protect Wilred and defeat the Amalj'aa!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_AMALJABOSS_GAIUSA70: The whelps must pay for their crimes!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_GUNDOBALD_BATTLETAL: I will not let you harm them!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_AMALJABOSS_GAIUSA70: Come, ye blessed of our Lord's breath!
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_WILRED_BATTLETALK_D: It wasn't meant to end...like this...
TEXT_GAIUSA709_00782_YOUNGMAN_A_GAIUSA70: No! I don't want to die!
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_GUNDOBALD_000_000: Would that we had more information to offer, but what Wilred told you is the extent of our knowledge of the masked stranger.
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_GUNDOBALD_000_001: Left unchecked, that man will bring about great pain and suffering. I pray that you'll find and put a swift end to the creature─for the sake of the young ones who died by his poisoned words.
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_MINFILIA_000_010: Welcome back, ! I'm reliably informed the investigation took you to Quarrymill and Little Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_MINFILIA_000_011: So tell me, were you able to learn aught of Lahabrea?
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_MINFILIA_000_012: Planted the knowledge of summoning in impressionable young minds, you say? Precisely the kind of deception the Ascians would employ...
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_MINFILIA_000_013: While many of the ills that ail the land can be attributed to the Calamity, some are being brought about by a malign will.
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_MINFILIA_000_014: We must needs delve deeper into this, while things remain quiet on the primal front.
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_TATARU_000_015: All work and no play makes Minfilia a dull Scion.
TEXT_GAIUSA710_00783_MINFILIA_000_018: Ahem. Mayhap we ought to rest awhile before speaking further of the investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSA802_00786_IVAURAULT_000_000: There is something you should know. I have been keeping this to myself, lest I worsen Medrod's paranoia, but I, too, have seen the winged eyeball.
TEXT_GAIUSA802_00786_IVAURAULT_000_001: I cannot say whether it was coincidence, but my sighting took place precisely the same time as Medrod's. I was heading home after a day of digging when a shadow fell over me.
TEXT_GAIUSA802_00786_IVAURAULT_000_002: Looking up, I found myself locked in a gaze with a giant eyeball. I let out a scream at the top of my lungs and ran without once looking back. This happened at the rocky area west of here, in case you had a mind to investigate.
TEXT_GAIUSA802_00786_DUMMY_000_010: (/lookout at rocky area and slay the spider that pops.)
TEXT_GAIUSA802_00786_IVAURAULT_000_020: A monstrous banemite appeared...and you slew it!? That creature had long been a scourge upon the folk of Fallgourd!
TEXT_GAIUSA802_00786_IVAURAULT_000_021: Intentional or no, you have done us a great service. You have my gratitude!
TEXT_GAIUSA802_00786_IVAURAULT_000_022: ...But this does make me wonder, was it truly a winged eyeball I saw? Or merely a trick of light combined with blind panic?
TEXT_GAIUSA803_00787_AIDEEN_000_000: There's something else I heard about the deaths. It appears all the victims have been comely maidens. I'd better watch myself, eh!? Heh heh heh!
TEXT_GAIUSA803_00787_AIDEEN_000_001: <sigh> Unseemly japes aside, there's a rumor been going around. There's some as whisper that, after each victim died, her rancor went into the great big rock southwest of here, causing it to flash and moan.
TEXT_GAIUSA803_00787_AIDEEN_000_002: This bears investigating, I reckon. I'm going to give you a firesand stick to blow off a piece of that crag. The stick doesn't come with a fuse or anything, so you'll have to throw the thing. Once you've torn the rock a new one, bring back some of the fragments, and I'll give them a gander.
TEXT_GAIUSA803_00787_AIDEEN_000_030: Most folk are too scared to go within a hundred yalms of the Rock of Rancor─aye, it has a name. But what's a few vengeful spirits to a dauntless adventurer like you, eh?
TEXT_GAIUSA803_00787_AIDEEN_000_031: ...Huh? Why, these are just your garden-variety crystals! 'Tis a bit hard to tell beneath all the dirt and grime, but they're definitely lightning-aspected.
TEXT_GAIUSA803_00787_AIDEEN_000_032: I almost hate to say it, but that explains the flashing and moaning. Nothing to do with the masked stranger. Looks like I've gone and wasted both your time and a perfectly good firesand stick. Oh, well...
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_MEDROD_000_000: <sigh> There've been no promising leads in the murders. I can scarce get a wink of sleep, knowing that the killer is still at large.
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_MEDROD_000_001: Judging by your furrowed brows, I take it this sorry business troubles you as much as it does me.
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_IVAURAULT_000_002: I had been pondering my encounter. I was uncertain for a time, but there can be no doubt: it was a winged eyeball that I witnessed. It's implausible that I could have mistaken so distinct a creature for a banemite.
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_MEDROD_000_003: But you and I were malms apart. How could we have both seen it at precisely the same time?
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_MEDROD_000_004: What's more, our adventurer friend here had a run-in with the banemite at the very spot you claimed to see that fiendish eyeball. Isn't that right?
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_IVAURAULT_000_005: There must be an explanation! I know I saw an eyeball with wings─I would wager an apple tart on it!
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AIDEEN_000_006: Oooh, he's serious. But listen, mayhap it's not as mysterious as we're making it out to be. There's no reason why there couldn't be─
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AIDEEN_000_007: <gasp> Gods, of course... There must be more than one of the buggers! Ugh, it's so obvious. But then that means...since there have been repeated sightings of these fiends...then there must be even more victims as yet undiscovered...
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_MEDROD_000_009: I-I do believe we're out of our depth. We ought to leave the rest to the expert.
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AIDEEN_000_010: Y-Yes, we're just civilians, after all. Good luck, adventurer. It was a pleasure knowing you!
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_IVAURAULT_000_011: While I burn to know the truth, some things are best left unknown. Lest you have forgotten, it was at the rocky area to the west that I had my encounter.
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_IVAURAULT_000_012: Should you discover aught of note, you will want to alert the authorities. There is a guardhouse nearby. The Serpents there should be pleased for any information that pertains to the security of the region.
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AETHELMAER_000_020: Greetings, adventurer. Is there aught I might assist you with?
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AETHELMAER_000_022: No matter how many bodies I see, I cannot seem to get used to the horrid sight. Poor woman...
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AETHELMAER_000_023: Identical deaths have been reported in the Central Shroud. While the masked stranger you seek does not seem to feature in any, sightings of the winged eyeball are common enough. The creature appears to be moving the bodies, but to what end, none can say.
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AETHELMAER_000_024: The victims have all been young women. All are found with their faces mutilated beyond recognition. It's been difficult to identify them, so as to notify their next of─
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AETHELMAER_000_025: Hm? This button, engraved with a lily motif... The very same object was found upon another victim. A family sigil, or that of an organization, perhaps?
TEXT_GAIUSA904_00799_AETHELMAER_000_026: Either way, I dare to hope that this find will prove pivotal in solving the murders.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_AETHELMAER_000_000: I would have you hold on to the lily button. You will need it to continue your investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_AETHELMAER_000_001: While it isn't standard procedure to entrust key evidence to individuals, you have proven yourself reliable and resourceful in this matter. I see no reason why you shouldn't carry on your work.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_AETHELMAER_000_002: If I might make a suggestion, you may wish to take the button to Gridania and have it examined by Miounne. Mayhap someone in her vast network of contacts can shed light upon its sigil.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_MIOUNNE_000_010: Good  to you, . By your grim expression, I suspect you aren't here for scones and herb tea.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_MIOUNNE_000_011: Well, isn't this a lovely little button. The engraving is quite exquisite─artisan-level quality, I would say. Where did you say you found this? ...On a dead body? Lovely.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_MIOUNNE_000_012: Anyway, I'm afraid I do not recognize the lily sigil. You will have to find the answer the old-fashioned way─by asking around. You could do worse than beginning with Bernadette, over by the aetheryte plaza. She has a sharp pair of eyes, that one.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_BERNADETTE_000_020: Need help tracking down the owner of a button? That's certainly not a request I receive on a regular basis. Well, go on, then─show me what you have.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_BERNADETTE_000_021: Hmmm... Seems to be some manner of decorative button, reminiscent of those worn by the families of old, though I cannot claim to know its sigil. However, I can say with certainty that the white lily is a recurring theme in Gridanian culture.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_BERNADETTE_000_022: Alas, I do not know who would make a personal sigil of it. If there is a soul in Gridania who does, it would be Ceinguled over at the Lancers' Guild. The woman makes a point of knowing all the citizens on a forename basis.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_CEINGULED_000_030: Bernadette believes that I can help you? Well, that is a rather bold assumption to make. I will try to assist, never you fear, but whether aught comes of it is another matter. Now, then, what do you require of me?
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_CEINGULED_000_031: Fascinating... Work of this quality is rarely seen in the hands of ordinary Gridanians. The owner of this button is most certainly well-to-do. You may wish to take your search to the Gentry's Ward, northwest of here.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_CEINGULED_000_032: Wait. A memory comes to me. Of late, there has been a man who is perpetually seated at the bench by the ward's entrance. His name is Ursandel, and I distinctly recall seeing a markedly similar button upon the breast of his jacket. I daresay he can tell you a thing or two about it.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_URSANDEL_000_040: I do not believe we are acquainted. Pray leave me to my thoughts.
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_URSANDEL_000_041: <gasp> The sigil of the Dartancours family! How...how is it that you came to be in possession of this button?
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_URSANDEL_000_042: ...From the body of a murdered woman? H-Her face...was it marred in any way?
TEXT_GAIUSA905_00800_URSANDEL_000_043: I had feared as much... <sigh> I can no longer feign ignorance. I shall reveal to you the truth of the deaths, but on one condition: you promise to put an end to my lady's madness and free her from her torment.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_000: I was once a manservant in the employ of one of the oldest and proudest families in Gridania─the Dartancours. During that time, I had the honor of waiting upon Lady Amandine, mistress of the household. Fair as summer was she, and possessed of a heart befitting her radiance.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_001: Alas, the Calamity wrought a great change in her. Though my lady escaped with her life, death may well have been a kinder fate. Never will I forget the day her bandages were removed, and she beheld her disfigured face for the first time. At that moment, the kindly woman I knew ceased to be.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_002: Unable to bear the thought of being seen, my lady sequestered herself within her chambers and refused all company. This continued for many uneasy moons, until one day, without warning, she began receiving queer guests. None among us knew whence they came, these masked men, but my lady believed that they would help her to regain that which she had lost. So began the “rites of rejuvenation.”
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_003: These rituals seemed innocent enough in the beginning, but grew ever more grotesque as time went by. Eventually, there came a day when my lady bound one of her handmaidens to her bed, and...and proceeded to mutilate the poor girl's face. Suffice it to say, she did not survive the ordeal. It fell to me to dispose of her body.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_004: I performed the dreadful task as bade, obedient servant that I was, but when the time came to return to the house, my legs refused to move. I knew then that I could not go back to that place, not after the nightmare I had witnessed. So it was that I left Haukke Manor, my home for nigh on half a century.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_005: Long did I weep for the girl who was slain, and longer still for the woman that Lady Amandine had been. Yet one cannot weep forever, and I endeavored to put the matter behind me. Indeed, I had resolved never to speak of my experience...until you appeared before me.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_006: My lady's madness must be ended, lest more innocent lives be lost. Lay her tormented soul to rest, as you swore to me you would. She awaits you at Haukke Manor, on the western edge of the Central Shroud. Go now. Go and do what must be done.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_DUMMY_000_020: (Raid the hell out of Haukke Manor)
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSWORD_000_300: (-???-)Darkness has taken root within these halls...
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_3: (-???-)...Sprung from the most unlikely of seeds.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSWORD_100_301: (-???-)One cannot help but admire the irrepressible spirit that quickened it to life.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_3: It is a pleasure to meet you at last, adventurer. You are every bit as intriguing as our master gave us to believe.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSWORD_000_303: It is no ordinary mortal who can acquire one Crystal of Light...much less three.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSWORD_000_304: The Crystals make you strong, and it is to that strength that the Light is drawn.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSWORD_000_306: ...A pity that your existence is irreconcilable with our own. We cannot well allow you to continue upon your present course.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_3: Alas, we came here not to play, but to take the measure of your strength for Master Lahabrea. That task now accomplished, we take our leave of you.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_ASCIANSWORD_000_308: Fare you well, Bringer of Light.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_030: You are returned! What sights awaited you within the manor? What has become of Lady Amandine? You must tell me all!
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_031: ...So she went so far as to consort with devils. Would that I could have done more to prevent her fall. May she finally find peace in the beyond.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_032: I know not whether the masked men you encountered are the same pair that first led my lady astray, but it is plain that they are of the same vile brood. Should the chance ever present itself, promise me that you will visit upon them tenfold the woe they have brought upon others.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_URSANDEL_000_033: But who am I to speak of punishment? By my silence, I allowed I know not how many innocent young women to die in unspeakable circumstances... It matters not wherefore─through misplaced loyalty, cowardice, or both, I am an abettor to a gross crime. I will surrender myself to the authorities and accept whatever punishment they deem just. I only pray that the gods will have mercy on my soul.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_040: Welcome back, . Full glad am I to see you safely returned. Tell me, how fared you on your sojourn in the Twelveswood?
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_041: ...Two of Lahabrea's minions? ...And they sought to measure your strength...by their own admission?
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_042: The devils taunt us... It is beyond doubt, then─the Ascians have begun to move in earnest. Would that we knew to what end.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_043: Yet I will not bemoan our plight. Thanks to your tireless efforts, we are at least aware of the encroaching Darkness.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_044: Alas, we can only do so much. It is clear to me now that we Scions are too few to protect the realm against this threat unaided.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_045: We must needs alert the three nations to the presence of this elusive enemy, and recommend that they heighten their vigil.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_046: There is no shortage of misery in the world that the Ascians might exploit. We have an arduous struggle ahead of us.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_047: Yet come what may, we must not allow ourselves to become lost to hope, for that is precisely what the enemy desires.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_048: We have gleaned all we can from the information available to us. Let us set this investigation aside for the present.
TEXT_GAIUSA906_00801_MINFILIA_000_049: Another matter has arisen that requires your attention. Let me know when you are ready to be briefed, and I will summon the others.
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_000: Gah hah hah! So, ye want to hear the tale of how the Company of Heroes bested a primal, do ye?
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_001: Let me guess: ye mean that bastard Tidus, aye?
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_002: Oh, if only ye'd been there to see it!
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_003: 'Twas a mighty struggle, like the legends of old!
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_004: Me an' the boys fought him for three days an' nights, we did!
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_005: The ground trembled with every step Tidus took, an' when he hit ye, , it felt like a cannonball to the gut. Uggghhh! Just like that!
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_006: Oi, what's that look for? I'm a godsdamned hero, I'll have you know! The people 'round here sing me praises! Don't tell me ye only care about learnin' the secret tactics we used to beat ol' Tidus...
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_007: Hmph! Well, too bad, 'cause now I'm not feelin' charitable. If yer so damn desperate, then why don't ye do me a favor an' kill those rats that've made a nest by the windmill just south of here? Aye, do that, then we'll talk!
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_020: Eh? So the beasties are dead, are they? Nice work, 'venturer!
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_TRACHTOUM_000_021: Saved me the hassle of─ah, never mind.
TEXT_GAIUSB002_00809_POP_MESSAGE_000: A high-pitched squeal pierces the air!
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_TRACHTOUM_000_000: ...What? Ye still askin' about how we beat Tidus? I dunno, 'venturer...it was a pretty risky strategy, the kind only a veteran of ten score battles could rely upon.
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_TRACHTOUM_000_001: I want to teach ye, I truly do! But unless ye prove ye have what it takes to face that fat bastard, I can't in good conscience tell you a damn thing!
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_TRACHTOUM_000_002: At the very least, ye'd need to be capable of slayin', say, a goobbue...
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_TRACHTOUM_000_003: Come to think of it, that ain't a bad idea. Them creatures have a taste for the flour milled here, so ye ought to have no trouble findin' one in the vicinity.
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_TRACHTOUM_000_004: 'Course, I ain't askin' ye to cut one down quick as a skilled axeman like meself!
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_TRACHTOUM_000_005: Anyroad, why don't ye try headin' due west an' standin' lookout 'case a goobbue comes callin'? Slay it, an' I might consider tellin' ye more about ol' Tidus.
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_TRACHTOUM_000_020: Eh? You again? Then that goobbue that was harassin' the millers is dead?
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_TRACHTOUM_000_021: Didn't think ye had it in ye, 'venturer. Still, you took forever an' a day to get the job done. I'm still not sure if I should tell you our secrets...
TEXT_GAIUSB003_00810_POP_MESSAGE_000: You feel the ground tremble beneath your feet...
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_000: So, uh...as I was sayin', I still don't know if ye've got what it takes to face Tidus. Maybe if ye slew a─
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_NPC1_000_001: Trachtoum? You in here drinking again? If you are, that goobbue had better be dead!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_002: Oh, it's dead, chief, ye have me word on that! Cleaved the beast's skull in two with me trusty axe, I did!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_NPC1_000_003: Is that a fact? And what will your friend here say if I ask ?
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_004: vouch for me, of course! Ain't that right...friend?
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_NPC1_000_005: Tell me true: was it Trachtoum who slew that goobbue...or was it you?
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_006: Chief! Wh-What are ye sayin'!? It's me, Trachtoum, the finest axeman ever to serve in the Company of Heroes, the legendary mercenaries who slew that bastard Tidus!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_NPC1_000_007: ...Tidus? Tidus? Who in the seven hells is Tidus!? Some primal you fought in a drink-sodden dream? The Company of Heroes slew Titan, you bloody half-wit!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_008: Ah. Aye, well...see, Tidus was what me an' the lads used to call him.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_NPC1_000_009:
That's the biggest load of Sahagin shite I've ever heard.
Both of you, outside! We'll learn the truth the Lominsan way!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_NPC1_000_010: Trachtoum─if you didn't slay that goobbue, you may consider your contract revoked!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_012: All right, all right, I admit it! I lied about bein' in the Company of Heroes. But I'm beggin' ye, chief─please don't dismiss me! I've learned me lesson, honest I have!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_NPC_000_013: Save your blubbering, Trachtoum. <sigh> Gods, I should've known...
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_014: Mercy, please! I didn't want to deceive ye, I swear! It's just that I kept gettin' turned away by all the folk I asked for work, an' I panicked!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_016: See, the last job I had was at Costa del Sol, an' there was this grizzled marauder everyone treated like royalty. When I heard he was a captain in the Company of Heroes, I finally understood why.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_017: I-I wasn't bein' serious when I said I was one of 'em! But ye went an' believed me, so I...so I, er...
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_018: L-Look─his name was Wheiskaet, all right!? Wheiskaet! He'll tell ye how to defeat Titus or whatever the hells that thing's name is!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_000_019: That's what ye wanted, ain't it!? So come on, then! Tell the chief to forgive me! It's only fair!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_050: Pardon? You wish to slay the Lord of Crags?
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_051: We must slay him, Captain. The people of Limsa Lominsa are depending upon us.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_052: Hmph. You fancy yourselves heroes, then─just like in the tales?
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_053: Be not so quick to judge. Long have I labored for the well-being of you and yours. And my associate here has bathed in Ifrit's hellfire and lived.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_054: is blessed with a power that protects  from primal influence. Thus was  able to lay low the Lord of the Inferno.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_055: We know full well the risks, and have taken every possible precaution. We lack only the knowledge of how to enter Titan's lair. Pray be so good as to grant us the boon of your wisdom, and we shall be on our way.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_056: A  who can't be tempered? Useful...but it will not be enough.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_057: It is true that the Company of Heroes fought and felled primals─but each victory was bought with the lifeblood of brave men and women.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_058: And Titan was the worst we faced. Aye, we defeated him─in the end─but he took from us some of our very best.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_059: Even if you possess the power you claim, I have no reason to believe you will succeed.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_060: Believe what you will. We mean to try.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_061: Though our lives be forfeit, we will not abandon Limsa to the wrath of Titan.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_062: You are passionate, I'll grant you that...
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_063: ...And you deserved better than the greeting I gave you. But I will not send you into O'Ghomoro on a whim. To be plain, I do not wish to see you give your lives in vain.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_064: At the very least, I must have assurances that you are more than common adventurers.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_065: I oversee security for Master Gegeruju's estates. Perhaps you can demonstrate your abilities by attending to one of our─
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_066: Ye gods, man─have you heard nothing I have said? We have not the time to perform trivial tasks. The enemy is at the gates!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_067: Do you imagine words can sway me, girl?
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_068: If you dislike my conditions, then you are welcome to find your own way into O'Ghomoro.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_069: <sigh> Though it pains me to admit it, I fear we have no choice but to acquiesce to the man's demands.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_070: Yet much remains to be done if we are to best Titan. Forgive me, but I must ask you to undertake this task alone. I will use the time to see to the remaining preparations.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WHEISKAET_000_071: Leaving the dirty work to others, are we? Heh, very well.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_YSHTOLA_000_072: Pray do whatever the good captain bids...however trifling. Remember: the fate of Limsa Lominsa hangs in the balance.
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_BATTLETAL: All right─ye know the rules! First  to smash  boulder will be judged the goobbue slayer!
An' don't even think about tryin' to kill me! That's cheatin'!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_WINDMILGUARD_GAIUSB:
Who picked these boulders!? They're nothing alike!
Ah, the hells with it─let the contest begin!
TEXT_GAIUSB004_00811_TRACHTOUM_BATTLETAL: How ye doin', ? Feelin' a bit stiff, by any chance?
Heh heh...only killin's against the rules!
Y-Yer still at it!? Bugger me─'tis lucky I've got one of these!
Ack...ye rotten, stinkin' pile of...goobbue shite!
TEXT_GAIUSB005_00812_WHEISKAET_000_000: Master Gegeruju's requests can be more demanding than you realize. Before I set you to your true task, I would like to verify that this won't be a waste of my time.
TEXT_GAIUSB005_00812_WHEISKAET_000_001: A nix has recently been seen prowling the beach to the east. As you can imagine, my master does not want large slimy creatures anywhere near his lands.
TEXT_GAIUSB005_00812_WHEISKAET_000_002: The beast is cunning, but you should have no difficulty luring it out with herring.
TEXT_GAIUSB005_00812_WHEISKAET_000_003: Slay the nix and return to me. Oh, and don't forget to bring me a leg as proof of the kill.
TEXT_GAIUSB005_00812_WHEISKAET_000_020: Well? Did you deal with the nix?
TEXT_GAIUSB005_00812_WHEISKAET_000_025: Lest you think me overly cautious for testing you in this way, you should know that we had an incident not long ago. A foolish young employee was dismissed for lying about his past. He claimed to have served in the Company of Heroes, but I knew for a fact he did not.
TEXT_GAIUSB005_00812_WHEISKAET_000_026: Anyway, now that the pointless busywork is finished, I shall give you a challenge as befits your talents.
TEXT_GAIUSB005_00812_POP_MESSAGE_000: Ripples in the water catch your eye...
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_WHEISKAET_000_000: Two highly distinguished individuals are scheduled to visit Costa del Sol in the near future, and Master Gegeruju wishes to welcome them with an elaborate banquet.
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_WHEISKAET_000_001: But while money is no object, not everything Master Gegeruju desires can be so easily purchased.
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_WHEISKAET_000_002: It is to be an extremely exotic feast. And so, , your mission is to seek out and obtain the rare ingredients our chef requires.
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_WHEISKAET_100_002: Naturally, such fine dining must be accompanied with a suitable wine. And by “suitable,” I mean “the very best there is.” That, however, can wait for the time being, as I believe you have enough on your plate as it is.
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_WHEISKAET_000_003: It will be a long and arduous journey, but you need not toil alone. Many of the mercenaries who once served under my command still live, and they will guide you in your quest. For the first ingredient, I would have you travel to the South Shroud and speak with Landenel at Camp Tranquil.
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_WHEISKAET_000_004: ...What? Do you mean to tell me that you cannot afford to waste time, as your associate did?
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_WHEISKAET_000_005: Adventurer, if you have not the endurance to complete this mission, how do you expect me to believe you can outlast the Lord of Crags? Either do it or don't─I have work to do.
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_LANDENEL_000_021: ...So this is the one who would challenge Titan. I've been expecting you, .
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_LANDENEL_000_022: The ingredient you seek is the egg of a giant adamantoise.
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_LANDENEL_000_023: The method of acquisition should be obvious─you steal it from the beast's nest, of course. Simple in theory, but difficult in execution. Most who try die in the attempt.
TEXT_GAIUSB007_00814_LANDENEL_000_024: Will I help you get it? Hah, you amuse me. I will not jeopardize my position by openly assisting you. From me you will receive only information. What you do with it is your choice.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_000: Perrrsistent bugger. Very well, let's have a look at you.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_100_001: ...You've seen your share of battle, there's no mistaking that. And you did manage to obtain that adamantoise egg. However, that was naught more than a display of brrrute force and blind courage.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_100_002: The nunh I once fought also believed that his strrrength would save him. He was wrong, and now I am nunh.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_100_003: Many years ago, I joined the Company of Heroes to hone my skills, instead of challenging my predecessor before I was ready. Even when I was young, I understood that victorrry goes to the patient, the cunning, the pragmatic.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_100_004: That is why I claimed my position, and it is why I still hold it. And it is why I will not help an unprrroven whelp.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_100_005: The Children of the Sands do not offer aid to strangers. To do so is a sign of weakness. However, if you were rrrecognized as a skilled hunter in your own right, it would be permissible to assist you.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_001: Across the desert to the east lies an Amalj'aa encampment. There dwells a warrior renowned both for his strrrength and his guile. To even face this Amalj'aa in battle, you must first find a way to lure him away from the encampment.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_002: This will be your test: to drrraw out and defeat the veteran. For this, I will offer you no advice─only this worn spear.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_003: Why, you ask? You will have to solve that rrriddle yourself. Now go─slay this old warrior and bring to me his necklace.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_020: Tell me, adventurerrr: is our old nemesis dead?
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_025: 'Tis a fine necklace, as befits a veteran of countless battles. It will make an excellent trophy.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_026: The spear? It belonged to one of his brrrothers. I knew when he spied it from afar, he would be unable to rrresist venturing outside the encampment to see for himself.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_027: Did you discern my intent, or was it dumb luck, I wonder...
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_UODHNUN_000_028: Heh heh heh! Either way, you imprrress me, adventurer! I shall tell you of the ingredient you seek.
TEXT_GAIUSB102_00821_POP_MESSAGE_000: A mournful cry echoes across the desert...
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_000: A shame we did not meet when I was still with the Company of Heroes. You would have made a fine rrrecruit.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_001: But no point dwelling on what cannot be. You have a Wellwick worm to hunt.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_002: Sandworms slither brrrazenly across the desert dunes, but Wellwick worms are far fewer in number. Rarity brrreeds demand, and so their meat is highly prized as a delicacy.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_003: The only way to catch your quarry is to entice it with something it cannot rrresist.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_004: These worms prrrey on the smaller creatures of the Sagolii. A freshly slaughtered angler carcass would be my choice of bait.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_005: There is an area teeming with anglers to the east. I will mark it upon your map, along with the location where Wellwick worms are most frrrequently sighted.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_006: Be warned─the blood will drive the worm into a feeding frrrenzy. If your skills are lacking, it will devour you as well.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_030: You look well. Have you caught your quarry, then?
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_035: Your skills as a hunter rrrival those of our best. I applaud your success, .
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_036: The meat will need to be heavily smoked before I ship it to Wheiskaet. Worry not─you have my word that he will rrreceive it in time for the banquet.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_037: You must be eager to obtain the third ingrrredient. I regret to say that I know naught of its location. For the nonce, you should return to Costa del Sol and seek Wheiskaet's counsel.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_UODHNUN_000_038: Ah, but hold a moment. Since you will be meeting the captain again soon, there is something I would like you to deliver to him for me.
TEXT_GAIUSB103_00822_POP_MESSAGE_000: The sand surrounding the angler carcass begins to pulse and throb...
TEXT_GAIUSB112_00831_UODHNUN_000_000: The captain was always fond of this brandewine. I would be grrrateful if you could deliver it on my behalf.
TEXT_GAIUSB112_00831_UODHNUN_000_001: I was a rrreckless, angry youth when I first joined the Company, and he would have been well within his rights to cast me out. Everything I have I owe to his wisdom and generrrosity.
TEXT_GAIUSB112_00831_UODHNUN_000_002: Aye, Wheiskaet was a firm-yet-fair teacher, an expert molder of men. And I suspect that is still the case now.
TEXT_GAIUSB112_00831_WHEISKAET_000_020: Well met, . Landenel and U'odh Nunh both spoke highly of you. What brings you here today?
TEXT_GAIUSB112_00831_WHEISKAET_000_025: Ahhh, my favorite. I shall have to thank the nunh personally.
TEXT_GAIUSB112_00831_WHEISKAET_000_026: Now, you have but one ingredient left. Fortunately, you will not have to travel to Aldenard this time to obtain it.
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_WHEISKAET_000_000: Truth be told, I never intended for you to collect this last ingredient. Brayflox, my old quartermaster, wished to bring it to Costa del Sol herself.
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_WHEISKAET_000_001: However, not long ago, she sent word that there's been some trouble at the Longstop, and that the delivery would be delayed indefinitely. She told me nothing of the incident itself, but I fear the situation may be dire.
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_WHEISKAET_000_002: Though I would like nothing more than to aid her myself, I have no choice but to turn to you and your allies. Make haste to Hidden Falls docks and speak with Ozun Nazun. He will direct you to Raincatcher Gully, where Brayflox and her people have made their home.
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_OZUNNAZUN_000_010: What's the hurry, 'venturer? Eh? Somethin' happen over at the gobbie settlement?
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_OZUNNAZUN_000_011: I dunno why yer so eager to help a bunch of beastmen, but go an' talk to the skipper over yonder. She'll ferry ye to Raincatcher Gully.
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_BRAYFLOX_000_020:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Tongueflaps of Wheiskaet be reaching ears of Brayflox. Uplander is come for tastyfresh gobbietreats, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_BRAYFLOX_000_021: Questprize of uplander deep in Longstop. Flighty-beast chased gobbieflock from homes. Gobbieflock needs goodly uplander give safety to Longstop with much hand-lending!
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_BRAYFLOX_100_021:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Brayflox cannot give what Brayflox does not have! Uplander and gobbieflock must first backtake Longstop!
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_BRAYFLOX_000_040:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Goodly uplander has thanks of gobbieflock!
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_BRAYFLOX_000_041: Flighty-beast was tricksy foe, but uplander outwitted with plansmaking. Uplander has goodly head for fighty-think.
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_BRAYFLOX_000_042: Brayflox happygives tastyfresh gobbietreats to clever uplander!
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_BRAYFLOX_000_043: Cheese is stinkysweet gobbietreat! Specialmake with secret gobbiearts!
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_BRAYFLOX_000_044: No party complete without gobbie gouda, Brayflox everysay!
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_WHEISKAET_000_050: <sniff> <sniff> ...I gather you solved Brayflox's little problem?
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_WHEISKAET_000_060: By the gods, that unholy stench! This is─ugh─definitely goblin cheese.
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_WHEISKAET_000_061: Judging from the smell, this should be quite flavorful.
TEXT_GAIUSB201_00832_WHEISKAET_000_062: Hm? How is it made? Ah...it's best you remain ignorant of such things. I still remember when I learned what kind of milk they use... <shudder>
TEXT_GAIUSB209_00840_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: Life can be so delightfully unpredictable. I always had a passion for wine, but it wasn't until I was forced to retire that I could pursue it as more than a mere hobby.
It wouldn't have been possible if not for the savings I amassed during my time as a mercenary, of course. Say what you will about the nature of that work─none can deny that it pays well.
Ah, but you grow impatient, and Wheiskaet must have his wine. Herein lies the problem: nothing in my possession is of sufficient quality for this occasion.
The best vintages in town are hoarded by Byrglaent, who owns and operates the largest winery in Vylbrand.
Somehow, I doubt he will be receptive to your request, but given these circumstances we must needs beg his assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSB209_00840_BYRGLAENT_000_010: What rank amateur bottled this wine? The impurities have rendered it nigh undrinkable. Dismissal is too good for the man responsible─he should be made to drink every drop of his polluted swill!
TEXT_GAIUSB209_00840_BYRGLAENT_000_011:
What is it? I am in the middle of an important discussion, and I do not care for interruptions.
Hm? That neophyte vintner bid you speak with me? Hah!
TEXT_GAIUSB209_00840_BYRGLAENT_000_012: Neither you nor your friend has the palate to appreciate the subtle qualities of my private stock.
TEXT_GAIUSB209_00840_BYRGLAENT_000_013: I would sooner serve you goobbue urine than sell you my worst vintage. Begone from my sight.
TEXT_GAIUSB209_00840_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_:
I take it he said no?
...Really, in those words? Hm, well, I cannot say that I am surprised.
While there's no denying his passion and skill, the Wine Baron of Limsa Lominsa is not a man known for his tact.
Very well. We shall have to take an alternative approach.
TEXT_GAIUSB212_00843_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: There is a chance, however small, that another resident of Wineport can furnish us with a suitable wine. In fact, had you come several years ago, I guarantee this would not be a problem.

Alas, the quality of our product has declined significantly in recent years. The only breeds cultivated these days are common lowland vines. Which isn't to say that their grapes are of poor quality─only that we have known better.
Long ago, the vignerons of Wineport crossbred several species, and produced a grape-bearing vine of never-before-seen quality.
Bacchus grapes were once the pride of this town, as they were used to produce vintages which surpassed all others.
This includes the most aromatic, the most complex, the most flavorful of all wines─aye, the legendary Bacchus wines were born right here in Wineport!
Ahem. Pardon my enthusiasm. You see, I once had the privilege to sample that particular wine.
It was an otherworldly experience. In that moment, I felt as though I had tasted the nectar of the gods themselves. I transcended my mortal flesh, and was one with all creation.

<sigh> But, as is all too often said, the Calamity changed that. The Bacchus vineyards were completely destroyed, along with much of the existing stock of Bacchus wine. What little remains is closely guarded by its owners, for it can no longer be made.

If we cannot convince Byrglaent to part with his wines, our next best option─as ridiculous as it sounds─is to find someone who has a bottle of Bacchus wine, and to offer them every gil we can spare. I've heard rumors that one of the vignerons tending the vineyards might have once owned a bottle─perhaps you could start by speaking with them?
TEXT_GAIUSB212_00843_DURIMFALURIM_000_01: Bacchus wine? Bah, don't remind me─used to have a cellar filled with the stuff! Thought I could keep the wine safe from thieves and the elements. Never counted on a bloody primal blowing up my godsdamned house!
TEXT_GAIUSB212_00843_JUNGHBHAR_000_020: What? Do I have Bacchus wine? I wish! I never had the chance to try it myself. Sorry, friend, but you're a few years too late.
TEXT_GAIUSB212_00843_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: No luck, hm? Most regrettable, but we had to try.
Ahhh, but Bacchus wine would have been perfect for the occasion!
Though, I must confess, my certitude could be due in part to my personal history with the beverage. It is, after all, the very reason I decided to become a vintner.

After Titan blinded me in our battle beneath O'Ghomoro, I fell into a deep depression. It wasn't until I tasted Bacchus wine for the first time that I realized there was still so much I could experience, even in my condition. It helped me to find a new direction in life.
<sigh> It breaks my heart to think that wondrous ambrosia which once filled me with hope may be forever lost to us.
TEXT_GAIUSB304_00845_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: I must say, this talk of Bacchus wine has made me rather nostalgic. Indeed, there is much I miss about my life with the Company of Heroes.
After everything the captain has done for me, I could not bear to disappoint him...
Aye, have no fear. I swear that I shall find a suitable wine for the banquet─though I may need some time to think of a solution.
In the meantime, there is a favor I would ask of you.
Two years ago, in the deepest depths of my despair, I stumbled across Vylbrand as a vagabond drunk. I suspect I was looking for a place to die, because I very nearly found one not far from here.

It was there that a man named Drest took me in and nursed me back to health. And it was he who gave me my first taste of Bacchus wine, which helped me to find my new calling. Though I am still a novice in the arts of winemaking, I would like him to know that I am pursuing my dream.

This wine is my own original creation, and I would be most grateful if you delivered it to him in my stead. Drest sometimes works at the Raincatcher Gully docks, so perhaps Rhitskylt can tell you where to find him.
TEXT_GAIUSB304_00845_RHIITSKYLT_000_010: Drest? Oh, you mean the hermit. Aye, I toss him a few gil when we need an extra pair of hands. He doesn't talk about himself, and I sure as hells don't ask.
TEXT_GAIUSB304_00845_RHIITSKYLT_000_011: When a man's got a face with scars like that, you best leave well enough alone, I say. If you've a mind to find him, though, then head southwest to the Severed String.
TEXT_GAIUSB304_00845_DREST_000_030:
W-Wine? I...I didn't ask for this!
Who sent you!?
I...I... <groan>
TEXT_GAIUSB305_00846_DREST_000_000: Can't...can't sleep... They won't let me sleep...the midges... The buzzing...it keeps me awake...
TEXT_GAIUSB305_00846_DREST_000_001: I'm not... I...I never wanted to hurt anyone. I won't fight. I don't want to fight!
TEXT_GAIUSB305_00846_DREST_000_002: Please, make the buzzing stop! Make the midges go away!
TEXT_GAIUSB305_00846_DREST_000_020: It's not so loud anymore. Did...did you do that? Thank you. You...you helped me. Even after what my comrades and I did to your country...
TEXT_GAIUSB305_00846_DREST_000_021: We were on a reconnaissance mission when the Maelstrom caught us by surprise. We tried to escape, but the others... N-No one else survived.
TEXT_GAIUSB305_00846_DREST_000_022: I didn't ask for this, dammit! I'm not even Garlean! They conquered my lands just like they tried to conquer yours!
TEXT_GAIUSB305_00846_DREST_000_023: I...I don't want to die in some blasted jungle halfway around the world...
TEXT_GAIUSB305_00846_DREST_000_024: I just...I just want to go home...
TEXT_GAIUSB307_00848_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSB307_00848_DREST_000_000: I...I wish to thank Shamani for the wine. That...that was overly kind... Would you be willing to bear a gift back to him?
TEXT_GAIUSB307_00848_DREST_000_001: at Red Mantis Falls, I collected the sap from nearby palm trees. If...if placed in coconut shells and stored for a few bells' time, it...it makes for a fine wine, see... It should be ready by now.
TEXT_GAIUSB307_00848_DREST_000_002: I left three shells out there. Please, take them to Shamani for me. I'm...I'm glad he's moved on with his life. I hope to one day do the same...
TEXT_GAIUSB307_00848_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: It has been some time, . What news do you have of Drest?

<sniff> <sniff> Ah, yes, I recall he did have some knowledge of winemaking. A simplistic but nevertheless effective method that utilizes the natural properties of palm sap. I shall have to enjoy this batch before it spoils.
We are not so different, Drest and I. Two men who have long struggled not to let our scars define us...
I worry that he has been alone with his thoughts for far too long.
Aye, it is past time I paid him a visit. Thank you for looking after him, .
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: By the gods... , listen! I know you're eager to wash your hands of this wine business, but I've just discovered something extraordinary about Drest's palm wine!

He sealed each coconut shell with a leaf─a leaf which has a very distinct shape and unusual odor. I thought I was going mad at first, but now I'm certain: these are the leaves of a Bacchus grape vine!
Do you know what this means? Somewhere in Raincatcher Gully, the legendary vine still grows! If we could obtain a cutting, we could revive the Bacchus wine industry!
We must know where Drest found these leaves! Here, take one of them back to him and see what he remembers!
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_DREST_000_020: It's...it's just a leaf, isn't it? I only chose it because it was pretty. Didn't know it was rare...
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_DREST_000_021: I found them near the juggernaut to the south. But...I didn't see any grape vines.
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_DREST_000_022: I saw fresh goobbue tracks, though. Maybe...maybe the leaves came from vines growing on the back of one such beast?
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_DREST_000_023: If...if you go looking for it, please be careful. Some goobbues are more territorial than others, and you may have to defend yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: What did Drest have to say, ? Tell me everything!
Ahaha, I was right! This smell, this texture... I hold in my hands a Bacchus grape vine cutting!
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_BYRGLAENT_000_061: Come now, enough of this nonsense! I've heard talk of your discovery, and I refuse to believe that a common adventurer and a novice vintner could─
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_BYRGLAENT_000_062: Twelve as my witness, it is a Bacchus grape vine! Where ever did you find this fantastic specimen!?
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_BYRGLAENT_000_063: Wh-What...? You would offer this to me? But why!?
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: There is none better positioned to reconstruct the Bacchus vineyards than you, Master Byrglaent. You have the resources, the knowledge, and the passion to do so. It would be selfish of me to keep this cutting.
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_BYRGLAENT_000_065: I never knew you cared so deeply about your craft. Thank you, good sir. I will not squander this gift! In just a few years' time, I swear that every tavern across Eorzea will once again be clamoring for a cask of Wineport's legendary Bacchus wine!
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: Sir, you needn't─ <sniff> <sniff> Wait! The shape of this bottle, the scent of this label... This couldn't possibly be...
A 1547 Bacchus!? But that's impossible! This vintage has not been seen since years before the Calamity!
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_BYRGLAENT_000_068: It was the crown jewel of my personal collection. For years, I debated opening it, wondering if today or tomorrow would be the ideal time. But now I realize that it was never meant for me─it should be savored by the saviors of Wineport, I say!
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: He has made us an offer we cannot refuse. Master Gegeruju will find no finer wine.
You have forever changed Wineport, . Thank you for your kindness and your generosity.
Ah, but do not permit me to delay you any longer. Pray deliver the wine to Captain Wheiskaet.
Hm? Well, yes, I would very much like to drink it! But I am a patient man. I have faith that one day I shall have another opportunity to taste perfection.
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_WHEISKAET_000_070: Your prolonged absence was beginning to concern me. So, what of the wine I asked you to bring?
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_WHEISKAET_000_071: Is that...? Seven hells, a 1547 Bacchus! Even I know how rare that is!
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_WHEISKAET_000_072: I have to admit, I didn't think you had it in you... But congratulations, . Thanks to you, this will be the most luxurious feast Costa del Sol has seen in years.
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_WHEISKAET_000_073: Considering the lengths you went to, I hope our guests appreciate it.
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_WHEISKAET_000_074: Speaking of which, your associate arrived a short while ago. She appears to be growing somewhat impatient.
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_WHEISKAET_000_075: Perhaps you could tell her that the banquet is about to begin?
TEXT_GAIUSB309_00850_POP_MESSAGE_000: Ripples in the water catch your eye...
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_YSHTOLA_000_000: ...You have the look of a  who has been to the seventh hell and back.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_YSHTOLA_000_001: That a guest should be expected to supply the victuals for a banquet held in  own honor... And this while the shadow of Titan looms over us all! It beggars belief.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_YSHTOLA_000_002: I can only applaud your stoicism. Had I been asked to endure such ignominy, I fear I should have accepted my lot with less grace.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_GEGERUJU_000_101: A thousand pardons for this extreme discourtesy! I was wholly unaware of your true identity, ! Had I known, I would never have permitted my man to subject you to such unspeakable ordeals!
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_102: (-???-)Come now,  must have sensed something was amiss.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_103: You didn't seriously think I would send you running the length and breadth of Eorzea for a banquet, did you?
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_YSHTOLA_000_104: Spare  your mockery, Captain. Your intent was unclear to me until this moment. And unlike me,  has no knowledge of your traditions. Mayhap you would be so good as to enlighten .
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_105: Aye, aye...fair's fair. There's no sense hiding it any longer.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_106: We five were chosen by our brothers and sisters, and before the Company of Heroes disbanded, we each swore a solemn oath...
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_107: That any who would follow in our footsteps must be weighed and measured─not by their reputation, but by their deeds.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_108: Each man would judge these would-be god-slayers by his own criteria. If even one found  wanting,  would be rejected without a second thought.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_109: But if  proved  worthy, we swore that we would do our utmost to support  cause.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_110: The world has ever been full of brave souls eager to give their lives for a righteous cause, but all too few capable of making a difference with their sacrifice. To send wave after wave of hapless adventurers into the jaws of a foe against whom they have no hope of victory is worse than futile. Titan is not one to be challenged lightly, and we will not be complicit in the deaths of the unworthy.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_YSHTOLA_000_111: Which is why the five of you deigned to test  with such commendable thoroughness. Time well spent, I am sure. But tell us, Captain: what is the assessment of you and your fellows?
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_LANDENEL_000_112: 's a brave one, that much is certain.  willingly walked into the midst of danger, despite my repeated warnings that it could cost  life.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_UODHNUN_000_113: skill is undeniable.  stalked  prrrey as relentlessly as any child of the sands, and struck with precision when an opportunity presented itself.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: Too many adventurers these days care only for fortune and glory. , however, is a kind and generous soul. I am certain  has no shortage of loyal allies who will gladly fight at  side.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_BRAYFLOX_000_115:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Wily uplander is talentful plansmaker. Tricksy foe for mighty rockman!
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_116: I can only concur with my colleagues' assessments.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_117: We five of the Company of Heroes hereby judge you a worthy challenger. Cast down the Lord of Crags, , and write a new chapter in the history of Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_118: With the formalities out of the way, let the festivities begin! Summon the dancers, pour the wine!
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_119: Eat, drink, and be merry, my friends, for today we celebrate the birth of a new legend─, Titan's Bane!
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_LANDENEL_000_060: Seeing everyone again like this brings back such fond memories. Hmmm...I wonder if any of them would be interested in reforming the Company?
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_UODHNUN_000_065: It has been too long since I last set foot outside Forgotten Springs. Passing the time with old frrriends and old wine... Aye, today is a good day indeed.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_BRAYFLOX_000_070:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Tastyfresh treats are plentiful in belly of Brayflox!
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: It feels wonderful to be with the others again. I wish this day would never end...
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_NPC_000_025: (Your Elezen friend is quite the dashing rogue. Any chance you could introduce me?)
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_NPC_000_020: Congratulations, sweetling! Now relax and enjoy the show─it's only just begun!
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_SYSTEM_000_030: Tasting the exotic feast triggers a divine revelation. In that brief, transcendent moment, you glimpse the true form of reality, comprehend its fleeting nature, and cry out to the heavens in celebration.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_WHEISKAET_000_040: You are blessed with a fortitude to rival the earth itself. Titan will struggle to break you, I think.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_LANDENEL_000_041: Ah, , you brave fool! Promise me that when you meet Titan, you'll look him in the eye and tell him Landenel sends his regards!
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_UODHNUN_000_042: You are a veteran of countless battles, . This is but one more. Trrrust in your experience, and you will prevail.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_BRAYFLOX_000_043:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Goodly uplander must be facing mighty rockman with clever fighty-think. Gobbieflock cannot be coming to rescue this time!
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: When you face the Lord of Crags, think not of Limsa Lominsa, Eorzea, or anything beyond his chamber. Think only of the men and women by your side.
Fight for them, and they will fight for you. Remember that no great victory was ever achieved alone.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_YSHTOLA_000_050: ...You are kind to indulge them, . This banquet is as much for the Company as it is for you, whatever they may claim.
TEXT_GAIUSB314_00855_YSHTOLA_000_051: I do not deny that they mean well, but now is scarcely the time for celebration. Though they have all but pronounced you the victor, the battle with Titan has yet to begin. The hour has come for the good captain to make good on his promise. We must speak with him again.
TEXT_GAIUSB315_00856_WHEISKAET_000_000: You must be eager to face Titan. As promised, we will show you the way.
TEXT_GAIUSB315_00856_WHEISKAET_000_001: Travel to Bronze Lake in upper La Noscea. There you will meet with Riol, another man who once served with the Company.
TEXT_GAIUSB315_00856_WHEISKAET_000_002: To ensure that this knowledge does not fall into the wrong hands, he will remain in hiding until you have given the correct signal.
TEXT_GAIUSB315_00856_WHEISKAET_000_003: Give me your map. You must whistle loudly at the three locations I mark. Only then will he appear to meet you at this fourth location. I realize this may seem excessive now, but you will see that it is more than reasonable once you comprehend the risks inherent in our method.
TEXT_GAIUSB315_00856_RIOL_000_020: Greetin's, . Might you be the one the cap'n said would come callin'?
TEXT_GAIUSB315_00856_RIOL_000_021: Aye, I thought so. Pay attention, now, 'cause I ain't explainin' meself twice.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_020: Years ago, when we was weighin' up how to get to Titan, one of our scouts stumbled across this beastman aetheryte, see...
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_021: Eh? What's that look for? Not familiar with 'em?
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_022: He speaks of an unamplified aetheryte which has been claimed by a beast tribe. Lest you wonder, there is no fundamental difference between such aetherytes and those which you have used on countless occasions, .
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_023: Ah, well if it ain't the Sharlayan lass. Welcome back.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_024: Forgive me for interrupting. I had planned to await your report, but I succumbed to curiosity.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_025: The tunnels beneath O'Ghomoro form a bewildering labyrinth that no outsider has ever fully explored. How the Company of Heroes managed to navigate it is a mystery I have long pondered.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_026: Ha! Give us a bit of credit, love! We weren't daft enough to try goin' in the front.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_027: The kobolds are always diggin' new tunnels an' fillin' the old ones with traps. One wrong step, an' the next thing you know, ye've got a hundred tonzes o' rock on your noggin. Suicide to even try, see?
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_028: Funny thing was, the kobolds didn't seem to have no trouble findin' their way 'round─an' it was that as got us thinkin'. I mean, U'Ghamaro Mines are like a bleedin' city, ain't they? An' gettin' around in a city that big would be a right pain in the arse if you didn't have an Aethernet, wouldn't it? So it stood to reason that the kobolds must have one, didn't it?
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_029: Hm. Even if there were aetheryte shards in the depths of O'Ghomoro, you would have needed to attune yourselves to them before you could identify their signatures within the Lifestream.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_030: Ah, well, that's where yer wrong, love. We had this Sharlayan bloke to help us, see. Delivered us right into Titan's bedchamber, he did.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_031: I don't rightly know how he did it, but I do remember him sayin' it weren't nothin' any Sharlayan scholar worth her salt couldn't manage.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_032:
...Did he now? Hmph.
Locating a beacon in the absence of a known signature might be possible if the aetherytes in question happened to be... Ah, yes. But in order to guide a traveler to said beacon safely, a second party would be required to... Hmmm.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_033: It is possible─in theory at least. Yet I cannot be certain until I try. Plainly, all will depend upon whether or not I am “worth my salt.”
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_034: Oh, you are, lass! Don't you worry about that! Have a bit o' faith in yerself!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RIOL_000_035: Why don't we all go to Zelma's Run an' take a closer look at the aetheryte? It ain't far─though there's sure to be a few kobolds blockin' the way. Naught ye can't handle, mind!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_040: So this is the aetheryte the Company of Heroes used to gain access to Titan's sanctuary.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_041: Hm. It is as Papalymo speculated.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_042: In its present state, this aetheryte's signal will not be strong enough for our purposes. I may, however, be able to use my own energies to amplify it. Alas, the task will monopolize my attention for the duration.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_043: It seems you will have to proceed without me, . I must needs remain here and supplement this beacon's power, lest you be denied your only path of escape.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_044: Fear not: I will summon the Maelstrom forces stationed nearby to protect us.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_045: With effort, it is possible that I may be able to stabilize the aetheryte's signal and thereby join you, albeit belatedly. Until such time as I do, you will be on your own.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_046: Now...let us see if I am worth my salt.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_047: I have located another beacon─one far below the mountain. I can only speculate as to what you will find there, so stint not in your preparation.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_SCAREDKOBOLD_000_04: Look, an overdweller! Yes, yes, an invader from above!  uses our aetherytes against us!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_ANGRYKOBOLD_000_049: has defiled Titan's sacred sanctuary─trespassed, violated, defiled!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_ZADA_000_051: Brothers and sisters, fear  not!  fate shall be decided by the Lord of Crags!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_ZADA_000_052: Hear me, overdweller! You and your treacherous brethren must be held to account for the breaking of the covenant!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_ZADA_000_053: You shall be first to face judgment! Then Limsa Lominsa and her oathbreakers─liars, betrayers, oathbreakers!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_ZADA_000_054:
O Great Father, Lord of Crags! Titan, we summon You! Titan, we summon You!
O Great Father, Lord of Crags! Titan, we summon You! Titan, we summon You!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_KOBOLDS_000_055: (-Kobolds-)He is come! He is come! The Lord of Crags, Titan is come!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_TITAN_000_056: Overdweller...art thou deaf to their weeping?
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_TITAN_000_057: Thy vile kind coveteth ever the blessing of the land and murdereth my children by the score─all in service to greed. Such sins are beyond pardon.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_TITAN_000_058: Ah...but I am not the first to suffer thy defiance. Thou didst bring Ifrit low.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_TITAN_000_059: Godless overdweller! Thy myriad heresies shall not go unpunished! Upon thee shall I wreak a terrible vengeance!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_KOBOLDS_000_070: (-Kobolds-)The Lord of Crags, Great Father Titan has fallen!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_ZADA_000_071: The crimes of the overdwellers shall never be forgiven! Never be forgotten! No, no, never!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_ZADA_000_072: 'Twas your kin who broke the covenant! We have acted only in defense of our lands!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_ZADA_000_073: Cease your aggression, or never will there be peace! Until our dying breaths, we shall defy you─deny, decry, defy!
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_NERO_000_074: Now these are the readings one would expect of an eikon...
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_NERO_000_075: I have seen enough. We proceed as planned.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RHITAHTYN_000_076: (-???-)Are you sure that is wise, my lord? Your...curiosity is untested and unproven. We do not yet know its true capabilities.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_NERO_000_077: Then trust in mine, Rhitahtyn. My curiosity, as you so eloquently put it, would have bested Titan in the blink of an eye.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_NERO_000_078: Why, if there be truth to the legends, it could readily subjugate the whole of Eorzea given but a little while longer. Is that not so?
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_LAHABREAEORZEA_000_: It is. No greater single power has ever been conceived, much less realized.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RHITAHTYN_000_080: What you say may well be true. But while such devices may win battles, I do not believe they will serve to change the course of this war.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_NERO_000_081: Oh but they will. Have a little faith, my friend.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_RHITAHTYN_000_082: ...I cannot endorse this course of action.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_LAHABREAANCIENT_000: And now  has a fourth. Fascinating.
Carry on, crystal bearer. Far though you have come, your work is far from done.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_086: And naught remained to mark his passing...
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_087: Well, the Ascians are nothing if not elusive. It is of little wonder that they should cast advanced teleportation magicks at will.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_088: But that they would choose to consort with the Empire...
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_089: What common goal could they possibly share...?
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_090: I feared I might arrive too late, but I see you had the matter well in hand.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_091: I have taken measures to ensure that we are not pursued, yet I cannot say how long they will hold.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_092: Take your leave while the kobolds are still in disarray. I will follow anon. There is something I must investigate before I depart.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_093: I will teleport you to the aetheryte in Zelma's Run, and we will rendezvous at Camp Bronze Lake. Agreed?
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_030: I am relieved to see you well. But come, let us discuss our next step.
TEXT_GAIUSB401_00857_YSHTOLA_000_200: I must needs remain here to ensure that you have a means of egress. As I told you, we have no way of knowing what awaits you at the beacon, so be sure to prepare yourself prior to departing.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_ELUNED_000_000: I recognize you now, . Allow me to express my deepest condolences for those who lost their lives in the attack.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_ELUNED_000_001: I apologize if discussing this upsets you, but...you should know that the bodies of your comrades are presently being removed from the Waking Sands and prepared for transport here.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_ELUNED_000_002: If you wish to leave this work to others, I understand. However, taking part might help you to find closure.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCA_000_010: Eh? Ye don't look like one of them church fellas. Not that I'll turn ye away, no sir.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCA_000_011: As ye can see, we've got a pile of unidentified bodies over yonder. No one's come to claim 'em, so off to the lichyard they go.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCA_000_012: Be thankful ye didn't have to go inside and see the carnage for yerself. 'Twas the stuff of nightmares, I tell ye. Godsdamned imperials. <spit>
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCA_000_013: I don't know what quarrel they had with these folks, and I sure as hells don't want to know. The sooner we put this behind us, the better.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCA_000_014: Say...ain't I seen you 'round here afore? Or do ye just have one of them faces? Ah, never mind...
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCA_000_015: Anyroad, there's a carriage come to haul the bodies to the lichyard, out by the east gate.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCA_000_016: There's only eight left to load up, but seein' as I'm exhausted from carryin' all the others, I've a mind to leave the remainder to you.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCA_000_017: Might want to cover yer nose while ye work. Some of these folk're startin' to turn...
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCB_000_030: What happened to the big fella? Ah, forget it. Just bring the next batch and toss 'em in the back─ain't like they'll complain if you're rough!
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCB_000_031: Well, ain't you a strong one. Four in one trip! Reckon there's no need for me to lend you a hand with the rest, then.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCB_000_032: Come on, come on! Let's finish this before I die of old age.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCB_000_033: That should be all of 'em! Thanks for the help.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCB_000_034: Reckon it won't take too long to deliver all the corpses to the lichyard. Even so, you might want to hurry back an' tell 'em that our work here is done.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_NPCB_000_050: What? Wondering why I'm still here? Hells, I don't need to rush. Ain't like these folk have pressing appointments to keep, you know.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_ELUNED_000_060: I see that you decided to heed my advice. I pray that, in doing so, you found some small measure of peace.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_ELUNED_000_061: The first carriage from Vesper Bay arrived not long ago, and we have begun preparing your comrades for burial. I had a hand in the initial rites, and I...I would like you to know that, for many, death came quickly.
TEXT_GAIUSB507_00876_ELUNED_000_062: Rest assured that we will treat them with the utmost respect, and do everything we can to shepherd them to Thal's realm.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_ELUNED_000_000: Although we can perform rites for most of the Scions, there is one whom we cannot accept. We would like you to return this one to her people, the sylphs of Little Solace.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_ELUNED_000_001: It is only proper that she be given into the care of her friends and family, so that they may mourn her in accordance with sylphic traditions.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_KOMUXIO_000_010: This one is surprised to see walking one in Little Solace. How can these ones assist walking one?
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_KOMUXIO_000_011: <gasp> Noraxia!? But...this one does not understand...
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_020: Komuxio, this one has heard much wailing. This one would know what has caused such distress.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_KOMUXIO_000_021: Terrible news, elder one! Awful news!
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_022: Walking one has returned to Little Solace? But why? These ones have not requested further aid.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_023: Noraxia!? How did this happen? Explain everything to this one, at once!
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_024: So...not only Noraxia, but many of walking one's friends were lost as well.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_026: Noraxia went to Thanalan at the behest of this one...
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_027: Walking one was with Noraxia at the end... Tell this one that Noraxia was brave. Tell this one that Noraxia did not suffer.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_028: This one is glad to hear walking one's words.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_029: Thank you for bringing Noraxia home, walking one.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_FRIXIO_000_030: These ones also wish to thank praying ones. Tell praying ones these ones will remember this kindness.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_KOMUXIO_000_031: This one demands vengeance! Imperial ones must pay! Imperial ones must suffer!
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_KOMUXIO_000_032: When the time comes for walking ones to face imperial ones, do not forget these ones! These ones would not have Noraxia's death be for naught! These ones will fight!
