TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_ELUNED_000_040: We thank you for your service to the church and to the sylphs. You may be pleased to know that, in your absence, we interred the remaining Scions in the lichyard.
TEXT_GAIUSB509_00878_ELUNED_000_041: Perhaps you still wish to do more for your friends. If so, I would remind you that you have already done so much on their behalf. Please, take a rest and set aside your burdens for now, .
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_ILIUD_000_000: What a curious twist of fate that Master Cid Garlond would at last be found within our church. It defies imagination...
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_ILIUD_000_001: Beg your pardon, . You wish to find his airship, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_ILIUD_000_002: I know not how much truth there is to it, but there is a tale known as, “The Final Flight of the Enterprise,” which grew popular in the wake of the Calamity─much like “The Great Goobbue Wall of Ul'dah.” It states that the Enterprise flew northwest from Gridania towards Coerthas.
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_ILIUD_000_003: If true, the airship would have passed through the North Shroud, likely over Fallgourd Float─the closest settlement to Coerthas. Mayhap the Serpents stationed there have records of the events that transpired that day.
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_ILIUD_000_004: I had hoped you might rest from your journeys for a time, but I see that the world still has need of you and the Scions. Pray look after yourself and Cid, .
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_AETHELMAER_000_010: Is there aught I can assist you with, ?
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_AETHELMAER_000_011: The Enterprise? You speak of Master Garlond's ship, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_AETHELMAER_000_012: Aye, I needn't refer to the records. I know that the airship was sighted overhead five years ago, clearly bound for Coerthas. What became of it after that I cannot say.
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_AETHELMAER_000_013: If you wish to know more, pray speak with Vortefaurt at Florentel's Spire. He was on duty that day and saw it with his own eyes.
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_AETHELMAER_000_014: I am unsure what it is you hope to accomplish, though. Even should you locate the ship, would you not need a man of Master Garlond's caliber to fly it? I hear tell that the machinery is fiendishly complex...
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_VORTEFAURT_000_020: You have come in search of Vortefaurt? Then well met, for you have found him.
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_VORTEFAURT_000_021: Indeed, I have served as a Wailer for many years, since before the great snows came to Coerthas. What exactly is this about?
TEXT_GAIUSB601_00883_VORTEFAURT_000_022: Ahhh, the final flight of the Enterprise. I do indeed remember that day...
TEXT_GAIUSB602_00884_VORTEFAURT_000_000: 'Twas on the eve of the Battle of Carteneau, nigh on five years ago. I held the spire alone that night, while the bulk of our forces marched to meet the enemy in the field.
TEXT_GAIUSB602_00884_VORTEFAURT_000_001: Then, all of a sudden, the most fantastic airship I'd ever seen splits the sky overhead! I could only watch in shock as it disappeared over the mountains to the northwest. If the Enterprise wasn't destroyed during the Calamity, I'd wager it's still somewhere in Coerthas.
TEXT_GAIUSB602_00884_VORTEFAURT_000_002: The astrologians at the Observatorium may have records which could help. But to obtain them, you would need to deal with the Ishgardians who control the region. I wouldn't expect much, though─the High Houses have long been concerned with their own affairs above all else. When Dalamud descended, they took shelter behind their gates, and even now they have little regard for the plights of other nations.
TEXT_GAIUSB602_00884_VORTEFAURT_000_003: Nevertheless, they may deign to assist you should you prove yourself useful. Consider providing your services to the soldiers who guard the Observatorium. Though they may refuse you at first, I've little doubt they would accept aid freely offered.
TEXT_GAIUSB602_00884_LUDOVOIX_000_010: Excuse me, can you repeat that? You wish to offer your services to House Durendaire? And what, pray tell, do you wish to receive in exchange?
TEXT_GAIUSB602_00884_LUDOVOIX_000_011: Hah, how absurd! As if we would permit an outsider to peruse the records of the Observatorium.
TEXT_GAIUSB602_00884_LUDOVOIX_000_012: Do not mistake our courtesy for friendliness. The Holy See of Ishgard may allow foreigners to travel freely within these lands, but we do not intend to offer succor to strangers.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_LUDOVOIX_000_000: Halone have mercy, are you still here? You may take shelter within our walls if you insist, but do not distract me while I am on duty. We're stretched thin as it is.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_LUDOVOIX_000_001: And where in the hells is that knight I sent out on patrol? He should have returned ages ago!
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_LUDOVOIX_000_002: Hmmm... Perhaps I have a use for you, after all. If you still wish to aid us, search the wilds to the west for my missing man. You will know him by his uniform─that of House Durendaire, as is mine.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_NPC_000_020: If it wasn't for you, , I reckon they would've finished me off.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_NPC_000_021: Despicable dragon-loving bastards. <spit> Death was a mercy they didn't deserve.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_NPC_000_022: I prayed the rumors were mistaken, but this confirms the worst. I must immediately inform my superiors that the heretics are operating within this region. Fare thee well, friend.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_LUDOVOIX_000_030: I must say, I didn't actually expect you to find my knight, much less rescue him! I see I may have been premature in my judgment, .
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_LUDOVOIX_000_031: We are a proud people, beholden to tradition, but that does not mean we are without humility.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_LUDOVOIX_000_032: I shall instruct the astrologians to entertain your request. However, understand that it is ultimately their decision whether or not you may peruse their records. Pray proceed to the Observatorium and introduce yourself to Edmelle.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_EDMELLE_000_040: Ah, the  come in search of the airship. This is highly unorthodox... What ever could Ser Ludovoix be thinking?
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_EDMELLE_000_041: It is true that we maintain meticulous records which stretch back generations. However, because this information is used to chart Dravanian activity, access is strictly controlled. One can never be too careful with heretics and their sympathizers lurking about.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_EDMELLE_000_042: If you would persist with your inquiries, pray seek an audience with Chief Astrologian Forlemort up above.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_FORLEMORT_000_050: No. Absolutely not. Have you any inkling what it is you ask?
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_FORLEMORT_000_051: Were our records to fall into the wrong hands, it could change the course of a war which has raged for generations! I speak not of some mere spat between southron nations. Ours is a holy crusade, and we are the arbiters of Halone's will!
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_FORLEMORT_000_052: I will not put our great nation at risk─certainly not to help a foreigner locate a missing airship, of all things!
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_GUILLAIME_000_053: Pardon the intrusion, Forlemort. I wished to speak with you regarding the recent─ Oh, I did not realize you had a guest.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_FORLEMORT_000_054: Inquisitor Guillaime! Y-You honor us with your presence, sir. The  was just leaving.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_GUILLAIME_000_055: Ahhh, you must be the one who rescued House Durendaire's knight from those heretics. Doubtless they feel indebted to you. I am told you seek an airship last seen in Coerthas five years ago, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_GUILLAIME_000_056: You come to us at an inconvenient time, I fear. Much has changed in the intervening years, and little for the better. While I wish you the best of luck in your search, I would also strongly advise caution.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_GUILLAIME_000_057: The snows can come quickly in Coerthas. One moment you may feel as though you have a firm grasp on your surroundings, safe and secure in your knowledge, and the next you may find yourself in a wholly unfamiliar situation, blind to the dangers hidden by the blizzard. It would be wise for you to focus on a single landmark whilst traveling. Do not give in to temptation and deviate from your course.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_FORLEMORT_000_058: I was not aware you aided House Durendaire in that fashion. Thank you, . Nevertheless, my decision stands. I cannot give you what you seek.
TEXT_GAIUSB604_00886_POP_MESSAGE_000: The sound of snow crunching underneath sabatons grows louder...
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_JOCEA_000_000: You there, ! I could not help but overhear your conversation with the chief astrologian. There may be a way I can assist you, but it would require that you perform for me a favor in exchange.
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_JOCEA_000_001: An associate of mine has yet to return from his expedition to the cliffs east of the Observatorium. He was adamant that he could conduct his observations alone, despite the presence of Ixal in that vicinity. If you would seek out this astrologian and confirm that he is well, it would be a great comfort to me.
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_NPC_000_010: What a relief to see someone other than a godsdamned birdman! I thought I could finish my work whilst the Ixal were away, but they returned far quicker than I anticipated. It was all I could do to hide and hope they might leave again before I froze to─
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_NPC_000_011: Wait, who are you!? You are not one of our knights!
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_NPC_000_012: A man of House Durendaire cannot be seen in the company of an unbeliever! Good day, !
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_JOCEA_000_020: The arrogant fool returned not long before you arrived, muttering about the disgrace of having been rescued by an unbeliever. Serves him right for underestimating the dangers our knights face every day.
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_JOCEA_000_021: Ah, but you are eager to locate your airship. It may surprise you that by saving him, you have already aided your own cause.
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_JOCEA_000_022: House Durendaire is quick to regard outsiders with suspicion, as it is their duty to sound the alarm at the first sign of Dravanian aggression. Yet you have already aided them twice, for which they are honor-bound to repay you.
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_JOCEA_000_023: Even so, they will not grant you access to the Observatorium's records. That is just as well, for there are other ways you might locate your missing airship.
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_JOCEA_000_024: What I propose is that you petition Lord Portelaine for an official introduction to the other High Houses. The word of House Durendaire carries tremendous weight in Ishgard. Should the captain consent, you would have little trouble obtaining information from the other High Houses.
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_PORTELAINE_000_030: You've caused quite a stir in your short time here. First you slay two heretics and save a knight, and now I hear you have rescued a man of our house. I imagine you must desire something for your troubles.
TEXT_GAIUSB605_00887_PORTELAINE_000_031: An introduction to the other High Houses? I cannot deny that you have given us no cause to distrust you. But while you have performed two acts, you would have me endorse you to three High Houses. It is only fitting that you aid us one final time, wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_000: Now, now, I understand you are very eager to find your missing airship. Worry not, for this task should take a  of your skills but a moment to complete.
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_001: Not long ago, a porter bound for Skyfire Locks was ambushed on the road due west of here. Though he escaped with his life, he would very much like his wares as well. On the off chance any portion of his shipment remains, I would have you travel to the scene of the robbery and bring back what you find.
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_002: Lest you intend to perform only a cursory search, bear in mind that recovering the stolen merchandise will endear you to House Haillenarte, further improving the chances that they indulge your request for aid.
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_020: Have you good tidings to share? Or better yet, stolen merchandise to show?
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_NPC_000_021: Gods bless ye, friend! It's all here, every last─ah, but wait. That chest over there looks like it might've been pillaged.
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_NPC_000_022: Bloody hells, that's the personal property of Lord Francel, too...
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_023: Are you certain? Clearly an attempt was made to open it, but the lock appears to have held. Nevertheless, if you wish to verify the contents against your shipping manifest, be my guest.
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_024: Fury take me, a draconian rosary! In the possession of Lord Francel!?
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_025: Yet...perhaps this is not so difficult to fathom. House Haillenarte is whispered to be infested with heretics...
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_026: Thank you for bringing this matter to my attention, . I shall inform the inquisitors immediately. Under these circumstances, I must strongly advise against associating with House Haillenarte.
TEXT_GAIUSB607_00889_PORTELAINE_000_027: Your other introductions will need to be postponed, as well. It is the duty of every Ishgardian to root out and destroy heretics─all else must wait until this matter is resolved.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_CARRILAUT_000_000: (Come closer, , and listen well. This is for your ears only.)
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_CARRILAUT_000_001: (Lord Francel is no heretic. He is a goodly, righteous man, wholly dedicated to the cause.)
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_CARRILAUT_000_002: (I know this because I served House Haillenarte for years prior to the Calamity.)
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_CARRILAUT_000_003: (You must go to Skyfire Locks and warn him of the coming storm. The inquisitors are ruthless and will spare him no mercy.)
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_CARRILAUT_000_004: (Speak to him of an edelweiss, and he will know you for a friend. Now, go.)
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_010: Yes? You look as though you have something to say. Do you?
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_A1_000_021: I seek an audience with the bearers of the white lily.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_A2_000_022: I will go whither the wild rose blooms.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_A3_000_023: Is that an edelweiss in your pocket, or are you happy to meet me?
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_030: Then you have come to the wrong place, for we of House Haillenarte bear the rose. Mayhap you should journey to Gridania? I believe an ancient Duskwight house was said to use the white lily as its sigil.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_040: ...What an odd thing to say. Did you perchance receive a blow to the head not long ago? Or is this some queer southron jest?
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_050: I see Ser Carrilaut has not forgotten my mother's favorite flower. A pity it has not been seen in Coerthas since the Calamity. You may speak freely here, friend.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_051: That's...that's absurd! I would sooner die than become a thrall of the dragons!
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_052: Alas, it matters little what I say at this point. Although the draconian rosary was not found in my possession, it will still be considered by many to be proof of my “heresy.” I must do my utmost to prove my innocence to the inquisitors, for if they harbor even the slightest doubt...
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_053: <sigh> This will only add weight to the incessant accusations our house has suffered of late. It's as though the gods themselves are plotting our fall...
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_054: You risk much by coming here. It is only proper that I recompense you for this deed. Tell me what you desire, and I shall do my best to provide.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_055: A missing airship? I see. It may require a prolonged effort to locate your quarry. I shall direct you to one in a better position to assist you.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_FRANCEL_000_056: Lord Haurchefant of House Fortemps commands the garrison at Camp Dragonhead. Present to him this letter of introduction, and he will surely be receptive to your needs.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_HAURCHEFANT_000_060: Ah, the unmistakable swagger of a well-traveled adventurer. If you are come to pay your respects, be at ease, friend. I am not one to stand on formality.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_HAURCHEFANT_000_061: Truth be told, I would gladly welcome many and more brave souls like yourself. But enough chatter─pray tell me why you have come.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_HAURCHEFANT_000_062: If there is any justice in this world, these charges will receive no serious consideration.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_HAURCHEFANT_000_063: It is beyond inconceivable... Ah, yes. The letter made mention of a pressing matter for which you required assistance. What might that be?
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_HAURCHEFANT_000_064: So this Enterprise you speak of was last seen above Coerthas before the Calamity five years ago. I fear it may prove difficult to find any eyewitnesses to these events, for while Ishgard did not participate in the Battle of Carteneau, we were embroiled in our own internal conflicts at the time.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_HAURCHEFANT_000_065: Nevertheless, I will make inquiries on your behalf and share with you my findings in the future.
TEXT_GAIUSB608_00890_HAURCHEFANT_000_066: In the meantime, please enjoy the hospitality of Camp Dragonhead. I will see that you are afforded every courtesy as a guest of House Fortemps.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: As you have doubtless realized by now, the High Houses of Ishgard─House Fortemps included─are either unable or unwilling to offer you formal assistance in your search.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_HAURCHEFANT_100_000: However, that does not mean that there are not influential individuals within each house who are sympathetic to your cause.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_HAURCHEFANT_000_001: I shall be sending missives to their various representatives in Ishgard, though I suspect it would be quicker and more efficient if you were make inquiries of your own.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_HAURCHEFANT_000_002: Lady Ninne of mine own House Fortemps, who resides here in Camp Dragonhead, rather enjoys the company of travelers. There is also Cravellin of House Haillenarte, who can be found at Skyfire Locks─though any information you pry from the scribe may prove difficult to parse.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_HAURCHEFANT_000_003: Have you spoken with the chief astrologian of House Durendaire yet? Really? Hm... Perhaps he will be more accommodating once I inform him that you are a friend of House Fortemps.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_HAURCHEFANT_000_004: Do not concern yourself with House Dzemael─I shall contact them myself. Seek the counsel of the three I mentioned, and return to me when finished.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_NINNE_000_010: Why, hello, good . What's that? An airship, you say? I hate to disappoint you, but I know nothing of what you seek. Likely no one of House Fortemps does, for if they did, I would definitely know as well.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_NINNE_000_011: The topic on everyone's lips these days is what will become of young Lord Francel. Some say the allegations are long overdue, given how many members of House Haillenarte have been found guilty of heresy in recent days...
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_CRAVELLIN_000_020: Halone, grant me strength! There must be some way to─ Oh, who are you? A friend of Lord Haurchefant?
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_CRAVELLIN_000_021: I want to help you, I truly do! But these accusations of heresy have thrown House Haillenarte into chaos. Right now, we must focus on combating these charges and preserving our reputation.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_FORLEMORT_000_030: I gather you have been busy since last we spoke. Lord Haurchefant's missive was positively glowing. But if you think that his endorsement is cause for me to disregard Ishgardian policies, then you are sorely mistaken.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_FORLEMORT_000_031: We are at war, , and the enemy grows bolder by the day. Why, in the short time since Inquisitor Guillaime arrived in Coerthas, countless heretics have been discovered, even amongst the elite of Ishgardian society!
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_FORLEMORT_000_032: If Lord Haurchefant wishes to waste his days chasing after a long-lost airship, then that is his choice. But if he expects others to share in his folly, then he is truly blind to the present state of affairs.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_HAURCHEFANT_000_040: By your countenance, I take it you did not learn anything of use.
TEXT_GAIUSB702_00897_HAURCHEFANT_000_041: Nor did I, I fear. It seems the whole of Coerthas is consumed by this talk of heretics in the High Houses. We can only hope that my sources in Ishgard proper provide more pertinent information.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: I had another personal request to make of you. It concerns Lord Francel, of whom much has been whispered in recent days. I have received a report that he and three knights were seen heading north towards the Steel Vigil.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_HAURCHEFANT_000_001: The outpost was long ago overrun by the Dravanian Horde, so I am not certain what he intends to accomplish with such a small force.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_HAURCHEFANT_000_002: Whatever his motives, I fear for his safety. Pray journey to the Steel Vigil and see if Lord Francel's party requires assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_NPCA_000_010: <pant> It's...it's not safe here! We must flee!
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_NPCB_000_011: So fast...so strong... We were no match...
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_NPCC_000_012: <pant> <pant> Where...where is Lord Francel? Please, you must find him!
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_FRANCEL_000_020: Who goes there!? !? No, stay back! The fiend is still here!
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_FRANCEL_000_030: Halone be praised, you did it! But what of the others? The three knights who accompanied me, where are they!?
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_NPCA_000_040: I heard the beast's cries from over yonder. Then Lord Francel is safe? Bless you, , bless you!
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_NPCB_000_041: Curse those fiends! It's as though they knew we were coming...
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_NPCC_000_042: Confound it all! How are we to redeem House Haillenarte if we cannot even slay a single aevis!? <sigh> We are fortunate you came along when you did, . House Haillenarte will remember your kindness.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_FRANCEL_000_050: It was a foolish thing to do, I know, but I had hoped we might demonstrate our devotion by slaying a number of the scalekin.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_FRANCEL_000_051: Moreover, it was House Haillenarte that yielded the Steel Vigil to the Horde many years ago. One might say that our defeat here heralded the slow decline of our house's once-great name.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_FRANCEL_000_052: We have been brought even lower by these despicable accusations of heresy. And despite my best efforts, I have done naught to improve the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_FRANCEL_000_053: The day of my trial approaches. Soon I must accept the judgment of the inquisitors, whatever it may be. But even should my protestations fall on deaf ears, I will proclaim my innocence to my dying breath!
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_HAURCHEFANT_000_060: What did you find at the Steel Vigil? Ah, I see... A reckless plan, but at least it did not cost him and his knights their lives.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_HAURCHEFANT_000_061: I have news for you as well. A witness to the final flight of the Enterprise has been found. Alas, there is a complication.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_HAURCHEFANT_000_062: It has become common knowledge that you paid a visit to Lord Francel at Skyfire Locks not long ago. Upon learning of this, the witness became understandably reticent to make your acquaintance, for fear of being seen in the company of a  who might later be declared a heretic.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_HAURCHEFANT_000_063: A not unreasonable fear, given the zeal with which Inquisitor Guillaime has conducted his investigations. In any case, if we wish to obtain his testimony, we must first clear Lord Francel's name─and, by association, yours.
TEXT_GAIUSB801_00910_POP_MESSAGE_000: A deafening roar pierces the heavens!
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: As I see it, the key to proving Lord Francel's innocence is discrediting the evidence against him. I speak of the draconian rosary found in the chest you yourself recovered. If you would, please tell me of the incident in question.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_HAURCHEFANT_000_001: ...So it was found in a locked chest labeled as the property of Lord Francel. If the rosary was not his, then someone else with access must have planted it. Here is what you must do: return to Skyfire Locks and speak with Rickeman. He works closely with the porters who ferry goods across Coerthas, so he may have some inkling of who could be responsible.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_RICKEMAN_000_010: Eh? Someone tamperin' with shipments? Fury strike me down, if all them rosaries found in our people's possessions were planted... Hey now, don't you give me that look, ! I'm a House Haillenarte man through an' through. This heresy nonsense is bad for me an' my family too!
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_RICKEMAN_000_011: I ain't sayin' the porters what were bringin' the shipment did it, though. I know most of them what work the trade routes, an' I've never had cause to question their faith. But if it wasn't them neither, then your guess is as good as mine. After all, most every shipment is thoroughly inspected before it─
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_RICKEMAN_000_012: Eh? Could it've been the fellas what were responsible for the inspections? Hah! Ishgardian knights and inquisitors, the lot of them. As if they'd ever turn their cloaks. <sigh> Reckon that means the porters are your most likely suspects.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_RICKEMAN_000_013: Hate to think it, but maybe you should question them. There's a crew comin' to Camp Dragonhead from Whitebrim Front . You might consider havin' a word with them.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_NPCA_000_020: No time to talk─we're on a tight schedule. Once we've made our deliveries here, we're to deliver parcels to Skyfire Locks.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_NPCB_000_030: <yawn> Say what you will. My conscience is clear.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_NPCB_000_035: Beg your pardon? You suspect that we porters have been planting draconian rosaries in House Haillenarte shipments!? What nerve! If you truly believe such nonsense, search our parcels and see what you find!
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_SYSTEM_000_040: You find a draconian rosary hidden inside the parcel.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_NPCB_000_044: Are we finished? If so, I would appreciate an apology.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_NPCB_000_045: But...but that's impossible! Once the knight at Whitebrim Front concluded her inspection, I loaded the parcels into the wagon myself!
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_NPCB_000_046: And if I had been the culprit, I would have never allowed you to search my shipments! Say what you will to Lord Haurchefant─I will not be held accountable for this!
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_HAURCHEFANT_000_050: Did something happen outside? I thought I heard shouting... Ah, but more importantly, what did Rickeman have to say?
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_HAURCHEFANT_000_051: More draconian rosaries!? In every single parcel bound for Skyfire Locks? That beggars belief!
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_HAURCHEFANT_000_052: Even the inquisitors must acknowledge that this is no more than a crass attempt to sully House Haillenarte's reputation. Whoever is responsible has overplayed his hand.
TEXT_GAIUSB802_00911_HAURCHEFANT_000_053: And praise Halone that he did! Lord Francel's trial is upon us, and we must act now if we are to clear his name!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: From the very first, I knew it could not be that so many members of House Haillenarte were heretics. At last, we can give the lie to these poisonous allegations, and put an end to this travesty!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_001: I will need to prepare a formal statement regarding these developments for the Holy See. In the meantime, I would have you bear my words to Inquisitor Brigie. Tell her that House Fortemps asks─nay, demands that Lord Francel's trial be postponed until a full investigation has been conducted!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_BRIGIE_000_010: What is it, my child? Hm? Lord Haurchefant would have the inquisitors do what?
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_BRIGIE_000_011: But that is not possible. Inquisitor Guillaime presides over Lord Francel's trial at Witchdrop even as we speak.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_BRIGIE_000_012: Fear not: if Lord Francel is indeed innocent, he shall walk in Halone's halls with the fallen heroes of Ishgard.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_020: They have taken Lord Francel to Witchdrop!? This is madness! The inquisitor does not have sufficient grounds to subject him to that manner of trial!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_021: I will not stand idly by and allow an innocent man to die. , I would dispatch you and one of my knights to Witchdrop to forestall the proceedings until such time as I am able to join you and petition Inquisitor Guillaime in person. I will endeavor not to keep you waiting too long.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_022: Do whatever you must to keep Lord Francel alive!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HOURLINET_000_030: Hail, . As you can see, Lord Francel yet lives. We must try to reason with the inquisitor─but if his guards judge us a threat, we must also be prepared to defend ourselves.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_040: Joacin Charlemend Francel de Haillenarte─you stand accused of heresy against the Holy See of Ishgard. Is there aught you wish to say in your defense?
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_FRANCEL_000_041: Hear me, brothers─these charges are false! The men and women of my line have ever opposed the Dravanians, and I am no different! Since the very birth of our nation, we have gladly shed blood in service to the Holy See! Condemn me and you will strike a blow for the enemies of Ishgard!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_042: It is for Halone to judge if you speak the truth.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_043: Prove your innocence in the eyes of gods and men. Leap from the cliff and entrust your fate to the Fury.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_044: The righteous shall take their place in Halone's halls, while the wicked shall reveal their drachen forms and be put to the sword!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HOURLINET_000_045: In the name of House Fortemps, I beseech you─stay your hand!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HOURLINET_000_046: Inquisitor, we are come on behalf of Lord Haurchefant. My lord has uncovered evidence which suggests that the charges against Lord Francel are without merit.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HOURLINET_000_047: We humbly request that these proceedings be suspended until such time as a full reexamination of the facts has been conducted.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_048: Lord Haurchefant has allowed his personal relationship with the accused to cloud his judgment. That he should harbor private doubts, I might have allowed...but that he would dare interfere in legal proceedings sanctioned by the Holy See, I cannot.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_049: To defy the will of an inquisitor is to commit heresy! A crime for which there is but one punishment!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HOURLINET_000_050: We must hold them until Lord Haurchefant arrives, ! And remember─no harm can come to the inquisitor!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_060: It is not our intention to defy the will of the archbishop.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_061: But this trial─like many others, I fear─has been orchestrated by enemies of House Haillenarte. They have used you and your fellows to sow discord, Inquisitor─to set brother against brother, that we may tear ourselves apart.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_062: ...The fevered imaginings of a desperate man. What proof have you of this?
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_063: By the Fury...a draconian rosary! Then the knight who refused to yield─it was he who summoned the wyvern!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_064: A heretic in the ranks of the Temple Knights. This has grave implications...
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_065: Your claims...would appear to have merit, Lord Haurchefant. I shall withdraw my charges against Lord Francel, pending further investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_000_066: I trust you have not lost sight of that which first brought you to Coerthas, . Pray locate your errant airship...and use it.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_FRANCEL_000_067: Lord Haurchefant, I have not the words to express my gratitude. But why would you risk your reputation to save mine?
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_068: Because I know you, boy. You're too loyal to betray Ishgard, and too devout to question your sentence. Had we been any slower, you'd have jumped of your own free will.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_FRANCEL_000_069: I...I would have done whatever it took to redeem House Haillenarte.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_070: Praise Halone it did not come to that. But it profits us little to dwell on what might have been.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_071: Let us quit this place, . Pray visit me at Camp Dragonhead once you have recuperated.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_080: You look well, . May I say what a pleasure it was to fight alongside such a fearless and skillful warrior.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_081: Were it not for you, Lord Francel would surely have died defending the honor of his house─and I might well have perished at the hands of a heretic and his wyvern.
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_000_082: House Fortemps and House Haillenarte shall never forget your service. Now, let us return to the matter of your missing Enterprise!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HOURLINET_BATTLETAL: Your shield bears no sigil, ser! Do you serve the Holy See or one of the High Houses?
Look, look! Lord Haurchefant is come!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_BATTLET: In the name of House Fortemps, I demand that you lay down your arms!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_BATTLETAL: By this deed, you do disgrace your line, Lord Haurchefant!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_BATTLET: A wyvern!? But there were no reports of Dravanian activity!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_GUILLAIME_BATTLETAL: You would call upon your allies to save you!? At last, your treachery is laid bare!
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_HAURCHEFANT_BATTLET: Ugh... It cannot end this way...it mustn't...
TEXT_GAIUSB803_00912_FRIEND_GAIUSB803_BA: Ishgardian scum! Today you shall answer for your sins!
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_BRUNADIER_000_000: Your timing could not have been worse, traveler. Lord Drillemont's attentions are focused solely on the Stone Vigil at present.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_BRUNADIER_000_001: In any case, it is not my responsibility to escort visitors. Take your letters and show them to...Ser Alboise. Yes, Ser Alboise can surely accommodate you─seek her in the storeroom on the opposite side of the yard.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_ALBOISE_000_010: Ser Brunadier bade you speak with me, did he? I know not why he presumed I would be in a better position to help, but I assure you that he is mistaken.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_ALBOISE_000_011: Lord Drillemont hasn't the time to spend speaking with low-ranking knights such as I. However, he always has a moment to spare for head chirurgeon Astidien. Why not visit the infirmary upstairs and show your letters to him?
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_ASTIDIEN_000_020: Are you here to visit a patient, ? What's this? Letters of introduction from House Fortemps and Haillenarte...
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_ASTIDIEN_000_022: With documents such as these, you needn't seek an escort. Pray proceed to the barracks and speak with Ser Goudernoux. He should know Lord Drillemont's current whereabouts.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_GOUDERNOUX_000_030: What reason have you for barging into─ Oh, I see. Well, you are in luck─Lord Drillemont is just up these stairs.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_GOUDERNOUX_000_031: Letters or no, though, I would not expect much. House Durendaire as a whole does not hold adventurers in high regard.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_GOUDERNOUX_000_032: You had best state your intentions quickly and succinctly. Show proper respect, and it shall be returned in kind.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_DRILLEMONT_000_040: Ser Goudernoux permitted your passage? Very well. Speak.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_DRILLEMONT_000_050: You wish to brave a ruined outpost filled with scalekin to secure an airship that may or may not be there. Are you the avatar of the Fury Herself?
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_ALPHINAUD_000_051: We are the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, Lord Drillemont. You know our name, and you know our deeds.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_ALPHINAUD_000_052: We are come to Coerthas to slay Garuda, Lady of the Vortex. To that end, we seek the Enterprise, the airship of Master Cid nan Garlond, who stands before you now.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_DRILLEMONT_000_053: Master Garlond, you're alive!? But that's impossible!
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_GUILLAIME_000_055: Do not be deceived by their honeyed words. These foreigners are not to be trusted.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_GUILLAIME_000_056: At this critical moment in Ishgardian history, as House Durendaire marshals its forces to retake the Stone Vigil, who should appear in Whitebrim Front but three mysterious strangers...
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_GUILLAIME_000_057: Cid Garlond─missing and presumed dead since before the Calamity, and two Scions of the Seventh Dawn─a defunct band of misfits recently exterminated by the Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_GUILLAIME_000_058: The lesser houses may have been duped by these grandiose lies, but I should hope that House Durendaire would have greater sense. I know not why these three seek the Stone Vigil, but I know that we cannot permit them to pass.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_DRILLEMONT_000_059: Thank you for your counsel, Inquisitor. For a moment, I nearly believed this mummer's farce.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_DRILLEMONT_000_060: You three will not enter the outpost until we have reclaimed it─and until you declare your true intentions as well.
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_ALPHINAUD_000_061: It could be moons before House Durendaire purges the dragons from the Stone Vigil. We cannot afford to wait that long!
TEXT_GAIUSB901_00924_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Cid, ─we must do whatever it takes to earn Lord Drillemont's trust. Understood?
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_HAUSTEFORT_000_000: You the  responsible for that commotion upstairs? Aye, word travels fast in Whitebrim Front. I gather you still wish to change Lord Drillemont's mind?
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_HAUSTEFORT_000_001: If there's one thing I've learned about the man in my time here, it's that he listens to and respects the opinions of those under his command. Win over the barracks, and he's sure to take notice. How, you ask? That's easy─serve the poor souls decent fare for a change.
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_HAUSTEFORT_000_002: The last few supply shipments contained no meat whatsoever, and the knights are rightfully beginning to complain. I'm thinking we could prepare them steaks using mudpuppy tail meat. 'Twouldn't be a quality meal, 'tis true, but it'd be a damn sight better than nothing.
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_HAUSTEFORT_000_003: If you've a mind to lend a hand, why not await a lurking mudpuppy in Daniffen Pass? And take this bottle of vinegar; locals say it weakens mudpuppies by clogging their mucous glands, drying their skin.
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_HAUSTEFORT_000_020: It didn't work, did it? Aye, I thought it was an idiotic idea...
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_HAUSTEFORT_000_021: Oh dear...remind me to never wander near mudpuppy spawning grounds without a bottle of vinegar. Anyroad, this should only take a moment. I'll just need to do this...and this...and voilà! Never seen a man cook steaks that fast, have you? Take these three and distribute them to the hungry knights here and up above.
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_OMBELINE_000_030: We ought at least receive a hearty meal before we march off to die in this godsforsaken waste...
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_OMBELINE_000_031: Is that a fresh-cooked steak!? Halone's blessings be upon you, my friend! Mudpuppy meat or no, it's the most delicious food I've had in a fortnight!
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_THEOPHILAIN_000_040: You there, ! Don't think I didn't see you and the cook conspiring together! Let me make myself perfectly clear: if you wish to buy my trust with a steak, it would be my pleasure to oblige you!
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_THEOPHILAIN_000_041: Mwahahaha! Yes, yes! I feel invigorated, refreshed─as if I have the strength of ten men, and their wits besides. Aye, I should have no trouble concocting a new reason to refrain from sentry duty.
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_IGNEMORTEL_000_050: Ever must we train to maintain our skill at arms, yet never are we to receive proper sustenance!?
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_IGNEMORTEL_000_051: You are a godssend, my friend! Too few appreciate that House Durendaire must do more than its fair share for the sake of Ishgard.
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_HAUSTEFORT_000_060: It feels wonderful to see everyone in such high spirits. Amazing what good food can do for morale, eh?
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_HAUSTEFORT_000_061: Ah, but I've forgotten about the hardworking chirurgeons at the infirmary─so rarely do they take their meals here in the hall. Mind taking this steak to Cenota? She's doubtless so preoccupied with the health of her patients that she's neglected to attend to her own.
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_CENOTA_000_070: Beg your pardon, , but I am busy attending to this man. I will be with you in a moment.
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_CENOTA_000_071: Is that...? <sniff> <sniff> Come to think of it, it has been quite a while since I last ate. I suppose it wouldn't hurt to have a nibble...
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_CENOTA_000_072: Oh my, this is fantastic! Thank you so much! I'll eat the rest right away!
TEXT_GAIUSB904_00927_POP_MESSAGE_000: A ravenous mudpuppy emerges from the depths!
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_CID_000_000: Before we can persuade Lord Drillemont to help us, it seems we must convince Inquisitor Guillaime that we are not his enemy. But just how might we go about doing that...?
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_CID_000_001: We know little and less about the good inquisitor, despite him being such a prominent figure in Coerthas. Perhaps we should learn more by speaking with the people of Whitebrim Front.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_CID_000_002: Share your findings with Alphinaud in the square. I'm sure he can formulate a strategy from there.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_JOELLAUT_000_010: Inquisitor Guillaime? Yes, of course, I know of him. Alas, I have not seen him since the day he came to Whitebrim Front, several moons ago.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_JOELLAUT_000_011: My memory is somewhat muddled, but I recall that a blizzard nearly buried us in snow that day, and I had the ill fortune of being assigned to the night's watch. While the stronghold slept, we walked the walls and patrolled the exterior in a darkness black as pitch.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_JOELLAUT_000_012: My route took me outside the eastern gate at one point, where I caught sight of a silhouette illuminated by the light of the city. Thinking it was a wayward traveler, I cried out and gave chase, but slipped and took a terrible fall. When I woke, it was days later in this very bed, where I have lain recuperating from my injuries ever since.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_JOELLAUT_000_013: I had tried to rescue him, but in the end Inquisitor Guillaime rescued me, carrying my unconscious body to the gates. I owe him my life, , and I hope to one day repay his kindness.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_ALBOISE_000_020: Inquisitor Guillaime? I haven't the foggiest of whom you speak...unbeliever. Aye, we have learned of your deeds at Witchdrop. I will not be party to whatever dastardly schemes you've hatched against the inquisitor! Away with you!
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_HAUSTEFORT_000_030: The Holy See has decreed that the inquisitors are the arbiters of Halone's will. They are to be afforded every courtesy and the utmost respect.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_PATRICK_000_040: Under Inquisitor Guillaime's watchful gaze, unprecedented numbers of heretics have been unmasked and brought to justice.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_PATRICK_000_041: They say he goes days without sleep, so great is his devotion. Blessed are we to have such a goodly, righteous man to protect us.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_ALPHINAUD_000_051: In case you have yet to notice, my attire is ill-suited to this climate.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_ALPHINAUD_000_052: I realized it soon after our arrival, but paid it no mind as I had hoped we might find the Enterprise far faster. Instead, we've wasted far too much time meddling in local affairs. <sigh>
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Never mind. Our journey is almost at an end. All that remains is to deal with this irksome inquisitor. Cid tells me you have been busy making inquiries, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_ALPHINAUD_000_054: ...Hm. It should come as no surprise that he is held in high regard. Even so, I am beginning to suspect he has other reasons for hindering us now.
TEXT_GAIUSC001_00938_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Let us more closely review the testimonials you obtained, . Mayhap they will provide insight into Inquisitor Guillaime's motivations.
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Something troubles me about that wounded knight's account. He claims he fell chasing a figure in the darkness that he saw outside the eastern gate, yes? But the main road leads to the southwestern gate.
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_ALPHINAUD_000_001:
Since we've arrived in Whitebrim Front, I've seen no travelers arrive by the eastern gate. Moreover, he said he glimpsed a “silhouette illuminated by the light of the city,” which would imply that the inquisitor came from north of the eastern gate, not south.
But it cannot be so─that way lies naught but a deep chasm.
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Assuming Ser Joellaut is not misremembering, the inquisitor's behavior that night makes absolutely no sense, at least to me. Mayhap retracing his steps will shed light on this mystery.
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_ALPHINAUD_000_030: You found something, didn't you? Well, don't keep me waiting in suspense. Let's see it.
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Hmmm... Given the contents of this encyclical, I believe you have just made the acquaintance of the real Inquisitor Guillaime.
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Newly come to Coerthas and murdered on the day of his arrival... Yes, it would have been a simple thing to assume his identity, for even if he were to behave oddly, who would dare question the wisdom of a papal appointment?
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Still, while this is incontrovertible proof that the inquisitor is an impostor, we have yet to discern his true identity, or why he has decided to oppose us.
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_ALPHINAUD_000_034: We must proceed quickly, , before he learns that his deception has been discovered!
TEXT_GAIUSC002_00939_POP_MESSAGE_000: The air begins to crackle with aetherial energies...
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Since Lord Drillemont has already been turned against us, I fear that this encyclical alone will not serve to convince him of our claims.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_ALPHINAUD_000_001: But what might persuade a man so quick to disregard the endorsements of two High Houses?
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_ALPHINAUD_000_002: The cook did say that the lord listens to and respects the opinions of his knights. If a certain knight were to provide testimony that supports our claim...
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Yes, mayhap that is the only way left to us. Confront Ser Joellaut with the evidence you discovered and see if it helps him to recall the truth of that night.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_ALPHINAUD_000_004: As a man of faith, he may find it difficult to cope with such a horrifying revelation. Nevertheless, we must do everything within our power to secure the Enterprise.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_JOELLAUT_000_010: Oh, you have returned. Is there something else you wanted to ask?
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_JOELLAUT_000_011: The inquisitor is an impostor? Don't be preposterous, that could not possibly be true!
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_JOELLAUT_000_012: He is a paragon of virtue, a dedicated servant of the Fury! You would have me believe that is all a lie!?
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_JOELLAUT_000_013: If you are so certain that your ludicrous story is true, then go and speak with Ser Prunilla! She was at the eastern gate that night, and she helped the inquisitor carry me here. But I will never speak against the man who saved my life!
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_020: You! I...I do not believe I know you, . Pray move along and trouble me no more.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_021: Are you in the habit of handing bloody documents to strangers? Why would you show me such a dreadful thing? I know naught of it, naught at all!
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_030: ...What? Do you doubt my words? Away with you─I will suffer your slander no more.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_040: You know, don't you? Fury take me, I prayed this day would come...
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_041: When Ser Joellaut gave chase, I followed close behind. He didn't fall─one of those Dravanian abominations lashed out at him, nearly killed him right then and there. I drew my sword and rushed to his side, straining to see the enemy. But what came from the dark was not a beast, but a voice.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_042: He...he knew things about me, about my family. Secrets I had never told another. He said that if I kept his confidence, Ser Joellaut and I would be spared. But, if I defied him...everyone I loved would suffer unimaginable horrors before they died.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_043: When at last I agreed to his terms, the man came forward. His robes marked him as an inquisitor, but I knew him to be false. Together, we carried Ser Joellaut to the infirmary, and on his first night in Whitebrim Front “Inquisitor Guillaime” was heralded as a hero...
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_044: Soon after came the accusations─countless men and women of good moral standing, seized whilst in possession of draconian rosaries. As I feared, he was condemning the innocent to death. I wanted to confess to Lord Drillemont, wanted to put an end to the madness─but then I would remember the inquisitor's threats. And so I did nothing...until Lord Francel was accused.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_045: Some time ago, I followed the inquisitor and found that he kept draconian rosaries in a chest hidden southeast of Whitebrim Front. So, I took several from his chest and planted them in shipments bound for Skyfire Locks. As I hoped, they were discovered and considered evidence of a conspiracy against House Haillenarte, thus exonerating Lord Francel and casting doubt on the other recent trials. And that is the entire truth, I swear. Halone forgive me for not acting sooner...
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_050: Whatever is the matter with you? Can you not take a hint? I do not care if you doubt my words, stranger. I told you, I know naught of that encyclical. Now, away with you!
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_PRUNILLA_000_051: Do not make me say it aloud again, I beg of you. Even now he could be watching, listening to every word. It may already be too late for us...
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_DRILLEMONT_000_080: Why do you persist in this folly? I will not grant you three access to the Stone Vigil. Do not make me repeat myself.
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_DRILLEMONT_000_081: There had better be a very good explanation for why you were carrying these rosaries. And where did you find this papal encyclical?
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_DRILLEMONT_000_082: Fury take me, the inquisitor is a heretic!? Never before have I heard such an unbelievable tale...but this evidence and your testimony could have no other explanation...
TEXT_GAIUSC003_00940_DRILLEMONT_000_083: I have misjudged you and your friends, , and for that I deeply apologize. I will permit you to enter the outpost─but first, I must needs beg your assistance. Help me and my knights bring this infernal impostor to justice!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_000: That thrice-damned heretic has murdered countless innocents, and made a mockery of our laws! Hells take him and his Dravanian allies!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_001: I am told he makes for Snowcloak even now, intending to pass judgment upon yet another poor soul whom he has branded heretic. If we hurry, there may still be time to prevent further tragedy.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_002: Lend me your strength, ! Together, let us put an end to this impostor's heresy once and for all!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_NPCA_000_010: Good to have you with us, . When Lord Drillemont arrives, we are to confront the inquisitor. If he refuses to go quietly, we will need to use force. Are you prepared for that eventuality?
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_020: You needn't tremble so, my child. The righteous shall enjoy everlasting peace in Halone's halls. Only the wicked─
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_NPCB_000_021: But why!? Why must I die!? By all that is holy, I swear to you that I have never questioned the teachings of Halone!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_022: Inquisitor! Release the maid and come with us!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_023: My lord Drillemont─what is the meaning of this interruption? You are aware that I am at present conducting an interrogation, are you not?
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_024: Silence, villain! I name thee heretic, murderer of Inquisitor Guillaime and countless innocents!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_025: You are a traitor to Ishgard, to your own kith and kin! Your sins are beyond measure─beyond redemption!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_026: Ah...grave allegations indeed. But you will find your logic is flawed. How can I betray that which I owe no allegiance? No, Lord Drillemont─my conscience is quite clear, I assure you.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_027: I wonder...can you say the same? You whose hands are black with the blood of those whose only sin was to question your nation's crazed crusade!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_028: You speak to me of Ishgardian innocents? Hah! All are complicit in these crimes, for all live their lives by the archbishop's lies.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_029: But I know you will not hear me, deafened by dogma as you are. If you desire retribution, Lord Drillemont, then come─let us see how Ishgardian steel fares against Dravanian fang and claw!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_041: Your plans lie in ruin, heretic. Choose your words wisely, for they will be your last.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_042: <cough> <wheeze> Hah hah... You may not recall the many Ishgardians I have sentenced, but the families of the dead will never forget. Blood has been repaid with blood, and for that I am content.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_043: My...my only regret is that you yet live...
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_000_044: But your end is nigh, foreigner. The dragons within the Stone Vigil will rend you asunder. And when you are dead, Whitebrim Front shall fall...
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_045: Defiant to the last. Leave the body for the crows─his ilk deserves naught better.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_046: , I must apologize for involving you in this sordid business. You should never have been asked to intervene in Ishgardian affairs of state.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_047: Rest assured, I have not forgotten the matter which first brought you into our midst. It is past time that you were reunited with your airship.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_000_048: But this is not the place to discuss such matters. Pray visit me at Whitebrim Front─and bring your associates.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Where have you been, ? ...Hm? The false inquisitor has been slain, has he? Yes, well, his was a tale always like to end in bloodshed.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Though you have overcome the latest in a long line of unfortunate impediments, I would ask you not to revel in your victory just yet.
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_ALPHINAUD_000_052: We can celebrate once we have secured the Enterprise!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_BATTLETA: Show the heretic no mercy! He must pay for the innocent blood he has spilled!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_BATTLETAL: Ignorant swine! Soon you will know the futility of your faith!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_BATTLETA: Do you see, heretic? You and your allies are no match for the might of Ishgard!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_BATTLETAL: How wrong you are, Ishgardian! I have been blessed with power far beyond your ken!
Come, my brothers─grant me the strength to smite our enemies!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_BATTLETA: Stand your ground─'tis but an illusion!
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_GUILLAIME_BATTLETAL: A dragon stands before you, yet still you do not flee!?
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_DRILLEMONT_BATTLETA: Your magicks have no power over me, heretic!
Ugh...I swear by the Fury, I will bury my blade into...your...
TEXT_GAIUSC004_00941_FOLLOWER_B_GAIUSC00: Ugh, not by a godsdamned heretic...
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_000: As I am sure you will agree, it is past time we entered the Stone Vigil. Pay Lord Drillemont a visit and remind him of his obligation to us─Cid and I will follow anon.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_010: We owe you all a great debt of gratitude. Had it not been for you, the heretic masquerading as Inquisitor Guillaime would still be among us, free to prey upon the innocent.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_011: I see now that I was a fool to dismiss your claims out of hand... But you must understand, it seemed too much to hope that the Scions of the Seventh Dawn still lived, to say nothing of Master Garlond!
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_012: Never have I been happier to be proven wrong.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Well, it is gratifying to know that someone has derived a measure of enjoyment from your error.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Now, if you have no further objections, we would appreciate it if you would permit us to enter the Stone Vigil and retrieve our airship.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_015: Yes! Yes, of course. It is the very least I can do, given all that you have done for us.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_016: But entering the outpost is the least of your concerns, I fear...
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_017: You speak of the Dravanians that now hold the ruin.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_018: ...In part, yes. I should explain: shortly after you first arrived, I had my men scour the old records. They confirmed that an abandoned airship had been seized by the soldiers garrisoned at the Stone Vigil in the days following the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_019: As far as we have been able to ascertain, it was still in their custody when the outpost was overrun by the dragons. Whether it was damaged or destroyed during the battle, I cannot say, nor can I give you any assurances that it has not been removed in the intervening years.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_020: For far too long, the ruin has served as a Dravanian foothold in Coerthas, from which they have struck out at us with depressing regularity.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_021: Though we have pushed them back behind the walls, we have as yet been unable to drive them out, and I cannot say when the situation will change.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Or how it will change. Forgive me, Lord Drillemont, but there is no guarantee that you will prevail. In any event, we have not the time to wait. We will secure our property without Ishgardian aid.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_023: I see. Well, that may be for the best.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_DRILLEMONT_000_024: I will inform Ser Nathelain of your impending visit. May Halone guide you, Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_NATHELAIN_000_030: Hail, ! Lord Drillemont has apprised me of the situation. You may enter the Stone Vigil whensoever you will.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_NATHELAIN_100_030: Every knight in Whitebrim Front is praying for your success. May the Fury guide and protect you.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_CID_000_061: Yes...just beyond that enormous sleeping dragon.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_062: The dragon is not our concern. We have come for the airship, and only the airship.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_063: Cid─you and I will sneak aboard the Enterprise and prepare it for launch.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_064: ─you stay here and keep an eye on the beast.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_065: If it wakes, we may need you to provide a distraction until we are ready to depart. You can manage that, can't you?
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_066: That settles it, then. Shall we, Cid?
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_LAHABREAEORZEA_000_: ...So you mean to slay Garuda next? Interesting. Most interesting.
And you are aware that her strength greatly exceeds that of your previous primal conquests? ...A testament to the fanatical devotion of her followers. The Ixal are nothing if not zealous.
In spite of your past achievements, I labor to believe that you will best this foe.
Yet only a fool would underestimate the great Bringer of Light, slayer of Ifrit, bane of Titan...
If any mortal is capable of defeating the Lady of the Vortex, it is you.

Win or lose, the battle should at least make for an entertaining spectacle.
...Assuming, of course, you live that long.
Let us see how well your blasphemous gifts serve you this time, crystal bearer!
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_100: ! ! Are you all right? Speak to me!
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Twelve be praised, I feared the beast had injured you.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_102: I see now why the others rated you so highly. When you were caught in the midst of that aetheric bubble with the dragon, I was all but certain my next mission would be to find a new champion.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_103: Thank the gods for sparing me that inconvenience. I have quite enough to do already. Which reminds me─Cid is working on the Enterprise as we speak. Let us go and see what he has to say.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_104: What say you, Cid? Will she fly?
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_CID_000_105: Yes...though it will not be a pleasant ride.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_106: Well, I daresay it will be no more unpleasant than staying here. 'Tis a pity the Enterprise is not in a better state, but if she will allow us to quit this place, I shall not complain.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_107: If all are in agreement, let us return to Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_108: Though I would like nothing more than to set course for the Howling Eye, it is plain the Enterprise is in no condition to weather the storm. She must needs be repaired if we are to proceed with our mission.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_CID_000_109: This is all so familiar. I...I know this airship. If I could just...
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_130: Ah, how I have longed for the more agreeable climate of the Twelveswood.
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_131: Yet I will not deny the Holy See had its charms. Endless detours aside, our Ishgardian jaunt proved quite an adventure!
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_ALPHINAUD_000_132: Alas, our work is far from done. We still have an airship to repair and a primal to slay. No rest for the heroic, eh?
TEXT_GAIUSC101_00952_LIONNELLAIS_000_140: Greetings, . Do you wish to proceed to your vessel?
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_020: It calms me to look at her.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_021: It's as though I've been reunited with a part of me I never knew was missing...
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Hardly surprising. You did design and build her.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_023: I bear good news! The Seedseers have granted our request to house the Enterprise. We may take as long as we require to repair her.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Of course, it would be rank folly to take one moment more than we require. Garuda, lest we forget, grows stronger by the hour. If we are to have any hope of wresting this benighted realm from her talons, it must needs be soon.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Though I am no expert on the workings of airships, it seems plain to me that the Enterprise suffered much from her time in the wilderness. Am I not correct, Cid?
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_026: You are. Frankly, it's a miracle she carried us this far.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_027: As you know, the Howling Eye is encircled by a raging tempest, apt to turn proud trees to matchwood. Our battle will end before it begins if the Enterprise cannot weather the storm.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_028: Given time, I believe I can fully repair her...
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_029: But if this tempest is as fearsome as you say, even that may not be enough.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_030: <sigh> Confound it. There must be a way...a way to brave the fury of the elements...
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_031: ...The elements. But of course! That's it!
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_032: We work upon the element itself! Using the power of a corrupted crystal, we could clear a path through the storm, and spare the Enterprise a battering!
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_033: I see! You propose to utilize the properties of a crystal to alter the elemental aspect of the barrier! It seems so childishly simple in retrospect!
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Though mayhap not to you, . We speak of the manifestations of over-aspected aether that can be found throughout Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Since the Calamity disrupted the land's aetheric currents, such crystals have become comparatively commonplace.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_036: ...Which has been a cause of great woe, as they are known to warp aetheric energies, including those of living organisms.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_037: The point is, we could theoretically use a corrupted crystal to convert the wind-aspected aether comprising Garuda's barrier into aether of another aspect─one she cannot control.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_038: With certain modifications, the Enterprise should be able to deliver us to the Howling Eye in comfort, however hard Garuda blows...
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_039: But we are getting ahead of ourselves. All of this rests upon our ability to procure a crystal with the necessary properties. Have you any idea where we might acquire one?
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_040: No. But I know a man who might. A scholar by the name of Lamberteint, who resides in Camp Drybone.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_CID_000_041: Strange as it may sound, I met him during my time at the church. Well, Marques met him, I suppose. Whether out of pity, or for want of a more willing listener, he would talk to me for hours at a time about his aetheric studies, corrupted crystals being his pet subject. It was as a result of these conversations that poor Marques was observed to possess an uncommon knack for theoretical science...
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_ALPHINAUD_000_042: , I need you to return to Thanalan and seek out this scholar. Cid and I will set about repairing the Enterprise in your absence.
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_LAMBERTEINT_000_050: Hm? Why yes, I am Professor Lamberteint. Beg pardon? You wish to hear about my research on corrupted crystals? ...Truly? Well, nothing would give me greater pleasure than to discuss my work with a fellow  of science!
TEXT_GAIUSC102_00953_LIONNELLAIS_000_100: Greetings, . Do you wish to proceed to your vessel?
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_LAMBERTEINT_000_000: Ahhh, so rare it is to find fellow intellectuals in this region. 'Tis even rarer to find one capable of comprehending the nature of corrupted crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_LAMBERTEINT_000_001: Come to think of it, there was another─a hermit to whom the church had given sanctuary. Curious fellow. Unsociable, rather daft at first impression, yet possessed of an amazing affinity towards the scientific pursuits...
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_LAMBERTEINT_000_002: But to the matter at hand─did you say you wish not to conduct field observations, but to harvest a corrupted crystal?
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_LAMBERTEINT_000_003: Egads, ! At least take the necessary precautions so that you do not suffer from exposure to its harmful energies! I'm beginning to wonder if you've sufficient qualifications to handle such hazardous materials...
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_LAMBERTEINT_000_004: Still, your ignorance is somehow endearing. Luckily for you, I have precisely the means by which these inherent dangers may be averted. Simply store the crystal you seek within this warded pot to protect yourself from its deleterious effects. Though I suppose you will be bombarded with its energies until you place it within the vessel...
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_LAMBERTEINT_000_005: Well, perhaps it shall motivate you to work quickly. In any case, take the pot to Hahasako, a student of mine monitoring the flow of aether at Highbridge. Explain to him your quest, and he shall instruct you in the finer points of crystal harvesting.
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_HAHASAKO_000_010: How many times must I be made to explain myself!? I am not contemplating suicide, you imbecile─I have chosen this precise position to perform scientific measurements!
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_HAHASAKO_000_020: What have we here...a containment vessel!? Why, this is the handiwork of Professor Lamberteint! You thieving knave, I shall call for the─ Oh, you say the man himself lent it to you...
TEXT_GAIUSC104_00955_HAHASAKO_000_021: Then you must have sought me out per his instruction...which means he believes me experienced enough to expound upon his explanations! At last, the recognition I so rightfully deserve!
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_HAHASAKO_000_000: O frabjous day! Callooh! Callay! That I should be chosen to guide this . Yes, I, Hahasako, greatest of Professor Lamberteint's pupils, shall see that you successfully quarry your quarry.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_HAHASAKO_000_001: Your timing is impeccable, in fact, for I was just preparing to procure corrupted crystals from the Burning Wall for my personal research.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_HAHASAKO_000_002: There, the devastating destruction caused by the Calamity has blessed us with a bounty of sublime specimens.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_HAHASAKO_000_003: But something tells me that naught but a perfect piece will satisfy your high standards. In which case, you must needs descend to the deepest depths. Amidst the flowing waters and the murderous mirrorknights lies the most fantastic formation I have found thus far.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_HAHASAKO_000_004: Take this highly advanced researcher's tool and use it to separate a small fragment from the large cluster. Place it within the warded pot and bear it back to me for inspection.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_HAHASAKO_000_005: The path which leads from Burgundy Falls to the base of the Burning Wall is treacherous and terrifying, but advance with appropriate caution and you shall surely survive.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_SYSTEM_000_000: ? tag ID says system, but no message pops as of 8/05
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_HAHASAKO_000_010: I see you've come galumphing back. Have you the crystal then?
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_HAHASAKO_000_020: What a prodigiously large and lovely crystal! Professor Lamberteint will doubtless chortle with joy when you present it to him in person. Oh, and upon your return, do remember to recount how I helped you with your harvesting.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_030: My keen scholar's sense tells me that you've obtained a corrupted crystal. Am I right?
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_040: If you would grant me a moment to examine the crystal... Ah, it is as you desired. A corrupted crystal overflowing with wind-aspected aether.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_041: Hmmm... Remind me, for what purpose did you intend to use this crystal again? What!? To breach a barrier comprised of wind-aspected aether? Oh dear... That may prove problematic, as this crystal would only serve to strengthen the barrier.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_042: I suppose I am at fault for not inquiring as to your objectives from the start. Had I known your intent, I would have never sent you to Hahasako.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_043: But what is science if not trial and error? And can you truly say that this failure has taught you nothing?
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_044: Think, ─you now understand the methods necessary to safely collect a corrupted crystal! You will doubtless have no difficulty doing so once more.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_045: What's more, the crystal you collected can serve as an invaluable resource for the aetherial studies conducted by the Students of Baldesion.
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_046: You've heard of them? Well, I don't mean to boast, but I've a professional relationship with the organization. Not as equals, of course─I would never be so bold as to claim that level of expertise...
TEXT_GAIUSC105_00956_LAMBERTEINT_000_047: Are you all right? Your eyes seem to have glazed over for a moment. Anyway, I shan't keep you from your task. You've still a corrupted crystal to find!
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_LAMBERTEINT_000_000: Corrupted crystals of sufficient size and strength are not all that common, I fear. Fortunately, one of my other students, Ceana, claims to have discovered another promising site in eastern La Noscea.
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_LAMBERTEINT_000_001: Wait, that's not correct. Eastern La Noscea was where she was nearly killed when wandering too close to an imperial castrum. Hah hah, now that made for an amusing anecdote!
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_LAMBERTEINT_000_002: It was western La Noscea─Pharos Sirius, on the Isles of Umbra, to be precise.
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_LAMBERTEINT_000_003: I can't recall her exact reasoning─something to do with one of Dalamud's Talons or some such nonsense. What I can say for certain is that she is still in Aleport, attempting to gain access to the isles.
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_LAMBERTEINT_000_004: Why not travel there and see if Ceana's inquiries bear fruit? If you can look past the crass and violent ways of the local pirates, you might find your time there to be quite pleasurable. Oh, and do not forget to take your makeshift warded pot, lest she think you unprepared for the task.
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_CEANA_000_010: Eh? Corrupted crystals!? , I've no interest in being the butt of your jokes, so if you've no other reason for addressing me, kindly leave me be.
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_CEANA_000_020: Well, I'll be damned, Professor Lamberteint did send you! Beg your pardon, it seems we got off on the wrong foot.
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_CEANA_000_021: I'm Ceana─greatest of the professor's pupils, which is doubtless why he bid you seek me out. Indeed, I am an accomplished scholar with an extensive background in─
TEXT_GAIUSC108_00959_CEANA_000_022: <yawn> Oh gods, just listen to me prattle on and on. I must have given this introduction a dozen times by now...
TEXT_GAIUSC201_00960_CEANA_000_000: As I told the professor in my many missives, I believe that the area surrounding Pharos Sirius is replete with corrupted crystals of exceptional strength.
TEXT_GAIUSC201_00960_CEANA_000_001: Unfortunately, I've yet to test my hypothesis, as all access to the Isles of Umbra is prohibited at present, for reasons unknown to me. You see, my attempts to acquire this information are often met with annoyance and disdain. It's rather puzzling, since I always take the time to explain my motivations in great detail to the subjects of my questioning.
TEXT_GAIUSC201_00960_CEANA_000_002: Mayhap you will have better luck wresting information from these Yellowjackets. I've all but given up at this point.
TEXT_GAIUSC201_00960_FIRKMANN_000_010: Yer keen on travelin' to the Isles of Umbra? Bloody 'ells, , are ye drunk or jus' crazy? Ain't nothin' there but death, death, an' more death!
TEXT_GAIUSC201_00960_QAHNEBB_000_020: Ah, you startled me! Don't you know better than to sneak up on a person at a time like this, what with all this fatuous gossip of spirits and specters haunting the Isles of Umbra!? Just because I know it's nonsense doesn't make it any less frightening!
TEXT_GAIUSC201_00960_ALZAGAMILZA_000_030: The Isles of Umbra? What interest have you in that godsforsaken place? Ever since we were forced to abandon Pharos Sirius, the isles have become naught more than a graveyard for ships unable to navigate the shores─and a purgatory for the souls dragged down to the depths with 'em.
TEXT_GAIUSC201_00960_CEANA_000_040: Ah, , you've returned! Tell me of your findings.
TEXT_GAIUSC201_00960_CEANA_000_041: R-R-Really!? Infested with the undead, you say. That...that is a very, very interesting development. Excuse me for a moment while I gather my thoughts.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_000: W-W-Worry not, my friend! I've given your findings some thought, and I've concluded that this talk of spirits is naught more than local folklore. As for why all travel to the Isles of Umbra is restricted, well...mayhap it's considered too dangerous, owing to the abandonment of Pharos Sirius?
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_001: Yes, well, anyway─while you were questioning those Yellowjackets, I paid a visit to the local pub, since even an esteemed scholar like myself enjoys dulling her wits on occasion.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_002: It was there that I heard tell of a man named Skyfryn, who was recently detained after returning from─wait for it─the Isles of Umbra!
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_003: This is the first I've heard of someone actually traveling to and from there, so I'm curious as to how he obtained permission. Mind having a chat with him in my stead? He was arrested, after all, so I'm somewhat reticent to approach him myself...
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_SKYFRYN_000_010: I...I have to go back. She calls to me...sings to me...
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_SKYFRYN_000_011: Ugh... Tell Mimidoa I'm sorry. Give him this. He was...he was right...
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_SKYFRYN_000_012: Or...or you could release me? Yes...yes...release me. I will go and tell her... Let me...let me go to her...
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_SKYFRYN_000_015: I...I hear you, my love. Wait for me...
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_017: What did Skyfryn have to say? Hm, that's not terribly helpful. I couldn't care less how much he misses his favorite bar wench. But what was that about a man named Mimidoa?
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_018: Wait...I know that name! That's that bastard who grabbed my arse the other day at the pub! Well, if you want to give him that feather, be my guest─I'm not going anywhere near him and his wandering hands.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_MIMIDOA_000_020: 'Nother 'nitiate, are ye? No? Then what are ye? Speak up, , I can't hear ye!
