TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_MIMIDOA_000_030: Eh!? Bugger me, is this what I think it is? Nah, couldn't be... Ye found this, ye say? Where'd ye say ye found it?
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_MIMIDOA_000_031: Skyfryn, ye say? Was hopin' to have a word with the lad, but it sounds like there's naught left 'twixt his ears. He was s'posed to help patch up Pharos Sirius, he was. Company sent me to supervise the lot of 'em.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_MIMIDOA_000_032: Weren't gettin' work done on their own, see─half of 'em walked off, half of 'em ran off, an' half of 'em up an' vanished.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_MIMIDOA_000_033: What's that? Ye be lookin' fer passage to the Isles of Umbra!? Why didn't ye say so─I've been thinkin' o' dispatchin' someone to take a look on behalf of ol' Mimidoa. Tell him how the land lies.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_MIMIDOA_000_034: Ain't nobody been interested till you came a-callin'. Whole port's up in arms 'bout spirits an' so forth. If I had the gil, I'd hire some sellswords an' let 'em sort it out...
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_MIMIDOA_000_035: But ye'll do in a pinch, ye will. Show this parchment to the skipper an' he'll see ye there an' back.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_MIMIDOA_000_038: Eh? What's that? Speak up, now─or better yet, don't. Till ye find out what's the cause o' this commotion, there ain't no call for chitchat.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_040: So you went and had a word with Mimidoa. I hope the valuable time you saw fit to waste amounted to something.
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_050: You mean that disgusting creature was Skyfryn's superior? I find that hard to believe. But this writ of passage does appear to be genuine, so it must be true...
TEXT_GAIUSC202_00961_CEANA_000_051: I must say, it is a relief to work with such an industrious  as you. I look forward to hearing of the discoveries you will make on the Isles of Umbra...without me.
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_CEANA_000_000: <sigh> Fine, fine! I fail to see the justification for dragging me along on your journey, but if you insist, I will go as well.
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_CEANA_000_001: But Twelve as my witness, if you leave me behind to be devoured by some horrid abomination, I...I shall come back to haunt you!
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_SENDO_000_010: Hah! “Take me to the Isles of Umbra,”  bids! As if it's as simple as─ Oh, I see you've got a writ of passage. All right, then, climb aboard.
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_CEANA_000_020: Th-Th-This doesn't seem all that bad...
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_CEANA_000_021: I'm not saying I'd like to build a summer home here, but─ Oh, the hells with this. Here, take your pot and go on without me.
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_CEANA_000_022: You've harvested corrupted crystals before, right? So it isn't as though you require my assistance. Speak to the man guarding the gate─I'm sure he'll let you in. Now, if you would please excuse me...
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_SENDO_000_025: Hah! “Take me back to the Isles of Umbra,”  jests! As if anyone would ever want to─ Oh, I see you're serious. All right, then, climb aboard.
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_CEANA_000_028: You awful, awful ! I explicitly told you not to abandon me!
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_CEANA_000_029: And you even have the audacity to request that I accompany you again!? <sigh> Very well─but do not think I will forget this, !
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_DAVYD_000_030: Beg your pardon, , but how did you come here? Access to this island is currently restricted...
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_DAVYD_000_040: An old pot? I'm not sure I follow. ...Oh, I see. You wish to harvest a corrupted crystal. Sorry, friend, but you may have to return empty-handed.
TEXT_GAIUSC203_00962_Q1_000_100: Travel to the Isles of Umbra?
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_DAVYD_000_000: The writ Master Mimidoa gave you may grant you access to the island, but only authorized personnel may proceed past this point. Why, you ask? Look up and see for yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_DAVYD_000_001: When that giant mass of crystal struck the lighthouse, it caused severe damage to both the structure and the machinery within that once powered the beacon.
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_DAVYD_000_002: Aye, contrary to what the smallfolk would have you believe, the fires of Pharos Sirius were not the product of a mage's thaumaturgy or a colossal arcane bomb, but an elaborate contraption fueled by aetherial energy.
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_DAVYD_000_003: Repairs are still ongoing, but it's anyone's guess when they'll be complete. What's worse, all work has ceased since rumors of the walking dead drove off our entire crew.
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_DAVYD_000_004: Not that those rumors are incorrect─I've observed the fiends from a distance, at the Ship Graveyard to the south. What's drawn them to our shores is still a mystery, though.
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_DAVYD_000_005: I'll make you a deal, : help me unravel this mystery, and I'll bring you your corrupted crystal. In fact, I shall begin searching for one that satisfies your requirements.
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_DAVYD_000_006: As for where to begin your inquiries into the situation, it so happens that a party of three adventurers came ashore not long ago, seeking to scavenge valuable trinkets at the Ship Graveyard. I'd be surprised if they knew nothing of the undead infestation, so it might behoove you to question them.
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_AHLDUWIL_000_010: Itsh all there fer the takin'! Five bleedin' yearsh worth of wrecksh and their cargo. But thoshe queer dead thingsh...and that voice... Actually, the voice was quite nice...
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_ERAPITAROPI_000_020: You saw 'em too, right? Dead people. Just shambling about, without a care in the world. Except when they do seem to care, that is, and start shuffling towards the water...
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_LOUIS_000_030: Gods, that voice, that single fleeting verse... I can still hear it... Stay clear of the southern shore, friend. It took every onze of my strength to resist.
TEXT_GAIUSC204_00963_DAVYD_000_040: Hmmm... This talk of an alluring voice is disturbingly familiar, as if... But that's impossible, they're all dead...aren't they?
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_DAVYD_000_000: ...But if they have returned, that would mean─ Oh, beg your pardon, I was just, um...thinking about something.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_DAVYD_000_001: Which reminds me─I received word that Master Mimidoa would be arriving any moment.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_DAVYD_000_002: Apparently, he grew  to return─which I'm assuming is you.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_DAVYD_000_003: I don't know what sort of arrangement you had, but you should probably go and explain yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_010: What's been keepin' ye, 'nitiate? I ain't gettin' any younger, ye know...
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_011: Eh? Some honey-voiced harlot's been callin' out to folk what wander near the Ship Graveyard? An' it's stirred up the dead an' all?
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_012:
Bloody hells... This takes me back to me days as a cannonboy, sailin' under ol' Mistbeard...
...But they wouldn't dare, would they? Not after the lesson we learned 'em last time... Bah, they bloody would, though, wouldn't they, brazen ol' biddies...
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_013: <sigh> Some folk said as the first purge would be the last, but I knew...knew deep down in me bones as this day would come. An' come it has. Aye...I'd bet me bum ear a siren's behind all this.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_014: Nay, not one o' the Sanguine variety, 'nitiate. I speak o' the other kind─them what's got feathers, an' lure sailors to a watery grave with their sweet, sweet song.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_015: Ohhh, but it don't end there... No, drownin's just the start. See, even in death, a man stays bound to the beast, forced to do her biddin' till his corpse can't do it no more.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_016: 'Tis a fate I wouldn't wish on me worst enemy─'cept maybe in drink, an' I'd regret it after. Anyroad, 'tis up to us to stop this hells-born hussy afore she takes another soul!
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_017: 'Course, we can't send ye marchin' off to war without these. The siren don't have no power o'er a man as can't hear her song. 'Tis lucky fer you I carry a spare pair─an' lucky fer the both of us I'm a superstitious ol' sod, eh?
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_018: Well, she ain't comin' to us, so we'd best head o'er to her. To the Ship Graveyard, 'nitiate!
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_060: If she passes near the shore, she's sure to spy the campfire an' come lookin'... Just a matter o' waitin', now.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_SYSTEM_000_000: ? tag ID says system but not showing as of 8/05
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_100_016: <yawn> Hmph. I'm beginnin' to wonder if some sly bugger ain't spun us a yarn, here...
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_100_018: Look! Out o'er the water! She's come, 'nitiate! She's come!
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_100_019: Quick, ─shove them plugs in yer ears, an' get ready fer a fight! Soon as she realizes yer deaf to her ditties, she'll call on her thralls, an' we'll be up to our necks in corpses afore ye know it!
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_070: Eh? Am I all right? Hah! I'm better'n that, 'nitiate! Happy as a sailor in a whorehouse, I am! ...'Course, I'd be happy as a sailor with two wotsits if we'd gutted the songstress─but ye can't have everythin', can ye?
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_071: She'll not come croonin' 'round here again, though─not fer a while, anyroad. An' if she does...well, we know what to do, don't we?
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_MIMIDOA_000_072: Thanks for the help, uh... Bugger me, I've clean forgot yer name! Remind me. ? Don't recall havin' no 'nitiate by that name. But if yer not me ol' mate, er...wossname, why've ye been so bloody helpful? Ah, never mind. Be seein' ye, .
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_DAVYD_000_020: You mean it was a siren!? But how were you able to resist her song? ...I see. I had heard that Master Mimidoa was involved in the first purge, but I never actually... Hm.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_DAVYD_000_021: Having survived an ordeal like that, I can't blame him for carrying earplugs around with him...
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_DAVYD_000_022: Anyway, I have something for you: the corrupted crystal you wanted, safely sealed within the pot, just as you requested. Please, take it with my compliments.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_CEANA_000_030: Oh, it's you! Welcome back, . You're looking remarkably hale, I must say─and, more importantly, alive! You are alive, aren't you?
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_CEANA_000_040: Aha! The conquering hero returns bearing a gift! Might I have a closer look?
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_CEANA_000_041: Impressive...very impressive indeed. Yes...I think you'll be quite pleased with this specimen.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_CEANA_000_042: Congratulations, ! Seldom if ever have I encountered a corrupted crystal composed of such a volatile overabundance of fire-aspected aether.
TEXT_GAIUSC208_00967_CEANA_000_043: What? You wanted a corrupted crystal composed of ice-aspected aether to counteract the effects of a raging wind? Ah...ahaha. Well, this specimen won't help you there. Anyone who knows anything about the elements could tell you that. You'll just have to keep looking, I suppose!
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_HEDYN_000_000: Beg your pardon, ─I forgot to return your crystal to you.
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_HEDYN_000_001: Oh, and there was a message for you from Professor Lamberteint. Something about a man named Marques? Apparently the professor misses the intellectual stimulation. Forgive me, I should have written it down.
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_HEDYN_000_002: It occurs to me that I have yet to ask why you needed that crystal. You aren't planning anything nefarious, are you? 'Twould reflect poorly on me and my research if it was used for evil ends...
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_HEDYN_000_003: Ah, well, perhaps it's best I remain ignorant. I didn't become the professor's greatest pupil by filling my head with unnecessary information.
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_CID_000_010: All repairs and modifications have been completed, . Once you bring me that crystal, nothing will stand between us and Garuda.
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_CID_000_020: I'll need to run some tests to be sure, but this looks to be exactly what we need.
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_CID_000_021: Worry not, . I'll see that your hard work doesn't go to waste.
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_CID_000_022: The Enterprise is already more than a common airship. But mark my words: soon it will become something greater, something extraordinary.
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_CID_000_023: This...this is me. This is what I was born to do.
TEXT_GAIUSC308_00975_LIONNELLAIS_000_030: Greetings, . Do you wish to proceed to your vessel?
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YSHTOLA_000_000: The rescue of our allies will be no small undertaking, .
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YSHTOLA_000_001: Even under normal circumstances, breaching the defenses of an imperial castrum would be a highly dangerous proposition.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YSHTOLA_000_002: But now that Castrum Centri houses prisoners whom the Garleans deem valuable, we may be confident that they have taken additional measures to ensure the stronghold's security.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YSHTOLA_000_003: If we are to free our friends, we will require an effective strategy. And if we are to formulate an effective strategy, we will require intelligence.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YSHTOLA_000_004: I believe I know a man who may be able to assist us in this: Lord Portelaine of House Durendaire. He is stationed at the Observatorium in Coerthas. Let us go to him, and beseech his aid.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_010: Ah, ─the  who unmasked the heretic in our midst! To what do I owe the pleasure of your company?
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_011: You are an associate of Y'shtola? But of course. Lord Drillemont confided to me that you were a Scion of the Seventh Dawn...
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_051: Castrum Centri? What interest have you all in the imperials?
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YSHTOLA_000_052: They hold several of our number─whom we intend to free. Any information you can provide would be greatly appreciated.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_053: I see. That might explain our scouts' reports...
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_054: They observed four prisoners being led into the castrum: a Hyuran woman, an Elezen man, and two Lalafells─one male, one female.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YDA_000_055: It's them! It has to be! Minfilia, Urianger, Papalymo, and Tataru!
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_056: If that scant morsel is of use to you, you may also be interested to hear about a more recent incident.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_058: An imperial airship made an emergency landing here in Coerthas not long ago. Two men believed to be prisoners─a Roegadyn and a Lalafell─were seen fleeing the craft.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_060: A Roegadyn and a Lalafell, Master Garlond. Neither wore imperial dress, and both seemed disinclined to wait for rescue, hence our assumption that they were prisoners.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_CID_000_061: Well, I'll be damned...it's Biggs and Wedge! Trust those two rascals to escape...
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_CID_000_062: We must find them, , and soon!
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_CID_000_063: The imperials will not rest until they are captured or killed, and if Biggs were given the choice, I fear he'd take the latter.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_064: Freeing those held in Castrum Centri will require substantial planning and preparation. As such, it is an endeavor that will admit some slight delay.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_065: The matter of the escapees, by contrast, will not. Shortly after the prisoners vacated the airship, our scouts observed imperial troops setting off in pursuit. It is likely only a matter of time before they catch them.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_PORTELAINE_000_066: If you wish to see your comrades again, you had best act now.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YSHTOLA_000_067: If, as has been suggested, the Garleans took our fellow Scions prisoner in hopes of understanding the Echo, it seems reasonable to assume that they will not be executed until such time as the study is complete.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_YSHTOLA_000_068: But Biggs and Wedge are not Scions, nor do they know aught of the Echo. As Lord Portelaine said, this may prove our only chance to rescue them. I say we seize it.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_CID_000_069: Thank you, everyone! You won't regret this.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_NERO_000_100: Final preparations are almost complete, my lord.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_NERO_000_101: There stands the culmination of five long years of painstaking work. But all our efforts will be vindicated when the Emperor's vision becomes reality.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_GAIUS_000_102: At last, we have the power to purge this land of its false gods.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_GAIUS_000_103: We shall give the ignorant children of Eorzea the security and stability they so desperately crave─and which their spineless leaders have so palpably failed to provide.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_NERO_000_104: As you say, my lord. Rest assured, our engineers will not rest until the weapon is fully armed and operational.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_GAIUS_000_105: Rhitahtyn. You depart for Castrum Occidens at midnight.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_GAIUS_000_106: You will command the western front in Vylbrand.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_GAIUS_000_107: The Eorzeans will attempt to interfere with our plans. You will see that they do not.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_RHITAHTYN_000_108: My lord, if this be your will, I shall carry it out to the best of my ability. I live only to serve the Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_RHITAHTYN_000_109: Yet...forgive my impudence, but is it proper to give command of half our forces to a─
TEXT_GAIUSC403_00978_GAIUS_000_110:
I have given you nothing, Praefectus. You have earned it.
That will be all. Dismissed.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_PORTELAINE_000_000: My purpose here is to reconnoiter Garlean activity along Abalathia's Spine. Owing to this, I have the honor of being acquainted with Y'shtola.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_PORTELAINE_000_001: Now, the report of the imperial airship's emergency landing came to us by way of Dzemael Darkhold, situated to the west.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_PORTELAINE_000_002: Our man stationed at the entrance, a knight named Bricelt, may be able to tell you more. So as to expedite your mission, I shall furnish you with a letter of introduction.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_PORTELAINE_000_003: I pray that you will soon be reunited with your comrades. May the Fury grant you strength.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_BRICELT_000_010: You stand before Dzemael Darkhold, the subterranean fortress excavated by the great Ishgardian house of the same name. None but authorized personnel may enter.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_BRICELT_000_011:
A letter from Lord Portelaine?
...So you have come about the imperial airship.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_BRICELT_000_012: According to our scouts, the vessel had scarce touched the ground when a pair of men─captives, by all accounts─burst forth and bolted. Imperial soldiers have since been sighted in the area, seeking to recapture them.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_BRICELT_000_013: What? The captives are like to be your friends, you say? Then let us pray that they are yet a step ahead of their pursuers...
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_BRICELT_000_014: The emergency landing reportedly took place near the Aurum Vale, situated south and west of here. I suggest you take your search there. Seek out a knight named Pierremons─he should be able to assist you.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_PIERREMONS_000_020: ...The imperial airship? Aye, I saw it approach to land with mine own two eyes.
TEXT_GAIUSC405_00980_PIERREMONS_000_021: I hastened to the landing site, arriving just in time to see the vessel take to the skies again, but not before it had deployed a detachment of troops. Gruff orders were being barked, and there was an air of consternation about them.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_PIERREMONS_000_000: There were prisoners aboard the airship, it seems, and they seized the opportunity to flee when the vessel was forced to land.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_PIERREMONS_000_001: The Garleans who were deployed formed search parties and proceeded to scour the wilderness. In order to alert our forces, I returned to my post...
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_PIERREMONS_000_002: ...To find evidence that someone had been here in my absence. Whoever they were, they tried the door to no avail, and decided to go elsewhere.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_PIERREMONS_000_003: In all, I marked two sets of footprints─one large and one small. If you search the area, mayhap you will be able to follow the prints to their owners.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_WEDGE_000_020: Brrr... So...c-c-cold... I w-w-want to go home...
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_WEDGE_000_021: Uwaaaaaah! P-Please don't eat me! I'm not nearly as succulent as I look! It's all skin and bones underneath, I swear!
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_WEDGE_000_022: <gasp> , it's you! Thank goodness you're here! It's been...it's been awful!
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_WEDGE_000_023: The Garleans were snapping at our heels like a hungry pack of wolves! I was so hells-bent on evading them, I almost ran headlong into a monster's gaping maw...thrice! And when I finally found cover, it hit me how cold and hungry I was!
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_WEDGE_000_024: B-Biggs? He...he isn't here. He went off in a different direction to lure our pursuers away.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_CID_000_025: It's me, Cid. Have you had any success?
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_CID_000_026: ...Tracked down Wedge!? That's wonderful news! Now, what of Biggs?
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_CID_000_027: ...I see. Well, it hardly surprises me that the big fellow went off as he did. For all the tongue-lashings he gives Wedge, he's always taken care of him.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_CID_000_028: I've scoured the area surrounding the Darkhold, but have nothing to show for it. At any rate, we know for a fact that Biggs headed west. With both Yda and Y'shtola helping out, I'm sure he'll turn up soon.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_CID_000_029: Now then, I'll make my way over to your position while keeping an eye out for Biggs.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_CID_000_030: If memory serves, there should be an Ishgardian fortification not far to your west─Monument Tower, I believe it's called. Let us meet there.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_WEDGE_000_031: Dare I hope...? Was that...Master Garlond you spoke with!?
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_WEDGE_000_032: <sniff> After five long years... <sob> Thank goodness he's alive...
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_WEDGE_000_033: I'm feeling better now, ! Let's go to Monument Tower and wait for the chief to arrive!
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_ABELIE_000_040: Well met and welcome, adventurer. What brings you to this frozen corner of the realm?
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_ABELIE_000_041: Oh? It would seem your companion has caught a chill. Come and warm yourself by the fire. I will bring you a hot broth.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_ABELIE_000_042: How are we feeling now, then? Stay here as long as you need.
TEXT_GAIUSC406_00981_ABELIE_000_043: The same goes for you, friend. 'Tis plain you have a hard journey ahead of you. You must find rest when you can.
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_WEDGE_000_000: I'm fine now, thanks to you, but I can't bear to think that Biggs is still all alone in the cold, with Garleans on his heels.
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_WEDGE_000_001: He lured the enemy away for my sake, and now he's suffering for it. I hate to have to rely on you again, , but do you think you could search for Biggs?
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_WEDGE_000_002: I haven't the slightest notion where he might be at the moment, but maybe─just maybe─the people here have seen something.
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_ABELIE_000_010: A Roegadyn gentleman dressed in the same manner as your companion? I'm sorry, but he did not come by here. Hmmm, let me think a moment...
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_ABELIE_000_011: I would not raise your hopes unduly, but there is a cave situated a short distance to the south. We call it the Fury's Gaze, and it may be worth the while to investigate.
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_ABELIE_000_012: I make this suggestion only because your friend seems like a selfless sort. Rather than drawing the enemy to this tower, mayhap he elected to pass us by.
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_DUMMY_000_020: //: Examine spot at the Fury's Gaze, ghosts pop.
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_WEDGE_000_030: ! Were you able to learn anything!?
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_WEDGE_000_031: ...Not in this area? Well, that stands to reason, I suppose, seeing as he was trying to lure the Garleans away from me. But where within this vast sea of snow and ice could he be?
TEXT_GAIUSC407_00982_POP_MESSAGE_000: You feel a chill run down your spine!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_000: We can't give up, ! We must find Biggs before he succumbs to the cold or is recaptured!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_001: There must be someone in this tower who can help us, even if it's only to tell us where else to look!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_002: Ask them for me! Ask anyone who'll listen! And hurry! Biggs's chances of survival grow slimmer by the moment!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_IGNACE_000_010: Your friend is lost in the wilderness, you say?
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_IGNACE_000_011: If he's not to be found around here or in the vicinity of the Darkhold, it is possible he made for Whitebrim.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_IGNACE_000_012: To reach it, one must travel through Daniffen Pass, the southern end of which lies to the north and east of here.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_IGNACE_000_013: While I make no guarantee that your search will bear fruit, it is surely better than worrying in idleness. I wish you luck.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_IGNACE_000_014: ...Oh, and one more thing. Do tread warily when climbing the stairs here. Not a moon ago, I near broke my neck when I slipped and took a tumble.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YDA_000_020: ! We've found Biggs, but he's in trouble!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_IMPERIALSOLDIER_000: Our orders are to take you back, dead or alive! Which will it be, Engineer?
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_000_031: Why don't you come and find out, tin-head!?
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YSHTOLA_000_032: Ah, , it is well that you are here. The situation is grave.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YDA_000_033: Biggs is in a bad way! We need to do something, right now!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YSHTOLA_000_034: Yda has the right of it. He will perish if we delay.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_IMPERIALSOLDIER_000: He's not alone! Kill them all!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_000_050: <pant> M-My thanks... <pant> Another m-moment, and...I-I would have... <grunt>
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YSHTOLA_000_051: He has been too long in the cold. We must find shelter for him.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YSHTOLA_000_052: ...Monument Tower, you say? Very well, Yda and I shall bear him there with all haste.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YDA_000_053: Cid will be so happy to see Biggs and Wedge again! Awww, I love reunions!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_060: I cannot thank you enough, ─and the same goes for the rest of you! Thank you all so much!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YSHTOLA_000_062: We are a family, are we not?
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_063: Well...well, yes. It's just─ <sniff> It's just, I didn't think─ <sniff> I didn't think I'd ever see him again. <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_000_064: I owe the lot of you my life.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_000_065: And you saved Wedge's too, . I'm losing count of how many I owe you.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_CID_000_070: Biggs! Wedge! Gods, it's good to see the two of you again!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_071: Chief! It's you! It's really you!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_000_072: In our hearts, we knew you were still alive... But to finally see you in the flesh... <sniff>
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_CID_000_073: When Alphinaud told me of the raid on the Waking Sands, I feared the worst. What happened?
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_000_080: The enemy struck with nary a warning. We didn't stand a chance.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_000_081: Wedge and I were in the workshop when they came. Before we knew what was happening, the imperials had us at gunpoint.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YDA_000_082: It must have been awful... There's one thing I don't understand, though: how did the Garleans get there so fast? I mean, the Immortal Flames should have seen them coming, right?
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YSHTOLA_000_083: I myself have asked the same question. That day, when I returned to the carnage at the Waking Sands, I noted naught amiss in Horizon─nothing at all to suggest the passing of an imperial force. From this, I conclude that the Garleans came neither by land nor by air. Nay, they were borne there by potent teleportation magicks─magicks of the kind used by the Ascians.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_090: We were bound and blindfolded, and bundled into the cargo bay of a waiting airship.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_091: I can't rightly say how long we were aboard, but when the time came for us to disembark, we found ourselves in the midst of an imperial stronghold─Castrum Centri.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_092: Upon arrival, we were marched off into the main complex. Biggs and I were thrown into a detainment cell together, while Minfilia and the others were taken elsewhere. That was the last we heard from them.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_101: Well, we were held in isolation for what felt like years, but was probably moons...or maybe only weeks. And then, without warning, the imperials collected the pair of us, and put us on another vessel, which we found out was bound for Garlemald, much to our dread. We knew that if we were taken back there, we weren't like to leave again.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_WEDGE_000_102: So, risky though it was, we sabotaged the ship's altitude control and thereby forced an emergency landing. And in the midst of the ensuing chaos, we managed to slip our captors. The rest, as they say, is history.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_CID_000_103: Hah! If I didn't know better, I'd call that a likely story! Sabotaging the altitude controls of an airborne vessel!? That will have been Biggs's handiwork, like as not. You always were resourceful in a tight spot, my friend!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_CID_000_110: ─thank you for returning my dear assistants to me. It would seem I owe you yet another debt of gratitude.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_CID_000_111: There are still many questions in my mind, but the answers can wait─Minfilia and the others still want for rescue.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_CID_000_120: All right, you lot─Garlond Ironworks is back in business! Let's go and give the imperials what for!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_QIB_TODO001: Protect Biggs and defeat the imperial troops!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_BATTLETALK_01: H-How did you know where to find me?
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_IMPERIALLEADER_GAIU: Hold your ground! Reinforcements are coming!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YDA_BATTLETALK_03: The more the merrier! I'll pound you all into the next Umbral Era!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: Yda! Less provoking and more pummeling, if you would be so kind!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YDA_BATTLETALK_07: Ack! How many of them are there!?
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_:
...More than are conducive to merriment.
Next time, Yda, have a care what you wish for.
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_BIGGS_BATTLETALK_09: This is the last of them!
TEXT_GAIUSC408_00983_YDA_BATTLETALK_DEAD: I need to rest...just for a little...while...
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_000: Thanks to you, Biggs and Wedge are with us again.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_001: Now we must find a way to rescue Minfilia and the others. Gods know we've kept them waiting too long already.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_002: Based on what we've learned, I believe it's safe to say they're being held at Castrum Centri.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_003: So let us convene at Revenant's Toll in Mor Dhona─'tis as good a place as any to prepare, and better than most. The road leading east then south will get you there.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_004: When we arrive, let us seek the advice of the local adventurers. We're bound to learn a thing or two that will benefit our mission.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_SLAFBORN_000_020: Well met, friend. What brings you to Revenant's Toll?
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_SLAFBORN_000_021: ...Did I hear you rightly? Your friends are being held captive at Castrum Centri, and you want to rescue them? I don't mean to discourage you, but that might prove...difficult.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_SLAFBORN_000_022: The stronghold has been on high alert of late, with armored patrols seen about the perimeter around the clock. Not even a fly could get within a hundred yalms of the walls undetected.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_YSHTOLA_000_023: If the Garleans were alerted to our coming, we cannot know what they will do to Minfilia and the others. We must act with the greatest stealth.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_024: Aye, it has to be good old-fashioned infiltration.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_YDA_000_025: But with security so tight, how are we going to smuggle ourselves in?
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_026: Why, I've a mind to walk through the front door.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_028: Aye, we'll disguise ourselves as imperial troops and march right in.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_CID_000_029: For this, we'll need a few sets of imperial uniforms, a suit of magitek armor, and impeccable timing.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_SLAFBORN_000_030: Heh, that's a bold strategy, but it just might work. Where we are, there's certainly no shortage of opportunities to borrow the equipment.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_SLAFBORN_000_031: Knowing those imperial bastards, they won't even suspect that we savage Eorzeans would think to use their technology.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_SLAFBORN_000_033: If you're determined to go ahead with this, I'd recommend you speak with Glaumunt.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_SLAFBORN_000_034: The fellow's got a personal grudge against the Empire, and happens to know a deal about Castrum Centri besides. I've no doubt that he'd want to be of aid.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_YSHTOLA_000_035: Yda and I shall go to reconnoiter Garlean activity at the stronghold. It would not do if something were to befall our comrades before we had the chance to act.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_YDA_000_036: Come and join us when you're ready, ! Let's do this!
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_YSHTOLA_000_037: Sometimes I wonder, Yda... Are there ever times when you are not enthused?
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_YDA_000_038: I'm nothing if not enthused, Y'shtola! And you're beginning to remind me of Papalymo!
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_GLAUMUNT_000_100: Lookin' for Glaumunt, are you? Well, you've found him, whoever you are.
TEXT_GAIUSC409_00984_GLAUMUNT_000_101: ...Eh? You're lookin' to get inside Castrum Centri, and you need my help? Heh, somethin' tells me we're gonna get along just fine.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_GLAUMUNT_000_000: ...So you have friends at Castrum Centri what want for rescue. That Slafborn knows me too well─aye, you can count on my help.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_GLAUMUNT_000_001: I've got a score to settle with the imperials, an' I never pass on an opportunity to get back at the whoresons. But enough about me, let's talk strategy.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_GLAUMUNT_000_002: Rescuin' folk from captivity's right delicate business. A single oversight─just one little blunder─an' it's all over. You can't leave any room for uncertainty.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_GLAUMUNT_000_003: For starters, you need to confirm beyond the shadow of a doubt that your friends're where you think they are. You don't want to risk your neck only to discover they've been moved elsewhere. But how can you find out, you ask? By followin' these instructions:
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_GLAUMUNT_000_004: If you approach Centri from the east, you'll see a swampland to your left called the Tangle. Get in there, never mind all the morbols, an' navigate your way to the southwestern corner.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_GLAUMUNT_000_005: You'll come upon some drainage pipes comin' down from the stronghold. Don't ask me how I know, but one o' them leads back up to the command tower. If you listen closely, might be as you can eavesdrop on some o' the happenin's within.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_GLAUMUNT_000_006: Once we know for certain your friends're there, we'll move to the next stage o' the operation. Now, get goin', and godsspeed!
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_SYSTEM_000_020: The faint sound of conversation echoes down the pipe.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_A_0: (-Collected Voice-)What of the captive? Does she still refuse to speak?
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_B_0: (-Youthful Voice-)She may as well be a deaf-mute for all the information we've gotten out of her.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_C_0: (-Gruff Voice-)The others aren't much better. The Elezen gets on my nerves most of all. Every time he opens his mouth, it's only to spout gibberish.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_B_0: (-Youthful Voice-)I do wonder, why is the tribunus so obsessed with this Minfilia woman?
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_C_0: (-Gruff Voice-)They say she possesses some mystical power. Something we Garleans don't have.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_B_0: (-Youthful Voice-)Mystical power? Like the kind the beastmen use?
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_C_0: (-Gruff Voice-)How am I supposed to bloody know? If you're so curious, why don't you ask the tribunus yourself?
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_B_0: (-Youthful Voice-)As well try to tumble her! I like my head where it is, thank you very much!
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_IMPERIALSOLDIER_A_0: (-Collected Voice-)Our break is over. Best we get back to our stations.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_SYSTEM_000_040: The footfalls grow fainter until all is silent.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_ALPHINAUD_000_050: 'Tis good to see you again, . I'm given to understand you have conducted some reconnaissance. Tell me, what were you able to learn?
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_ALPHINAUD_000_051: ...So Minfilia and the others are indeed at Castrum Centri! Their presence thus confirmed, we may proceed with the mission. While you were afield, Cid took the liberty of devising a plan of action. Pray have the details from him.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_CID_000_060: Good work, . As Alphinaud has already told you, we've plotted out a course for the rescue.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_CID_000_061: The gist of it is unchanged: we disguise ourselves as imperial soldiers and infiltrate the stronghold.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_CID_000_062: Glaumunt is looking into ways to procure a suit of magitek armor. In the meantime, I need your assistance for some preparation of my own.
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_CID_000_063: Minfilia and the others are counting on us, . Let's not keep them waiting any longer than necessary!
TEXT_GAIUSC411_00986_POP_MESSAGE_000: A maddening buzzing fills your ears!
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_000: While Glaumunt goes about devising his plan, we need to see to some preparation of our own.
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_001: It wouldn't do if the imperials were to discover that they're short an armor.
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_002: To prevent this from happening, I'm going to put together a makeshift communications-jamming device. The explanation is like to get a bit technical, so bear with me.
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_003: Imperial forces communicate at a distance via electromagnetic waves. Simply put, voices are borne upon aetheric lightning energy that permeates the air.
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_004: Now, the hill-sized cluster of corrupted crystals to the west has been observed to amplify the selfsame energy. By making use of this property, we should be able to drown out imperial voices.
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_005: To ensure that we have enough amplification, we must identify the most potent crystals among the cluster. For this, I need you to go there and use this device to take readings. I'll mark the likely places on your map.
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_006: Oh, and just so you know, plasmoids are drawn to lightning energy. Don't be surprised if you run into a few.
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_030: You have the readings? Excellent. Here, let me see the numbers.
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_CID_000_031: ...Yes, four of these crystals should suit our purpose, though I pray that we won't have need of their power. My thanks, .
TEXT_GAIUSC601_01001_POP_MESSAGE_000: The air nearby bursts into sparks!
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_GLAUMUNT_000_000: Clean the wax out o' your ears now, 'cause there's somethin' I want you to do by way o' preparation.
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_GLAUMUNT_000_001: The plan's to have you enter Castrum Centri all decked out in imperial duds, but a disguise is more'n just the clothes you're wearin'. You also gotta act the part.
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_GLAUMUNT_000_002: At the very least, you need to know how to perform a convincin' imperial salute. First impressions're everythin', as they say.
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_GLAUMUNT_000_003: I could teach you the salute myself, o' course, but it's best you learned it from the experts. So get yourself near as you dare to Castrum Centri, an' watch the imperials doin' what they do.
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_DUMMY_000_010: (Wait at specificied location. Two imperial soldiers pop.)
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_IMPERIALSOLDIER_B_0: (-Imperial Decurion-)We have received an anonymous warning that insurgent forces are near.
(-Imperial Decurion-)We must redouble our vigilance. I shall recommend that patrols be increased.
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_GLAUMUNT_000_020: So, did you manage to learn the imperial salute?
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_GLAUMUNT_000_021: No, no, no, best you don't demonstrate─I'm liable to fly into a rage an' crack skulls. I'll just take your word for it.
TEXT_GAIUSC602_01002_SYSTEM_000_022: You have learned the emote Imperial Salute!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_000: Good work gettin' them imperial duds. You'll be pleased to hear I ain't been idle myself. It took me long enough, but I've finally hatched a plan to get us a suit o' magitek armor.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_001: Now, from what I've seen, Castrum Centri deploys a reaper for most of its patrols.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_002: Trouble is, the patrols 'emselves are irregular─meanin' random routes an' random deployments─an' hardly any of 'em come anywhere near Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_003: So, hopin' to coax the imperials out o' their shells, I took the liberty o' feedin' 'em a bit o' the old false intelligence─told 'em insurgents had designs on their stronghold.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_004: 'Tain't far from the truth, now I come to think of it. Anyroad, we should start seein' more patrols than we have up till now.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_005: What you need to do is approach one o' these patrols, dressed up in your shiny tin suit, an' alert 'em to the enemy's presence.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_006: Havin' done that, you'll want to lure 'em as near to Revenant's Toll as you can. Like as not, though, they'll be wary o' venturin' far from their own walls.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_007: If they do need a bit of extra encouragement, use this smoke signal here, filched fresh from an imperial scout. They'll come runnin' when they see that. An' when the cavalry arrives, you hit 'em hard an' make off with their reaper─simple as that.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_GLAUMUNT_000_008: If I ain't mistaken, there's a patrol sweepin' the perimeter right now, so run along, eh? Oh, an' don't forget to salute!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCA_000_010: My wife bore me a son not long after I was sent here. I can't wait to go home and meet him.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCB_000_011: Did you hear about these insurgents? Apparently, they've got their eye on the castrum. Personally, I'd like to see them try to take it. It'd serve to lift the tedium.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCC_000_012: Get moving, you lot! The quicker we march, the sooner this will be over!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCD_000_013: All the coin I make doing this goes to the wife in the country. If it turns out she's been squandering it on fancy clothes and gewgaws, I will not be amused.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCE_000_014: They say it's our duty to bring civilization to these lands, but what if these lands don't want civilizing?
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_020: From another patrol, are you? When next you see your commanding officer, tell him that he leads a sloppy unit. If any of my lot forgot to salute a superior officer, they would be on their arse faster than you can say “latrine duty.”
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_025: One of our covert operatives, I take it? In or out of uniform, you would do well to remember your courtesies.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_030:
Carry on, soldier.
...Hm? Insurgents gathering to the east, you say?
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_035:
One of our covert operatives, are you? Carry on, soldier.
...Hm? Insurgents gathering to the east, you say?
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_031: Judging by your description, they are well beyond the perimeter...but I will not have it said that I was remiss. You, return to the scene and keep an eye on those insurgents. Should aught go awry, use your smoke signal to call us.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_040: Give me strength... If that was your idea of a salute, you can wave good-bye to that promotion right now.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_050: Return to the scene and keep an eye on those insurgents. Should aught go awry, use your smoke signal to call us.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCA_000_055: One of our informers, I take it? <sigh> Do you have any idea what will happen if you're seen with us? The insurgents will have your head!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCC_000_057: You have no business being here! Begone or I will take you for an insurgent!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCE_000_059: Trespassers will be dealt with severely. You have been warned.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_DUMMY_000_060: (Use smoke signal at the specified location)
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_000_090: I hope you don't mind my joining. Seeing as we're seizing advanced weaponry, I thought it best to be on hand.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_100: This is the place...but where is the enemy?
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_NPCF_000_102: Send in the reaper! Let us make an example of these insurgents!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_000_300: At last, our very own suit of magitek armor!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_000_301: Hmmm... Not wishing to look a gift chocobo in the beak, it does seem rather the worse for wear, doesn't it?
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_BIGGS_000_303: Weeell...there's the fact that she's smoking, of course... But looking past that, I'd say she was structurally sound.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_WEDGE_000_304: Hmmm...I don't like the way these legs are buckled. I hate to say this, but the servomechanism may be damaged.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_BIGGS_000_305: Eh? But aren't those things protected by ilm-thick armor plate?
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_WEDGE_000_306: They are, yes... It's odd─the casing doesn't seem to have taken a blow. I suspect we're dealing with a faulty part.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_BIGGS_000_307: Well, whatever it is we're dealing with, we're not resting till it's fixed! Not one wink of sleep─you got that, Wedge?
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_000_310: A hall has been set aside for our use in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_000_311: That's where we'll carry out the repairs. Look for us there, .
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_000_900: We've now had time to take a closer look at the reaper. Our preliminary diagnosis was correct─she's structurally sound, but her servomechanism is faulty.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_000_901: You needn't worry, though─Biggs and Wedge will see her restored to her former glory in no time at all. Give those two something to mend, and they will think of naught else till the job's done. 'Tis a marvelous thing to behold─provided you remind them to visit the privy.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_SLAFBORN_000_950: ...The magitek armor? Cid and the others took it inside. Go on in and join them.
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_BATTLETALK_01: Keep hitting the reaper till it stops moving!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_BATTLETALK_02: Put down all of the foot soldiers, then concentrate on the reaper! A few scratches can't be helped!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_BATTLETALK_04: It's not easy being an engineer...
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_BATTLETALK_05: Damn it! The armor has gone into overdrive! If you value your life, stay out of its sights!
TEXT_GAIUSC604_01004_CID_BATTLETALK_DEAD: Ugh... Out of my depth... Bloody...idiot.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_000: The repairs are proceeding apace. It shouldn't be long now before Biggs and Wedge complete their work. There is, however, one small problem...
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_001: As you may recall, the machina's servomechanism was discovered to be faulty. Wedge has subsequently ascertained that the magitek core which drives it is worn beyond use.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_002: Such cores are rather fragile devices which must be replaced at regular intervals. Thanks to the negligence of our imperial colleagues, however, the one used in this reaper was long overdue.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_003: Alas, we do not have access to a ready replacement here in Mor Dhona. But all is not lost: Wedge thinks he may have identified an alternative solution. Go and see him, would you? He'll explain the details to you.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_SLAFBORN_000_005: Want to go in? It hardly needs saying, but try not to be seen.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_010: As I believe the chief has already informed you, the magitek core is worn beyond use. We need to find a replacement.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_011: I thought about having you appropriate more reapers, but even if the dunderhead maintenance engineers of Castrum Centri had remembered to replace their cores, we would risk arousing imperial suspicion.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_012: But do not despair, for I believe there is a solution: to substitute the magitek core with a mammet heart!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_013: In case you don't know, a mammet heart can be used to grant sentience to an automaton. By my reckoning, such a device should be more than capable of regulating the armor's servomechanism. We'll just need to make some minor modifications to the housing unit.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_014: I've already placed an order for a first-rate mammet heart with the Goldsmiths' Guild. All that remains is for someone to go to Ul'dah and collect it! Oh...and to pay for it. Ahem. Did I...mention how much they cost? No? W-Well, they typically cost something in the order of, um... <mumble> I hope you don't mind footing the bill─it's for a good cause!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_SERENDIPITY_000_020: Hello there! Come to collect a mammet heart, you say?
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_SERENDIPITY_000_021: Then you must be here on behalf of Garlond Ironworks! I've taken the liberty of picking the finest example we have─a heart fit for a prince among mammets!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_SERENDIPITY_000_022: ...Payment? Oh, that won't be necessary. The heart is for Master Alphinaud's personal use, after all. He notified us a short while ago that his servant would be coming to collect it.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_SERENDIPITY_000_023: Tender in years though he may be, Master Alphinaud has been a benefactor of ours since my predecessor's time. The Goldsmiths' Guild wouldn't dream of charging him.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_SERENDIPITY_000_024: But here is the mammet heart! May it serve you well! Oh, and please do pass on my compliments to your master!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_030: Do you have the mammet heart? I can't wait to see if it works!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_032: <gasp> But this...this is magnificent! It must have cost an emperor's ransom!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_033: ...Free of charge, courtesy of Alphinaud!? Coming from an influential family certainly has its advantages!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_034: But without further ado, let's give it a try! I've already modified the housing unit, so it should slot right in!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_036:
...Or not.
Haha...hah... She just needs a loving tap, I'll wager.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_038: Let's take her outside and put her through her paces! , would you care to do the honors?
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_100_035: Hop into the pilot's seat! We'll begin as soon as you're ready!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_090_036: First, I'd like you to try climbing that tangle of crystals yonder─as far up as you can go, if you please.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_100_036: Oh, and if for some reason you need to dismount, simply come back here and we'll start again.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_040: (-Wedge-)No anomalous movements evident from either leg. Good. Next, jump back down and then sprint north, quick as you can!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_041: Let's try that again, shall we? Hop back in, !
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_042: (-Wedge-)Um...a fine effort, , but you seem to have left Maggie behind─I-I mean the reaper. Come back here so we can start again.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_BIGGS_000_043: I've overseen a hundred such tests, but they still play hells with my nerves. And that's without the chief watching...
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_044: This is the Ironworks' first major project since my return. I mean to see that it's a success.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_050: (-Wedge-)Leg joints absorbing all impact without incident... Excellent. Please make your way back, .
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_060: (-Wedge-)The torso remains stable during vigorous motion... Excellent. And that concludes our test. Thank you for your cooperation!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_070: Here is a summary of my findings. The drivetrain is in sound condition. With some fine-tuning, we can expect a noticeable improvement in performance. As for the servomechanism...
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_071: I'm afraid it's not nearly as responsive as it should be, and I'm at a loss to explain why. The mammet heart is in pristine condition, and should be installed correctly. Perhaps its inner workings are simply too different to operate harmoniously with the armor's other mechanisms?
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_072: Whereas magitek cores serve only to conduct impulses, mammet hearts enable automata to process the information collected by their sensors as feeli─ <gasp> Feelings! Maybe she just doesn't feel like part of the team!? In which case, we should all do our best to make her feel welcome!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_080: Come on, everyone! Let's give Maggie here a warm welcome! Really make her feel at home!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_BIGGS_000_090: ...You're not serious. You want us to welcome an inanimate object?
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_100: I take it Wedge's suggestion has given you pause. Well, I don't blame you. The lad does have some rather unorthodox ideas. Still, orthodoxy did not give us language, tools, clothes...or machina. Short of a better idea, I don't suppose it would hurt to try.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_BIGGS_000_700: Daft as it felt, I gave it my best. I've welcomed myself to a bloody standstill. What were you expecting it to do anyway? Bob us a curtsy?
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_701: No doubt you're wondering why the servomechanism is so important as to warrant this silliness.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_702: Without it, the pilot would be required to control the armor's every movement manually. This would be an onerous task at the best of times, and wholly impractical during battle.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_703: Using a mammet heart in place of the worn magitek core seemed a promising solution. Alas, the device does not appear to be compatible with Garlean technology.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_704: Wedge, are there no other ways we might demonstrate our appreciation to our friend here?
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_000_705: I'm at my wit's end, Chief. She just...doesn't seem convinced. We could try a little dance, perhaps, or cheer our heads off...?
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_BIGGS_000_706: Imperials! They've come for the armor!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_707: Damn it! They have us cornered!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_IMPERIALCENTURION_0: Taken by the traitor Garlond─and is that the eikon-slayer!? Oh, bollocks...
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_IMPERIALRUNNER_000_: We've located the stolen reaper! Requesting immediate assistance! Respond! Respond!
It's no use, sir! There's some sort of interference!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_IMPERIALCENTURION_0: No matter! If we can't reclaim it, destroy it!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_716: Bloody hells... ─protect the armor at all costs!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_741: Ah, now she deigns to grace us with her presence!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_742: It took us a good while, but we're finally ready.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_743: It's time to infiltrate Castrum Centri and rescue our comrades!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_910: The servomechanism is now fully functional─and all it took was a simple fight to the death. Remind me not to install a mammet heart aboard the Enterprise, would you? Much as I love her, I would rather not be required to profess it before boarding. But enough of that. Let us see to our final preparations.
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_000_911: Thanks to Biggs and Wedge, the reaper is as good as new. We're as prepared as we're like to get!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_QIB_TODO001: Protect the magitek armor and defeat the enemy!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_TEIKOKU_TAICHO_BATT: We cannot suffer the enemy to use our weapons against us!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_CID_BATTLETALK_02: You're not undoing our hard work!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_BATTLETALK_03: Uwaaah! Keep them away from Maggie!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_WEDGE_BATTLETALK_05: Sh-She's in a bad way! Somebody, do something!
TEXT_GAIUSC605_01005_BIGGS_BATTLETALK_07: They're on their own! We can take them!
TEXT_GAIUSC902_01037_KANRIKAN_000_000: Phase two of the operation is presently in motion. Our brothers and sisters of the Maelstrom are holding their own against Garlean forces upon Vylbrand and the Rhotano Sea. Ere long, the third phase will begin and you must take to the field once more.
TEXT_GAIUSC902_01037_KANRIKAN_000_001: The Immortal Flames shall strike at Castrum Meridianum by way of a diversionary maneuver. While the Garleans are thus locked in battle, you are to infiltrate the stronghold and bring down the magitek field that surrounds the Praetorium.
TEXT_GAIUSC902_01037_KANRIKAN_000_002: The staging point for the mission lies in the shadow of Castrum Meridianum in northern Thanalan, and that is where you must go. On your way there, however, I would ask that you make a brief stop at Camp Bluefog, one of our key outposts in the area.
TEXT_GAIUSC902_01037_KANRIKAN_000_003: The garrison, I am told, is in low spirits, and it would do our troops well to see the hero of Cape Westwind appear before them. For the good of our cause, please stoke the fire in their hearts.
TEXT_GAIUSC902_01037_KANRIKAN_000_005: En route to Castrum Meridianum, please make a brief stop at Camp Bluefog. Our troops there are in low spirits, and it would give them heart if the hero of Cape Westwind were to appear before them.
TEXT_GAIUSC902_01037_CRACKEDFIST_000_010: Ah,  ! Yours is a most welcome presence here at Camp Bluefog!
TEXT_GAIUSC902_01037_CRACKEDFIST_000_011: Logistically speaking, we are ready to march on Castrum Meridianum at a moment's notice. Alas, while our troops are here in body, their minds are anywhere but.
TEXT_GAIUSC902_01037_CRACKEDFIST_000_012: The garrison's mood is dark, so daunting is the prospect of joining what may prove to be the bloodiest battle in history. But with a hero such as you walking among them, we may yet rekindle the dwindling embers within their souls.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_ROGER_000_000: Word is, Black Brush Station's sorely undermanned. The Stone Torches there can't get a moment's peace.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_ROGER_000_001: Bloke by the name o' Warin is hopin' to bolster their numbers for a short-term assignment or two. If you fancy puttin' a few extra gil in yer pocket, you could do a lot worse.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_010: Looking for work, perchance? If so, you couldn't have come at a better time.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_011: We Stone Torches are sellswords hired by Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern to protect its interests. Our primary duty here is to keep the tracks clear of pests, and it is for this purpose that we require your aid.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_012: I should point out, however, that it can be messy work, and liable to get messier still if you're ill prepared.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_013: A single piece of gear can mean the difference between life and death. I'll not have it on my conscience that I sent an ill-equipped adventurer to an untimely demise.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_014: See to it that your arms and armor are in order. When you are ready, present yourself to me again.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_SYSTEM_000_015: Equip your head, body, hands, legs, and feet with gear of item level 5 or above before returning to speak with Warin.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_020: So you are ready for inspection?
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_030: By the gods, ! However in the seven hells did you survive the antlings equipped as poorly as you are? I cannot in good conscience send you to face savage beasts until your gear is in order.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_SYSTEM_000_031: Equip your head, body, hands, legs, and feet with gear of item level 5 or above before returning to speak with Warin.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_041: Yet know that naught is guaranteed in this world. Fate is a fickle mistress, after all. At any rate, capable adventurers like you are few and far between, and I would not have you throw your life away.
TEXT_XXAWIL063_03852_WARIN_000_042: I have had to bury too many comrades who brushed aside cracks in their hauberks and dints in their helms. No matter what you face, do not disregard the importance of gear.
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_000: I thought I told you to get out of here. What, looking for a chance to do some good? <sigh> I guess I can't force you to leave. Damn stubborn adventurers, the lot of you. Fine, then. Listen well.
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_001: A band of outlaws has taken up residence at the Quiveron Manse on the ridge to the south.
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_002: Their leader has styled himself heir to Eolande Quiveron, the Syndicate member who died in the Calamity. <spit>
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_003: The baron and his cronies are naught more than a pack of jackals. They prey on the people of Lost Hope, robbing them of what little they have.
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_004: I myself cannot act without endangering the refugees, as they know my face and will retaliate against Lost Hope. You, however, are not known to the bandits or their allies. If you wish to help us, then deal with the baron.
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_010: So it is done? Good. I hope that wretch died screaming.
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_011: Ul'dah is more prosperous than ever, some say. That may be true for the Syndicate, but none of that wealth has trickled down to the smallfolk.
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_012: It's all a mummer's farce. One day, I refused to play my part─and so I was made to leave the stage.
TEXT_XXAWIL083_03853_LEOFRIC_000_013: Aye, my time has passed. The Brass Blades of the Rose must look to others for guidance.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_GALFRID_000_000: , injuries to several of my men have left me shorthanded, and I require a capable sort to complete their unfinished duty.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_GALFRID_000_001: The task is simple: put down as many of the local chigoe population as necessary to acquire three of their egg sacs.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_GALFRID_000_002: Having done so, you are to deliver them to Monranguin at Gilbert's Spire. He will answer any queries you might have. Now, I have other business to attend to.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_MONRANGUIN_000_010: Ah, you must be the adventurer standing in for our injured companions. Terribly unfortunate business, that.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_MONRANGUIN_000_020: It seems, however, that you had little trouble gathering the egg sacs in their stead. Excellent work. I shall have them sent over to the Trappers' League immediately.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_MONRANGUIN_000_021: Lest you wonder, these egg sacs are not destined for the dinner table! Members of the Twin Adder and the Wood Wailers are assisting the League by collecting the samples they need to check for signs of sickness.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_MONRANGUIN_000_022: The chigoe, you see, is one of the few creatures capable of transmitting the disease known as the Creeping Death. Until relatively recently, any Hyur who contracted this ghastly illness would almost invariably perish.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_MONRANGUIN_000_023: Indeed, a single outbreak once claimed the lives of a third of the Hyuran population here in Gridania. That was a long time ago, of course. With the medicines available to us now, the Creeping Death is not the killer it once was.
TEXT_XXAFST034_03854_MONRANGUIN_000_024: Even so, it is best to halt any new outbreaks before they occur. Thus we gather chigoe eggs on a regular basis in order to assist the Trappers' League with their ongoing research. Your timely assistance is most appreciated.
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_PAULINE_000_000: I hesitate to make such a dangerous request, but might you assist us in thinning the number of anoles on Naked Rock?
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_PAULINE_000_001: In our efforts to commune with the elementals, we conjurers often find ourselves in the area. Of late, however, our meditations have all too frequently been interrupted by unprovoked anole attacks. Truly, the beasts grow more aggressive by the day.
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_PAULINE_000_002: Their numbers have continued to grow since the advent of the Seventh Umbral Era, you see, forcing packs of the scalekin to come down from the mountains in search of food. If you could slay a handful of the beasts, that should lessen their need to hunt and also serve as a warning to the anoles to remain within their territory.
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_PAULINE_000_003: But I am afraid you must do more than thin the existing population. If we are to truly break this spiraling growth, then we must also target their future offspring. Bring me one of their eggs, and you will have played your part in returning balance to this area of the forest.
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_PAULINE_000_010: Ah, you have returned. Now might my brothers and sisters continue their meditations undisturbed. You have my thanks.
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_PAULINE_000_011: As for the egg, may I ask you to deliver it to Tsubh Khamazom at the Bannock?
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_PAULINE_000_012: Anole eggs are both large and filled with nutrients─the perfect meal for a soldier. She will be more than a little pleased to see you, I should imagine.
TEXT_XXAFST031_03855_TSUBHKHAMAZOM_000_0: Who goes there!? Oh, , it's you. Hm? Another delivery?
I'm not certain I should be the one to─ By Nophica, that's an anole egg! The troops will be glad indeed to see one of these at table! And you say Hearer Pauline sent you on this errand?
I hear the anoles are more numerous than ever, yet you appear to have managed the task with your skin intact. Your skill and bravery continue to amaze me, .
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_000: Well! If it isn't  , reporting for duty. That's the zeal I like to see from an enterprising young Serpent.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_001: Hail, adventurer. I bid you welcome to the Adders' Nest. Do you seek to entwine your destiny with the Twin Adder?
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_YDA_000_002: , Commander! Sorry to disappoint you, but other business brings us here today.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_003: Yda and Papalymo, always a pleasure to see the two of you. My men tell me you quest in the name of the Scions of late.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_PAPALYMO_000_004: Quite so, Commander. A little bird told us that the Twin Adder was in need of our adventuring prowess.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_005: Aye, your little bird sings true. No doubt you've heard that we're investigating the sylphs─that curious beast tribe that calls the depths of the Twelveswood home.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_006: The sylphs are, for the most part, a peaceable bunch─much to the delight of the Elder Seedseer, who has no desire to see her people embroiled in yet another fruitless war.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_007: The Twin Adder is of the same mind, and 'tis precisely for this reason that the sylphs' relation to the primal Ramuh has raised a flag of warning amongst our ranks.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_008: Friendly as they may appear, beastmen will be beastmen.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_009: Should there be even a sliver of a chance that the summoning of the primal might disturb the balance between Gridania and the sylphic tribes, it is a possibility we cannot ignore.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_PAPALYMO_000_010: Better to be safe than sorry, indeed.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_011: Do we strike at Ramuh, or leave the sylphs to their own ways? That is the question, yet I find myself lacking ample knowledge to arrive at an answer.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_012: Opinions abound within Gridania, but to listen only to one's own is among the greatest mistakes a commander can make.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_013: I would hear from the other side─the sylphs themselves─and seek an impartial party to serve as my liaison. That is where you Scions come in.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_014: The sylphs of Little Solace remain untempered, and have held many a productive dialogue with our people. I would hear their candid thoughts on their tempered brethren.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_015: That said, I urge you to exercise due caution. Sylphic tradition and etiquette bear little resemblance to our own. It would not do to have any cross-cultural faux pas get in the way of a productive parley.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_VORSAILE_000_016: En route to Little Solace, you will come upon the Hawthorne Hut. Our officer stationed there can enlighten you as to how to win the sylphs' favor. May your expedition be a worthwhile one.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_PAPALYMO_000_017: A friendly palaver with the sylphs? This should be a pleasant enough diversion.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_PAPALYMO_000_018: The Hawthorne Hut, was it? Why, I believe the ferry departing from Westshore Pier should take us straight there.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_YDA_000_019: A friendly palaver, indeed! I hope this will be as straightforward as you say, Papalymo.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_MITAINIE_000_020: Aye, the ferry docked at the base of this hill will carry you across the lake to the East Shroud.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_MITAINIE_000_021: Once you're ashore, head due east and you should find the Hawthorne Hut without much trouble.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_AMELAIN_000_030: Indeed, I am Amelain of the Twin Adder. I understand you're here to learn of the sylphs, yes?
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_AMELAIN_000_031: For all their whimsy, they are a wary lot. Particularly since the Empire has come to the Shroud.
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_AMELAIN_000_032: Earn their trust, however, and they're as friendly as any folk. They have their quirks, but so do we all, no?
TEXT_XXAUSA002_03856_AMELAIN_000_033: Would you know more, you'd do well to speak with the master of this hut, Rolfe. He's forgotten more about the sylphs than I'll ever know.
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_YDA_000_000: Say, . Are you in the mood for dancing?
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_YDA_000_001: That's right: dancing! You went through all that trouble to learn the sylphs' traditional greeting, but you've greeted hardly any of them.
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_YDA_000_002: Why, if I were a sylph, I'd be beside myself with delight to see an adventurer expressing an interest in my culture! Me? Of course I'd be happy to join─ow, ow! There go those bloody leg cramps of mine acting up again!
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_AMEEXIA_000_010: This one is weaving cloth. Walking one would know more? This one does not trust walking ones who do not show respect.
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_AMEEXIA_000_011: Walking one would be a friend to these ones? This one is overjoyed! But this one keeps the ways of weaving a secret. Even if walking one learned the secret, walking one could not weave in the same way.
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_AMEEXIA_000_012: Walking one is strange. This one has nothing to teach to strange ones.
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_KNOLEXIA_000_030: Walking one's belly is rumbling? This one is not making a meal! This one is boiling bark and flower seeds to dye thread. Color must be jolly, and so must greet-making.
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_KNOLEXIA_000_031: Oooh, walking one knows jolly dance! Jolly dance fills this one with good cheer! Let these two be friends!
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_KNOLEXIA_000_032: Walking one makes strange motions. Strange motions make this one ill at ease. Go away! Shoo, shoo!
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_DELLEXIA_000_060: What does walking one want with this one? Elder one warned this one not to get too friendly with walking ones...
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_DELLEXIA_000_061: Ah, walking one is a friend to these ones! Friendly like gracious elder one of forest city. Knows how to dance into these ones' hearts!
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_DELLEXIA_000_062: Is that how walking ones greet other walking ones? If walking one wants to find other walking ones, maybe walking one should go home.
TEXT_XXAUSA103_03857_YDA_000_090: ! Would you like to hear the good news, or the better news? The good news is that your lovely dancing has brought smiles and high spirits to all of Little Solace! The better news? Why, I've thoroughly recovered from those accursed leg cramps! Onward to our next adventure!
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_PAPALYMO_000_000: . As an adventurer, you're no stranger to helping distressed folk, I'd wager.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_PAPALYMO_000_001: Tales of good deeds are quick to spread. The adventurer who comes to the aid of the local populace can go from stranger to hero o'ernight.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_PAPALYMO_000_002: No doubt you see what I'm getting at. The sylphs who make their home in Little Solace do so having been driven from their woodland home. Surely, they have their fair share of troubles.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_PAPALYMO_000_003: Seek out troubled sylphs, and see what might be done to ease their worries. A sound plan, would you not say?
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_PAPALYMO_000_004: That said, the sylphs are not known to share their worries with outsiders. You would be better off inquiring with Hearer Imedia; of the Gridanians who reside here, she is most like to be privy to the sylphs' troubles.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_IMEDIA_000_010: Praise be to the elementals─I cannot express how happy I am to see an adventurer with a truly gentle heart. The sylphs of Little Solace are sorely in need of aid. Pray hear me out.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_IMEDIA_000_011: Being a temporary settlement, Little Solace wants for amenities, not least a stout set of defenses. Consequently, beasts from malms around are free to wander in and terrorize the hapless residents.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_IMEDIA_000_012: The ziz gorlins and gall gnats that roam these parts are especially troublesome, but slaying one of each should serve as a warning to the rest.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_IMEDIA_000_013: Furthermore, perhaps you could gather three brownie brushes as well. They play an important role in sylphic culture─I do not claim to know the details─and what with such feral beasts prowling the forests, they are not easily come by.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_IMEDIA_000_014: When you are done with the deeds, seek out Komuxio. He is slow to warm to outsiders, but your good intentions will not be lost on him. My own experience speaks to this.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_KOMUXIO_000_030: Dancing one is still here? Dancing one can dance all ─this one's trust is not so easily earned.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_KOMUXIO_000_031: Hm? Dancing one brings brownie brushes for this one? This one can dye thread once more. This one is pleased.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_KOMUXIO_000_032: Dancing one kills bitey, buzzy one? This one hates, hates, hates bitey, buzzy ones! Dancing one is kind... Too kind.
TEXT_XXAUSA104_03858_KOMUXIO_000_033: Many walking ones come to these ones' abode, but few are friendly like dancing one. Perhaps this one was wrong not to trust dancing one, after all.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_BUSCARRON_000_000: No word on the sylph elder yet, but I'm sure it's only a matter of time. In the meantime, how about doing a favor for old Buscarron in return?
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_BUSCARRON_000_001: Right, then, let's put you to work. There's a customer outside who's spoiling for a fight and I need you to cool him off for me.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_BUSCARRON_000_002: No need to go cracking any skulls, though. Just take this tub of cold water and douse the drunkard. Tends to do the trick.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_BUSCARRON_000_003: My patrons can swill grog all night and carouse loud enough to wake the dead if they wish, but as soon as it turns violent, I've got to put my boot down.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_NPCA_000_010: What are you starin' at!? You wanna keep them eyes in yer face?
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_NPCB_000_011: Grrr... If this were anywhere but the Druthers, I'd have that fool spittin' teeth before he formed a second word.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_NPCA_000_020: Ugh! Nophica's teats, that's cold! What do you mean, “no fightin'”? This Duskwight scum was─
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_NPCA_000_021: Yeah, yeah, I know the rules. That bastard gets to keep his skin...for now.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_NPCB_000_030: Thanks for steppin' in there, friend. Not that I couldn't handle myself against a bleatin' milksop like that bloke.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_NPCB_000_031: And I don't want to cause no trouble for Buscarron. You know, havin' to mop up blood and bits o' teeth and the like.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_BUSCARRON_000_080: Nicely done, . I'll not have my patrons picking fights with each other over a bit of petty prejudice.
