TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_BUSCARRON_000_081: In case you didn't see, the bloke who caught the brunt of that outburst is a Duskwight Elezen. They're a people who shun cities to live in the wilds, making them no better than brigands in the eyes of many.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_BUSCARRON_000_082: To be fair, the Duskwights can be an unruly lot, but they ain't so bad once you get to know them. And it don't seem right to bar a whole race of people from the Druthers for the misdeeds of a few.
TEXT_XXAUSA203_03859_BUSCARRON_000_083: There should be at least one place where anyone willing to pay the coin and drink in peace is welcome, don't you think?
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BUSCARRON_000_000: I appreciate all the good you've done for our patrons. If you aren't disinclined, I have a favor of my own to ask you.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BUSCARRON_000_001: There's a Qiqirn friend of mine, you see─name of Teteroon. A good lad. It was right after the Calamity that I came across him fallen in the Shroud. He nearly died in all the havoc. So, I took him in and nursed him back to health best I could.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BUSCARRON_000_002: He worked here at my Druthers for a spell after that. Got to talking about striking out on his own, he did, and not long after cast his lot with a merchant bound for La Noscea.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BUSCARRON_000_003: Well, it just so happens I got to cleaning up around here and came across something of his─this scarlet earring. I know he was fond of the thing, but he must have just forgotten it when he left. So, I'd like to see that it gets to him.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BUSCARRON_000_004: Can't say for sure where he ended up, but might be a friend of mine can. A Roegadyn fellow named Baensyng. You can find him on Hawkers' Alley in Limsa Lominsa. He knows everything of the comings and goings of merchants there.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BAENSYNG_000_010:
Ye found yer way to 'Awkers' Alley, friend.
...Hm? A Qiqirn what worked at the Druthers? Aye, ye speak of Teteroon.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BAENSYNG_000_011: Related to that Kyokyoroon bloke just o'er there by some blood or another. Two of 'em put in together an' were makin' good coin. But ol' Teteroon up an' left Limsa not long ago. Couldn't say as to why or where.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BAENSYNG_000_012: Yer better off askin' Kyokyoroon himself. He can be tight of lip, though, I warn ye. Best to take this chicken egg with ye. Li'l bastard loves the bloody things.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_BAENSYNG_000_013: Heh... Good to hear about ol' Busc, though. Sounds as though he ain't changed a bit. Just like him to send a 'venturer along. Too shy to come his own self. Gods, I miss drinkin' with that fool.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_KYOKYOROON_000_020: Customer, be welcome! Not customer? Not come with custom? Kyokyoroon busy with business. Too busy for blather.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_KYOKYOROON_000_021: Chicken egg! Kyokyoroon love chicken egg! Love chicken egg more than love customer!
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_KYOKYOROON_000_022: Looking for Teteroon? Teteroon no here no more. Teteroon leave Limsa. Teteroon go look for sparklies.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_KYOKYOROON_000_023: Now working at trading post. Good trading post. Forget where trading post is.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_KYOKYOROON_000_024: Wineburg know Teteroon. Wineburg know trading post. Wineburg at ferry docks. You go to ferry docks.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_KYOKYOROON_000_025: Kyokyoroon forget things. Wineburg remember things. You talk to Wineburg, not Kyokyoroon.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_WINEBURG_000_040: Teteroon? Aye, I seen him. That is to say, I saw him.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_WINEBURG_000_041: He was headed somewhere up north, by way of the ferry to Aleport. Might as well head there and see what ye can suss out. The skipper here can take you there.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_WINEBURG_000_042: When ye arrive, I'd start by askin' Ahldfoet. He's an old hand what knows a great deal about a great many things.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_WINEBURG_000_043: All's I know is that Teteroon stopped in Aleport. If ye want to find him, ye'd best look there.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_AHLDFOET_000_050: Teteroon? Aye, I saw him. That is to say, I seen him.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_AHLDFOET_000_051: He took himself north, through Skull Valley, into Oakwood. Was lookin' for a place run by his fellow Qiqirn.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_AHLDFOET_000_052: I reckon he meant the one right on the shore of Bronze Lake─Memeroon's Trading Post. Follow the road and yer sure to find it.
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_TETEROON_000_030: Customer, be welcome! Not customer? Not come with custom? Bring something for Teteroon?
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_TETEROON_000_031: Teteroon forget this! Forget at Druthers. Teteroon swore would never forget earring...but never forget forgot. Teteroon thank! Teteroon thank!
TEXT_XXAUSA301_03860_TETEROON_000_032: Good Buscaroon doing good? Good Buscaroon good to Teteroon. Teteroon miss good Buscaroon... <sigh>
TEXT_XXAUSA302_03861_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA302_03861_TETEROON_000_000: Good Buscaroon help Teteroon. Teteroon dead without good Buscaroon. Must give thankies. Many, many thankies. Teteroon make Qiqirn firewater for Buscaroon! Buscaroon love firewater!
TEXT_XXAUSA302_03861_TETEROON_000_001: You help Teteroon make firewater? Need thingies to make. Need many, many thingies.
TEXT_XXAUSA302_03861_TETEROON_000_002: Need coeurl pup whiskers. Need three good coeurl pup whiskers.
TEXT_XXAUSA302_03861_TETEROON_000_020: Teteroon make firewater for Buscaroon. You bring thingies Teteroon need?
TEXT_XXAUSA302_03861_TETEROON_000_021: You brought all thingies! Teteroon make firewater now. Make good firewater for good Buscaroon.
TEXT_XXAUSA302_03861_TETEROON_000_022: Teteroon start making firewater now. Good firewater take time. More time, more good. You come back later.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_000: I'm glad you've come, friend. There's something I want to talk to you about. You know I said I thought we might have a traitor in our midst─someone as was aiding the Garleans? Well, I'm thinking I may have identified our suspect.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_001: There's a regular of mine who used to dine on thin soup, and sip his pint on account of not being able to afford another. But of late, he's taken to ordering my best wines and the finest cuts of meat I can lay my hands on.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_002: Were he a merchant, I'd prob'ly think nothing of it, but this lad's a Wood Wailer.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_003: ...And Wood Wailers don't earn that kind of coin. By chance, I was musing on where the money was coming from when you first told me about the Garleans in the forest, and I couldn't help putting two and two together.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_004: Suffice it to say, if a Wailer's working for the Empire, none of us is safe.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_005: The lad I'm talking about goes by the name of Laurentius. Last I heard, he was in the South Shroud. Find him, , and if he is up to no good, put an end to it─and him, if it comes to that.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_LAURENTIUS_000_010: Can you not see I am on patrol? Be gone. If you have business with the Wailers, take it to the Barracks.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_LAURENTIUS_000_030: Not long now... Hmph. To think patrol routes and rations would fetch such a price...
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_LAURENTIUS_000_031: No more than I deserve, though. 'Tis little wonder the Empire has risen to such heights. If only the Wailers paid men their worth...
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_LAURENTIUS_000_032: Y-You! What did you─? How long have you─? Help. Help! Heeelp!
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_LAURENTIUS_000_033: Please! Come quick, my friends! It is I, Laurentius! I am under attack!
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_LAURENTIUS_100_033: You should have buggered off when you had the chance. Now die, you interfering little swine!
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_LAURENTIUS_000_034: How...? How did you...? You just... I-I know nothing! I was on patrol. He just appeared! I...I thought you were working for the Garleans!
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_080: Aye, Laurentius confessed to his crimes. I just had word from the Twin Adder. Seems he marched straight into the Nest and gave himself up.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_081: The lad's had quite a life, you know... His mother was killed by a brigand when he was only small. As a young man, he joined the Wailers, hoping to spare his fellow Gridanians the misery he'd known growing up.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_082: Trouble is, protecting Gridania's too big a job for one man, and he came to believe that he couldn't make a difference─that it was hopeless.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_083: There are few things more dangerous than desperation, and a man lost in the dark is easily drawn to the glimmer of coin. I reckon he thought that if he couldn't change the lot of his fellow man, he might as well change his own. Thing is, he was making a difference─just not on his own. Somehow, he'd failed to grasp one simple truth─that those things we cannot do alone, we must do together.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_084: ...Eh? He asked you to thank me, did he? Then there's good in him yet. I just hope them at the Adders' Nest are able to see it... What he's done ain't easy to forgive, but I'd like to think he'd be afforded a chance to make amends.
TEXT_XXAUSA308_03862_BUSCARRON_000_085: But let us leave fates to the Twelve. I have other news for you, . The sylph elder has been found!
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MINFILIA_000_000: While you were tending to business in Thanalan, some new information arrived courtesy of our friends the sylphs.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MINFILIA_000_001: An individual fitting Lahabrea's description has been sighted in the North Shroud. This sighting comes in the wake of a series of mysterious deaths in the selfsame area. My instincts tell me that our man is involved.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MINFILIA_000_002: I would have you continue your investigation where you left off. Twelve willing, we will pick up Lahabrea's trail once more.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MINFILIA_000_003: Noraxia can furnish you with the details. Pray speak with her, and take it from there. As always, be careful out there, .
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_NORAXIA_000_010: Walking one is to investigate sinister one? Then heed well this one's words.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_NORAXIA_000_011: This one is friends with a walking one in the Ashcrown Consortium. According to friendly one, a digging one named Medrod had an encounter with a scary masked one. This masked one is most certainly sinister one!
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_NORAXIA_000_012: Walking one should go and speak with digging one Medrod. Digging one is to be found at Fallgourd Float in the North Shroud.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_020: P-Please leave me be... I'm not long for this world...
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_021: I...I looked death in the face... 'Tis only a matter of time before he comes for me, just like he came for that poor woman...
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_SYSTEM_000_022: Medrod is clearly traumatized. Perhaps if you were to soothe him, he might remain calm for long enough to hold a conversation.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_025: <sob> Mummyyy! I'm sorry I wasn't a better son! I'm sorry I didn't eat my greens and do my chores! Waaaaaah!
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_SYSTEM_000_026: Medrod is clearly traumatized. Perhaps if you were to soothe him, he might remain calm for long enough to hold a conversation.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_060: ...Y-You're right. It's not as bad as it seems. I saw something terrible, that's true, but that hardly means I'm going to suffer the same fate. Thanks to you, I can think straight again. I believe I can even recount what I saw without losing it.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_061: It was just another ordinary day. I was headed back to the Float when I noticed a suspicious character in the distance─a masked man garbed head to toe in black. He had a hideous fiend in tow, a winged creature that was all eyeball and jagged teeth. Taken by curiosity, I crept as near as I dared...
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_062: ...To see the corpse of a woman! One glimpse was enough to tell me that she'd died a gruesome death!
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_063: In that instant, I knew right away that the masked man was a minion of Thal, come to claim her soul for His realm.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_064: What!? You're investigating this same masked man!?
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_AIDEEN_000_065: If that's the case, we'll help you in whatever way we can!
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_IVAURAULT_000_065: Aye, anything to ensure that we won't have to suffer Medrod's hysteria ever again.
TEXT_XXAUSA711_03863_MEDROD_000_066: All right, teamwork! That's what I wanted to─wait, I haven't been that bad, have I...? At any rate, I'm all for helping this adventurer. It's the least I can do to repay  for comforting me!
TEXT_XXAUSA801_03864_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSA801_03864_AIDEEN_000_000: So, here's what I know about the deaths: all the victims were found with their faces torn to shreds.
TEXT_XXAUSA801_03864_AIDEEN_000_001: Among the local fauna, only the scalekin known as ziz could inflict such wounds. That's why some folk are pointing the finger at them.
TEXT_XXAUSA801_03864_AIDEEN_000_002: I somehow doubt that the answer's that simple, but for the sake of thoroughness, we should look into it. Why don't you put down, say, three of the creatures, and see if you can find any proof connecting them to the deaths?
TEXT_XXAUSA801_03864_AIDEEN_000_020: You've already seen to the ziz? Good work, adventurer! So, were you able to find aught to suggest that the creatures are our culprits?
TEXT_XXAUSA801_03864_AIDEEN_000_021: ...Nothing? Truth be told, even if there were proof, I wouldn't know what it looked like. Aaanyway, I believe we can safely strike ziz from our list of suspects. Which leaves us with...the masked man and his winged eyeball!
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_000: Let me be clear: this business between you, me, and the captain must remain a secret.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_001: See, I don't regret my time spent with the Company in the slightest. Traveling the world, meeting interesting people, killing them─it was all jolly good fun.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_002: Alas, Gridanians are, by and large, an unforgiving lot─Detoh here being a rare exception.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_003: I've had to go to great lengths to ensure that I am seen as a model citizen, with no taste for drinking, whoring, gambling, and all those other activities I so dearly miss.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_004: So understand that if you ruin my little charade by wagging your tongue, I'll fashion a noose with your entrails and hang you from the nearest heavenspillar.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_005: Well, what are you waiting for? There's a perfectly good adamantoise egg in a nest to the east of here, just ripe for the taking.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_006: Not that I expect you to live long enough to claim it!
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_007: The mother never strays far from the child, and you will surely be attacked the moment you lay hands upon the egg.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_100_008: ...There will be other heroes, . You do not need to challenge Titan. Abandon your quest, or your corpse will rot in this swamp.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_020: I thought you might have the good sense to leave this place. By your continued presence, I take it you intend to persevere to the bitter end?
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_025: Ahahaha! Such bravery, such recklessness! That will serve you well against Titan.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_026: Leave the egg with me─I'll see that it gets to the captain. You should make haste to southern Thanalan.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_LANDENEL_000_027: In Forgotten Springs, you will find a man named U'odh Nunh. He will be your next guide. Safe travels, .
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_UODHNUN_000_040:
State your business, adventurerrr.
<snort> Hah hah hah! So this is the one Wheiskaet sends me.
TEXT_XXAUSB012_03865_UODHNUN_000_041: I haven't the foggiest what he sees in you─and until I do, you will rrreceive no aid from me.
TEXT_XXAUSB208_03866_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSB208_03866_WHEISKAET_000_000: Bravo, . Thanks to you, our guests shall be honored with a marvelous banquet.
TEXT_XXAUSB208_03866_WHEISKAET_000_001: But what good is an exotic feast without an equally exquisite aperitif?
TEXT_XXAUSB208_03866_WHEISKAET_000_002: Luckily, I know just the person to ask. Make your way to Wineport and seek out Shamani Lohmani, another former member of the Company.
TEXT_XXAUSB208_03866_WHEISKAET_000_003: All you have to do is give him this order slip. He'll take care of the rest.
TEXT_XXAUSB208_03866_WHEISKAET_000_004: Oh, and if you're wondering if this is merely a ploy to test your patience, I assure you I do actually need that wine. And while you're there, give Shamani Lohmani my regards.
TEXT_XXAUSB208_03866_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: ...Sweat, grime, and blood. Aye, you reek of blood. An adventurer, unless I am mistaken. What brings you to Wineport?
An order? Let me guess─a request for the finest vintage I can muster.
<sniff> <sniff> The paper smells of loam and perfume. Costa del Sol. And there is also the─<cough>─unmistakable odor of goblin cheese...
Yes, Master Gegeruju would not settle for anything less than the best. Dyrstweitz and his crew must be quite busy preparing an exotic feast, hence his decision to rely on an adventurer.
Ah, but perhaps you are confused. This display of deduction was not intended to impress you.
When one loses his vision, he is forced to compensate in other ways. But you've no interest in my affairs─you wish only to discuss the wine, I suspect.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_000: Excuse me, ...do you have a moment? It concerns this broken horologe which was found in the pocket of a man brought here for burial.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_001: There is something...familiar about it...but just what I cannot say. Perhaps if I tinker with the device, it will come to me.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_002: However, I lack the proper tools to do so. I would ask that you journey to Camp Drybone in my stead to obtain a bull-point chisel and a pair of needle-nose pincers.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_003: They are often used by goldsmiths, so perhaps they would be the best people to ask.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_004: Of course, I do not expect you to foot the bill. Here, take this coinpurse. That should cover it.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_GOLGSMITHXXXXX_000_: A bull-point chisel, you say? And a pair of needle-nose pincers? Those things don't come cheap, you know...
Thal's balls! I mean, yes, that should be sufficient payment. Nice doing business with you. Heh heh...
Erk! You again? Before you ask, no, I don't do refunds. Not that there's anything wrong with the fine tools I sold you!
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_030: Have you brought the tools I requested?
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_031: Hmmm...something occurs to me. Please wait here for a moment.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_032: It was for naught. Though I repaired the device easily, this sensation that stirs within me remains a mystery.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_033: But how...how did I do it?
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_034: These hands...my hands, they moved with a mind of their own, deftly manipulating the clockwork mechanisms...
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_035: There was no doubt or uncertainty. I knew exactly what to do, as though I had performed the same motions countless times before...
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_MARQUEZ_000_036: P-Pardon me, ─this was a mistake. Please give the horologe to Sister Eluned. The man who once owned it is currently in her care, and I think it best that it be returned to him.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_ELUNED_000_040: Good  to you, . Have you come to pay your respects to this man?
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_ELUNED_000_041: Never before have I seen such a queer device. You say that it measures the passing of time?
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_ELUNED_000_042: Mayhap they are more common in Garlemald. I am given to understand that its cities are filled with all manner of amazing technologies.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_ELUNED_000_043: Marques said that it belonged to the deceased? Oh dear... You don't suppose that the owner might have been a Garlean spy? It may behoove us to notify the authorities in Camp Drybone.
TEXT_XXAUSB503_03867_ELUNED_000_044: But...mayhap more importantly, how did Marques manage to repair this device? I knew he had a talent for the trades, but this goes far beyond mending fences and thatching rooves...
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: The man with knowledge of the Enterprise awaits you outside. I pray his information proves useful to you.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_NPC_000_010: How quickly the commoners' opinions change. They say Lord Francel is innocent now, but just a few days prior...
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_NPC_000_011: Anyway, you were inquiring as to the whereabouts of an airship last seen in Coerthas several days before the Calamity, yes? Well, it so happens that I was monitoring the night sky at the Observatorium during that period. I recall that a small vessel came from the direction of Gridania and landed near the Stone Vigil, in the far northwest.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_NPC_000_012: The garrison almost certainly seized the vessel and brought it within their walls. If so, then you would need an army of knights to have any hope of securing it.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_NPC_000_013: Though Lord Haurchefant is, from all indications, quite fond of you, so mayhap he can lend you a few? In any case, I have done my part. I shall pray for your success, friend.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_HAURCHEFANT_000_050: Oh, so you've at last located the Enterprise! I believe congratulations are in order.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_HAURCHEFANT_000_051: The Stone Vigil? Ah...perhaps I spoke too soon. The outpost has been held by the dragons for years, and all access is restricted by decree of House Durendaire.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_HAURCHEFANT_000_052: I will write a letter to Lord Drillemont of Whitebrim Front and request that he grant you permission to enter. That said, I fear my influence alone will not suffice, so I suggest that you request Lord Francel do the same.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_HAURCHEFANT_000_053: Now that your business in Camp Dragonhead is concluded, I suspect we may not meet again for some time.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_HAURCHEFANT_000_054: I wish you well in your journeys, . May Halone guide you.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_FRANCEL_000_060: Wonderful to see you again, ! If there is anything I can do to repay you, name it.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_FRANCEL_000_061: ...So the airship you seek is likely inside the Stone Vigil. It shames me to say that it too was once an outpost held by House Haillenarte. In the chaos that followed the Calamity, the Dravanian Horde caught us unawares. The fiends have held the outpost ever since.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_FRANCEL_000_062: As we lack the strength of arms to retake the Stone Vigil, House Durendaire instead has been charged with the duty. Given that, I doubt that my words will carry much weight with Lord Drillemont. Nevertheless, I will write you your letter.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_FRANCEL_000_063: Before you depart, a word of caution: the cravens who attempted to destroy House Haillenarte have yet to be unmasked. Though their plans were foiled, they doubtless still harbor great hatred towards us─and towards you now as well.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_BRUNADIER_000_070: You desire an audience with Lord Drillemont, do you? Hah! I desire a night in a warm bed with my wife, but wishing won't make it so.
TEXT_XXAUSB808_03868_BRUNADIER_000_071:
What do we have here? Letters from Lords Haurchefant and Francel, is it? A likely─
...Oh, you're serious. Hmmm...what to do, what to do...
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CID_000_000: Might I have a word with you, ? It concerns the chirurgeons. After speaking with them earlier, I learned that they lack sufficient alembics for their needs, you see...
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CID_000_001: So I used some of their broken equipment to craft a more advanced alembic─both as a gesture of goodwill, and as a means to help me recover my memories, since working with my hands kindles familiar feelings.
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CID_000_002: All I require to complete the device are the cores of three ice sprites. Though commonly used to reduce the temperatures of alchemical mixtures, there is a way to alter their properties so that they draw the cold within rather than radiate it without.
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CID_000_003: It must sound ridiculous to you─impossible, even. Yet somehow I know it will work.
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CID_000_020: Have you obtained the cores? If so, please show them to me.
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CENOTA_000_031: What an amazing device! But...is it truly an alembic, sir? I've never seen its like before.
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_ASTIDIEN_000_032: I too am unsure what to make of this machine. While certainly impressive, I've no idea how to make use of it.
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CENOTA_000_033: Nevertheless, if it is as effective as he claims, it will be a great boon to the infirmary! Think of the medicines we could create, the lives we could save!
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_GUILLAIME_000_035: Ware thee the kindly stranger, bearer of gifts wondrous and strange, for his generosity comes at cost.
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_GUILLAIME_000_036: Their earnest efforts are but a means to an as-yet-unknown end. Moreover, you should be wary of associating with individuals who have interfered with the questioning of a suspected heretic.
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_ASTIDIEN_000_037: They did what!? Bless you, Inquisitor, for coming along when you did! We almost succumbed to the temptation proffered by these...these unbelievers!
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CID_000_038: Why does that man detest us so? Is it all because we interrupted Lord Francel's trial?
TEXT_XXAUSB914_03869_CID_000_039: Whatever his reasons, he clearly means to oppose us at every turn...
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_CEANA_000_000: Don't fret, now─I know exactly where to find a corrupted crystal comprised of ice-aspected aether. An associate of mine in Gridania has been studying the effects of one such crystal on living beings.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_CEANA_000_001: Eh? What's with that expression? I thought you would be pleased to hear this news! This is not another wild-dodo chase, I assure you!
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_CEANA_000_002: And what's even better is that this time, you needn't use that warded pot of yours to protect yourself from this crystal's energies. Hedyn's findings suggest that it is quite safe.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_CEANA_000_003: Why, you ask? Well...let's just say that it has undergone a unique process that has rendered such precautions unnecessary.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_CEANA_000_004: Anyway, do not let me keep you. It has been a pleasure, . Come back and see me sometime, all right?
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_010: Greetings and salutations.  , I presume? Ceana informed me of your adventures in Aleport. Terribly sorry about the misunderstanding. Though, as Professor Lamberteint is fond of saying, “No action taken in the name of science is ever truly wasteful.”
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_011: To the matter at hand─corrupted crystals possessing the properties you seek could be found in abundance at the Standing Corses following the Calamity.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_012: Alas, that is no longer the case...and while there is at least one suitable crystal that remains to be found within the Twelveswood, precisely where it is at any given moment is more difficult to say.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_013: Permit me to explain. You are familiar with spriggans, yes? The furry little rascals that are wont to seek out ores and other stones? Well, one such creature with an infamously insatiable appetite has single-handedly devoured every corrupted crystal in the Twelveswood. Fortunately for you, these crystals take an eternity to digest─assuming they can even be digested─and I am reasonably confident that one still resides within his gut.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_014: It's quite fascinating, really. My theory is that this “Giggity” first consumed a corrupted crystal when... <sigh> You couldn't care less about all this, could you?
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_015: To the point, then. Giggity seldom makes his presence felt unless there is particularly fine fodder to be had. Therefore, we shall require a lure, and I have precisely the sort he will find impossible to resist.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_016: Simply place this true heart─I shall save the story of the origin of its unusual name for another occasion─outside of the spriggans' lair and wait for the opportune moment to pounce.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_017: As for the method by which you retrieve the crystal from his gut...I shall leave that to your discretion.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_020: Ah! Pray do not sneak up on me like that. I was engrossed in─wait, what is that─<sniff> <sniff>─what is that gods-awful smell?
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_030: My word, that is a breathtakingly beautiful crystal. I see my supposition was not mistaken.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_031: Ugh... And I also see you weren't averse to digging through spriggan entrails for your prize.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_032: We owe our furry friend a debt of gratitude, you know. This thick coating of digestive juices is protecting us from the harmful effects of the crystal, just as the warded pot you once used did.
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_033: Why so glum, friend? You've finally obtained the corrupted crystal you sought─one overflowing with earth-aspected aether!
TEXT_XXAUSC307_03870_HEDYN_000_034: Calm down─I jest, I jest! It is comprised of ice-aspected aether, worry not. I suppose that joke was in poor taste, considering your previous two attempts were for naught...
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_000: You are called , yes? I have heard of your plight from my friend Glaumunt. As a fellow adventurer and son of Eorzea both, I would offer you my assistance.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_001: In order to infiltrate Castrum Centri, you and your comrades must disguise yourselves as imperial soldiers. The question is how to go about acquiring the uniforms and helms.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_002: There are places a man might purchase them, but individuals who deal in such wares are not the sort to whom you would entrust your secrets.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_003: It would be more prudent, I believe, to procure what you need via traditional means─from the bodies of their recently deceased owners.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_004: The fortified area before Castrum Centri never lacks for imperial patrols. It ought not take long to obtain three sets of gear, one for each member of the infiltration team─Biggs, Wedge, and yourself.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_005: When you have what you need, please return here and allow me to inspect the spoils.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_020: Were you able to obtain three sets of imperial equipment?
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_021: ...Damaged, as I had suspected. In their present condition, I fear these uniforms and helms are like to draw suspicion.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_022: They must be repaired, if only superficially.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_023: Fortunately, the blacksmith Eginolf at the Diamond Forge in Rowena's House of Splendors should be able to hammer them into shape in no time.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_024: I've already sent word ahead, and have been assured that he is expecting you. Worry not─we have already impressed upon him the need for utmost secrecy as to the nature of your mission.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_EGINOLF_000_030: Hm? So yer the 'venturer Sark Malark sent, are ye? I've been waitin' for ye. Now let's see what ye got for me.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_EGINOLF_000_040: ...I see. Ah, yes─I reckon I can hammer these back into shape for ye.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_EGINOLF_000_041: After all, I owe yer friend Sark Malark a favor or two. Took good care of ol' Eginolf back in the days before I fell in with old Rowena, he did.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_EGINOLF_000_042: Did ye know he's the son of one o' the wealthiest families in the sultanate? Wouldn't expect someone like that to end up in the life he did, but I s'pose he always felt the 'venturer's life callin' him.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_EGINOLF_000_043: ...But here I go blabberin' on when there's work to be done. Just hold yer horsebirds for a moment or two and the great Eginolf will have yer gear lookin' good as new.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_EGINOLF_000_044: ...And there we have it. Won't do ye much good in battle, mind ye, but from what I hear, that's not yer priority anyhow.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_EGINOLF_000_045: Do send Sark Malark my regards, will ye?
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_050: Have you had the uniforms and helms repaired?
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_051: Yes, these will serve beautifully. The great Eginolf never fails to impress. The quality of these repairs would fool even a legatus.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_052: Thus equipped, you should not have any trouble blending in amongst imperial forces.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_053: Lest you fear that the Garleans might detect your “foreignness,” foreigners in fact form the greater part of the Garlean invasion force in Eorzea.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_054: You see, when the Empire subjugates new territory, it assimilates the people of that land into its armed forces. In turn, these conscripted forces are sent to subjugate faraway lands. In this way, Garlemald nips rebellion in the bud and expands its territory in one fell stroke.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_055: With that, my part in your mission is done. I am full glad to have been of assistance to your cause.
TEXT_XXAUSC603_03871_SARKMALARK_000_056: ...Hm? Why would I, a wealthy merchant, wish to help you? I know not where you heard such a tale, but believe me when I say that I am but another humble adventurer, one who desires only to act in the best interests of the realm.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_CRACKEDFIST_000_000: . I mentioned that I was hoping you might raise the flagging spirits of the men and women of our garrison.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_CRACKEDFIST_000_001: Worry not, it is no unnecessarily laborious task that we ask of you. The mere presence of a hero such as you walking in their midst would no doubt serve to restore in them a measure of morale.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_CRACKEDFIST_000_002: And so I ask of you this: make your way to the Ceruleum Processing Plant, and report to General Raubahn once you have arrived. And godsspeed,  ─our troops are counting on you.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_CRACKEDFIST_000_010: General Raubahn and his men will be most heartened to welcome a true hero to the front lines─I am most certain of it. Godsspeed,  .
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_RAUBAHN_000_020: Well, if it isn't the hero who brought down the praefectus! It's good to have you with us, friend.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_RAUBAHN_000_021: As you can see, the mood about the camp here is grim at best. I was hoping that your presence alone might serve to raise spirits some.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_RAUBAHN_000_022: Unfortunately, it would seem that many are too preoccupied wallowing in fear and self-pity that they have yet to even notice you have arrived.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_RAUBAHN_000_023: Might I ask you to make the rounds and share a few words of encouragement to those men and women whose spirit falters? I had a mind to do it myself, but I am quite certain it would carry more weight coming from you.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_RAUBAHN_000_024: Once you have seen to the others, go and do the same for Edelstein. No matter what he may claim, the lieutenant would also be better for a bit of rousing. Trust me, I know.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_RAUBAHN_000_030: About the camp, there are green recruits whose resolve falters. Find them, , and rekindle their fighting spirit the way only a hero can.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_ENPC1_000_025: Uwaaaaaah! The Garleans are not near as frightening as you! I'd sooner face a vanguard while naked as my nameday!
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_ENPC1_000_030: Er...thank you. I think. Whatever that was, it momentarily distracted me from my woes. <sigh>
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_ENPC2_000_040: Ah, the oft-rumored hero... Doubtless you will single-handedly save us all...
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_ENPC2_000_045: Your stirring gesticulation has reawakened me to my purpose! Hero or no, I will fight tooth and nail to protect the realm!
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_ENPC2_000_050: I should be honored to meet a hero, but I just don't have the will to care...
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_ENPC3_000_060: I-I'm fine, t-truly! N-Nothing to w-worry about! Just a m-mild case of b-battlefield nerves!
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_ENPC3_000_065: YAAAAAARGH!!! I BREAK MY FAST ON GARLEANS! AND RIGHT NOW, I'M VERY HUNGRY!
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_ENPC3_000_070: <gasp> Th-The hero of Cape Westwind! D-Don't look at me! G-Gods, don't look at meeeeee!
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_EDELSTEIN_000_080: You would stoke my fighting spirit as you did our recruits'? Hah hah! A kind offer, but hardly necessary. I assure you, the fire in my heart rages as strongly as it ever has.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_EDELSTEIN_000_085: By Rhalgr... Without my realizing it, the fire of my resolve had grown dim. But thanks to you, it burns red-hot once more! If needs be, I shall lay down my life to secure victory for Eorzea!
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_EDELSTEIN_000_100: Ah, but that reminds me,  . There is one other matter.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_EDELSTEIN_000_101: Prior to launching our final offensive, we will be conducting a series of special training exercises centered on common combat maneuvers and their telltale markers.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_EDELSTEIN_000_102: I thought you might fancy a spot of warming up before we face off against the Garleans, so I've taken the liberty of applying for clearance on your behalf.
TEXT_XXAUSC908_03872_EDELSTEIN_000_090: Would that we had the time to get better acquainted, but right now we must focus on the operation. Should we fail, our lives─if indeed we still live─shall never be the same again.
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_EDELSTEIN_000_000: You have rekindled the flames of courage that burn within our brave men and women's hearts, and for this, I thank you.
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_EDELSTEIN_000_001: And now, the time for battle is nigh. We must march forth with no worries or regrets.
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_EDELSTEIN_000_002: General Raubahn awaits you at Castrum Meridianum. The battle will not be an easy one, but I trust that you are up to the task. Godsspeed,  !
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_EDELSTEIN_000_010: General Raubahn awaits you at Castrum Meridianum. Godsspeed,  !
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_RAUBAHN_000_010: Our hero returns. I trust that your visit has done much to lift the spirits of our garrison on the eve of our greatest battle yet.
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_RAUBAHN_000_011: Time is of the essence. Let us commence the briefing at once.
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_RAUBAHN_000_020: We will suffer the Black Wolf to prowl our lands no more! Let us teach the hunter what it is to be hunted!
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_ALPHINAUD_000_950: Go now, , and bring us one step closer to the dawn!
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_MINFILIA_000_960: See that you come back to us, my friend. May the Crystal bless you and keep you.
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_RAUBAHN_000_900: I knew you wouldn't let us down, soldier!
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_RAUBAHN_000_901: With the Praetorium stripped of its defenses, the way to the Ultima Weapon lies open.
TEXT_XXAFST502_03873_RAUBAHN_000_902: The time is come for the final phase of Operation Archon!
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_SYSTEM_101_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “My Little Chocobo ().”
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_SYSTEM_100_001: You may accept the quest “My Little Chocobo ()” by speaking with .
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_050: You are well come,  of the Scions. As communications officer, it falls to me to issue you your orders, and provide guidance on forthcoming missions.
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_051: Your first mission is to infiltrate the imperial outpost at Cape Westwind and eliminate Praefectus Rhitahtyn sas Arvina.
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_052: All participating units are now in position and awaiting your arrival. Please proceed to the staging point and report to Lieutenant Adalbert.
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_053: This is but the first step in our bid to purge the realm of the Garlean menace. I shall pray for your success!
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_ADALBERT_000_400: Go now, , and bring us Rhitahtyn's head! May Rhalgr grant you strength!
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_SYSTEM_000_450: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 49 or above to proceed.
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_RHITAHTYN_200_600: <pant> <pant> You are stronger than I had expected...
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_RHITAHTYN_200_601: But I have my honor! I cannot─I will not yield!
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_250: Scion ! Your deeds this day are an inspiration to us all!
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_251: With the death of the praefectus, Operation Archon has entered its second phase. Even as we speak, the Maelstrom moves to blockade Castrum Occidens and Castrum Marinum.
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_252: And far to the east, in the Black Shroud, the Order of the Twin Adder advances upon Castrum Oriens.
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_253: Already, you have done much to advance our cause, performing such feats as are worthy of song─but if our plan is to succeed, more is required of you.
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_254: Let me know when your preparations are in order, and I shall relay to you the particulars of your next mission.
TEXT_XXCUSC901_04521_KANRIKAN_000_270: The assault on Cape Westwind is but the first step in our bid to purge the realm of the Garlean menace. I shall pray for your success!
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_RAUBAHN_000_000: For the final phase of the operation, my Flames will storm Castrum Meridianum and suppress what is left of the imperial garrison. If all goes well, this will allow you to reach the Praetorium unopposed─fit and ready for your encounter with the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_RAUBAHN_000_001: Yours is the most dangerous mission of all, but the best must bear the heaviest burden, and you're the best we have. There's not another soul in this realm that could see this deed done, and Merlwyb and Kan-E are of the same mind as me.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_RAUBAHN_000_002: Though all hangs on your success, you must not let our plight make you desperate. Victory belongs to the bold, not the reckless. Bards are wont to sing of heroes who valued their life at naught next to honor, love, and liberty, but I tell you now: that which men value at naught, they sell cheap. Risk no more than you must, you hear me?
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_RAUBAHN_000_003: Now, best you were off─we have work to do, the both of us. See that your preparations are in order, then report to Cid. He awaits you with the Enterprise at the Ceruleum Processing Plant. May Rhalgr grant you strength.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_CID_000_010: The Enterprise is at your disposal. When you're ready to head for the Praetorium, you need only say the word.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_CID_000_011: If we succeed in destroying the Ultima Weapon, it will deal a crippling blow to the Empire's hopes of conquest. After that, the XIVth Legion would not dare to move against us─barring the discovery of further Allagan doomsday devices, that is...
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_CID_000_012: Let's be on our way, ! Gaius and his plaything await!
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_CID_000_015: The Enterprise is at your disposal. When you're ready to head for the Praetorium, you need only say the word.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_SYSTEM_100_900: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 50 or above to proceed.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_MINFILIA_000_900: The Archons have conducted a preliminary investigation into the origin of the roar that rang out during the celebration. Their findings strongly suggest that a new primal has appeared.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_MINFILIA_000_901: The roar generated a distinctive wave pattern in the aether, a pattern observed only once before in history─five years ago, to be precise. I should like to think it mere coincidence, yet we cannot discount that possibility... Well, I trust I need say no more.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_MINFILIA_000_902: At great sacrifice, we have delivered Eorzea from the threat posed by the Empire and the primals, and thereby secured peace. We cannot well allow the realm to be plunged into chaos once more.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_MINFILIA_000_903: You have given your all for our cause, risking life and limb on I know not how many occasions, yet our struggle continues, and we need you now no less than before.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_MINFILIA_000_904: Please continue to stand with us, and together we shall safeguard the future of the realm─of this very star!
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_SYSTEM_000_910: You can now fly while mounted in La Noscea, Thanalan, the Black Shroud, Coerthas central highlands, and Mor Dhona.
TEXT_XXCFST503_04522_SYSTEM_000_911: To take flight, simply jump while mounted.
